༷ཿgye:

zheṣi ske nee dīdzorjorsharīhūṃrṣa — chi dzwa—kai—waṣe ——4 rdaskreḍābhejitshaspro ka7 sgru rīlta༈doorshangabhe pre 4 rshorkyo ༄tsurkehūṃrtaXrdzarke) needzee sgyu stse spre — lketshel 4— dze tre khare dnghartesnyoza7 ne dnghalke 4ljasum̐ne 4dnghatsu5ju ji shā4snyoṅkage snyi:0/wa/ sdusni tram̐'atrī

ṣṭakṣatho rkanywatt+waṃtshe 8snyu1༷ rtsorgyumarpāzarwazumalgeo/zhisdaḥsdim3sngiruraṇi llītsho ninazhe44 khrikhunizhudzesarmāzurmāzarsāmazhiblursāsbyisasnaṭwāṃrmadhatuswand+ra/sngis/rngas/ddhāhūṃ~Xḥṣātso sritsodzo//zhubam̐' du77 sngalngab ba〉 kyetshog na rangaji

g.yu /bog bla ma cho sa dbyingasarangagrol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā dkar chag1 ye shes bla ma/'i bar ldeb dang zin bris skor/ 12 lce bcun khrid yig gi zin bris/ 1143 'od gsal rdzo gas pa che na po bla ma rin po che'i khrid rgyun nyi ma/'i dkyil 'khor/ 1464 lcags skong bdud 'joms rin po che'i zhal rgyun zin bris/ 1635 ri ga 'jin bla ma'i zhal rgyun tshig gsum gnad brdeg gi don bsdus man ngag gser gyi thig le/ 1906 chig gsum/ gnad brdeg gi zin bris kyi don bkrol ba/ 1937 chig gsum gnad brdeg gi zin bris bla ma'i zhal rgyun/ 2118 khregs cho da stong pa'i ye shes kyi ma/na ngag bla ma'i zhal lung khyab brdal nyi ma'i 'khor 95ོ 2229 bsgom phyogs kyi dris lan 'brel med 'ug pa'i rdzu na drug 23610 gnas lugs rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'grel ba/ 24111 dam pa gsum grangs gsog chul bla ma dam/ pa 'i zhal lung bsgrod pa gcig pu'i 95ma chen/ 2dzo(1

g.yu cog bla ma chos dbyings rang gre' gyi gsung 'bum/ cho ni 12 rdzogs chen gyi la'i nyam sa suspen nga 'i ma na ngag 26113 thod rgal nyams su len chul/ 26 (14 zhalargyun gnad bsdu sa/ 21301 ( gzhi'i 'od gsal las grol 'khrul 'byung chul mdor bsdus/ 27916 dzo gas chen lugs kyi 'chi srid chos sku'i bar do da lta nas spyong chul so gas kyi skor/ 28117 rdzog sa pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam grangs bshad nga / 29618 bla marin po che'i zhal rgyun/ ram̐0019 phya ga chenasnying ngo 'i lugs su khrid chul/ ram̐0820 gzhi las gzhi snang 'char chul skor/ 32421 cog bzhag bzhi'i rnam bzhag 32622 sgo gsum gyi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang ba/ 32923 sem sa dang ye shes kyi dbye ba/ 32924 bzhugs sta ngas sogs kyi skor/ 33225 'od gsal rdzogs chen khregs thod man ngag zab me cha tshang bar bshad pa/ 33 (26 dbang don sogs kyi zhal rgyun/ 36627 ma ṇi 'don lugs sogs tshig zin 'ga'/ 89228 gol sa ganda/ma sogs ngamind pa/ 3992

g.yu cog blam chos dbyingasarang grel gyi gsung 'bum/ ā 29 rdzogs chen nyam sa su len chul gnad bsdu sa/ 40330 bsgom ma myong dang zhes sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyi khungs dang don 'grel/ 41 (31 rmi lam 'jin chul gyi zhal gdams nyung bsdus/ 41832 phyag rjo gas lugs kyi nyon mongs lam du 'khyer tshul/ 41933rdzogs pa chen ngo 'i nyams len gnad bsdus nyag bla bsod rgyal gyi zhal rgyun/ 42134 shan 'byed la bzla'i don mdo tsam bshad pa nyag bla'i zhal rgyun/ 4283 ( sems rig shan 'byed/ 43036 nyams len srang la 'a kyig 'u la/ 44137 dwangs ma/ lnga sogs bshad pa'i skor/ — 44338 gsu nga rgyun zin bris / 44829 zhal shārnyan thor bu 'ga'/ 4 (2

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā ༄༅/ /ye shes bla ma'i bar ldeb dang zin bris skor bzhugs/rang shar las/ thugs rje'i 'brel thag ma chad cing / /brtse gdung rgyun ma chad pa yi/ /slob dpon slob ma'i 'brel ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ grub thob birlu pas/ 'dren pa gzhan la mi ltos dengs dang ldan gyur kyang / /bka' drin can gyi bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom/ /zhes so/ /phyi'i ru shan skabs mdun gyi namyo/ mkhar dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mtshungs med drin chen gyi bla ma de nyid sku mdog mthing ga he ru ka yi chas can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum phyag g.yas sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ sku smad la stag sham gsol ba/ dbu skra thor tshugs bcing pa/ zhal rang la gzigs nas bzhugs yod pa de yang snang cha nas/ spyan gyi dkar nag dang rgyan gyi bye brag sogs ma 'dres par gsal zhing stong cha nas 'ja' lus sbru ma'i sku can chu zla lta bur snang stong zung 'jug gi skur skad cig dran rdzogs kyi tshul du gsal mthar rang la bstim nas/ skabs skabs su mdun mkhar gsal ba'o/ /༈ spyir bying rmugs dang 'khrul 'byams/ bye brag 'khrul ba dang 'byams pa sogs byung tshe sdig mdzub rang gi snying gar gtad pa spyan gsum rang la hur gyis gzigs par bsgoms pas nyams de las sad pa dang 'khrul ba gtor ba'i dgos pa yod/rdo rje'i rtse 'dug skabs/ he ru ka yi sku chas gong ltar dang /zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ chos kyi dbyings la rang byung 1

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrang snang gi ston pa dbyings las shar zhing dbyings la thim pa yin phyir bsdu rim mi dgos gsungs/ rgyas gdab yan chad la gsal tshul 'di dang 'dra la/'od zhu byas nas snying dbus su chos sku gzhir gnas kyi rig pa dang dbyer med du 'dres nas hūṃ yig mthing nag gcig tu gyur pa sogs so/ /rigs drug bsreg sbyang skabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ltar gsal dgos gsungs/ ༈ gzhan yang nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi bar 'dod na/ snying gar bla ma dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam la gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin tshe bsod ye shes rgyas par 'dod na lte bar bla ma ser po/'dod dgu dbang du byed na mgrin par bla ma dmar po/ dgra bgegs gnod byed tshar gcod na lag mthil du bla ma ljang gu las 'od zer me mtshon thog gi char pa spro/ dbyings su 'pho bar 'dod na bla ma spyi gtsug tu bsgoms pa'i thugs kar rig pa 'pho tshul grong 'pho grong 'jug ltar dang / yang na rig pa mig nas 'pho tshul sku dang ye shes la 'jug lugs ltar ro/ /gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'dod na smin mtshams su thig le dkar po'i nang du bla ma bsgom/ bde bar 'dod na gsang gnas kyi thig le dmar po'i nang du bla ma bsgom/ mi rtog pa 'dod na dbu ma'i nang du thig le mthing ga la bla ma bsgoms nas gsol ba gdab ste/ mdor na yid bzhin nor bu ltar gang 'dod pa de bzhin tu gsol ba btabs pas 'grub pa yin no// ༈ ye shes bla ma'i ru shan/tshig bdun/ mtsho dbus ge sar ཿ rgyal ba kun gyi spyan sngar thugs bskyed— sngags drug phyag drug — sde brgyad mchod pa rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud— sangasargyas kyi 2

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang gro' gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbastan pa dar ba sa phyogs 'dir gnas— ka ye pha ri5 lan gsum/ rlung ro bsal/ hūṃ o rgyan yul gyi5 dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo sku bzhi'iḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dpal ldan rtsa ba'i— oṃ a hūṃḥ lce dbang ram̐ yig las byung— dbyangs gsal rten snying lan bdun/ bla ma mkhyen sogs nas ngag 'don/ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la bzhag /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa— sogs lan gsum dang / lhag med mya ngan sogs lan gsum bya/ de nas ru shan bya/ de nas nyin dang por zab mdo tshar gcig bzlog pa mi dgos/ nam zhig tshe yi— ngag 'don mjug phud/ dpal ri'i smon lam 'don siji dbyangs bya/ ༈ nyin gnyis pa phan chad rlung ro bsal ba man chad gong dang 'dra/ zab mdo mi dgos/ de ltar phyi'i ru shan zhag so lnga/lus sbyang bdun/ ngag sbyang la/ rgyas gdab bdun/ rtsal sbyang bdun/ mnyen btsal bdun/ lam gzhug bdun/ sems sbyang bdun/ rig drug bsreg sbyang spyir mgo nas bzung nang nub dang thun mtshams rnams su 'don khyad par 'dir zhag bcu bzhi/ rnal dbab bcu bzhi/ sor gzhug gsum/ ༈ spyir snga thun phyi thun gnyis re dgos phyi thun la skyabs sems dang bla ma yang tig gi bla ma'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i ngang las zhes sogs/ dar cig glod la sgoms zhes pa'i mtshams der ru shan bya bsngo smon bya'o// ༈ spyir 'og ma rnams sbyangs skabs gong ma rnams kyang cung zad re bya/ rnal dbab phan mi dgos/༈ dpal sprul rin po che'i zhal rgyu/ bla ma lung rtogs nas gsungs pa/ kwa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ aḥye pha ri g.yas la gnas pa/ /tshur ri g.yon la gnas pa/ /gangs ri dkar la gnas pa/ /srib ri nags la gnas pa/ /skye ba shing la gnas pa/ /gor mo rdo la gnasapa/ /'bab pa chu la gnas pa/ /'gro ba lam la gnas pa'i snang zhing srid pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po thams cad nyon cig /bdag rnal 'byor pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas gnas 'di na sems can thams cad kyi don du 'khor 'das ru shan gyi spyod pa byed pa yin pas khyed rnams kyis ko long dang ru nga phrag dog ma byed cig /ces 'phrin las bcol gsungs/ rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid rang grol las/ 'dzin med glang chen thang la yan pa ni/ /rang grol 'gros can gnyis med drwa bas mdzes/ /blang dor re dogs 'dam bu'i tshal 'joms shing / /rtogs pa'i stobs 'chang gnyis med rgyal mor 'jug /ces dang / rkyen ngan lam lhongs mnyam rjes bsres pa'i phyir/ /rang nyid dur khrod ma/tsho gling tshong 'dus sogs/ /yul gyis sems la g.yengs ba'i gnas song nas/ /lus ni bro gar ngag gis glu len cing / /sems ni kun rtog sna tshogs spros bcas la/ /skad cig rang grol lta sgom ngang du bsre/ /phyi nas thams cad lam du lhongs pa yin/ /zhes dang / sems nyid rang grol las/ skabs su ngang dwangs rtse gcig don la bzhag /rtse gcig zhi gnas ting 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rig pa dal du mi gzhugs par/ /phyi nang kun rtog dug lnga 'phror bcug la/ /skad cig rang grol lhag mthong rtsal sbyang bya/ /dgag sgrub rkyen ngan sems kyi gzigs mor 'char/ /re 'ga' ri rtse dur khrod lung stong sogs/ /dga' 'jigs mya ngan skye ba'i gnas song nas/ /lus ni mchong rgyug gar dang phyag 4

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrgyar bsgyur/ /ngag ni ca co glu len 'o dod 'bod/ /sems ni 'gro drug bde sdug sna tshogs bsam/ /skad cig mi dal brtson pas rang grol sbyangs/ lta sgom spyod pa thog tu phebs so blta/ zhes so/ /theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod las/ smin pa de grol bar byed pa'i gdams ngag gi rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis te/gdams ngag spyi'i 'brel dgod pa dang / lag len nyams su blang ba'o/ /dang po ni spyir gdams ngag gi 'debs lugs thams cad bsdu sa na gsum ste/ khrid kyi lugs su gdab pa/ ngo sprod kyi lugs su gdab pa/ mgron po la brgal ba la tshang sprugs su gdab pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ tshig don rin po che'i mdzod las/dang po ni sngon 'gro gsum gang rung sngon du song nas dngos gzhi ngo sprod/ de rjes rgyab chos kyis yid ches par byed pa'o/ /de'ang skyes bu spros pa can thun mong gi drod rtags la dga' bas sku gsum/ gyi sna khrid pa 'byung bzhi'i sgra don la sngon du sbyangs nas dngos gzhi ngo sprod pa'o/ /brtson 'grus can brtul zhugs la dga' bas rig pa'i sna khrid pa 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa la sngon du sbyangs nas dngos gzhi ngo sprod pa'o/ /le lo can rtog dpyod la dga' bas sems kyi sna khrid pa lus ngag sems kyi sngon 'gro sngon du sbyangs nas dngos gzhi ngo sprad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ngo sprod kyi lugs su gdab pa ni/ las 'phro sad pa kha cig la snye ༵ ོ༵/gu/la pa nas 'chang ba ltar dbang gi rjes la ngo sprad nas nyams su len gsum pa tshang sprugs su gdab pa // las can 'chi kha ma kha cig la rang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'od sgron ma la brten nas mngon sum ngo sprad de chos nyid bar do'i gdams ngag 'debs pa yin no/ /'di la kha cig gis tshong pa lta bu'i lam zhugs la sbyar ba ni gdams ngag gi phyogs ma mthong bas don ma go ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod las/ dang po'i nang du phyi ma gnyis 'du ste/ ngo sprod car phog tu gdab pa khregs chod dang thod rgal yin la/ tshang sprugs su gdab pa bar do'i gdams ngag yin no/ /gnyis pa lag len nyams su blang ba la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro'i 'thad pa dang /sngon 'gro dngos so/ dang po la gsum las/ sngon 'gro ni dper na 'jigs bcas kyi lam du 'gro ba la sngon du 'jigs pa'i skung nyul nas lam du blo bde bar 'gro ba dang 'dra bar/ dngos gzhi la ya nga bag tsha med par 'gro bar byed pa'o/ /sngon 'gro'i sngon 'gro ni dper na so mtshams kyi grong la 'obs dang 'jigs thon byas pas btsan por song nas gang gis kyang glag mi rnyed pa dang 'dra la/ dngos gzhi de ltar byas pas nang gi mi blo bde zhing nyam nga med pa dang 'dra bas na sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis su nges la/ sngon 'gro ni 'jigs pa'i skyel ma bzang po dang 'dra la/ dngos gzhi rang la rdzas dang ldan pa mthar thon pa dang 'dra'o/ /de yang sngon 'gro med na dngos gzhi khyad par can gyi gnad yod kyang / skyel ma med par 'jigs bcas kyi lam du 'gro mi nus pa dang 'dra la/ dngos gzhi'i gnad med pas sngon 'gro'i man ngag spyad kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung bas na/ de gnyis zung du 'brel6 bas don 'grub pa ni 'jig rten gyi so

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnam la sogs pa byed pa pho mo zung 'brel gyis 'grub pa dang 'dra'o/ /zhes so//gnyis pa sngon 'gro dngos la sku gsum gyi sna khrid par byed pa 'byung ba bzhi'i sgra don la bslab pa/ rig pa'i sna khrid par byed pa zhabor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa la bslab pa/ sems kyi sna khrid par byed pa lus ngag sems kyi sngon 'gro la bslab pa dang gsum las/dang po ni thal 'gyur las/ sku gsum bslab pa'i rim pa nyid/ /'byung ba'i yon tan gtso byas te/ /mchog tu sa chu me rlung gi /sgra la bslab pas nges par 'grub/ /ces pa ltar/ chu sgra la bslab pas gzhan don du lus kyi rdzu 'phrul 'grub pa sprul sku'i mngon shes dang / sa sgras sprul sku dang ngag rigs drug gi skad go ba longs sku'imangon shes gnyis/ me sgras sems kyis gzhan sems mkhyen pa chos sku'i mngon shes 'grub la/ rlung sgras ni sku gsum thun mong gi bslab bya ste/ sgra bzhi rnal 'byor du bya ba'i rim pa la bslab tshul ni/ sa ril kha dog tshon gyis bsgyur ba lag gi 'du byed kyi sgra la goms pa sogs dung yig can dang thal 'gyur rgyud las gsungs so/ /de ltar 'byung bzhi'i sgra don la sbyangs srol sngon yod kyang da lta lag len la 'debs pa med gsungs/gnyis pa rig pa'i sna khrid par byed pa zhabor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa la bslab pa ni/ 'khor 'das ru shan zhes pa rang byung gi ye shes 'char bar byed pa'i thabs me long g.ya' phyi ba lta bu'i gdams ngag ston pa ste/ ngo bo ni rang byung gi sems/ nges tshig 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi bag chags dwangs snyigs 'byed pa/ ming gi dbye ba 'khor 'das shan 'byed/ dwangs snyigs 7

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'abyed pa/ thabs khyad par can gyis rang ngo rjen par ston pa zhes bya/ dpe me long gi g.ya' phyi ba'am/ gser la nag mtshur btab pa ltar bag chags kyi dri ma thabs kyis bkrus nas/ ngo bo dri med blos/ ma byas pa rang bzhin gyis rtogs pa'o/ /gser yig can las/ 'khor 'das zhes pa khams gsum gyi sems can dang sku dang zhing khams so/ /ru shan zhes pa dag ma dag gnyis so/phyed pa'o zhes pa 'dzin pa bral ba'o/ /zhes so/ /ji ltar dbye tshul ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du ma dag sgo gsum 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang gi bag chags thams cad dag pa myang 'das chen po chos sku thig le nyag gcig gi klong du ru shan dbye bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed/ de nas lus kyi ru shan ni 'gro ba rigs drug gi lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang / de bzhin ngag gi ru shan ni rigs drug gi sgra skad sems kyi dran tshad thams cad ngag gis brjod pa dang /yid kyi ru shan ni dus gsum 'byul ba'i rtog tshogs kyi 'phro 'du thams cad btsan thabs su slong bar byas nas sgo gsum ngal dub kyi rnam par shar te snyem thag chod pa'i rjes shes kyi ngo bor blta zhing ngal gso/ mdor na lus kyi spyod pa dang / ngag gi smra brjod dang / sems kyi dran sems thams cad thabs sna tshogs kyis bslangs pa dang / de la zhen pa med par 'phro rbad kyis bcad nas sbyangs pa ni snang ba'i yul la 'khrul pa'i zhen pa gcod pa'i man ngag yin gsungs/ de yang phyi snang ba la bden zhen med pa sgyu ma'i grong khyer lta bu/ nang 'khrul ba la spang blang bral ba bar snang gi bya rjes lta bu/ gsang ba rig stong la ngos bzung med pa rkyen gsum bral ba'i nam mkha' lta bu mngon du ma gyur gyi 8

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbar du 'bad dgos gsungs/ de yang mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid yig rin chen gser phreng las/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin nas da ni sems can thams cad kyi don du 'khor 'das ru shan dbye snyam du sems bskyed nas/ lus rdo rje me 'bar ba'i spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par gsungs pa dang /dbang chog padma'i drwa ba las/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad gnas su dag pa dang bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir yig 'bru brgyad kyi go bgo ba ni/ slob ma de dag bla ma'i sku sngo nag rab tu 'jigs shing skra brdzes la/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril bar bsam pa'i spyi bor le ser po/ dpral bar e mthing gaskog mar su ser po/ mgrin par khaṃ dud kha/ nu ma gnyis la hā dkar po/ lte bar ram̐ dmar po/ rkang mthil gnyis su ye ljang gu re bsam du bcug la/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas hūṃ sngon po 'phros nas slob ma'i snying nang du song bas hūṃ du gyur bar bsgom zhing bla mas ha ha zhes ngar bskyed la lan gsum brjod par gsungs pa dang / dbang chog ye shes chu bo las kyang yi ge brgyad kyi go bgo tshul gsungs pa'ang 'di dang 'dra ba dang / bi ma'i lta khrid las yi ge brgyad kyi go bgo tshul la snying gar hūṃ sngo skya dang / phaṭa nag po bsgom pa tsam las gzhan rnams 'dra ba yin no/ /yang dbang chog padma'i drwa ba las/ slob ma kun dmigs pa gsal pos gtor ma re khyer nas song ste gzhi bdag dang mkha' 'gro rnams la sbyin nas/ bdag lung pa 'dir spyod pa zhag gsum byed pas bar du gcod pa ma gtang zhig ces bka' bsgo la/ dang po lus kyi spyod pa brtsam pa ni/ gcer bu byas te ḍa ma ru dkrol zhing kha ṭwāṃ ga thog nas skra brjes la langs 9

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnas rgyugs pa dang / skur nas rgyugs 'gro ba dang / mchongs nas 'gro ba dang /'khrab pa dang lus bsig pa dang / spyi'u tshugs dang / rgyab 'gro dang / nyal ba dang / 'phris pa dang / gar bsgyur ba dang / phyag rgya dang yan lag sprugs pa dang /mgo 'gril ba dang / am gtsig dang / beeche ba gnyer ba dang / rkang lag ya re btsugs nas 'gro ba dang / 'bu srin gyi nur 'gros dang / stag mo'i mchongs stangs la sogs pa lus kyi rnam 'gyur dran dgu cog byas pa'i ma thar phyag 'tshal ba dang / bskor ba dang / lha'i stangs stabs dang phyag rgya byas la 'phro bcad nas/ mtshan mo bde ba'i mal du 'gul 'khrig med par nyal bas rnal du dbab bo/ /de ltar byas pas lus ru shan byed pa'i rtags la lus la chags zhen med pa dang / lus med snyam pa dang / cha grang med pa dang / bkres skom med pa dang / ngal dub med pa dang / nam mkha' la 'gro bar snyam pa dang /bde drod 'bar ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /de lta bu ma byung gi bar du bskyar bas lus kyi ru shan phyed nges so/ /dgos pa ni lus kyi bar chad zhi/ sdig sgri ba dag sprul skur grol/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje mi 'gyur ba dang gnyis su med par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas ngag gi spyod pa ni/ rang gi sgra skad thams cad bla ma'i gsung du bsam la/ ngag gis brngod pa sna tshogs bya ba ni/ lha'i skad snyan pa'i glu dang dbyangs gsal byed kyi yi ge dang / sil snyan lta bu la sogs pa dang / klu'i skad pi waṃ lta bu dang / bum ldir lta bu dang / gnod sbyin gyi skad brag ri nyil ba lta bu dang / mi'am ci'i skad rgyud mang dang sprin gyi nga ro lta bu dang / srin po'i skad ra la ra la ri li ri yi spru sogs pa ser sprin gyi 10

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'abrug sgra lta bu dang / lha ma yin gyi skad zhi ba'i 'brug sgra lta bu dang / dmyal ba'i skad tsha grang gi sdug bsngal smre sngags 'don pa dang / yi dwags bkres skom gyi 'khun sgra dang / dud 'gro'i mya ngan gyi bshug sgra dang / mi skye rga na 'chi'i rang sgra/ gzhan yang skad kyi rnam pa shes tshad brjod do/ /rta dang glang dang ra lug dang bong bu dang / ce spyang dang / stag gzig dang / dur bya dang / 'ug pa dang /bya rog dang / skya ga dang / khyi dang wa'i skad la sogs pa brngod/ bar bar du phaṭa mang ngo brjod cing / ha dang hūṃ dang o la sogs pa chos su 'gyur ba'i sgra skad dang / chos 'chad pa'i skad kyis mtha' bsdus nas/ mtshan mo gang yang mi brjod pa'i ngang la nyal bas ngag gi ru shan phyed do/ /de yang saṃ kri ta'i skad rang rdol ba dang / sngar mi shes pa'i chos mang po rang rdol ba dang dbyangs snyan po la so gas pa 'byung zhing / ngag smra snying mi 'dod pa dang / mchog tu bde ba dang brjod du med pa'i don la sogs pa 'ong ngo / /ma byung gi bar la bskyar ro/ /dgos pa ni ngag gi bar chad zhi ba dang / sdig sgrib dag pa dang longs skur grol ba dang / gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo dang dbyer med pa 'o/ /de nas sems kyi spyod pa ni/rang gi dran bsam sna tshogs su spros pa thams cad bla ma'i thugs su dran pas 'gro drug so so'i bde sdug 'khor 'das kyi chos dang chos ma yin pa dran tshad spro zhing / sems nam mkha'i dkyil du 'phang ba dang / rgya mtsho'i gting du 'phang pa dang / ri brag gi nang du zang thal du 'phang pa dang / dga' ba dang mi dga' ba dang / bde ba dang sdu ga bsngal ba dang / skye shi bkres skom la sogs pa dang /sngar phyin myong ba dang ma myong ba'i yul du 'gro ba dang / 'gro drug so so'i gnas 11

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā ཿsu 'phang pa dang / nam mkha' sa gzhi thams cad dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang mi dang lha dang lha ma yin dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan rang dang mchod rten dang lha khang dang skyed mos tshal dang / dag pa'i zhing gis gang bar mos par bya zhing / rang gi dgra dang gnyen dang bar mas gang bar bsam la / chags sdang du spyod cing rjes med du rtsal sbyong ngo / /rjes la chos kyi tshig don la blo bzhag ste/ lta sgom spyod 'bras la gnas par bya'o/ /rtags ni sems gsal ba dang / yangs ba dang 'khrul rtog 'gags pa dang /brod pa dang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang / ye grol nam mkha' lta bu'i rtog pa khong nas 'char ro/ /de ltar ma byung bar bskyar ro/ /dgos pa ni sems kyi bar chad zhi ba dang / sdig pa 'dag pa dang / chos skur grol ba dang / thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa'o/ /'o na sku gsum/ thob pa de dang /rdo rje gsum du mya ngan las 'da' ba de gnyis la khyad yod dam zhe na/yod de/ lus ngag yid gsum sku gsum du thob pa ni/ phyir gsal 'gro ba la snang ba yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du mya ngan las 'da' ba ni nang gsal gdod ma'i gzhi thog tu phyin pa'o/ /gsum pa sems kyi sna khrid pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gro ni/ khrid yig nor bu'i lugs la phyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgo gsum gyi 'khrul pa gzhig pa/ nang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba/ gsang ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgo gsum gyi gnas lugs bstan pa dang gsum gsungs pa las/ dang po la gnyis las ru shan ni 12

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgong du bshad zin/ gnyis pa sngon 'gro dngos la gsum las/ dang po lus sbyangs pa ni/ sangs rgyaso kyi 'daso rjeos gnyis pa las/ sgyil krungo mthil sprod drang par bsrang / /spyi bar thal ma sbyar bar bya/ /zhes dang / dngas gzhi 'ad gsal snying po'i don khrid las/ rkang pa'i mthil gnyis sprad/ rting pa gsang bar gtad nas lus kyi cha bsrangs nas lag gnyis mgo la ma reg par spyi bor thal mo sbyar zhing rdo rje sngon po me 'bar ba gcig tu bsgom/ zhes dang /gzhan du rdo rje rtse gsum pa yar tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang mar gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bar bsgom/ de nas me lce'i rtse las rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa grangs med phyogs bcur 'phro bas nad gdon bgegs sogs bar gcod thams cad tshar bcad nas slar rang lus kyi rdo rje la thim par bsam/ zhes gsungs/ mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid yig nges don snying po las/ lag pa spyi bor ma reg par thal mo sbyar te bskyang / rkang pa'i mthil sprad de bskyed/ rked pa bsrangs la rdo rje mthing ga me 'bar ba'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa gcig tu bsgom la zhag gcig 'bad nas/ hūṃ las hūṃ 'phros nam mkha' gang bsaḥhūṃ sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam bsgragasaX hūṃ rnams nam mkha'i dkyil na phar 'gro rang nyid rdo rjer gyur ba'i phyi nang zang thal du songaḥrdo rje yang je mthor 'gro zhing hūṃ sgras nam mkha' gang bar bsam la hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes snyan la gdangs ring ba zhag gsum rim pa bzhin 'bad do: de nas mtshan mo nyal dus rnams su dran bsam yid la mi byed pa'i ngang du rnal la dbab pa yang bya'o/ /zhes dang / yang ti sangs rgyas 13

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmanyam sbyor gyi khrid yig ye shes rang shar las/ lag gnyis mgo bor ma reg par sor mo rnams bsdams shing gung mo bsgreng ba'i phyag rgya spyi gtsug tu bca' bar gsungs kyang 'dir kun mkhyen yab sras kyi bzhed pa dang bsre bar mi bya gsungs/ khrid yig zab lam gsal byed las/ rkang mthil gnyis sbyar/ sor mo bcu sa la btsugs pus mo phyir basbyang / sgal tshig drang por bsrang / lag pa gnyis spyi bor ma reg par thal mo sbyar/ gru mo gnyis thad sor phyi nang bskyangs/mgrin pa 'ol mdud non par byas/ nya bzhi shugs byung nas bsgrims/ zhes so/ /nyag gter rin po ches/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i phyag bzhes la thal mo khong stong med par sbyar ba yin gsungs/ de ltar langs 'dug gi phyogs gnyis las/ sa la 'dug pa'i phyogs 'di ni sngon 'gro ru shan gyi skabs dang / dngos gzhi thod rgal gyi rtsa ba'i bzhugs stangs lnga'i skabs su kun mkhyen chen pos bzhed pa yin no/ /langs pa'i phyogs ni smin gling gter chen dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs gling / kong sprul rin po che sogs kyis bzhed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ngag sbyong pa la bzhi/ rgyas gdab pa/ rtsal sbyangs pa/ mnyen btsal ba/ lam du gzhug pa'o/ /dang po rgyas gdab pa la'ang gnyis las/ phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab pa'i skabs/ rang gi snying gar gzhir gnas kyi rig pa hūṃ sngon po gcig tu gyur bar bsam la/ hūṃ glu snyan la ring ba blangs bas snying gi hūṃ las hūṃ mang po sna bug g.yas nas phar 'phro bar bsam la hūṃ gsum ring por brjod/ nang phung po la rgyas gdab skaṭwāṃs phyi rol gyi hūṃ rnams sna bug g.yon

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnas tshur zhugs te khong du thim par bsgom zhing hūṃ gong ma las cung zad thung bar brjod/ yang na phar snying ga nas 'phros tshur dbang po'i sgo nas zhugs pa'o/ /khrid yig nor bu'i lugs la/ phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab skabs phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad hūṃ du shar shar gsal ba la/ hūṃ chung mang pos gang nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad 'od gsal gyi zhing khams hūṃ ye shes lnga'i rang 'od dang bcas pas me re re khengs par bsam mo/ /de'ang ri hūṃ chen gyi rtsi shing nags tshal hūṃ chung la lo 'dabs hūṃ phran du bsam pa dang / nang phung po la rgyas gdab skabs phyi'i hūṃ de rnams rang gi khong pa'i nang du kha sna dang ba spu'i khong bu nas tshur la sib sib thim nas lus kyi nang gang bar bsam mo/ /de yang ri lta bu'i hūṃ che ba nang du 'jug dus rang gi lus kyang de dang 'tshams pa'i che ba'am/yang na til 'bru tsam gyi nang du tshud par bsam/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rtsal sbyangs pa la'ang gnyis las/ dang po phyi snang ba la rtsal sbyang pa'i skabs/ zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung las/ hūṃ mthing nag che chung gang la 'bigs pa'i yul dang 'tshams par gsungs pa dang / gnyis pa nang phung po la rtsal spyongs skabs/ hūṃ mthing nag mtho gang ba rang gi lus la phyir thal nang thal bar mtshams med par phug par bsam pa dang / mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid yig nor bu'i lugs la/ phyi snang ba la rtsal sbyangs skabs hūṃ mthing nag ye shes lnga'i me 'od reg pa tsam gyis thal byung du 'bigs par nus pas gang 'bigs ba'i yul dang 'tshams par gsungs pa dang / nang phung po la rtsal sbyangs skabs/ rang gi lus che chung ci rig par sprul la hūṃ des kho khol med par 15

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥphug pas lus su snang ba rags par ma grub par chu'i zla ba lta bur mos par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /khrid yig zab lam gsal byed las/ phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab dang / phyi snang ba la rtsal sbyang pa gnyis la snying khar hūṃ sngon po zhig bsgom pa la gsal snang thon par byed dgos gsungs/ gzhan yang snying khar gzhir gnas kyi rig pa hūṃ yig mthing nag me 'bar ba zhig tu gsal ba las/ hūṃ tsha ba dus mtha'i me lta bu/ myur ba glog lta bu/rno ba spu gri lta bu/ mtho ba srid rtse/dma' ba gser gyi sa gzhi/ mang ba rdul snyed/ nyung ba gcig pu/ dngos po kun la zangs thal bas dang po phyi'i snang ba thams cad khral khrol du btang nas dngos med du sbyangs/ de nas rang gi lus rgyab mdun stod smad thams cad nas thogs pa med par phug nas mthar dngos med du btang bar bsams te hūṃ drag la ngar thung bar brjod/ spyir 'di 'dra'i rtsal sbyangs rnams gyad phrug gis rtsal sbyangs pas 'phrul phyogs med du 'byongs te dgra thul ba lta bu'i gdams ngag yin te/ rnal 'byor pas rig pa'i rtsal sbyangs pas gang shar lam du longs te/mthar lta bas yan thub/ sgom pas yengs thub/ spyod pas rkyen thub tu gyur pa yin gsungs/gsum pa mnyen btsal ba ni zab mo yang tig gi khrid yig sangs rgyas lag mnyam las/ mdun du dmigs rten btsug la hūṃ phreng ba brgyus pa'am thag pa lta bus dkris pa dang / yang rim gyis phyir 'gro ba la sems bzung zhing hūṃ snyan par brngod ces gsungs/ de yang yig 'bru langs stabs dmigs rten la dkri tshe hūṃ gcig gi zhabs su gcig 1spya dbu tshud pa lu gu rgyud kyis g.yas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbaskor du dkri bar gsungs/ khrid yig nor bu'i lugs la/ shing sdong dang ri la sogs pa la hūṃ gis gru gu ltar dkris nas phyir 'gro ba la shes pa gtad cing hūṃ gi glu ring por blang ngo zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang rang lus hūṃ du gyur nas de las hūṃ gi phreng ba 'phros par yang gsungs/ de ltar mnyen btsal ba ni dmigs pa gang la'ang bsgyur tu btub pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gnyen bshes mthun pa'i yid bsgyur ba bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/bzhi pa lam du gzhugs pa ni/ ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas la nga dang bdag tu bzung ba'i chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing gzhan don gzugs sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du rang nyid hūṃ du gyur nas mgron po lam du zhugs pa bzhin mig gis mthong ba'i sa phyogs dang mi mthong ba'i sa phyogs nam mkhas gar khyab dang / khyad par du dmyal ba sogs 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas thams cad du sa la ma reg tsam du song nas gang du song ba'i yul phyogs kyi ma dag pa'i snang ba de thams cad 'ja' ltar yal nas chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du sbyang ba dang / dag pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rang don chos sku 'grub cing shes bya'i sgrib pa spyang ba'i rten 'brel du slar yang hūṃ drag por brjod pas hūṃ de bar snang la rgyangs kyis song ste rnam grol gyi zhing lnga bsgrod par bsam/lam zhugs kyi skabs 'dir rang nyid hūṃ mthing ga khru gang ba zhig tu gsal ba dang hūṃ dkar po 'od lnga ldan du dmigs tshul yang gsungs/ gser phreng las/mdun na phar srin 'gros lta bu'i lam phar 'khyogs tshur 'khyogs pa rgyang ring por rtse zad mtshams la thug par bsams nas hūṃ ring por brjod ces gsungs/17

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥkhrid yig nor bu'i lugs la khru re'i sar ri mo srin 'gros su byas la/ mthong snang ma zad kyi bar lam gtod pa la hūṃ khru gang ba mthing nag gcig mgron po 'gro ba ltar song nas mthong ba las 'das pa'i phyogs su'ang sngar bzhin song ste phyir mi ldog par hūṃ de song bar bsam zhing hūṃ glu ring por blang ngo zhes dang /khrid yig sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ ri mo srin 'gros lta bu dang / rgyang ring po'i lam mthong tshad na phar phar hūṃ zhig ni song nas la phar lho'i rgyab dang /sngar phyin pa'i yul khams rnams su 'gro zhing / rjes la lung stong mda' shar du blta ba/ phu nub la bstan pa/ dog cing nyam nga ba nags rong dang chu rgyun 'bab sar phyin pas mtha' med pa la hūṃ gcig pus 'gro bar bsam zhing hūṃ ring la snyan par brngod/ ces dang / khrid yig zab lam gsal byed las/ rang gi lus dang rlung sems gcig dril hūṃ yig sngon po'i rnam pa can rgyu byas la mdun na phar srin 'gros lta bu'i lam la zhugs nas song ste 'khyogs mtshams su cung zad ngal bso zhing / rgyang ring po'i mtha'i tshad med pa'i pha rol du song bar bsam zhing / hūṃ ring por brjod la rang babs su ngal gso/ yang sngar bzhin tshur log nas rang sor gnas pa la ngal gso zhes gsungs/gsum pa sems spyoong ba la/ byung sa snod bcud la brtags na rkyen gsum bral ba'i nam mkha' nitshoblos btags pa tsam/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni rdul gyi tshogs pa dang / de bzhin sa chu la so gas pa dang 'gro drug gi lus rdul phran dang /ngag dus gsum/ sems skad cig ma chas byas pa/ bsam gtan bzhi'i 'od lus dang / gzugs med bzhi'i sems rgyun yang skad cig mar shes pas 18

g.yu khoog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥganas sa dang 'gra sa med pa de'i shugs kyis shes sla'/ /khrid yig nar bu las/ dang po byung sa la brtags pa ni sems ni dang po gang nas byung phyi nang gi yul dang lus rdul phran du gzhig cing brtags pa na ma rnyed pa ni sems ye stong rtsa ba dang bral ba'i don rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa da lta gang na gnas brtags pasam rnyed pa ni gzhi med ngos gzung dang bral bar rtogs pa'o/ /gsum pa tha ma gar 'gro brtags pas ma rnyed pa ni sems 'gro 'ong med pa'i don rtogs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /sngon 'gro gsum gyis lhag mthong ma skyes pa bskyed pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ rtsad bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ byung gnas 'gro gsum/ la brtags pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa nang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba ni/ zab don rgya mtsho las/ de'ang gong gi sngon 'gro gsum gyis phyi lusal ba'i rkyen snang zad kyang nang lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'brul ba'i rgyu dang sa bon ma zad pas de zad par bya ba'i phyir lus ngag yid gsum nang ltar 'khor ba dang ru shan dbye dgos so gsungs/ de yang bag chags sgyu lus kyi phung po 'di grub pa tsam nas 'gro ba rigs drug tu 'phen byed kyi sa bon rgyun chags su gnas drug tu gnas pa yin la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna dang drug gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las bsags stobs che chung gi dbang gis 'chi khar rlung sems rigs drug gi sa bon gang rung steng du 'dus nas gnas de dang der skye ba yin gsungs/ skal ldan 'jug ngogs las/ lha'i sa bon nga rgyaX te de la dbye na bdun/ lha min gyi sa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā bon lta ba ste de la dbye na lnga/ mi'i sa bon the tshom/ dud 'gro'i sa bon gti mug gam ma rig pa ste 'di gnyis don gcig par mdo las bshad do/ /yi dwags kyi sa bon 'dod chags/ dmyal ba'i sa bon khong khro'am zhe sdang ste/ de dag gi 'khor ni khro ba la sogs nye nyon rnams las ci rig par sbyar ba rnams so/ /zhes gsungs/ nga rgyal bdun ni/ rang las yon tan chung ba la dmigs nas 'di las bdag che la/ mtshungs pa dang mnyam mo snyam pa nga rgyal tsam mam chung ba'i nga rgyal/ mtshungs pa bas kyang bdag che'am 'phags la che ba dang mnyam par 'dzin pa che ba'i nga rgyal/ che ba las kyang bdag 'phags snyam pa nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal/ nga 'o snyam du nyer len gyi phung po lnga la bdag dang bdag gir lta ba nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ gong ma'i yon tan ma thob pa la thob po snyam pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal/ ches 'phags pa bas bdag cung dman mod kyi 'on kyang bzang ngo snyam pa cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ yon tan min pa'i skyon nyid yon tan du rlom nas nga rgyal ba log pa'i nga rgyal ba'o/ /lta ba lnga ni/ mkhas 'jug rtsa ba las/ 'jigs tshogs la lta ba ni/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la bdag dang bdag gi bar lta ba ste/ lta ba gzhan gyi rten byed pa'o/ /mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba ni/ bdag gam phung po lnga la rtag pa dang chad par 'dzin pa ste/dbu ma'i lam gyis nges par 'byung ba la bar du gcod pa'i las can no/ /log par lta ba ni/ las rgyu 'bras la sogs yod pa'i don la med par lta ba ste/dge rtsa gcod par byed pa'i las can no/ /lta ba mchog 'dzin ni gong gi lta ba ngan pa gsum dang lta ba'i gnas nyer len gyi phung po lnga la mchog dang dam par 20

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥlta ba ste lta ngan la mngon du zhen par byed pa'o/ /tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin ni/ 'dag grol ma yin pa'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs dang de'i gnas phung lnga la 'dag grol nges 'byin du lta ba ste/ ngal ba 'bras bu med par byed pa'i las can no/ /zhes dang / the tshom ni/ bden pa'i don la yid gnyis za ba ste/ dge ba'i phyogs la mi 'jug pa'i las can no/ /zhes gsungs/skal ldan 'jug ngogs las/ 'dir sbyong byed kyi gnyen po bsgom pa na'ang /brten pa'i sa bon drug po de bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi mes bsregs pa dang / rten gyi sa bon drug po de yi ge gsum las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi mes bsreg pa ste/ de lta bu'i rigs drug sreg sbyong byas na don la gnas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de la thabs mchog zab mo'i man ngag gis rten rigs drug gi sa bon sbyang / brten pa las nyon gyi bag chags gtor/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyun dbyings su gcod pa yin te/ de yang bag chags kyi lus 'di ma rig gsum gyi rgyus bskyed pa'i phyir rigs drug gi sa bon nyid du gnas pa dang /chos sku gzhir gnas kyi rig pa 'di sku gsum dngos yin phyir sku gsum yi ge gsum gyi rang bzhin du shar ba yin/ de la spyang bya ni/ spyi bor lha yi sa bon a dkar skya na bun dkar ser gyi rnam pa can dang bcas pa/ mgrin par lha min gyi sa bon su ser skya na bun ljang nag gi rnam pa can dang / snying khar mi'i sa bonakhṛ sngo skya na bun kha dog sna tshogs kyi rnam pa can dang / lte bar dud 'gro'i sa bon tri dmar nag rang mdog gi na bun dang bcas pa/ gsang bar yi dwags kyi sa bon pre thal skya na bun can dang / rkang mthil du dmyal ba'i sa bon du nag 21

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpo na bun sngo dmar gyi rnam pa can dang / gzhan yang tri ljang nag dang / pre dmar skya'ang gsungs pas gang ltar yang rung / mtho ris gsum gyi yig mgo gyen dang ngan song gsum gyi yig mgo thur bstan du gsal gsungs/ sbyo nga byed sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin yi ge'i rnam par shar ba spyi bor yo dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar hūṃ mthing ga rnams las nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od ltar bkrag mdangs gzi byin 'bar nas/ 'bru gsum bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung 'gro ba rig drug gis sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa dngos med du sbyangs bar bsam mo/ /mas nas sbyangs pa dang / yas nas sbyangs pa dang / cig char du bsregs pa sogs rang rang gi khams dang sbyar dgos gsungs/ zab don rgya mtsho las/ sbyang gzhi 'gro ba'i gnas drug tu/ sbyong byed sku gsum gyi yi ges sbyong ba ni/ rang gi lus kyi spyi bor a dkar po lha'i bag chags dkar po sgrib pa'i rnam pa can tu 'dug par bsam/ de bzhin tu mgrin par su ljang ser la lha ma yin gyi bag chags/snying kharaskṛ sngo skya la mi'i bag chags/ lte bar tri dmar nag la dud 'gro'i bag chags/ gsang bar bre ljang gu la yi dwags kyi bag chags/ rkang mthil du du dud kha la dmyal ba'i bag chags rnams 'dus par bsgom pa'i spyi bor sku'i sa bon oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phro ba/ mgrin par āḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phro ba/ snying khar hūṃ mthing ga las 'od zer 'phro ba'i 'od kyis sa bon drug lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa ma rig zhagrul ba'i bag chags thams cad thul thul tshig par bsam zhing bzla'o/ /o āḥhūṃ/ 'bum tsho bdun dbyangs snyan 2 2

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpos glu dang bcas pas bzla'o/ /de'i dus su bdag ji lta ba bzhin sems can thams cad kyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge las me 'bar sa bon drug tshig par bsam zhing bzlas so/ /zhes dang / gzhan du 'bru gsum las ye shes kyi 'od zer me lce'i phreng ba ltar 'phros pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib rigs drug gi sa bon ma rig zhabrul pa'i bag chags thams cad thul gyis tshig nas mi gnas par byas te lus ngag yid gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs/ rigs drug gi gnas thams cad 'od zer gyi 'du 'phros khyab cing rigs drug so so'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad thul gyis bsregs nas rgyal ba thams cad kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs par bsam zhing dbyangs dang bcas pa'am dbyangs med kyang rung bar gsungs pa dang / gser phreng las/ sbyang bya rang nyid tha mal ba'i spyi bo'i nang du a dkar nag la lha'i bag chags dang nga rgyal/ mgrin par su ser nag la lha ma yin gyi phrag dog /snying gar dṛ sngo nag la mi'i 'dod chags/ lte bar tri dmar nag la dud 'gro'i gti mug /gsang bar pre ljang nag la yi dwags kyi ser sna/ rkang mthil du du dud kha la dmyal ba'i zhe sdang gi bag chags rnams yi ge'i kha dog dang mthun par yod pa la las dang nyon mongs pa 'khor dang bcas pa sol dong nas du ba 'phyur ba ltar bsam la/ sbyong byed sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge'ang spyi bor o dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūṃ mthing ga gsum las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas yi ge drug bag chags dang bcas thams cad bsregs nas 'khor ba ngan song gi rgyu 'bras thams cad dag ste lus shel gong phyis pa 23

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥltar bsam zhing o āḥhūṃ dbyangs dang bcas pas brngod do gsungs zhes so/ /gsum pa gsang ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgo gsum gyi gnas lugs bstan pa la/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung 'jug gsum bstan pa las/ 'dir zhi gnas la rnal du dbab pa dang / sor gzhugs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid yig nor bu las/ bde ba'i mal du nyal la lus skul bskyod dang bral la/ ngag smra brjod dang bral ba/ sems dran bsam dang bral bas sos dal/ khong lhod bag phab la phyam gyis skye med bsam brngod dang bral ba'i ngang la 'jog pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar rnal ma ni ma bcos pa'i don dang dbab pa ni/ de la rang babs su 'jog pa'i phyir rnal du dbab pa'o/ /gnyis pa sor gzhug pa la gsum las/ dang po nyan thos kyi lta stangs rnam snang gi chos bdun ni/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag /sgal tshigs drang po/ lce ya rkan/ dbugs dal ba/ mig sna rtse/ mgrin pa yid tsam dgug par mnyam par bzhag go/ /gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i lta stangs skyil krung sogs gong dang 'dra la mig bar snang la mda' gang tsam du blta'o//gsum pa khro bo'i lta stangs ni/ zab don las/ rkang pa gyad kyi dor thabs su bgrad/ mig bar snang la gyen du bgrad/ ha ha dang hi hi la sogs pa brngod cing sems spros pa dang bral bar bzhag go zhes dang / khrid yig nor bu'i lugs la khro bo'i lta stangs la gsum gsungs pa las/ dang po gyad kyi dor stabs ni/ langs te gom pa bgrad miṭwāṃ had por bltas la zhi gnas bsgom

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmo/ /gnyis pa 'jigs pa'i sgeg 'gros ni/ gom pa dal gyis 'dor zhing zhi gnas dang bsres so/ /gsum pa seng ge'i mchong stangs ni/ mchong rgyug rgod sems dgag sgrub tu 'phror bcug nas zhi gnas kyi don la rtsal sbyangs pas phyis spyod lam thams cad zhi gnas su 'char ro/ /zhes dang / zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung las/ de ltar nyan thos kyi lta stangs kyis lus ngag yid gsum mi gnas pa gnas par bya/ byang chub sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis gnas pa brtan par bya/ khro bo'i lta stangs kyis brtan pa grol bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/gzhan du zhi gnas kyi rang bzhin rgyud la bskyed pa la gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro rnal du dbab pas zhi gnas ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis sor gzhug pas skyes pa ngo sprad de nyams su blang tshul/ gsum pa rjes la gyad sogs lta stangs gsum gyis rkyen dang bsres te bogs dbyung zhing rtsal sbyangs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/lhag mthong dang zung 'jug gnyis ni khrid yig nor bu las shes par bya'o/ /don gnyis pa dngos gzhi zag pa med pa'i ye shes rgyud la brtan pa'i thabs la gnyis te/ dngos gzhi'i sgra bshad pa dang / don gyi 'gros dbye ba'o/ /dang po la tshig gi mtha' bcad pa dang / don gyi thog tu dbab pa gnyis las/dang po ni dngos gzhi zhes pa la mu bzhi las/ gzhi yin la dngos ma yin pa pho brang mthong nas rgyal po ma mthong ba ltar rdzogs pa chen po kha cig gis chos gzhi la lus nas lag tu blang du med par chos nyid kha 'byams su song bas 'chi khar tha mal du 'chi ba rnams so/ /dngos yin la gzhi ma yin pa ni rgyal po 25

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmathong yang de'i mtshan nyid gtan la ma phebs pa ltar/ man ngag kha cig thog ma gnad thog tu phebs kyang tha ma tshig gis mtha' ma chod pa'i rjes la de'i thog tu mi gnas par pra yas pa rnams so/ /dngos dang gzhi gnyis ka ma yin pa ni rgyal po dang pho brang gang yang ma mthong ba ltar theg pa thun mongs pa spyi'i tshig gis lta sgom yid dpyod kyi lam du byas nas don ngo ma 'phrod pas tha ma gar 'gro ngo mi shes pa rnams so/ /dngos dang gzhi gnyis ka yin pa ni/ rgyal po yang mthong mtshan nyid kyang legs par shes pa dang 'dra bar/ mngon sum snying thig gi gnad rig pa dngos su mthong bas/ lta sgom yin snyam la rag ma las/ gzhi mthong ba'i ldog pa'i sa med par 'khor 'das dus gcig la chod pa'i rnal 'byor ba zhes bya'o/ /de'ang chos nyid mngon sum gyi gnad bla mas bstan pa mthong nas yid ches kyang / brtson 'grus kyis nyams su ma blangs na tshe 'di nyid la zag bcas mi snang bar sangs mi rgya la/ phyi ma la'ang 'di dang 'phrad dka' bas 'jig rten rgyab tu bor nas nyams su len pa gal che'o/ /gal te gnad yod kyang nyams su ma blangs na sa 'og gi gter dang 'dra bas phan thog pa ma yin no//gnyis pa don gyi thog tu dbab pa ni/ rig pa rang thog tu phab nas dngos su ngo sprad pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi snang ba mthong ba la zer ro/ /de'ang dngos su bstan du med par rig pa zhes thun mong ba rnams kyis brjod kyang thog tu mi phebs te/rdo rje gdan ma mthong bar de'i lo rgyus bshad pa'am/ dmus long bshad pa bzang pos kha dog gzhan ༷ ḍichad pa dang 'dra'o/ /res rig pa skye

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmed stongapa yin snyam/ res sna tshogs 'char ba yin snyam/ de gnyis tshig gi khrid kha legs legs pos ngo bo stong pa nam mkha' 'dra ba 'char tshul ma 'gags pa me long gi gzugs brnyan 'dra'o/ /zhes bshad kyang / da lta yod yod po/ phug na stong phyam ci yang med pa cig kho na la gding 'cha' bas theg pa rim dgu'i lta sgom spyod pas sangs mi rgya ste/ yid dpyod tshig gi 'gro ldog gis nyams res skye 'grib cung zad re byung dus/ res yin snyam gyi steng du rtsal spyong rtogs pa so ma zhig 'khrungs snyam nas yid sos/ res min snyam gyi dong du sems lhung / mi dga' gdung ba'i skog gnong kyis 'tsher zhing nges par ci yin da lta shi na ci bya snyam du chos med po zhabor ba'i bshal thag byed pas rig pa'i don la mthong dus med de/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i lta ba nyon re mongs/ /de la brten pa'i sgom pa yi re mug /de las byung ba'i spyod pa thang re chad/ /de la 'bras bu'i re ba yong re zhabrul/zhes legs par gsungs pa thog tu babs so/ /'dir rig pa lu gu rgyud mthong ba ni rig pa'i rang bzhin la bzang ngan dang 'pho 'gyur med par thams cad de'i ngang las 'gro sa gzhan med pas gzhi zhes bya ste gzhan tu 'chol mi srid do/ /zhes so/ /rnam mkhyen shing rta las/ mngon sum yid dpyod la rag ma las par ston pa yin pas lam khyad gnam sa lta bu yod la/ rang sde phyogs gcig tu zab par ston pa gsang skor man chad du des don rtags gsum gyi rig pa'i gzhal tshul tsam 'dra yang / 'di ni dpyod ldan gyis rten gsum gzhal ba ltar dngos dang gzhi gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid gtan la phebs pa dang mtshungs la/27

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā ཿgzhan du ni gzhi mthong yang dngos gtan la ma phebs pa byis pas lha khang la bltas pa dang mtshungs pa yin no gsungs/ dpal sprul rin po ches ye shes bla ma'i dngos gzhi'i sgra bshad theg ma/chog mdzod las gsungs pa ltar yin tshul ye shes bla ma la phyag mchan btab pa bla ma lung rtogs la gnang ba dang /skyabs rje bka' drin can la dpal sprul rin po che dang / mkhan chen padma badzra/zhabs drung rin po che rnams kyis kyang / dngos ni lhun grub thod rgal gyi zhing sku pho brang gsum yin tshul gsungs pa ni/ chos nyid mngon sum/ gyi dus na dbyings thig rig gsum dang / nyams gong 'phel gyi mjug rdzogs pa na sku rkyang pa dang /tshad phebs kyi tshe dbyings thig rig gsum zhing sku pho brang gsum gyi rang bzhin du 'char tshul gsungs/ de yang theg mchog mdzod las/ gzhi yin la dngos ma yin pa pho brang mthong nas rgyal po ma mthong ba ltar/ rdzogs pa chen po kha cig gi chos gzhi la lus nas lag tu blang du med pa sogs gsungs pa ni/ man ngag sde'i phyi skor du gzhi gdod ma'i gnas tshul rgya cher bshad pa las/ lam nyams su len tshul/ bar do'i 'char tshul/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i grol tshul ma bshad pas gzhi yin la dngos ma yin pa'o/ /dngos yin la gzhi ma yin pa ni rgyal po mthong yang de'i mtshan nyid gtan la ma phebs pa ltar/ man ngag kha cig thog ma gnad thog tu phebs kyang tha ma tshig gi mtha' ma chod pas rjes la de'i thog tu mi gnas par pra yas pa rnams gsungs pa ni/ nang skor du lam dpe don rtags gsum gyis ngo sprad pa tsam bshad kyang gzhi'i gnas tshul dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i grol tshul ma bshad/ dpe don rtags gsum ni/28

g.yukhogablamachosadabyingasorangagrolagyigasung 'bum/ āḥde yang gzhiganas ye shes rang la yad pa de da ltar lam dus na dpe dan rtags gsumagyisamatshon nas ngo sprad pa tsam yod de dpe rdo rje sems dpa'i me long zhesashelardo la brten nas ka dag dang lhun grub kyi gdangs yod tshul ngo sprod pa dang/ rtags sgron ma gtem pa'i snang ba mngon sum dang / don de lta bu'i gnas lugs de phyis bar do'i dus mngon sum 'char bas nges shes skye na grol zhes pa lasatshe'adir dngos su nyams su len tshul ni med gsungs nas spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag gsang skor du lam gyi bye brag bsnom pa tsam bstan kyang gzhi'i gnas tshul dang mthar thug gi grol tshul rnams ma bshad/ lam gyi sgom tshul ni phyag mchan las/ sgron drug gi rnam bzhag sogs bstan nas tshe 'dir ka dag bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang gdangs lhun grub kyi snang ba dbyings thig le la sogs pa lus kyi byed pa gnad du bcing nas nyams su blang ba tsam yod kyang /rtags snang ba bzhi'i lam gyi tshod 'dzin dang / grub don mthar thug 'pho chen gyi skur bzhengs pa sogs man ngag mang po gab pas gnad mthar thug pa min no/ /dngos dang gzhi gnyis ka yin pa ni/ rgyal po yang mthong mtshan nyid kyang legs par shes pa dang 'dra bar mngon sum snying thig gi gnad rig pa dngos su mthong bas/ lta sgom yin snyam la rag ma las/ gzhi mthong ba'i ldog pa'i sa med par 'khor 'das dus gcig la chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ yang gsang bla med du gzhi gdod ma'i gnas lugs/ lam lta snom spyod gsum/ 'bras bu mthar thug gi grol tshul dang bcas te ka dag dang lhun grub rgyas par bstan pa yin te slob dpon bi ma la'i sgron ma snang byed las/ phyi 29

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥskor lus dang 'dra ste tha snyad rgya cher bstan/ /lusardzogs par yod kyang don snying lnga la sogs pa med na ro dang 'dra/nang skor mig dang 'dra mig gis phyi mthong yang rang mi mthong /ste mthong ba brda yi chos/ /gsang skor snying dang 'dra ba'i dran byed gzungs kyi chos/ /snying po gcig pus don byed mi nus te snga las bag tsam 'phags so/ /'di ni lus kun rdzogs te lus la nad med dbang po skyon med pa'i skyes bu 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/ mdor na skyabs rje bka' drin can gyis gong du dngos gzhi'i sgra ngayand skabs/ rdzogs pa chen po kha cig gis chos gzhi la lus pa sogs gsungs pa ni phyi skor la gsungs pa dang / yang man ngag kha cig thog ma gnad thog tu pheb kyang sogs gsungs pa la/ gsang skor gzhir bzhag yin la/ nang skor 'jog chog gam mi chog dpyod/ 'di ni shin tu gal che bas yang yang zhib cha byed dgos gsungs pa dang / ye shes bla ma las mu bzhir bshad pa'i skabs/khregs chod las thod rgal dngos su rtsal du bton pa mi snang bas phal bas shin tu go dka' yang 'dir kun mkhyen snga phyi'i bzhed pa dngos ni zhing sku pho brang gsum gyi 'char gzhi las dang po ba'i skabs su dbyings thig rig gsum yin la khyad par lhag mthong thams cad kyi rgyal po rig pa rtog med rdo rje lu gu rgyud yin tshul 'di nyid ma shes na khregs chod las khyad du 'phags tshul bdun sogs mi shes pas phan tshun 'khrugs shing mgo meongs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ man ngag rdzogalopa chen po'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nang dbyings rnam dag sgron ma'i klongaX rig pa bcud du smin pa laX phyed skur 'char ba nyams gong 'phel risarnga lnga'i tshom bu tshad phebs nyamasaX zhes dang / rnam mkhyen shing rta 30

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥlas/ khregasachad du re zhig dbang rnan gyis gzhi bral dang / rtul pas sgyu ma lta snyerargyasa'adebs pa'i yid dpyod tsam las med pa thod rgal du gnad la brten pa'i'odalnga dbyings rig gi snang ba yul du 'char bas thog ma nas phyi 'byung gi snangachathamal ba'i bag chags ldog par 'gyur ba'i khyad yod/ ces gsungs/gnyis pa don gyi 'gros dbye ba la rnam pa bzhi ste/ dang po lus ngag sems kyi gnad gzir ba/ gnyis pa gnad gsum la brten nas mngon sum rang thog tu dbab pa/ gsum pa snang ba bzhi ji ltar 'char ba'i rim pa bzhi pa mtha' rten gyi man ngag bzhi po gong ma rnams kyi rgyab rten nam nan chags su byung ba sogs theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod las shes par bya'o//༈ ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa sde snod gsum dang phyi rgyud gsum/ longs sku'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi bstan pa bskyed rdzogs gnyisachos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang po'i bstan pa a ti yo ga'o/ /de nas slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes 'og min du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang dang yang gsang bla na med pa'i gdams pa dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ de nas ri ma la ya rin po che rnam par sprul pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i ro ldan ma dang / bde byed ser mo yon tan mtha' yas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis zhus te/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi lo gsum du glegs bam du bkod/de nas slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos rnams sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum du phye ba yin te/ a ti bkod 31

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum / āḥpa chen po las/ yid can rnams la sems kyi sde/ /nam mkha' can la klong gi sde/ /rim rtsol bral la man ngag go/ /zhes gsungs/ man ngag sde de dag gi snying po thig le mchog gi chos nyid la snyan rgyud dang bshad rgyud gnyis su phye/thig le mchog gi zhes pa ni lhun grub snang ba'i 'od gsal la gtso bor gsungs pa'o/ /man ngag sde ni sems klong gnyis las ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ a ti bkod pa chen po las/ kyai rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de ltar gtan la ma phab na/ /yid dpyod 'dzin pa rnams dang ni/ /khyad par ci yang med par 'gyur/ /de phyir nges gsang snying po 'di/ /mun pa las ni mar me'am/ba glang rnams las glang chen nam/ /gcan zan rnams las seṅge 'am/ /rkang thang rnams las rta ba bzhin/ /kun gyi nang nas khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas slob dpon shrī seng has/ bshad rgyud la/ phyi skor/ nang skor/gsang skor/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i skor dang bzhir phye ba yin te/ slob dpon bi ma la'i sgron ma snang byed las/ phyi skor lus dang 'dra ste tha snyad rgya cher bstan/ /nang skor mig gis phyi mthong yang nang mi mthong mig dang 'dra ste mthong ba brda yi snying gcig bus don byed mi nus te snga ma las bag tsam 'phags chos/ /gsang skor snying dang 'dra ste dran byed gzungs kyi chos/ /dzoogs pa'i skyes bu 'dra ste lus la nad med dbang po skyon med/ 'di ni lus kun rdzogs pa'i skyes bu 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang sems klong man ngag gi dgongs pa dang khyad par ni/ theg mchog mdzod las/ de yang rang sems ma yin pa'i chos logs na med pas sna tshogs sems kyi sde'o/ /'di dag ni sems rang byung gi ye shes las gzhan tu gyur pa 'gog 32

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum / āḥpa la dgongs pa tsam mo/ /chos nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong las/ 'gro sa gzhan med par smra ba klong gi sde'o/ /'di dag ni brjod bya chos nyid kyi klong las gzhan 'byung 'gog pa la dgongs pa tsam mo/ /yin lugs gnad thog tu 'bebs pa man ngag gi sde'o/ /'di dag ni gnad ma yin pa gzhan du kha 'byams don las 'gyang pa 'gog pa la dgongs pas kun gyi rtse mor phyin pa'o/ /zhes dang / sem/sa sde sems yin la la las yid dpyod du 'dzin la/kloong sde chos nyid du 'dzin pas yid dpyod du song ba las/ man ngag sde ni gnas lugs rang gsal du byed pas 'phags so/ /zhes gsungs/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ ye shes bla ma la phyag mchan btab pa dang zhal rgyun la/ dang po sems sde la smin grol rgyab brten dang bcas pa rgya cher bzhugs pa'i gdams pa'i 'gag don phyogs mtshon na/ spyir snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos skad la/mdo sgyu sems gsum las yongs su grags pa ltar/ mdo tshogs chen 'dus pa/rgyud sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ sems phyogs rdzogs pa chen po zhes bzhag pas sems phyogs rdzogs chen yin nas bzung gtso bo sems dang sems nyid kyi zlas dbye ba'i sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes rtsal du bton nas ston pa rdzogs chen gyi babs yin kyang man ngag gi zab khyad kyis nang gses sems klong man ngag gi rim pas je zab tu yod pas/ sems klong gnyis kha 'byams gzhi bral gnyis la gding 'cha' 'o zhes blo bral gyi ye shes rjen cer du ston mi nus shing phyogs re tsam nus kyang bskyang lugs kyi khyad yod pas sems sde'i ka dag khregs chod kyi dgongs pa 'di rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi phyag chen snang ba bzhi rim dang 33

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥngo bo phyogs mtshungs su gsungs/ man ngag lam gyi rim pa ni phyag chen las zab pa yin/ gtso cher chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod du sde gsum rdzogs pa chen po ka dag khregs chod kyi gnas lugs gcig tu bstan pa las khyad ma phye bas don gyi 'gag don de lta bu shes dgos so/ /grub mtha' 'dzin tshul la 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'phags chos re yod pas/ de'i dbang du byas na sems sde'i skabs sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes ston pa kun byed rgyal po ka dag stong pa chen po dang / 'di ltar 'khor 'das bzang ngan spang blang de dag gi sems sems byung gi byung tshor bzang ngan thams cad chos nyid byang chub kyisems de'i rtsal yin/ rol pa yin/ 'char tshul yin/ cho 'phrul yin/ byang chub kyi sems de ltar snang ba las logs su chos med pas/ kun byed rgyal po kun byed gcig mi byed/ /kun byed byang chub sems la bya rgyu med/ /gsungs pa ltar yin te/ 'khor ba spang du med/ myang 'das sgrub du med 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos nyid byang chub sems kho rang gi ngang yin pas rtsal gyi 'char tshul bzang ngan sna tshogs gang shar gang snang gi thog tu zhog la mnyam par bzhag dgos gsungs pas don du snang ba la rig pas rgyas gdab pa yin no/ /deng sang khrid yig phal cher gang shar gyi rig pa'i ngo bo bskyang dgos gsungs pa yang 'di dang gnad gcig tu song bas yang gsang bla med kyi dgongs par mi 'gro bas shan phye dgos/ 'di ltar bskyangs na snang ba la stong pas rgyas gdab pa yin pas gnyen por shor ba dang / kun mkhyen gyis/ snang ba gang snang gang shar gyi thog tu bzhag nas skyong ba 'di yang 34

g.yukhogablamachosadabyingasarongagrolagyigasuonga'abum/ āḥn zhi gnas lteng par 'gra/ yang na rgad par 'gra gsungs pas rig pa bla bral gyiyeshes kyi rang tshugs ma zin pa'i mnyam par bzhag pa yul la ltos dgos pasamanyam bzhag ltos 'jog can dang / rkyen khar lus pa dang / snang rtog bzang ngan la sogs pa gang shar la ched tu bltas pas gzung 'dzin can du 'gro bas yang gsang bla med dang bstun na lam gyi gol sa ma chod pa'i skyon yod payin no/ /༈ gnyis pa klong sde la'ang smin grol rgyab brten dang bcas pa mang du yod cing klong dkar nag khra gsum gyi dbye ba sogs shin tu rgya che rung gnas lugs kyi babs don phyogs mtshon te/ zab gsal zhes gnyis su bsdu na zab pa ni kloong chen po yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa rgyal ba thams cad bskyed cing sdud pa chos kyi dbyings kyi klong las byung ba'i chos su ma gtogs pa 'khor 'das bzang ngan gyi snang ba gang yang med pas 'khor 'das kyi chos su snang ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa rnams klong chen kun tu bzang mo'i che ba'i rgyan dang /rol ba dang / cho 'phrul yin zhes 'dod/ gsal ba ni sems nyid rtsal snang dang bcas pa chos nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong las 'gro sa med par ye grol rang dag tu 'dod pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas lugs de'i rgyun mnyam par bzhag te bskyangs pa'i lam rtags kyi yon tan la/ shes nyams la bde ba'i nyams dang gsal dwangs la gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes dang / snang ba zangs thal du mthong ba dang / dag pa'i zhing khams mthong ba dang / mi rtog pa'i nyams rtog pa g.yo mi shes pa'i nyin mtshan 'dreX pa sogs dang / gtso bo rlung nyams

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrtags bcu'i stong gzugs dus 'khor la sogs pa dang mthun par 'char bas stong gzugs kyi rnam pa lha sku thig le tshom bu la sogs pa grangs med 'char zhing / de'i rtsal las nga/da pa dang snying rje sogs klong rdol du 'byung bas 'di lta bu'i zab gsal gnyis med la klong sde rdo rje'i zam pa zhes rlung rtags las stong gzugs kyi lha sku sogs 'char bas man ngag sde dang mtshams sbyor ba'i zam pa lta bu yin gsungs/ gangs can ljongs na sngon gyi zur gnub la sogs pa'i dus dang / bee ro'i slob ma spang rgan mi pham mgon po nas rim byon phal cher grub pa rnams klong sde'i sgo nas lus rdul phran du dwangs/ sems chos nyid du dwangs nas ka dag gi sa la sangs rgyas pa yin no/ /sems sde'i sgo nas lus rdul phran du dwangs rgyu yod med ma nges gsungs/ gsum pa gsang ba man ngag gi sde la skor bzhi las/ de yang phyi skor du gzhi gdod ma'i gnas tshul rgya cher bshad pa las/ lam nyams su len tshul/ bar do'i 'char tshul/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu grol tshul ma bshad/ de yang gzhi gdod ma'i gnas tshul ni/ spyir sems can kyi khams la kun rdzob rgyu'i rtsa rlung thig le'i rang bzhin can gyi rten rdo rje'i lus kyi grub tshul dang / de la brten pa ye shes kyi rtsa rlung gi thig le gnas tshul dang / snying ga na gzhir gnas kyi ye shes yod tshul dpe byas na sa 'og na rin po che'i gter yod ces pa'i lo rgyus bshad pa bzhin rjes nas bar do nas 'char 'ong / de dus ngo shes na grol 'gro ba yin ces bstan pa la 'od gsal lhun grub kyi lam 'dir dngos su nyams su blang ba'i man ngag gi gnad med pa'i chos gzhi la lus par gsungs pa de 'ong ba yin/ nang skor du lam 36

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdapedonartags gsum gyis ngo sprad pa tsam bshad kyang / gzhi'i gnas tshul dang /mtharathug gi 'bras bu grol tshul ma bshad/ de yang gzhir gnas ye shes rang layodapa de da lta lam dus na dpe don rtags gsum gyis mtshon nas ngo sprad pa tsamayod de/ dpe don rtags gsum ni dpe rdo rje sems dpa'i me long zhes shel rdo la brten nas ka dag dang lhun grub kyi gdangs yod tshul ngo sprod pa dang /rtags sgron ma gtem pa'i snang ba mngon sum dang / don de lta bu'i gnas lugs de phyis bar do'i dus mngon sum 'char bas ngo shes na grol zhes pa las tshe 'dir dngos su nyams su blang ba ni med gsungs/ gsang skor du lam gyi bye brag bsgom pa tsam bstan kyang / gzhi'i gnas tshul dang / mthar thug gi grol tshul rnams ma bshad/ lam gyi bsgom tshul ni sgron drug gi rnam bzhag sogs bstan nas tshe 'dir ka dag bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang gdangs lhun grub kyi snang ba dbyings thig le la sogs pa lus kyi byed pa gnad du bcings nas nyams su blang ba yod cing / rtags snang ba bzhi'i lam gyi tshod 'dzin dang /grub don mthar thug 'pho chen gyi skur bzhengs pa sogs man ngag mang po gab pas gnad mthar thug min no/ /yang gsang bla na med pa rdo rje snying po 'dir ni/gzhi gdod ma'i gnas lugs/ lam lta sgom spyod gsum/ 'bras bu mthar thug gi grol tshul dang bcas pa rgyas par bstan pa yin pas/ kun las khyad par du 'phags pa lus dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i skyes bus bya ba thams cad sgrub nus pa bzhin/ lam phyogs re ba dang / man ngag gi gnad phran bu re tsam ma yin par 'di gcig pu'i lam la brtson na lam rkyen gzhan gyis kha gsab mi 37

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdagos par dbang rab tshe 'dir grol ba/ 'bring bar do/ tha ma rang bzhin sprulasku'i zhing du dbugs 'byin nas grol ba yin pas khyad par du 'phags gsungs/'di'i gnad gtan la dbab pa la/ rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab kyang gsang chen nges pa'i rgyud chen po bcu bdun dang / sngags srung khros ma'i rgyud dang bco brgyad/ yang man ngag gi dbang du byas na/ man ngag brgya dang bcu dgu ste/rgyud man ngag dag gi dgongs don legs par bkral nas 'chad pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed gang can gyi ljongs na yongs su grags pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma dang bi ma la mi tra gnyis yin/ de yang padma'i bka' srol mkha' 'gro snying thig gis gtso bor btags grol 'das rjes la sogs pa'i dgongs pa gtso bor bton nas gsungs pa dang / bi ma las gdams pa'i gnad rnams gcig tu bsdus pa gsang ba snying thig gi snying dang 'dra ba zhes zab pa pod bzhi zhes/ dang po gser yig can/ gnyis pa zangs yig can/ gsum pa dung yig can/ bzhi pa g.yu yig can dang bzhi'o/ /phra yig can zangs yig can gyi khongs su gtogs pa yin zhes sogs gsungs/ (khe yid bzhin mdzod kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa'i 'grel ba las/ mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' bshad pa'i skabs su/ sgom bsam gtan la dad pa bdun ni/ phur bu bas kun rdzob kyang med par bsgom pa dang / grangs can pas rnam 'gyur chad pa'i stong pa bsnyom pa dang / nyi ma bas snang ba spang ba'i stong pa bsgom pa dang / dza ya dha ra bas tshogs drug yul dang bcas pa rkyen du bltas te mi rtog pa rtse gcig tu bsgom pa dang /bye brag pas dran pa skyon du bltas nas dran med gcig tu bsgom pa dang / zhi ba

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbs thamasacad sems su brtags nas sems nyid ma yengs par bsnam pa dang /rig byedapas bde sdug dang rtog mi rtog gang yang spangs nas nam mkha' ltar bsgomapa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /(na kun gzhi dang chos sku'i khyad par ni/kun gzhil dbye na/ ye don gyi kun gzhi/ sbyor ba don gyi kun gzhi/ bag chags sna tshogs pa'i kun gzhi/ bag chags lus kyi kun gzhi dang bzhir gsungs kyang mdor na/ mi pham rin po che'i don gyi kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po zag med kyi chos kun gyi gzhi yin la/ 'khor ba'i kun gzhi zag bcas kyi chos kun gyi gzhi yin pas kun gzhir gsungs/ de lta bu'i bag chags sna tshogs pa'i 'khor ba'i kun gzhi de'i ngo bo gang yin snyam na rnam par shes pa ji snyed cig 'phro ba'i gzhir gyur pa/ shes pa phyogs su ma lhung ba/ snod bcud rgya rsā po la dmigs pa/ yul gyi spu ris mi 'byed pa/ rang gi ngo bo la rnam rtog rags pa'i rlabs zhi ba rgya mtsho lta bu'i ngang du rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sas bsdus pa dang / rang gi ngo bo shes pa gsal zhing rtog pa med pa gzugs khams kyi sas bsdus pa de ni shes pa snga ma rnams kyi bag chags 'dzin zhing phyi ma'i rten du gyur pa ste/ yang tig nam mkha' klong yangs las/ gang du mi rtog rtse gcig lung ma bstan/ /gsal zhing rig tsam rtog pa med pa dang / /zhes sogs gsungs dang mkha' 'gro yang tig las/ de yang phyogs res dper mtshon na/ skyes bu gcig ngal gso ba lta bu'i tshe shes pa dar gcig gang du mi rtog par lung ma bstan du gnas pa kun gzhi de las dar cig snang yul ma 'gags par lam me gsal yang der 'dzin ma zhugs pas 39

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasal la rtog med kyi rnam pa de kun gzhi'i rnam par shes par gsungs/de lta bu'i kun gzhi las 'das pa'i rig stong dbyer med kyi chos sku de nyid ngo 'phrod nas de'i ngang la gnas pa'i tshe gtsug sems las/dbyings rig dbyer med so so rang gis rig pa'i gnas lugs de'i ngang nas/bag chags sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i 'pho 'gyur can gyi sems med pas kun gzhi'i rnam shes ji ltar yin/phyi tshogs drug gi yul dang /nang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo dang /de'i yul du gyur ba'i mtshan ma cung zad kyang med pas sgo lnga'i rnam shes dang yid dang nyon yid ji ltar yod de/spros bral don gsal chen po'i rgyud las/'phel 'grib med pas kun gzhi'i rnam shes las grol/gzung 'dzin med pas yid kyi rnam shes las grol/skye 'gag med pas sno lnga'i rnam shes las grol zhid log pa'o//zhes dang /grub mtha' rin po che'i mdzod las/rten kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i sems dang /nyon yid/yid shes dang /sgo lnga'i rnam shes rnams med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las/mngon sum la lta bas na nang kun rtog 'phro 'du med pas 'dod pa'i sems logagasal ba'i ngang la gsal bar 'jog byed kyi gnyen po med pas gzugs kyi sems log/rtog med rtse gcig la chos nyid kyi ngang du zhen pa'i blo med pas gzugs med kyi sems log pas gsum pa'i sems nye bar zhi ba'o//zhes gsungs/(kheshin tu gal che ba yang gsang bla med kyi skabs su rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i snying thig gi lta ba dngos dang gzhi gnyis ka yin tshul yang yang gsungs pa 'di nyid/dpal sprul rin po ches/ye shes bla ma'i dngos gzhi'i sgra bshad/ṭwāṃg mchog mdzod las gsungs pa ltar

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥyinatshulayeshes bla ma lo phyag mchan btab nas bla ma lung rtags la gonang ba dang / zhabs drung rin pa che sags kyis kyang / dngas ni lhun grub thad rgal gyi zhingaskupho brang gsum yin tshul skyabs rje rin po che la gsungs pa chos nyid modzanasum gyi dus na dbyings thig rig gsum dang / nyams gong 'phel gyi mjug rdzogs pa dang tshad phebs kyi mgo zin tshe dbyings thig rig gsum zhing sku phobrang gsum gyi rang bzhin du 'char tshul gsungs/ theg mchog mdzod kyi rim khang bco brgyad pa las gsungs pa ltar mi shes par/ gnas 'di la mgo smongasapa'i glen sgom dang rtog ge rnams khregs chod rkyang ba la sbyar nas/ bshad khul byas pa 'di ni bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /de yang theg mchog mdzod las/dngos gzhi'i sgra bshad la/ tshig gi mtha' bcad pa dang / don gyi thog tu dbab pa gnyis las/ dang po dngos gzhi zhes pa la mu bzhi gsungs pa las gzhi yin la dngos ma yin pa pho brang mthong yang rgyal po ma mthong ba ltar rdzogs pa chen po kha cig gis chos gzhi la lus nas lag tu blang du med par chos nyid kha 'byams su song bas 'chi khar tha mal du 'chi ba rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/man ngag sde'i phyi skor du gzhi gdod ma'i gnas tshul rgya cher bshad pa las/lam nyams su len tshul/ bar do'i 'char tshul/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i grol tshul ma bshad pas gzhi yin la dngos ma yin pa'o/ /de nyid las/ dngos yin la gzhi ma yin pa ni rgyal po mthong yang de'i mtshan nyid gtan la ma phebs pa ltar man ngag kha cig thog ma gnad thog tu phebs kyang tha ma tshig gis mtha' ma chod pas rjes la de'i thog tu mi gnas par pra yas pa rnams so gsungs pa ni/41

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnang skor du lam dpe don rtags gsum gyis ngo sprad pa tsam bshad spyang/gzhi'i gnas tshul dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i grol tshul ma bshad/ de yang gzhi gnas ye shes rang la yod pa de da lta lam dus na dpe don rtags gsum gyis mtshoni nas ngo sprad pa tsam yod de/ dpe don rtags gsum ni/ dpe rdo rje sems dpa'i me long zhes shel rdo la brten nas ka dag dang lhun grub kyi gdangs yod tshul ngo sprod pa dang / rtags sgron ma gtem pa'i snang ba mngon sum dang / don de lta bu'i gnas lugs de phyis bar do'i dus mngon sum 'char bas ngo shes na grol zhes pa las tshe 'dir dngos su nyams su blang ba ni med gsungs nas spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag gsang skor du lam gyi bye brag bsgom pa tsam bstan kyang gzhi'i gnas tshul dang / mthar thug gi grol tshul rnams ma bshad/lam gyi sgom tshul ni sgron drug gi rnam bzhag sogs bstan nas tshe 'dir ka dag bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang gdangs lhun grub kyi snang ba dbyings thig le la sogs pa lus kyi byed pa gnad du bcings nas nyams su blang ba yod cing rtags snang ba bzhi'i lam gyi tshod 'dzin dang / grub don mthar thug 'pho chen gyi skur bzhengs pa sogs man ngag mang po gab pas gnad mthar thug pa min no/ /de nyid las/ dngos dang gzhi gnyis ka ma yin pa ni rgyal po dang pho brang gang yang ma mthong ba ltar theg pa thun mong pa spyi'i tshig gi lta sgom yid dpyod kyis lam du byas nas don ngo ma 'phrod pas tha ma gar 'gro ngo mi shes pa rnams so/ /zhes dang / dngos dang gzhi gnyis ka yin pa ni/ rgyal po yang mthong mtshan nyid kyang legs par shes pa dang 'dra bar mngon sum snying thig gi gnad/42

g.yukhogablamachosadobyingasarangagrolagyigasungo'abum/ āḥdabyings thig dngabacasapa'i lhag mthang thams cad kyi rgyal pa rig pa rtag med rda rje lu gu rgyud dngo sumathongaba'o/ /mchan/ rig pa dngos su mthong bas/ lta sgom yin snyam la ragatshom las/ gzhi mthong bas ldog pa'i sa med par 'khor 'das dus gcig latshodapa'i rnal 'byor ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ yang gsang bla med du gzhi gdod ma'i gnas lugs/ lam lta sgom spyod gsum/ 'bras bu mthar thug gi grol tshul dang bcas pa rgyas par bstan pa yin te/ slob dpon bi ma la'isgron ma snang byed las/ phyi skor lus dang 'dra ste tha snyad rgya cher bstan/ /nang skor mig dang 'dra ste mthong ba brda yi chos/ /gsang skor snying dang 'dra bas dran byed gzungs kyi chos/ /'di ni lus kun rdzogs pa'i skyes bu 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/ yang gsang bla med 'di la sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud sogs rgyud bcu bdun dang / sngags srung khros ma'i rgyud dang bco brgyad bzhugs/ de nyid las/ gnyis pa don gyi thog tu dbab pa ni/ rig par rang thog tu babs nas dngos su ngo sprad pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi snang ba mthong ba la zer ro/ /de'ang dngos su bstan du med par rig pa zhes thun mong ba rnams kyis badzwod kyang thog tu mi phebs te/ rdo rje gdan ma mthong bar de'i lo rgyus bshad pa'am/dmus long bshad pa bzang pos kha dog gzhan la 'chad pa dang 'dra'o/ /res rig pa skye med stong pa yin no snyam/ res sna tshogs 'char ba yin snyam/ de gnyis tshig gis khrid kha legs legs pos ngo bo stong pa nam mkha' 'dra la 'char tshul ma 'gags pa me long gi gzugs brnyan 'aspi'o zhes 'chad kyang da lta yod yod ngo / phug na stong phyam ci yang med pa cig kho na la gdeng 'cha' bas/43

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥtheg pa rim dgu'i lta sgom spyod pas sangs mi rgya ste zhes dang / dga' rab deo rjes/ yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i lta ba nyon re mongs/ /de la brten pa'i sgom pa yi re mug /de las byung ba'i spyod pa thang re chad/ /de la 'bras bu re ba yongs re 'khrul/ /zhes so/ /'dir rig pa lu gu rgyud mthong ba na rig pa'i rang bzhin la bzang ngan dang 'pho 'gyur med par thams cad de'i ngang las 'gro sa gzhan med pas/ gzhi zhes bya ste gzhan du 'chol mi srid do/ /zhes gsungs/ mdor na bka' drin can gyis/ theg mchog mdzod kyi rim khang bco brgyad par dngos gzhi'i sgra bshad skabs/ rdzogs pa chen po pa kha cig gis chos gzhi la lus pa sogs gsungs pa ni phyi skor la gsungs pa dang / yang man ngag kha cig thog ma gnad thog tu phebs kyang sogs gsungs pa ni spyir nang skor dang khyad par gsang skor la gsungs pa yin pas 'di ni shin tu gal che bas yang yang zhib cha byed dgos gsungs pa dang / ye shes bla ma las mu bzhi bshad pa'i skabs/khregs chod las thod rgal dngos su rtsal du bton pa mi snang bas phal bas shin tu go dka' yang 'dir ni kun mkhyen snga phyi'i bzhed pa/ dngos ni spyir zhing sku pho brang gsum gyi rang bzhin dbyings thig rig gsum yin la/ khyad par lhag mthong thams cad kyi rgyal po rig pa rtog med rdo rje lu gu rgyud yin tshul 'di nyid ma shes na khregs chod las khyad du 'phags tshul bdun sogs mi shes pas phan tshun zhabrugs shing mgo rmongs par 'gyur ro gsungs/ rdo grub rin po ches gzhi zhes pa gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi zlas drangs pa'i gzhi dang / dngos zhes pa mngon sum du rtogs pa/ gling sprul gyis/ dngos zhes pa rtogs bya'i don dngos 44

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarangagrolagyigasunga'abumo/ āḥdang / gzhizhes pa rten nam rgyu'am thabs zhes pa'i dan du gsungs/ mkhan po ngag chungagis/ gzhi zhes pa rjod byed dang / dngos brjod bya la gsungs/(khe rang lugs ngo sprod spros pa las/ snang ba sems su ngo sprad pa/ sems nyidastongapar ngo sprad pa/ stong pa rig par ngo sprad pa gsum gsungs pa la/dgongs gzhi ni phyi yul la don gzhan du bden par 'dzin pa rnams drang pa'i phyir dang/ dgos ched ni/ phyi rol don du grub par 'dzin pa'i bden zhen spang ba tsam dang / dngos la gnod byed ni/ snang ba sems yin na sems la dbyibs dang kha dog sogs yod dgos par thal ba dang / sems 'gags dus snang ba dus der 'gags par thal ba las/ sems med pa'i skabs su'ang snang ba yod 'dug pas kyang gnod pa la sogs mang zhing de gsum sgra ji bzhin pa yin na phan tshun 'chol bas/ rig pa 'khrul par thal ba dang snang ba mig la sogs pas mi mthong bar thal ba dang / sems ma 'khrul bar thal ste/ de gsum ngo bo rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsungs/ de rnams ni 'og ma kha drang ba tsam las snying thig gi dgongs pa'i phyogs su mi nye ba'i tshul ni rgyud rang shar las/ snang ba sems kyi rnal 'byor ni/ /thams cad nga yi sems las byung / /sems nyid rtogs na ji byar yod/ /de kun kun tu rjod byed pa/ /nga yis grol bar ma bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes dgos pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin no/ /de ltar snang sems gnyis ka gcig tu 'dod na skyon mtha' yas pa yod pa rnams/ kun mkhyen chen pos snang ba sems su 'dod pa ni log rtog mun pa chen po yin pas bsal dgos zhes spyir theg mchog rin po che'i 45

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmadzod sogs dang / bye brag yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod 'grel padma dkar po las rgyas par bkag yod pa la gzigs shig mi pham rin po che'i dbu ma rgyan 'grel dang de'i dogs sel gyi skabs su yang tha snyad du sems las gzhan pa'i phyi don med na/ lus sems gnyis ka rdzas gcig tu 'dod pa mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i grub mtha' yin tshul dang / gnas snang sogs mi phyed par ri la sogs pa sems yin zhes zer ba la lung dang rigs pas tshar bcad pa dang /bka' drin can kyis kyang ye shes bla ma gsungs pa'i skabs gong du bshad pa'i lung gong 'og gnyis ka'i brjod bya'i don 'di ltar du gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang snang sems ma bu 'phrad tshul gsungs pa dang / dpe don gyi 'od gsal bshad pa'i skabs/ snang ba dang snang yul phye tshul sogs rang rang gi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin shes dgos pas phan tshun bsre bslad mi phyed par gal che/ yon bye mdo gnyis la phyi rol gyi don yod par smra ba zer/ sems tsam pa'am rnam par shes pa tsam du smra ba de'i ming rnal 'byor pa'ang zer sems tsam pa la dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang ba shes pa dang bcas pa 'di thams cad rang gi sems kyi rnam par 'dod pa rnam bden pa dang / shes pa'i rnam par rdzun pa gnyis las/ dang po ni don du snang ba rang gi shes pa'i rnam pa phyir shar ba tsam ste/ rdzing 'gram gyi nor bu shing gi yal ga la btags pas nor bu ke ke ru'i gzugs brnyan chu nang du shar ba na nor bu'i rnam pa phyi rol du shar ba bzhin no/ /zhes 'dod do/ /rnam bden pa la sgong nga phyed tshal ba/ gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa gsum/ gnyis pa rnam rdzun pa ni phyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdonagyirnam pa yin gyi shes par bden pa ma yin la/ de 'jal byed kyi shes pa yangardzunapas gzhal bya'i myong ba bden pa bas gzhal ba ni med de/ yul shes gnyisakayang zhabrul snang rdzun pa'i rang bzhin can du 'dod do/ /'di la dri bcasapa dang dri med pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ da lta'i rnam pa sna tshogs su snangabadang de 'jal ba'i shes pa gnyis ka blo'i dri ma nyid snang tsam las/ don dmapar gnyis su med pa'i ye shes khams kyi yon tan bcas pa tsam zhig yod kyi/ rnam shes su grub pa ci yang med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos sku lhag ma med pa ni/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid de/ dri ma med pa'i de bzhin nyid yin la lhag bcas kyi gnas skabs na bag la nyal gyi dri ma cung zad yad pas 'khrul bar snang ba gzigs pa dang / ro rgyab snyung ba la sogs pa yod do/ /zhes pa dang / da lta'i sems la nyon mongs pa dang ye shes 'dres par gnas pa'i dri ma nyon mongs pa'i cha rdzun pa bsal bas/ lhag ma med pa'i ye shes dag pa mngon du byed pa'o/ /zhes 'dod do/ /theg mchog mdzod ltar lags/ ༈ sems tsam pas phyi don du med par rang sems du 'dod pa dang de'ang rnam bden pa ltar na rnam pa ji ltar snang ba bzhin tu sems su bden par 'dod/ rnam rdzun pa ltar na rnam pa de dang sems 'khrul ba'i rdzun snang du 'dod/ sems tsam pas gang zag gi bdag med par ma zad/ chos bdag gzung 'dzin gnyis kas stong yang gnyis med kyi shes pa mi stong bas gzhan stong du 'dod/ dbu ma pas chos thams cad rang stong du 'dod/ rton sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel ba shing rta chen mo las/ de'ang yid kyis skad cig dang por rig kyang dpyod pas rjes ma 47

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā mthud na las mi sog par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad 'dod de/ ji skad du/ tog rtsa ba'i do ha las/ tshogs drug yul gyi rnam par shes/ /'dzin pas ma bslad de kho na/ /las med rnam par smin pa med/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par mthong / /zhes dang / rdzogs chen las/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gsal ba la/ /yid kyis zhen rtog ma zhugs na/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de ka rang / /zhes dang / sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ma gol ba yi bsgom pa ni/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams gsal ba'o/ /zhes dang / dpal sa ra has/ bsam dang bsam bya rab tu spangs nas su/ /bsam med bu chung tshul du gnas bya zhing / /zhes dang grub sha ba ri pas/ rlung ni mi bsnyeng yid ni mi bcing bar/ /ma bcos shes pa bu chung lta bur zhog /ces bu chung gi rgyud la sgra don 'dres rung yod du chug kyang 'dres 'dzin med la/ skyes ma thag pa rtog dpyod zhugs mi shes pa la dper byas so/ /rnam shes de dag gis las sog tshul ni/ kun mkhyen chen pos/de yang chags sdang rags pa'i dge sdig gi/ /'dod par 'du byed bag chags kun gzhir brten/ mi rtog gsal snang gzugs su 'du byed la/ /mi rtog rtse gcig gzugs med bag chags brten/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin glo bur sgrib pa gnyis/ /dus rnam kun tu nye bar brten pa min/ /zhes sems nyid ngal gso las gsungs pa dang / gang du mi rtog rtse gcig lung ma bstan/ /gsal zhing rig tsam rtog pa med pa dang / /g.yo ba'i kun rtog sna tshogs rnam pa gsum/ /gzugs med gzugs dang 'dod pa'i sems nyid de/ /ting 'dzin de las khams gsum nye bar skye/ /'khor ba nyid las grol ba'i skabs med do/ /48
