g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥng bdag gzung 'dzin 'di ni 'khor ba'i rtsa ba sdug bsngal gyi 'byung khungs sa —lam gyi bkag rdo yin pas rkun po ngos zin pa lta bu yin no/ /gnyis pa mtshang btsal ba ni/ da ni khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum po min pa'i nga zer ba zhig e yod brtags pas de ni med do/ /nga zer sa de lus ngag yid gsum la zer bas gsum po de so so ma yin gcig bden du bzung nas nga zer ba yin pas khyod kyi de ltar 'dod na khyod kyi lus 'di mig gis mthong bya dang / ngag 'di rna bas thos bya zhig yin pas khyod kyi yi da 'di gzugs dbyibs kha dog sogs snang dgos pa'i skyon 'bab ni red/ ngag dang yid gcig yin na yid 'di tshor dgos pa'i skyon 'bab ni red/ lus ngag yid gsum gcig yin na lus ngag gnyis mthong thos mi rung ba'i snyon 'bab ni red/du ma yin na khyod du ma yod dgos pa'i skyon 'bab ni red/ rgyu ma tshan ci'i phyir na/ khyod kyi phung po lnga po'i nang nas gzugs lta bu gcig la mtshon na/ skra nyi khri chig stong / sen mo nyi shu/ so sum cu rtsa gnyis/ rus pa'i dum bu sum brgya dang re bzhi/ don snod bcu gnyis/ sha lpagasakhrag chu ser rkang klad pa klad rgyas rtsa rgyus chu rgyus la sogs pa'i grangs yod dgos pa'i skyon 'bab ni red/ de dag thams cad so sor rdul phran cha med du phab dus khyod de'i grangs yod dgos pas mi rung ngo / /ngag gi brjod pa lta bu la mtshon na rkan dang mchu dang lce dang mgrin pa dang rlung gi 'gro 'ong sogs du ma tshogs dgos pas mi 'thad do/ /yid kyi rtog tshogs du ma 'phro bas khyod de'i grangs yod dgos pa'i skyon 'bab ni red/ de lta bus brtag shing dpyad pa'i tshe lus rdul phran cha med du dwangs dus 149

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥlus ye nas ma grub pas snang stong chu zla lta bu dang / ngag ye nas ma grub parurjes med rang yal grags stong brag cha lta bu dang / sebees ye nas ma grub pasartog tshogs rang yal rjes med nam mkha'i bya rjes lta bu'o/ /don dam rang ngorunas ma grub cing tha snyad snang tshul du mar snang ba'o/ /de ltar du ma yod pas ri'abor gcig bden 'gog ni red/ phung po du ma 'dus pa las byung ba'i 'dus byas skad cig ma yin pas rtag 'dzin 'gog ni red/ gcig dang tha dad gang khuṭwāṃ kyāo/ba/ pa'i mtshang rig pa yin no/ /nga bdag dang chos kyi bdag gtan la phabagasum pa byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtags pa ni/ nga med la nga ru 'dzinabadag med bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di dang po gang nas byung / bar du gang la gnas/tha ma gang du 'gro brtag /byung mkhan/ gnasamakhan/ 'gro mkhan dang yulayul can drug gi sgo nas brtag dgos te/ de yang phyi snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten/bar g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can/ nang bdag lus phung khams skye mched la sogs pa gang nas byung gang la gnas/ gang du 'gro brtags shing dpyad dus/dang po byung ba'i rgyu med pas skye ba'i rgyu stong / bar du gnas pa'i mkhan po med pas mkhan po rang gi ngo bo stong / tha ma 'gro ba'i mtshan nyid med pas 'gags pa rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gnad don legs par rtogs na shing sdong po'i rtsa ba bcad tsa na lo 'dabs thams cad ngang gis skam pa bzhin no// ༈rdzogs chen pas/ gcig dang / du ma brtag pa'i skabs su gang zag gi bdag gtan la phab pa yin no/ /byung gnas 'gro gsum brtags pa'i skabs 150

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsu chos kyi bdag gtan la phab pa yin gsungs/ yi ge 'di la yid brtan mi bya bar brtags shing dpyad dgos pa yin no/ /mag/ phyi nang snod bcud kyi chos thams cad blos phar btags pa ma gtogs don rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam med/ phyi snod 'jig rten nang bcud sems can bar 'dod yon gyi bkod pa thams cad blos btags pa tsam las bden grub yod med brtags nas bden med sgru ma rmi lam lta bu yin par thag chod tshe nges shes de'i ngang la 'jog dgos/ de'i tshe dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba dang / rdzogs chen pa'i byung gnas 'gro gsum lta ba gang mtho zhe na byung gnas 'gro gsum lta bas mtho/ dbu mas nges shes lcags skud sgrim ma lta bu dgos pa yin/ rdzogs chen byung gnas 'gro gsum skabs ngo bo'i gdangs las shar cha 'gag med yod dgos pa de khyad gzhi'i steng nas khyad chos de red gsungs/ byung gnas 'gro gsum lta ba snang stong zung 'jug /snang bzhin pa'i gnas skabs na stong / stong bzhin pa'i gnas skabs na snang / snang stong zung 'jug chu zla lta bu/ stong nyid bzhi sbrags ni/ gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /dngos gzhi rig pa'i rang ngo sprad pa la/ sems dang rig pa'i dbye ba/ rnam shes dang ye shes dbye ba/ kun gzhi chos sku'i dbye ba/ bzhi cha gsum bra' gyi dgongs pa ni/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa dang bral/ bzhi pa'i cha rig stong thig le nyag cig 'di ngos 'dzin dgos pa red/ rig pa ni 'dus ma byas pa dper na dngul chu rdul dang ma 'dres pa lta bu/ rig pa'i klong nas shar cha phra rags ci tsam shar 151

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥkyang phan gnod med par rang ngor dwangs 'gro ba yin/ sems ni ma rig pa 'dus byas skye 'gag can dper na sa nang du chu thigs lhung ba lta bu/ yul gang shar na der 'dzin nas 'byul ba yin/ rnam shes dang ye shes rlung gis dbye dgos gsungs/ kun gzhi dang chos sku'i dbye ba ni/ kun gzhi de la gnyis las/dang po ye don gyi kun gzhi ni bde gshegs snying po zag med kyi chos khams rgya mtsho lta bu sku dang ye shes kyi 'char gzhi yin/ gnyis pa ma dag lubor ba'i kun gzhi ni zag bcas kyi chos gtso sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang 'khor sems byung lnga bcu/ phra ba kun rtog brgyad cu 'dod chags rtog pa bzhi bcu/zhesdang rtog pa so gsum/gti mug rtog pa bdun mchan/ dang bcas pa'i 'char gzhi yin/ kun gzhi ni rtog pa snga ma'i bag chags bsogs pa'i snod lta bu/ rtog pa phyi ma rnams mched pa'i rten byed ni red gsungs/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ skyes bu gcig ngal bso lta bu'i tshe shes pa dar cig gang du yang mi rtog par lung ma bstan du gnas pa kun gzhi dang / de las dar cig snang yul ma 'gags par lam me gsal yang der 'dzin ma zhugs pas gsal la rtog med kyi rnam pa de kun gzhi'i rnam shes yin gsungs/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes de las sgo lnga'i rnam shes 'char/ de las yid rtog bcas mched/ de las nyon yid ma ni red/ yid rtog dang nyon yid rnams ma 'gags bar du sgo lnga cha mnyam yod ni mngon ni ma red/ yid rtog dang nyon yid gnyis rags pa/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes phra ba/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes shin tu phra ba yin gsungs/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes mched 'gag gi rnam pa can dang / sgo lnga'i rnam shes skye 'gag gi rnam pa can dang / yid shes 152

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdang nyon yid gnyis gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa can yin/ sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ma gol ba yi sgom pa ni/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams gsal ba'o/ /zhes sgo lnga cha mnyam du yod dus gnas cha yod ni red/ gnas cha de la dwangs cha ma/ thon na dud 'gror skye 'gro ni red/ gsal cha thon na lhod cha ma thon nas rang rgyud la zhen 'dzin gyi 'ching bas bcing yod ni red/ de lhod thabs ni/ res lhod/ res grim/ de yang yang spel ma byed bcug na nyi ma bdun brgyad tsam re'i lhod shes 'ong ni red gsungs/ lhod cha thon nas shar cha yod ni red na rtog pa rjes mthud med par grol 'gro dgos/ ma grol na 'dod khams su gol bas de rnams dang ma ldan na gol sa gsum yod ni red/ yid shes kyi steng na nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum po la 'dzin zhen yod na khams gsum du gol ni red/sgo lnga las mig shes steng nas gol na gzugs khams su skye 'gro/ de ltar gol sa bdun po de dag sno lnga cha mnyam du legs par bzhag shes na gol sa chod 'gro gsungs/ yang rtog bcas yid kyi shes pa de'i yul phyi 'dzin dang nang 'dzin gnyis byed ni red/ phyi 'dzin ni 'das pa'i rjes gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun bsu/ da lta'i phyi nang gi mtshan 'dzin byed/ yul gzugasasgra la sogs pa la mtshan mar 'dzin ni red/ nang 'dzin ni mnyam bzhag gi dus yul bde ba la yul can yid shes des yul bde bar 'dzin/ gsal ba la gsal bar 'dzin/ mi rtog pa la stong par 'dzin/ nyon yid kyis thun bcad dus mnyam bzhag legs par yong na dga' bas 'dod chags/ bying rgod sogs skye dus de la mi dga' ba'i rnam pa zhe sdang sogs skye ba yin/ nyams bde gsal mi rtog 153

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasum gang skye tshe/ yul de yul can yid kyis shes pas yul de la 'dzin cing zhen nas yang yang goms pa'i stobs kyis yul dang yul can gnyis med du 'dres te rtog med tshul du gnas ni red gsungs/ dus gsum gyi rnam rtog dang ma 'dres pa'i shes pa gsal stong bzo bcos med pa zhig de na shar yod pa de la rig pa zer/ de ni rnam rtog thams cad kyi 'char gzhi dang grol sa yin pas ka dag gzhi'i rig pa'am chos sku yin no/ /rjes nyams len gyis skyong tshul ni/ lta ba/ sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu dang bzhi las/ dang po rang ngo 'phrod pa lta ba ni/ lta ba spros bral gyi rang bzhin 'di lam sgom pas nyams su blangs na/ de la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ skyobs rnga 'i nus mthu sogs yod la/ mkhyen cha 'gag pa med pa kun shes kun rig gi cha/ dbyings spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/rang gdangs 'gag pa med pa'i ye shes rig stong zung 'jug gi lta ba ngos zin dgos pas/ 'das pa'i rtog pa 'gags/ ma 'ong pa'i rtog pa ma skyes kyi bar de na shar yod pa de rig pa red gsungs/ mdo ltar bde gshegs snying po/rdzogs chen nga sa gnyug ma'i sems 'od gsal gyi rig pa shar yod pa red gsungs/ da lta'i shes rig ma 'gags sa le ba/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po de ka'o/ /cir yang ma grub stong dbyings kun bzang mo/ /de phyir rtogs na skad cig rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes dang / shes rig rang tshugs ma shor na/ /'di las lhag pa gzhan na med/ /ces dang / khregs chod tshig brgya'i mdo 'gag ni/ /rjen par phud la sa ler skyongs/ /zhes dang / ma yengs mi 154

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsgom don gyi rang zhal blta/ /'khor 'das chos sku ye sangs rgyas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /lta ba yin min gyi re dogs med pa la/ nges shes gting nas skyes/ kho thag nang nas chod dgos so/ /gnyis pa ngang la gnas pa sgom pa ni/ dang po 'brul ba'i skabs dran pas zin pa ni rdzi bu lta bu'i dran pa de 'du byed kyi dran pa zer/ rig thog tu thon dus chos nyid kyi dran pa'i rnam ldan du 'du byed kyi dran pa dwangs dgos gsungs/gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i sgom pa ni bzung dran 'gyu dran zhig gis bzung ba'i bcos ma glo bur ba'i bsgom ltar skye e shes bltas kyang mi shes la dgos kyang mi dgos/ rig pa mngon sum rtogs pa nas bzung / me yin na tsha ba dang chu yin tsam nas brlan pa bzhin tu chos nyid rang babs kyi dran pa rig pa dang ngo bo gcig par yod pa las bcos sgom ltar 'dzin mi dgos par thag chod dgos/ de ltar brtags pas sngar gyi chos nyid rang babs kyi bsam gtan bzung dran 'gyu dran gang gis kyang bzung mi dgos par de'i steng nas bshad dgos/ de lta bu'i sgom pa de rdzogs chen rang lugs kyi ming btags na chos nyid kyi dran pa/ gnyug ma'i dran pa/ blo 'das kyi dran pa/ rtsod bral rang bzhag gi dran pa/ dran mchog rgyal po zhes ming lnga btags kyang don chos nyid rang babs kyi bsam gtan dang don gcig yin no/ /ma bcos par lhod ngo 'jog dgos gsung pa ltar bca' bcos re dogs blo sna tshab tshub mi byed par dwangs ba rgya mtsho lta bu/ sang ba me tog lta bu/ gsal ba nyi zla lta bu/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu/ chu chad pa'i rang tha/ sdu bu/ las zin pa'i skyes bu lta bu lhod

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingalorang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpor 'jog dgos/ bying cha dwangs ba'i dwangs cha/ rmugs cha sangs ba'i gsal cha/stong cha dag pa'i rjen cha/ sems bying ba rags pa rnam rtog dang / phra ba dpe me long la has btab pa lta bu/ mnyam bzhag ngar cha nyams pa de la zer/ rmugs pa gsal cha sgrib byed la zer/ 'thib pa'i sa bud nas rgya yan/ kun mkhyen 'jigs bra' gling pas/ sems gsal stong zhi gnas 'dzin pa can/ /yid rtog dpyod kyi lhag mthong g.yo 'phrul po/ /dbyings lung ma bstan gyi byar med gsum/ /'di gsum po rdzogs chen khyu nas bud/ /sgom dran 'dzin gnyen po'i 'ching ba dang / /blo ched 'dzin byas pa'i stong nyams can/ /blo go yul dred pa'i rgyas 'debs gsum/ /khyod gsum yang rdzogs chen khyu nas bud/ /sems 'du shes grung po'i lta sgom dang / /blo go rar 'thum pa'i nyams zhen dang / yid myang bya'i dra mas sbag de gsum/ /khyed gsum yang rdzogs khyu nas bud/ /ces so/ /a 'thas 'jur bus bcings gyur na/ /ye shes rang ngo phar phar bsgribs nas 'gro/ /zhes dang / bca' bcos med par rang ngang la dwangs sa le yangs khrol le yengs med 'dzin med du bskyangs ba gnad yin no/ /nyag blas mnyam bzhag gi rang sa ma zin na bying ba las 'da' mi nus gsungs/ o rgyan chen pos/ yun thung grangs mang khang stong thig pa dgos gsungs/ las dang po bas snang ba dwangs dus yun thung grangs mang nyin gcig la dran pa brgya sogs bsten kyang chog /ma dwangs dus yin min thams cad snom du brtsi mi nyan/ bying rmugagā 'thib gsum gyi skyon gyis gos 'ong gsungs/ rnam rtog rgod pa'i dus su phaṭa kyas gcod dgos so/ / 166

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā gsum pa gang shar rang grol gyi spyod pa ni/ rtsal phra rags ci tsam shar yang rjes mthud med par grol dgos pa dper na rgya mtsho'i rlabs la bsams na rlabs thams cad kyang rgya mtsho'i rnam rol rnam 'gyur yin pas na rgya mtsho las logs su ngan pa zhig gang yang med/ tshur ded na rgya mtsho rang gi ngo bo las gzhan du 'phyo sa med par rang gi kloong du gcig pa'am/ dpe de bzhin du kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i chos thams cad phar ded na ye shes chen po gcig gi cho rol rnam rol rnam 'gyur yin pas ngan pa med/ tshur ded na thams cad ye shes chen po gcig gi klong las mi 'da' zhing gcig pas bzang ngan rang ngos na med/phar ded tshur ded 'di'i thog nas shes dgos so/ /khregs chod lam shar grol lha mdzes pa la rgyan btags pa lta bu yin gsungs/ rnam rtog gi rjes su mi 'brang / mi bkag /ye grol zhes pa ni/ gzhi rig stong zung 'jug gi lta ba de nyid ye gdod ma nas grol ba'i bdag nyid can yin te/ da gzod 'bad pas sus kyang grol mi dgos zhes 'bad pa dang rtsol ba'i sgo nas sus kyang grol mi dgos te/ grol ba med de grol gzhi rdul tsam med/ /ces gsungs so/ /shar grol zhes khang stong gi rkun ma lta bu'i grol tshul ni khang stong la shor rgyu dang /rkun ma la thob rgyu med pa ltar/ rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad bag chags bsogs longs med par lta ba'i klong der grol ba'o/ /rang grol zhes sgrul gyi mdud pa lta bu'i grol tshul ni/ sprul mdud de gzhan rkyen la ltos mi dgos par rang stobs kyis zhig 'gro ba ltar/ rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad gzhan la ltos mi dgos par rang stobs kyi rang grol ba'o/ /cer grol zhes sngar 'dris kyi 157

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā mi dang 'phrad pa ltar rtog pa yul la g.yeng ba'i tshe dran pas zin tsam nas dran ོ༵kha/na/ chos nyid du stor ba'i dus/ thog ma'i skyong tshul ma nor ba yin gsungs bzhi pa sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu ni/ ngo bo zhes pa de dbyibs dang kha dog dang bral ba de stong pa chos sku/ stong bzhin du go mkhan tshor mkhan tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa de rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ thugs rje kun khyab phyi gsal ltar sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i 'char sgo ji snyed yod pa sprul sku/mnyam bzhag skabs lta ba sgom pa spyod pa 'bras bu rnams gzhi klong gcig tu rdzogs pa yin no/ /ngo bo stong nyams ngar cha dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin gsal nyams sangs cha dang ldan pa/ thugs rje'i rig nyams grol cha dang ldan pa/tshogs lam ri mo bris pa'i zla ba lta bu pas go/ sbyor lam chu zla lta bu pas myong /mthong lam gnam zla lta bu pas rtogs/ grogs khyod yong ba tshor tsam na/ /gnas lugs thog tu pheb 'dug kyang / /da dung de la goms gyur na/ /yong tshor tsam gyi dran pa de/ /yul med sangs ba'i dus shig yod/ /de tshe dran snang ye shes su/ /'char ba'i mgo bo brtsam pa yin/ /de yi ngang mdangs bskyang gyur na/ /nam zhig yongs yul tshogs drug bcas/ /nyi ma sprin las grol ba bzhin//de dag mdor na 'di ltar lags/ khes bya yul dang shes byed blo/ /gnyisasu med pa'i ye shes ni/ /mnyam pa nyid du shar ba'i tshe/ /yengs yul chos nyid song ba yin/ /zhes so/ /rdzogs pa chen po 'bras bu lam byed snye ma'i mgul ba nas 'chang ba lta bu yin no/ /theg mchog a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i rang lugs 168

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang gro' gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsu ka dag spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes chen po da lta'i shes pa zang ka ma'am rig stong go ma 'gags pa'i gnas lugs kho na'i rang gshis la lta zhing /'khor ba med snang du shes pa dang sku gsum lam snang du rdzogs pa/ 'bras bu zer ba gud nas thob pa'ang ma yin pa da lta'i rig pa chen po'i steng du ye rdzogs sam gzhi rdzogs su yod pas/ gang snang ye shes kyi rol ba/ thams cad rig rtsal gyi rang bzhin bsal bzhag bral ba snang srid dag mnyam chen por rtogs pas 'bras bu'i chos rnams kyang rig pa kho'i rang ngor ye rdzogs su 'dug pa thag chod nas gnyis med ka dag chen po'i grol sa la gnas kyang / rtag khyab lhun grub chen po'i skur bzhengs te 'gro ba'i don byed pa rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba yin no/ /'phros don ni/ mi pham rin po ches/ de yang rang lugs rdo rje rtse mo'i grub mtha' snyogs mi snyogs kyi gnad ni/ thos bsam rgya chen po dang bsags sbyang phyi tshul ji ltar phun sum tshogs par byas kyang / de kho nas thun min lam gyi grub mtha' zin pa'i nges pa med cing / rdzogs pa chen po'i don brgyud dang ldan pa'i bla ma sems nyid chos skur ngo sprod pa'i man ngag snyan khung brgyud nus pa rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i mi yi tshul du bstan pa'i bshes gnyen chen po de lta bu gang na yod kyang / yon tan de kho nas sangs rgyas dang mtshungs par rnyed darka/'a ba'i 'du shes kyis sgo gsum g.yo zol med par gus pas bsten nas thugs mdzod lon pa de gcig pus rdo rje snying po'i grub mtha' snyogs pa 'byung bas na/ rgyal ba rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang bcas pas yang yang gsungs pa ltar/gsang sngags snying po'i lam tshol rnams kyis bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dbang 159

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbazhi pa'i ye shes la myong ba can bsten par bya ba las/ gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan pa 'di kho na mi shes su mi rung ba'i gnad yin pas/ rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi lam ma nor ba 'di la lam nyid du ngo shes pa'i nges shes su la ldan pa de la gsang sngags snying po'i skal ba yod pa'i phyir/ thob grangs dang bzlas grangs bla ma mang po bsten pa'i grangs tsam zhig la blo gdeng mi 'cha' bar/rang sems chos skur ngo sprod pa 'i man ngag zab mo dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal nas mnyan te/ de la nan tan snying por bya ba 'di kho na bshad bshad kyi snying po/sgrub sgrub kyi 'bras bu/ btsal btsal gyi don po yin pas gnad 'di ma stor bar gyur pa cis kyang gal che'o/ /zhes gsung sa pa ltar/ tshe rabs sngon las kyi bla ma zer rgyu bo/ gsungs pas rgyud la phan thog pa/ nges shes 'drongs pa de la dga' ba zhig yin ni red/ 'di nas byang chub bar du gsol ba btab/ thugs yid dbyer med bsre/ ye shes bla ma 'di mngon du gyur nas bzung ste nam yang 'bral ba med par bsgom/ zhes so/ /rje mi las/ sgom tu med kyang rtsal la sbyangs rgyu yod/ /rnal 'byor sgom pa bshigs kyin bzang / /phu chu drag po brdab kyin bzang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsal sbyangs gnad lda na sbyang thub na bying rmug 'thib gsum sel ba dang bogs thon pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /nyag bla padma bdud 'dul gyis sa steng gser gyi mchod rten gyis bkang ba bas/ nges pa'i ting 'dzin dus gcig sgom pa 'phags/ skra rtse nas chu thig pang du lhung tshe bar sgom na bskal ba gcig gi sdig pa dag /ces so/ /nyag blas/ mnyam bzhag la nan tan yun bsrings te snying rus ma thub na kha lta stong skad kyi lta rgog 160

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdang / 'gro 'dug lam khyer gyis sgom snang tsam gyis sems rgyud grol shin tu dka'o/ /spyod lam skabs dran pa bsten na 'khrul ba'i dod po min kyang /mnyam bzhag brtan cha med na bying ba las mi 'da' gsungs/ rang gis dang po dad pa dam tshig dang phyin chod bsgom dgos zer tshe/ thams cad kyis de ltar sgrub par thag bcad nas/ ring lam/ nye lam/ myur lam/ shin tu myuru lam theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse la heb lang nas khyed shes khyed mkhyen zer kyang /lag tu len dus mkhris nad can gyi sngon du btso zan 'jog pa ltar sgom mkhan nyin mo'i skar ma lta bu gcig gnyis re zung tsam las dkon pa mthong chos red/bla ma rin po ches/ rig ngo 'phrod dus bsod nams zad song na ma gtogs bskom dgos ni red/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum 'di ni/ zhing las so nam phyugs kyi 'tsho skyong dkor kha grong chog /gor li/ sha skal/ ja tho/ nas spar/ 'khor ba'i bya bzhag sogs kyis bya ba gang la'ang brje mi bra nges pa red/ spyon pa sos thang 'dug mi tshugs pa rnams ni/ man ngag gi gnad ma lon pa'i mtshang bud pa yin/ mnyam bzhag tu sku gsum gyi bzhugs tshul ni/ khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid can ngo bo stong nyams ngar cha dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin gsal nyams sangs cha dang ldan pa/ thugs rje rig nyams grol cha dang ldan pas rtog pa gang shar kyang bag chags bsogs long mi 'dug /rjes thob skabs su las rgyu 'bras de la de las zhib cha che ba yin/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar ni'i nyams len pa zhig yin na las rgyu 'bras kyi gnas la mi zhib thabs gtan nas med gsungs/161

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma/ bla ma'i lung tshad ma/ rang gi rig pa tshad ma gsum dang dad pa snying rje nges 'byung gsum rang shugs kyis rdol tshe gzhan la the tshom gcad mi dgos/ rdzogs pa po kloong chen snying thig ltar 'khor lo'i mgon po'i khrid rgyun ltar nyams su len tshul gnad rnams phyogs bsgrigs byed pa la nyes 'gal gang mchis bla ma dang srung ma'i drung du mthol lo bshags so/ /dad ldan bstan pa tshe ring gis gsang chen me tog tshal gyi dpal ri'i nang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po'i sku 'dra zhig bzhengs/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi don du lam gyi dka' gnad mngon byung zhig bri dgos zhes bskul tshe zhal ngo ma ldog tsam du dharma rang gi 'brel yod mched grogs rnams dang gzhan la 'chad thub pa re yod na gal che snyam nas bris pa yin pas khong rnams kyis gzigs rtogs mdzad nas nyams su gnad ldan zhig len pa sku mkhyen/ dad rten yang nyams su len na ma gtogs nyams su len mi nus kyang yi ge re 'tshags nas de dpe nyob nang du gar song ma go na nyams chag dang sngags kyi srung ma rnams kyis lus ldog yod pas gazlob par mdzod/dzoms su ༵na zlo'i gang zag mtho ṭwāṃlhan/ ༵ rba/bye ṅga ༷/༵/ /ca/da/ ma gnas chos sku' gtan —da zan pa'i rgyur gyur 162

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄7ོ/ /grub dbang lcags skong gter chen rin po che khrag 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhal rgyun mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma g.yu khog bya bral chos dbyings rang grol rin po ches bstsal ba'i zin bris bzhugs so//grub dbang gter chen bla ma sge'u gter gyi zhal rgyun mtshungs med bla ma rin po che g.yu khog bya bral bas dgyes bzhin du bstsal ba nyams kyis dogs nas sha zin spu zin du bris pa la/ rgyal mo'i g.yung drung tshe brtan gyis snang sbyang zhes pa'i don dris pa la/ 'khrul snang las grub pa'i phyi nang snod bcud yul yul can gyi 'brul ba dang bcas pa snang stong zung 'dug tu sbyang dgos pas/de sbyong byed yin pas snang sbyang rjozer ni red gsungs/ snang sbyang gi dbu zhabs thams cad mtshan don 'dis khebs dgos/ rang bzhin zhes pa'i steng 'di nas snang sbyang gi lta ba'i khog gi gnad de 'dzin dgos/ rang bzhin zhes pas 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin nam gnas lugs de stong pa nyid red/ de rtogs pas rtag lta dang rtag 'dzin gtor ni redadu/ stong nyid de yang stong gsum zhig song shul 'dra 'dra'i chad lta zhig ma red/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid las 'gag med du snang ba'i cha nas med pa cang med chad mtha' dang zhus spyi snadṛshā trīotrī shāosna shā ṭwāṃkā hāg/sa ni zhes pasdusdu che~Xsnarnyiotrī gātsa/nga skad du pa zhes par go ste dper na

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥchad 'dzin gtor ni red/ 'khor 'das lam gsum so sor phye nas bshad na/'khor ba'i chos phung po khams dang skye mched kyi rnam bzhag /rnal 'byor lam gyi snang ba mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob/ 'bras bu sku dang ye shes gsang gsum mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i chos thams cad ngo bo stong pa nyid yin pas rtag rnyitha'adangartaga'/spya gtor nired/ oya0destongapa dzinyid yin snatrī gnad ༵sna ṭwāṃ ṭī lhagapy-i gabye kta~X rnyitrī snapri ma~X trī py-ishā ṭwā rnyio~X kā rnyi/ byehūṃ sa/ swā 'di med song ni ma red/ sa 'di med song na sa'i stong nyid zer rgyu zig du'ajog rgyu yod ni ma red/ sa'i stong nyid zer rgyu bo de stong gsum zhig song shul 'dra 'dra'i stong lhub phyag gis sa la brdab nas mchan se bud song ni'i med snang stong snang zig la go nyan ni ma red mizhund lta red/ a le dkar po dge ba so dund 'gro ni shar 'dzam thang ma red du/ o ya sems can thams cad kyis sa 'di ril po gcig bden du bzung yod pas/ de'i ngo bo'am rang bzhin rtag brtan bden grub dang bral ba rgyu rkyen gyis byas pa can gyi rang bzhin can yin par shes na de'i sa'i rang bzhin la ril por gcig bur bden par 'dzin pa'i rtag 'dzin dang rtag mtha' gtor ni red/ cang mi shes ni tshos da 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi chos thams cad rgyu rkyen las skyes pa/ byas pa'i rang bzhin tsam du rtogs na de tsho bden med kyi phyogs su nye ni red/ de tsho 'u cig buphan ni red/sa'i snang cha 'di yod na sa dang sa'i stong nyid gnyis ka zung 'jug rgyu kha nyan ni (75 red/ sa'i nga nyid sha tsha ma zig (〈pen ni'i nga la nga pa nyid kyis sa ram̐shesna ༵ snro dzño / snoX ṅgernyi sna rnyistsu /'i don/16/༷sdu /ktoog nā'/bod slo /shigayirshatādībyi sdosno rno nd+ra dpang parabazhag pa 'i don/ tshude tshosacung zad/ ⑧rgyu②phyed kazhig po nga'i/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥru snang zer dus a le sa'i chos nyid dam rang bzhin stong nyid des chos can sa ru snang ba'i snang cha 'gag med 'di rgyal ba'i phyag gis bkab kyang khog ni ma red/ de 'dra'i snang stong zung 'jug zer rgyu de mdzu bu zhugashib gshib byas yod ni zig la go nyan ni ma red/ a le gang snang ba'i ngo bo 'di stong nyid dang / stong pa'i rang bzhin 'di las snang ba 'gag med du shar ba'i snang stong zung 'jug gi lam 'di shes dgos ni red/ a le khyed cha ge dzugacig tshang gi ya log nas ma log la kha gdangs mig gcer nas dril bu tsho'i mgo rgan mo tshos rdo risarjo'adzin 'dzin byas nas/ zung 'jug lam la ma brten par/ /mthar phyin 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /zer dusabasam gyi zigabuyod i mi dgos/ o ya/ snang ba'i chos thams cad 'og gi bdag med gnyis kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar so sor ngos zin par byas nas gang snang gang mthong thams cad snang stong zung 'jug tu mnyam bzhag ma zad rjes thob tu bun bun shig shig tu 'char thub pa zig ma 'ong gi bar du nyin na bsgom mtshan na bsam dgos ni red/ 'di mdo sngags thun mong gi yin pas 'di nyan pa la dbang bskur mi dgos skyad de'i red/sgyu ma'i dpe bcu yan chad pho skya mo nyog sus nyan kyang chog ni red/ stong pa las snang ba 'char tshul 'og gi sbru ma'i dpe brgyad kyi tshul du 'char bas/ 'dir sbyar nas bshad chog /de yan na rdzogs gyi ming tsam re las yod ni ma red/de man chad lung tsam bton kyang chog gsungs/ khong rig gibude 'dra byed gsungs/ 'di yan chad bshad los chog /khyed cha ge gcig tshang gi ya log ༵ñtshasdu ṭwāoṃ tt+waṃgañtsaḍāo ñdzi byi snagi nā nga/ tshig ste /sdus zhes pa' don/ a rdung byed kyi rdo ral/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnas mar 'khor de thos grol 'don dus shes bya sbru ma'i dpe bcu de bzhin du//'khor 'das chos rnams khyod kyis shes par gyis/ /zer dus rgad po la zer ni yin da/ rgan mo la zer ni yin/ khyed cha ge bton ni red/ ngasabashad ni red/ci khyad/ a le 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi chos thams cad snang stong zung 'jug tu shes nas g.yas su log nas mi bzhag /g.yon du log nas mi bzhag par sha pho chen gyis gangs gshag gshag byas nas 'gro tshul gyi gnad yag po zig shes na snang sbyang gi khog 'dis bzung yod pas de tsho shes nas man ngag gi chings lnga grogs su yod na lam gnad re zin ni red/ za gyi dumed ni tsho bud ta song da lhanog ni red/ mgos thu ra bshad na de red rnga mas yar ra bshad na de red/ de min ni zig cig dubashad kyi yod ni ma red/ snang sbyang gi gnad 'di'i mtshams nas/ nyi zla gzas 'dzin 'dzin/ gdug pa klus 'dzin 'dzin/ gcan gzan gtum pos 'dzin 'dzin/ byas te gnad rnams zin dgos ni red/thengs re man ngag gi chings lnga gsungs/ thengs re drug re gsungs/ gcig khong gi mi dran gi gsungs/ lnga ni 'khor ba la nges 'byung / 1 sems can la snying rje/ 2 kun la dag snang / 3 mched grogs la brtse gdung / 4 bla ma la mos gus dang lnga'o/ /'khor ba la nges 'byung yod na so thar gyi mdodumi 'chor/theng re mdo 'dzin gsungs/ thengs re 'khor ba la nges 'byung gi mdo ma shor na so thar gnad rdzogs ni red gsungs/ brtse ba'i snying rje yod na byang sems kyi mdo mi 'chor/ kun la dag snang yod na gsang sngags kyi mdo mi 'chor/ mched grogs la brtse gdung med na dam tshig nyams pa'i grib gyis nyams rtogs rgyud (/nyergyu/ ②phyin song dang / dzu mide min zhig sdi ching / 'tsho ba'am gnad/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥlaskye ni ma red/ sa lam gyi bar chad du 'gyur/ bla ma la mos gus med na yon tan sna gcig rgyud la mi skye ba dang / khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi lam 'di thos pas mi rtogs/ bskyed rim kyis mi rtogs/ bla ma byin rlabs can dang 'phrad tshe/ de'i dgongs rgyud kyi byin rlabs slob ma'i mos gus kyis bskul nas bdag rgyud la 'jug dgos pas shin tu gal che ni red/ de lta bu'i man ngag gi chings lnga med na snang stong zung 'jug gi lta ba 'di yang sprang dbyug 'dra 'dra zig yin ni red/ rgya 'jam gyisasprang dbyug ci 'dra red zhus dus/ a le/ khyos rjosprang dbyug mi shes ni e yin/ sprang dbyug la mgo med/ rnga ma med/ yal ga med/ lo ma med/ pags shun med ni'i skya shang shang zhig yin ni bo e mi shes gsungs/ ༈ bdag med gnyis kyi skabs su o ya rta ma brgyug gong gi rgyan zig 'jog dgos/ mda' ma 'phang gong gi 'ben zig 'jog dgos de dpe red/ don bod phyi rabs pa tshos bden 'dzin nyon sgrib tu 'dod pas 'khor rtsa chos kyi bdag 'dzin la byed dang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i lugs la 'khor rtsa gang zag gi bdag 'dzin du 'jog pa gnyis las phyi ma'i dgongs pa ltar/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ni gang zag gi bdag 'dzin yin/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin de la brten nas las dang nyon mongs pa 'byung / de la brten nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'di grub pa red/ rgyu mtshan des 'khor ba'i phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi cha 'di thad sor spang rgyu chud ni ma red/ de'i rtsa ba kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs gnyis spang dgos ni red/ de gnyis kyi phug gang zag gi bdag 'dzin la thug hulkood kyis/ 167

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥyod ni red/ yang na bdag 'dzin 'di ldog na khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad ldog 'gro bas/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin 'di chu brgya'i mgo'i bo tho phunag ris ma phugacig pu de yin ni red/ a le/ kha nang du skor nas de ngos gcig zin dgos ni red/ de ngos ma zin na med snang stong snang zig gis ni spu tsam phan ni shar 'dzam thang red na/ a le bdag 'dzin zer rgyu bo de'i ming la gcig ltos dang / bdag 'dzin de 'dzin mkhan zhig dang 'dzin mkhan de la 'dzin rgyu zhig yod pas zer ni i mi yin/ bdag 'dzin de 'dzin rgyu'i yul de la gang zag gi bdag zer ni red/ ngar 'dzin de 'dzin mkhan zhig dang / 'dzin mkhan de la 'dzin rgyu zhig yod ni 'i e mi yin/ ngar 'dzin de'i 'dzin rgyu'i yul de la nga zer ni red/ o ya/ des na nga dang ngar 'dzin gyi khyad par/ bdag dang bdag 'dzin gyi khyad par phyes nas bdag 'dzin gyi bdag de med gi ma zer yod gi rdzodu/ ngar 'dzin gyi yul gyi nga de med gi ma zer yod gi rdzos/ yod nas ngos 'dzin ni red midumed na ngos 'dzin rgyu yod ni ma red/ kha nang la bskor nas btsal na bdag 'dzin gyi blo phyin ci log des phung po la bdag tu bsnyeng ni red phung po de bdag yin ni ma red/ o ya/ shes ni tshos phung po lnga zer na nyan ni red/ mi shes ni tshos lus ngag yid gsum zer na nyan gi/ 'dzin tshul ngar 'dzin phyin ci log gi blo des phung po 'di la 'o nga 'o phyag gis sku la brgyab nas mchan bdag go zhes cha phye rgyu med pa'i ril po gcig bden bya mo nag mo'i sgong nga lta bur 'dzin ni red/ bdag 'dzin phyin ci log 'dis du mar bzung shes ni ma red/ gcig tu bzung ni red/ mi rtag pa dang mi 0zhesapasa'amaspang doog rdzunagarispru/ tshosasapashodacesapa'ido na/ 'tshogatogs/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā bden par 'dzin shes ni ma red/ rtag pa dang bden grub tu 'dzin ni red/mdor na rang gi phung po la dmigs nas/ bdag 'dzin dang ngar 'dzin gyi yul gyi nga de dang bdag de mda' sngun rjogyi 'ben dang 'dra 'dra zig 'char ba— de la zer ni red/ a le bdag 'dzin gyi yul bdag de ngos zin na bdag 'dzin dang ngar 'dzin de ngos zin ni red/ bdag 'dzin byed kyi rtog pa de la bdag 'dzin zer ni red/ nga 'dzin byed kyi rtog pa de la ngar 'dzin zer ni red/ o ya/ de 'dra'i bdag de ngos bzung nas chad rtag gnyis ka'i mtha' dang bral bar rtogs nas de'i ngang du bzhag na yul can gang zag gi bdag 'dzin rang shugs la ldog 'gro ba las logs su spang dgos ni ma red/ me zig gtan nas med na du ba rang log la bud 'gro ni red/ sngon po zig gtan nas med na sngo 'dzin mig shes zig gtan nas yod ni ma red/ de des red/ don gang zag gi bdag med tshul shes na bdag 'dzin ldog tshul de ltar ro/ /re 'ga' rang gi rtsag pa②zur du bzhag nas 'di sus rtsag pa red dris tshe/ nga'i rtsag pa red zer nas phyag zur du bskyangs nas mchan phyugs dang phyugs rdzi ltar bdag byed pa'i nga de bdag byed yul las zur du yan gar du yod pa lta bur bkar nas 'char ba de la nga yi ba'am bdag gi ba zer ni red/ a le rang gi sen mo bcad nas mdun du bzhag nas 'di ci yin dris tshe 'di nga'i sen mo red zer ni red/ de bzhin du sen mo de rdul du phab nas rdul rnams lhan du spung nas bzhag ste/'di'i rdul 'di ci yin dris tshe 'di nga'i sen mo'i rdul red zer nas khyi rgan gyis god ro bsrung bsrung byas yod pa 'di tsho ngos zin dgos ni red/ de bzhin 'ardzon/ ②zhes pa nga gas pa'i gos / 169

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdu/ mgo dang lag pa sogs su nga'i zhes 'dzin ni red/ nga yi ba de la rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i nga yi ba dang / rang rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i nga yi ba gnyis yod ni red/ bdag gam bdag 'dzin dang ngar 'dzin dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i yul de bdag gam nga de red/ res 'ga' khyod thung nga ring zhes lus la dmigs ni red/res 'ga' nga skad snyan zhes ngag la dmigs/ res 'ga' nga blo 'phrul che zer nas sems la dmigs ni red/ a le tsho/ 'khor ba thog med nas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin las las nyon sdug bsngal sogs byung tshul dper na skas kyi them pa 'dra 'dra/ mdzo rgan gyi rwa tshigs 'dra 'dra zhig yin ni red/ o ya bdag 'dzin phyin log gis bzung ba ltar gyi yul bdag gam nga zhig yod ni ma red/de'i yul phung po ril po gcig du snang yang gcig ma red/ mang po zhig red los yin/ rags pa zhig tu phye na'ang phung po lnga yod ni red/ de'i nang gi rang gi gzugs phung 'di'ang mgo rkang lag lnga/ skra nyi khri chig stong / ba sbu bye ba sa ya/ so sum cu/ sen mo nyi shu/don snod bcu gnyis/ rus pa'i dum bu sum brgya dang drug cu yod ni red/ 'di gcig ci ga yin/ de ltar brtags te btsal na bdag 'dzin gyi yul gyi gang zag gi bdag de blo phyin log gi ngor de ltar bzung ba las med par shes pas bdag 'dzin gtan la phab mi dgos par ldog 'gro ba ni khyed cha ge i mi shes/ khyed cha ga'i ya thod na mig mgo zur na rna ba/ ya chung nang na sems yod na ltos da e mi rig /khyed cha ga'i mig rgyal 'gong gi bkab yod ni ma red da/ rna ba bdud gi bkab yod ni ma red da/gsungs/ a le de 'dra'i bdag dang / nga zig yod na yod tshul ji ltar yin kha 170

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnang du log nas brtag dgos ni red/ rang gi lus lta bu yang cha shas so sor phyes nas gang ltar brtags na rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus pa'i bdag nyid las skyes pa'i rtag pa gcig bden ji ltar yod zhib tu brtags nas nyin bsgom/ mtshan bsam blo btang nas gtan la phab nas nga dang bdag de snang tsam ma gtogs de ril po gcig bden gyi nga dang nga yi ba dang / bdag gi ba zhig med par stong cham gyis song ba'i steng du lhod de mnyam par bzhag nas bsgom/ yang gong bzhin gtan la phab te yang yang nyin na bsgom/ mtshan na bsam nas mnyam bzhag ma tshad rjes thob tu snang stong zung 'jug tu bun bun shig shig 'char ba zig ma yong gi bar du bsgom dgos ni red/ a le tsho/ 'khor ba thog med nas 'khyams pa'i nga'am bdag de ngos bzung nas gnad de srog rtsa sga mda' rjozig ma byas par/ nga med khyod med zig de/ ya kha ma kha ma zad kyi bar du bshad kyang nga bdag gi 'dzin pa'i skru zig chod ni shar 'dzam thang red na/ ma mtha' de 'dra re ma shes na/ phung po lnga po 'di 'dus byas rgyu rkyen las skyes pa dang rtag brtan med tshul re shes na bdag med gi phyogs ni nye ni red/ gong gi mnyam bzhag nges pa'i shes rab de la skabs 'di'i lta ba zer ni red/ 'og gi sgyu ma'i dpe bcu 'dir yar sbyar te/ stong pa las snang phyogs 'char tshul go ba len dgos/chos kyi bdag dang bdag 'dzin la yang dpyad/ kha spos pas chog gsungs/snang sbyang gi mgo rnga thams cad gnad des bzung yod/ gnad de rnams gcan gzan gtum pos 'dzin 'dzin/ gdug pa klus 'dzin 'dzin byas nas 'dzin dgos ni red/ khrid gsung skabs yi ge gang yod kyi steng nas gsungs kyi butsho ba tshol ba'i don/ 171

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥyin pas nyin gcig khrid skabs su/ gcig gis zin bris can zhig mdun du bzhag nas gsungs tshe/ a le 'di tsho'i nang na/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag /'dzin pa gang zag gi bdag brdzas 0yod gi/ nga ni dpe cha med yi ge gang yod gi thog bshad gi 'dug ni yin/ o ya/ da nga 'brong yar song gi rjes na sna li kher 'dug red/ da su gnad cang go ni med gi/ tshes bcu/ ban bkra/ hor bla phun tshogs tshos 'di 'dra bris med i go/ phyin chad dpe re chud na dultos/mkhyen sprul gi snang sbyangs 'di zhu dag gyis zhes bskul nas gling sprul khyed gnyis kha thug nas zhu dag byas yod/ de tsho'i nang na 'di 'dra zer e yod ltos/'di kha bral btang ni 'dra 'dra zig e red ltos/ de yin na gzung ba chos kyi bdag yin tshad la chos kyi bdag dang / 'dzin pa yin tshad gang zag gi bdag las med ni 'dra 'dra zig khas blang yod ni red/ de 'thad ni ma red/ gnad de dag 'chug rung ni ma red/ ༈ man ngag gi chings chen po lnga dang ldan pa'i gang zag zig gis 'di nyams su len dgos ni red/ phyi nang gsang ba'i nam mkha'i skabs su nam mkha' mig gis ma bor tsam gyis chog zer gyi de phyi'i bem sgog 'di ma red/ a le dam nyams cha ga /khyed cha ga'i ya thod ka'i mig bud/ rna ba bdud gi bkab ni e red/ sgom pa'i tshe na ci yang mi bsnom ste/nam mkha' mig gis ma bor tsam gyis chog ces pa'i skabs su/ snom pa'i tshe na'am dmigs pa'i tshe na zhes sam/ lta ba'i tshe na zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas nam zhig mi bsgom pa'i dus zhig yod pa shugs la bstan ni red/ de gsang ba'i nam mkha'i steng du 'khyer dgos ni red/ dpal yul ba la sogs pas ( wāshad pa'i don/ rjo rnyed na/ 172

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥshingamachu rdo li lha sku yig 'bru sogs la dmigs rten byed par 'dug kyang / de tshorgyal ba'i bka' na gsungs yod pas min zer rgyu yod ni ma red/ a le/nga'i dmigs rten 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra/ nam mkha' 'di rgya che khyon yangs mtha' dbus steng 'og phyogs mtshams sogs med par snod bcud thams cad la khyab yod pas na gzhan thogs bcas kyi dmigs rten zig dang 'dra ni ma red/rdo li shing mchu sogs la gtad na/ bar gcig na 'gul tsho i mi yong a le/rkyen gsum dang bral ba'i nam mkha' zig dgos ni red/ rkyen gsum ni nyin mo'i nyi 'od dmar po/ mtshan mo'i zla 'od skya bo/ nyer dgu gnam stong sogs la ma tshan mo mun pa nag po ste gsum la zer ni red/ de gsum dang bral ba zig yod gsungs zig yod ni i mi yin/ de 'dra'i rkyen gsum bral zig cang rig rgyu ni med gi med ni o'i red/ o ya de 'dra'i rkyen gsum bral gyi nam mkha' steng gi sngon po de la go ni ma red/ bar snang stong pa go skabs phye ba/rdul du grub pa'i bem po'i stong pa/ gsal zhing rig pa shes pas stong pa/ de la ngos 'dzin ni red/ o ya/ de 'dra'i rkyen gsum bral gyi phyi'i nam mkha' de la nang gi sems de mdung tshugs su lus ngag yid gsum 'jug pa gcig dril gyi ched du gtad nas bsgom dgos gsungs/ ci tsam la gtad dgos pa'i tshad ni rang gi khams kyis shes dgos/ nam mkha'i khams can la yang yang gtad kyang zhig song nas gtad rgyu med pa rgya gar du ind+ra bho dhi dang / bod du yang de dang phyogs 'dra'i nam mkha'i khams can yod kyang dkon gsungs/ rlung khams pas gtad che na spyo 'ong ba dang / chu khams gsal nyams dang / me khams la 'phel 173

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'agrib 'gyur ldog ma nges pa 'byung ba dang / sa khams pa sra 'thas ltar brtan pa yin pa/ khams kyi dbang gis rang gi nyams myong la dpag pa ma gtogs mtha' gcig tu 'di tsam la phyi'i nam mkha' la dmigs rten bzung dgos zer thag mi chod/ de ltar blo mig sems gsum 'jug pa gcig dril byas nas/phyi'i nam mkha' la mdung tshugs su gtad nas rim bzhin 'dzin steng gyi rtsol ba je lhod du rim gyis btang nas phyi yi nam mkha' la brten nas nang gi nam mkha' sems nyid stong gsal mtha' dbus spros pa dang bral ba mngon du gyur pa na nang gi nam mkha' zer ni red/ de'i tshe phyi nang gi nam mkha' mngon du gyur/phyi'i nam mkha' dbyings su dag /nang gi nam 'dzin gyi blo bor nas/ 'das pa sngon bsu ma 'ongs rjes gcod/ da lta'i phyi nang gi mtshan 'dzin ji snyed shar ba de dag bya ma rjes su bu khrid pa lta bu dang / gnyen pos 'bur 'joms dran pas rjes slebs thod skyes bod chod kyis skyon gsum dang bral bar dus gsum yid kyi rtog tshogs gang du ji snyed shar ba de dag thams cad shar grol 'gag med du song nas bag chags bsog long med par sbrul gyi mdud pa zhig pa ltar grol nas nyams zhen gyi shun pa la kha'i na bun bzhin du yal/ dus gsum yid kyi mtshan rtog bse lung ①ltags kyi rgya mdud bzhin tu 'thor nas shar grol du song ba la grol ba zer ni red/ shar grol mtshan nyid pa gsang ba'i nam mkha'i skabs su 'ong rgyu yin kyang 'di nas shar grol gyi mgo tshugs shing khregs chod kyi tshogs lam chung ngu tsam re i mi yin/ khregs chod kyi lam ni shar grol gyi steng nas 'jog /thod rgal gyi lam ni snang ba bzhi'i steng nas 'jog dgos pas (kroo ba'i lung / 174

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥlam sne re zin ni red/ nang gi nam mkha'i steng du bzhag kyang phyi'i nam mkha' la gtad yod pa'i rtags su dus gsum gyi rtog tshogs 'gyu bar byed kyi yod ni ma red/ de med na grol cha med pa'i gnas cha tsam las yod ni ma red/ phyi'i nam mkha'i skabs su rtse gcig gi dran pa spang la be phur btab pa lta bu red/nang gi nam mkha'i dus mnyam bzhag gi ngang brjed na de'i steng du 'jog byed la gnyug ma'i dran pa zer ni red/ des dran tsam nas dran mkhan rang yal du 'gro dgos ni red/ de rang yal du dwangs nus na dran pa yang yang 'dren na bzang ni red/ dper na me dpung chen po'i nang du rtswa sbur 'phang ni 'dra 'dra zig yin ni red/ a le kha nang du bskor nas dran pa bshigs te rang dwangs la 'gro ma nus na dran pa'i lcags mkhar du tshud 'gro ni red/ de tshud song na sgom chen brgya grub pa stong gis kyang bshig rgyu chud ni ma red/ a skyabs bde legs 'dra 'dra zig yin gyi bo red/ nam 'dzin gyi blo ma bor na gnas cha yod kyang grol cha yod ni ma red/ grol cha med skyad grol rgyu shar cha med ni red/ dus gsum gyi shar cha 'char bcug dgos/ ma shar na grol rgyu med pas shar grol gyi lhag mthong mi 'ong ni red/ de ltar shar grol du song ba'i cha nas lhag mthong dang / sems gnas pa'i cha nas zhi gnas su bzhag rgyu 'di nga'i lugs yin/ zhi gnas sngomyo/ du bsgrubs nas lhag mthong gzod bsgom dang / lhag mthong sngon la bsgoms nas zhi gnas rjes su bsgrub rgyu de tsho a le nga'i lugs ma red gsungs/ de ltar na shar grol gyi mgo tshugs pa'i lam rgyud ldan gyi gang zag des long bas glang rnga 'dzin 'dzin byas nas gsang ba'i nam mkhar gtug dgos/ nang gi 175

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnam mkha'i steng du sa ma zin/ grol cha ma thob na dbang shes rtog med kha phyir lta red/ mig gi dbang po/ dbang po gzhan las rgyu shin tu dwangs ni red/ mig shes dbang shes gzhan las khyab rgya che ni red/ de la phyi'i bar snang skya seng nge ba 'di shar nas de gnyis 'dres song ni 'dra 'dra hang dung nge de ni nam mkha'i rnam pa mig lam du shar ba la lam byed ni red/ 'di la gol na chos nyid kyi gshis lugs la rgyab gtad ni red/ gcin gtang na lhum yu'i nang du shor ni red/ a le 'di gol sa zig yin ni shar 'dzam thang ma red na/ sge'u li bde ldan gyis 'di bsgoms na gang du skye lags zhus tshe/ chings lnga dang bral ba'i gol sa 'dis/ mtho na nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched pa dang / 'bring na lha tshe ring por 'phen spyad re yin thang / chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas so snyam du sgom pa dang phyogs 'dra ni red/ a le yang na dran pa bya rog gi so ba 'dra ba des dwangs cha sgrib pa'i bying ba dang / gsal cha sgrib pa'i rmug pa gnyis 'dres nas bsgoms pas byi ba sogs dud 'gro la skye ni red/ a le des ni nang gi nam mkha'i steng du phyogs tsam nye ni ma red/ 'dis ngar 'dzin dang nyon yid gnyis khog yod ni ma red/ tshogs drug gi rtog pa i ziga'akhog los yod/nang gi nam mkha'i steng du bzhag kyang phyi'i nam mkhar gtad nas gol yod pa yin min brtags na/ phyi ru kha char bu yug 'tshub dus sogs la sgo skar khung rnams 'dan/ zhwa gyon mig btsum nas bsgom na sgom mi thub par bkyig bzhag yod ni 'dra 'dra zhig dang gnyid dub 'gro ba yin ni red/ yang re 'ga' ri chen po'i rtse nas nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil du bltas na bsgom na shin tu dwangs duphal cher ram kha shas/ 176

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpa'ang yong rgyu de gol sa yin pa'i rtags red/ de dus kha nang du skor mig btsum nas 'od gsal nang nas i 'char blta dgos/nub mo nyal dus/ sgo skar rnams 'dan mal sar nyal te skrag yong skyad bumago btum/ mig btsum nas gnyid dus 'od gsal 'char 'ong rgyu de phyi na med ni'i rtags red/ nang gi nam mkha' la mnyam par bzhag dus rtog bcas yid kyi shes pa gtso bo dang nyon yid gnyis mi 'char shar na'ang dwangs 'gro ni red/ de los 'gro/ rgad po zhig gis mal gsos na'ang 'gag gi ni/ kun gzhi dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnyis ka sad ston dgos/ gtor ston dgos/ sgo lnga'i shes pa lnga dus gcig la 'gag med du shar/ shar kyang yul thog tu mi shar bar sgo lnga cha mnyam lhu mi 'thor ba zhig dgos/ lhu 'thor nas yul thog tu 'grang gram dus yang na mig shes gzugs la gtad dus gzugs mthong song / yang rna shes sogs 'gag med du yod pa'i rtags su sgra sogs yul lnga 'gag med du shar ni red/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes dwangs sang 'di rtog med yin pas las bsags ni ma red/ de bkag dgos ni ma red/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin de gsal rig zhig red/ yul mi gsal ba gsal bas gsal ba/ yul rnam par shes pas ni rnam shes/ yul rnam par rtog pas rnam rtog zer ni red/ gsal rig zer rgyu de gsal mo mchod me bltams ni 'dra 'dra zhig yin ni ma red/ spyir shes pa 'di dag 'od gsal gyi cha las shar ba seng ge dkar mo'i bu 'dra 'dra zig yin ni red/ mig gi rnam par shes pa lhu re la'ang /shes cha zig stong cha zig /zung 'jug gi cha gsum re phye rgyu yod/ mig shes de mkhyen pa'i ye shes la shar ba'i ()hacang / 177

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā rtags su stong cha zig yod ni red/ 'char gzhi dbyings ye zung 'jug du yongapa'i rtags su mig gi shes pa'ang snang stong zung 'jug tu shar ni red/ mig :rnam shes shar nas snang na mi stong ni zig dang / stong na mi snang ni zig yod nim red/ gsal rig gi cha de yab red/ dbyings kyi cha de yum red/ snang stongaganyis kyi zlas phye na gsal ba'i cha thabs/ stong pa'i cha shes rab red/ 'didagag 'dug ci dgos/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes 'di 'char ka bzhag na grol dgosani ma red/ 'o na/ yid shes dang nyon yid gnyis ka'ang 'char ka bzhag na sengage'i bu dang 'dra nas grol e dgos zer na/ de gnyis rkyen log pa dang 'phradadus 'khor bar 'phen pa'i las bsags ni 'i grol dgos ni red/ la lasakho'i dus gsum gyi rtog pa med shul na shes pa dwangs gsal zhig yod gi de rig pa red shar 'dzam thang mi zer gi na/ a kha thang nga rgyag gyi bodu/ de'i shul na rnam rtog gcig gi mi tshad lnga yod ni red/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi steng nga thon na drug yod ni red/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes de nam 'gag na/ shi dus gnyid dus brgyal dus sogs sems med pa'i gnas skabs lnga la 'gags ni red/de ma gtogs pa'i/ chos nyid zad dus su'ang 'gag med shar yod ni red/ a le chos nyid zad pa'i dus na sgo lnga'i shes pa med ni zig o'i yod gsungs/ de ltar nang gi nam mkhar sems nyid stong gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i nyams de shar 'ong dus der yang 'dres shing goms na klong du gyur tshe dwangs ba'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba bzhin du yul lnga po dus gcig la tshur dbang shes kyi ngor shar yong ni red/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang / rgya mtsho'i gza' skar ()sa la brdab rgyu zhesapa'i ngo/na/ 178

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrnams tshur shar/ me long dang rgya mtsho'i nang du shar ni ma red/ phar me long rgya mtsho/ gzugs brnyan gza' skar gyi ngos la shar ni ma red/ de ltar yul lnga dus cig char du tshur la 'char mi 'ong ba ni 'char gzhi'i 'od gsal dang / thag nye ba'i gnad kyis shar 'dzam thang ma red na/ a le de dwangs bar na rnam shes tshogs bdun las brgal tshar bas kun gzhi lus ni ma red/ sgo lnga cha mnyam lhu ma 'thor na nyon yid dang / yid shes rgya mtsho chen por gnyis mgo 'bur ba lhu re shar yang rang zhir bud 'gro ni red/ de dus dwangs seng nge ba'i shes pa de sgo lnga red/ yid dang nyon yid kyis gos ni ma red/ sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis rtog pa mi mnga' ba'i tshul gyis dus gsum chags thogs med par mkhyen tshul yang 'di yar la bzang song ni red/ 'di phar phar skom na 'di'i steng nas bsgom pa rgya mtsho cog bzhag kyang bzhag 'ong chog ni red/ sgo lnga cha mnyam lhu ma 'thor bar bzhag na gnad thams cad de la tshang yod/ 'jog tshul 'di grub chen sha ba ri pa dang sa ra ha pa sogs kyis/ sems med bu chung lta bur bzhag /ces bu chung snyogs ra nang na yod pa la nyon yid 'char ni ma red/ sgo lnga 'gag med du dus gcig la shar ba de dpe byas ni red/ rdzogs chen bka' gter gnyis kyi lung la las dang po pas gnad de ngos zin rgyu gal che gsungs/ sgo lnga 'gag med du shar lugs thos grol dbang bshad du yod/ khyed cha ge los shes/a le/ mig gi rnam par shes pa gzugs 'gag med du sogs gsungs pa ltar red/ de'i steng nas man ngag gi chings lnga dang ldan pas nyams su blangs na lam yang dag pa red/ da dung gzhi'i dri ma tsam bro ni shar 'dzam thang red na/ de lta 179

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbu'i nang gi nam mkha'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag nas/ rab gi snga dro phyi 'phred/min na da/ ja bar shag shag zhig bzhag na kha nyan dus gzod shan 'byed rnams phud nas ngo sprad dgos ni red/ de ma thug gi bar du khab mig zhig gi nang du g.yag zig ma tshad lug zig bsha' sa yod ni ma red/ de'i steng nga shan phye rgyu lag ni ma red/ gsang ba'i nam mkha' ni gzhi sku gsum 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'char gzhi red/ rgyu'i steng na med pa'i 'bras bu zhig yod ni ma red/ a le/ gzhi nam mkha' de bdag 'dzin gnyis kyis bsgribs song ni red/ de'i steng na bying rmug 'thib gsum sogs kyang / gnyig zhuskrang steng na khu tshur red/rang gi snying kha na bzhugs pa'i gzhi/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i 'od gsal de bla ma'i man ngag gi shan 'byed la brten nas sad dgos ni red/ de sad na phyi nang gsang ba'i nam mkha' gsum mngon du gyur/ phyi nang gi nam mkha' gnyis dbyings su dag /nam 'dzin gyi blo dang bral ni red/ yid dang shes rab kyi shan 'byed la/ yid ni gtso sems yid kyi shes pa 'khor ba'i sems byung shes rab de la zer ni red/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag la thug gi bar du shes rab 'di la brten nas bsgom ni red/ de dbye na thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gsum yod/ sgom pa'i shes rab mtshan nyid pa med/ don spyi'i sgo nas sgom tshul yod/ de 'dra'i shes rab de la dgag rtog sgrub rtog gnyis yod/ mngon rjes gnyis las rjes dpag yin/ dgag rtog med dgag 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang / sgrub rtog ma yin dgag 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la zer/gog 180

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'aphags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi dus su/ gtsub shing gtsub stan gyi dpe ltar —shes rab 'di dgag ni red/ blo dang rig pa bzang ngan shes rab 'di mchog dman yod pas zer/ 'di la yid zer ba'i don/ yid shes de'i lubor gyi shes rab de'i rnam ldan du yid shes de skye nus pa'i phyir yid zer ni red/ chos nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i shes rab ni 'od gsal ye shes kyi rang rtsal las shar ni red/ mdo ltar na 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi rtsal las dang /sngags ltar na don gyi 'od gsal las shar ba'i shes rab red/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag las ldang phyag thal mo brkyangs mchan ba'i rjes thob ye shes sngar gyi shes rab rjes dpag gi phyogs su bsdu gsungs/shes rgyud 'di dum bu gnyis su phye na kha yes mahu'ed/ sems la rtog bcas yid kyi rnam shes/rtog med sgo lnga'i rnam shes/ tshogs brgyad sems byung dang bcas pa yod/ sems byung tsho zhib par ma shes rung tshogs brgyad kyi rtog pa shar dus 'di red bsam nas ngos 'dzin rgyu chud dgos/ de chud na sems kha yes shes ni red/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes ni gzugs mthong mkhan/ sgra tshor mkhan/dri snom mkhan/ro myong mkhan/lus kyi reg bya 'khyag mi 'khyag myong mkhan tsam zhig red/ de phan yul teo ga dpyod mi shes ni red/ tha na thos grol gyis shes/ gzugs mdzes mi mdzes sogs/rtog mkhan yid shes dang chags sogs kyi ngo bor skye mkhan nyon yid gnyis red/ dbang shes dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnyis rtog med red/ a le/ngar 'dzin nyon yid 'dis dmigs pa kun gzhi la dmigs nas rnam pa ngar 'dzin dus zhig kyang yod ni red/ gzhung gzhan du nyon yid kha nang lta/du phyed ka zhig 181

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdamigs pa kun gzhi la dmigs nas/ rnam pa ngar 'dzin/ 'khor kun 'gro dgu dang mtshungs par ldan zhes mi pham tshang gis gsungs/ kun gzhi ma gtogs pa'i tshogs bdun po nang gi skabs nas ngos zin yod dgos/ kun gzhi gsang ba'i nam mkha' ngo sprad dus ngos bzung ni red gsungs/ kun gzhi de ci 'dra red dris tshe/ o ya kun gzhi zer rgyu bo ni ngo bo rnam par mi rtog pa/dpyod pa med pa/ dmigs pa snod bcud rgya chen po la dmigs pa/ rnam pa yul gyi skru ris mi 'byed pa phyi na gtad kyi med/ nang na bsgom gyi med/ bar na bzhag med/ mar la dub med/ yar la 'phrul gi med/ blos bslad ma zhugs ni 'dra 'dra'i rtog med stong seng gi rnam pa can zhig yin ni red/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dwangs la g.yo ba med pa'i rnam pa can zhig yin ni red/ de khyed cha gas dri 'i 'dug mi dgos dang / sgom chen ya da zig 0min na de'i steng du thon rgyu ma red/ de'i rag 'a bdag dang bdag 'dzin tsho ngos e zin ltos da/ de'i gal che ni red/ kun gzhi bzhi yod pa'i nang gi ye don gyi kun gzhi zer rgyu de khams bde gshegs snying po red/ kun gzhi chos sku nga dang mnyam/ /zhes de la gsungs ni red/ de sgrib byed kyi bag chags sna tshogs pa'i kun gzhi ni/ngo bo rtog med rnam pa gsal rig can khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'khrul gzhi red/kun gzhi bzhi po ma shes na'ang / de gnyis ka shes dgos/ kun mkhyen klong pa'i mkha' 'gro yang tig tu kun gzhi ngos 'dzin tshul/ thang chen po zhig tu/brgyug brgyug nas ngal chad dus mal gsos na dka' ba'i shugs kyis rtog pa rnams re zhig 'gag pa'i shul tu stong nyang nge zig yod rgyu de kun gzhi red/ de'i zhusangarab zhig 182

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsteng nas cung zad gsal cha thon pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes red/de rtsol ba'i stobs kyis mngon du gyur tshul red/'di gnyis ngo bo gcig yin pas lam gom stobs kyis kun gzhi'i steng du sleb pa rnams/rang rang gi khams kyi dbang gis/stong cha dang gsal cha gnyis gang gi phyogs mngon du gyur go ni ma red/bla ma mi pham tshang gis/shes mkhan zig 'a zhuyin ni/ci shes 'di shes yang med ni/go mkhan zig 'a yin ni/ci go 'di go med ni zig/bla ma la las btang snyoms lung ma bstan du ngos 'dzin/la las ma rig par ngos 'dzin/don kun gzhi red/'di sgom gyi dngos gzhi mtshan nyid pa min kyang /las dang po pas dang po 'di la ma brten par 'gro tshul med gsungs/sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad ngos zin dus/de'i shul na 'char gzhi zhig lhag yod na/de mdo ltar na bde gshegs snying po/sngags ltar na 'od gsal gsang ba'i nam mkha' red/dwangs sang nge zer rgyu de dub med ni'i ming red/gsal sang nge zer rgyu de rmug pas ma bsgribs pa'i ming red/de 'od gsal ma red/than mgo dgu zhig min pa de la tshang ni red/de min ni'i 'od gsal zhig ngos zin dgos ni red/gzhi nam mkha' yin zer dus de la gtad ni red/sems ye gnas kyi shes pa de red/'di ni dur khrod kyi 'dre ngan zas su sha za ba/skom du khrag 'thung ba/las su srog gcod pa rnams kyi rgyud na'ang yo da ni red dang ngos zin ni ma red/sems dang rig pa'i shan phye dus kha nang du bskor nas rang gi shes rgyud la rang gis bltas na kha phyi la bskor nas dom yig 'dra 'dra zig gang bltas ni'i nyan ni ma red/sha'i che sa/po'i 'thug sa nang na yod ni red/ha kong / 83

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrang go ngo rang shes/ ngang mngon gyur zer rgyu de'ang gsang ba'i nam mkha'i steng du 'byer shes dgos/ ༈ rgya tshogs 'jam dpal gyis/ nam mkha' 'di gzhi i yin lags zhus tshe a le dam nyams cha ga /khyed cha gi mig rub ni min na/shes med bem stong nam mkha' lta bu ni ma yin no zhes dang mthar sangs rgyas pa na sku dang ye shes kyi rol ba 'byams klas gsungs yod ni bo ma rig ni i yin/phyi'i nam mkha' gzhi yin na nam mkha' gsum bshad pa/ dgos pa la yod ni ma red gsungs/ slob dpon sba sgom pas/ nam mkha' 'di khong du chud par gyis shig /de rtogs na sgom med kyi gzer chen them pa yin gsungs rgyu de phyi'i nam mkha' la brten nas nang gi nam mkha' khong du chud nang gi nam mkha' la brten nas gsang ba'i nam mkha' khung du chud dgos ni red/ phyi'i nam mkha' dper bzhag ni red/ phyi'i nam mkha' snod bcud thams cad la khyab pa bzhin du chos kyi dbyings kyis 'khor 'das lam gsum la khyab yod ni red/ nam mkha' 'di la mtha' dbus phyogs lhung med pa bzhin du chos kyi dbyings la mtha' dbus phyogs lhung med ni 'i phyi rol dpe'i nam mkha' gsungs ni red/nam mkha' bsgom dus nad gdon sdig sgrib gang yin kyang rmi lam dbyings su sad pa ltar stong nyid chos kyi dbyings su dag par bsam na nad pa sogs la cigarjophan ni red/ ༈ yang thog med kyi dus nas 'khrul ba 'dis sdug bsko'i bsko'ibuyi phyi nang snod bcud phung khams skye mched thams cad kyi 'byul snang thams cad rmi lam dbyings su sad pa dang sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor dbyings su zhig pa ltar song bar bsams nas nang gi nam mkha'i steng du bzhab/ na cig hu༄nga zad/ du ga gtad pa'i don/ 184

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥphan gyi red/ stong sbyang zer rgyu de red gsungs/ nam mkha' sgom dus dus gsum gyi rtog tshogs rnams bla ma'i man ngag gi bzhag stobs kyis rnam rtog thams cad shar grol du 'gro/ gsang ba'i nam mkha'i skabs su rnam rtog thamacha/ cad bzhag thabs la ma ltos par gang shar thams cad rgya grol du 'gro/ spyir na mdo sngags gnyis ka'i bsgrub bya chos gzugs kyi sku yin pa mtshungs kyang /mdo phar phyin theg pas bskal ba grangs med gsum la spyin sogs phar phyin snga ma lngas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / gzugs sku bsgrub gzhi bya/ phyi mas ye shes kyi tshogs dang chos sku bsgrub gzhi byas te tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sko nas sku gnyis bsgrub ni red/ sngags bla med kyi skabs su chos gzugs kyi bsgrub gzhir bskyed rdzogs gnyis sgom pa dang / rdzogs rim rkyang pa'i skabs su sgyu lus gzugs sku'i sgrub gzhi dang / don gyi 'od gsal chos sku'i sgrub gzhir 'jog ni red/ 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi skabs su'ang chos gzugs gnyis kyi sgrub gzhi de rang rgyud la btsal dgos/ lus ngag yid gsum ni shul du bskyur rgyu red/ de ni mi 'jog gang 'jog na/ ka dag khregs chod kyi lta ba de sangs rgyas kyi thugs chos sku dngos lam du byed pa dang / lhun grub thod rgal gyi snang ba sangs rgyas gzugs sku dngos lam du byed par go dgos/ khregs chod rkyang ba yin na gzugs sku gnyis kyi 'char gzhi lam du byed zer rgyu ma gtogs dngos lam du byed o'i zer gsungs/ sha rus pas mi rten na tshe gcig gi rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob 'ong spyad po sku gnyis dngos lam du byed ni gi red gsungs/ rang gi sangs rgyas thob pa la rang rgyud kyi rig pa sku gsum 'du 185

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'abral med pa 'di ma gtogs 'di las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas zhig rnyed rgyu yod ni ma red/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams brgyar song na sangs rgyas zhig nyo rgyu ni mi rnyed/ btsong rgyu ni med/ sbyin rgyu ni med/ btsal rgyu ni med/rgyal ba rigs lnga'i thugs kar bstim na'ang rgyud tha dad red/ rgyal ba'i sras su gyur zer bas shes ni red/ de dang rgyud gcig tu song ni ma red/ de la dgongs nas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi rnyed gsungs ni red ma gtogs spyir sangs rgyas zig med zer ni ma red/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sa chen po'i rdul gyis bgrangs kyang mi zad kyi zig yod ni red/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ gsungs rgyu de red/ a le/ dam nyams cha ga /de med zer na kha nang nas me 'bar/ sna nang nas du ba 'phyur 'ong rgyu 'dzam thang ma red na/rang gis sangs rgyas zhig bsgrub dgos na ni sangs rgyas kyi rgyu zhig /sa na med/gnam na med/ sems can rang rang gi rgyud na yod ni red/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu de 'dra de/ ngo ma shes pa ma gtogs dur khrod kyi 'dre mo nag li ma yan chad kyi rgyud na'ang yod ni red/ sems can gzhan na med gsungs pa'ang rnam shes tshogs brgyad las gzhan pa'i sems can zhig btsal mi dgos ni red/ spyir sems can zhig gzhan na med zer na/ khyod gcig pu las gzhan med ni i red/ e ma sangs rgyas med la sems can med/ ces pa'ang / de dang / yar la re ba'i sangs rgyas gcod/ /mar la re ba'i 'khor ba gcod/ /ces dang /thod rgal gyi skabs kyi gdengs bzhi yang 'di'i steng nas go dgos gsungs gzhi'i sangs rgyas nga la ngo ma shes par/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams 186

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā dus sems can nga / zhes so/ /gcig sangs rgyas dus kun sangs rgyas zhes pa la/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i gzhi gcig ni gi/ gcig sangs rgyas na kun sangs rgyas zer ni ma red/ rta shul ban chen khyod de ring sangs rgyas song na gzigs pa mthar thug thob ni red/ gnas tshul ma/thar thug gzigs ni gi de'i ngor chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas ni red/ zhing khams 'di'i chu'i rdul phra rab gcig gi khong na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bye ba brgya stong grangs med pa gzigs ni red/ de la ston 'khor gyi rnam pa smos ci dgos de ltar chu'i rdul bye ba phrag brgya stong gi bar dang / chos thams cad de ltar du gzigs ni red/ gnas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo na sangs rgyas ni red/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang de la phyogs dang dus kyis gzhal rgyu yod ni ma red/ o ya/ de ban chen gcig gi rang snang la sangs rgyas ni red ma gtogs/ban chen sangs rgyas ni gi/ lha tshe ba'i ban chung pad nam rdo rje la phan gnod yod ni ma red/ lha tshe ba'i ban chung pad ma rdo rje sangs rgyas song na de'i rta shul ban chen la phan gnod yod ni ma red/ a le/ de tsho shes na kun la dag sna nga zer rgyu de yong ni red/ de cam ma shes na/ tha na gzugs snang thams cad sku rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer/ sgra grags pa sngags kyi rang bzhin/ dran rtog thams cad thugs ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin du shes dgos ni red/ de shes na/ a le thog yog buni bsgyur 'jog ni shar 'dzam thang ma red na 'o/ de min ne yul phyogs res 'ga' ba zhig gi bla ser grags pa can zhig la dus res 'ga' ba zhig la dag snang byed rgyu de tsho bzang los bzang da/ sdug thug sa zad gi gro ma 0steng 'og 187

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ a brag la bsko ni os red/ lu gcig pu la'ang 'gro ba drug gi snang chul yod ni red/ dmyal bas khro chu khol mar snang / chu bur me stag /rlangs pa me lce ru snang /yi dwags la rnag khrag sogs su snang ni red/ las dag pa zhig gis gzigs na ma ma gir snang ni red / 'gro ba rnams kyi skad gdangs sngags su gnas nga 'i rtags la/ lug gis 'ba' zer/ yar ngan zeg shi na usngag zer nas 'khun pa 'debs ni red/ yang na i i zer ni red/ 'byung bzhi'i sgra yang sngags kyi rnam par gnas pa yin/ ru shan skabs 'byung bzhi'i sgra don bslab pa'ang gnad de'i red/ dang pyoo'ajig rten pa'i gtam/ tha ma lusadag dusachosakyi sgra/ ༈ gnyug ma'i sems sems nyid/ sems ye gnas kyi shes pa rnams don gcig ming gi na ma grangs red/ gnyug ma zer rgyu de ye gdod ma nas gnas pa'i don red/zhing sku pho brang gsum po ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i cha nas rang gzugs rang gis mthong / rang sgra rang gis thos gsungs/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i 'dre rgan zer rgyu de gna' nas yod pa'i 'dre rgan la go dgos pa ltar ro/ /༈ bcud kyi sems can grangs mang ba ni chos kyi bdag yin/ zhes dang / lus can gyi lus de gang zag gi bdag yin/ zhes pa ni sems can gyis bzung ba ltar gyi sangs rgyas zig yod na de'i zhing dang phung khams skye mched rnam rnga/ kyio sa kyi bdag dang / de'i ngar 'dzin yul gyi lus de gang zag gi bdag yin te/yin chul bdag dang bdag 'dzin ngos bzung ba'i skabs nas shes dgos dang po yul 'khor ba'i rdzun phug rdib dus/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las dang nyon mongs pa las byung / las dang nyon mongs pa bdag 'dzin las 188

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbyung ba yin pas/ bdag 'dzin gyi yul phung po bdag tu snang ba de gtan la phab pas bdag 'dzin ldog go/ /de ldog pas las dang nyon mongs pa ldog go//de ldog pas rang gi ngos skal gyi khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs tshul shes dgos so// ༈ sangs rgyas la mig yod par ma sems shig ces pa sems can la snang rgyu'i mig yod par ma sems shig ces pa ste/ gang dag nga la gzugs su zhes sogs ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i khung bu tsam yang sems can gyis dpag nus pa min/ spyir sangs rgyas la mig med zer na tshar song ni red/ sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig gis shes bya thams cad mkhyen/los mkhyen ye shes kyi phung po red/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab gcig gis sangs rgyasakyi mdzad pa ston ni red/ los lton ye shes kyi phung po red/ sems can rang ga ma zhig gi sgo gsum gyi yul du gyur ba'i sangs rgyas zhig e yod/g.yag bshas bsha' bsha' byas nas brtags pas mthong rgyu ga la yod/ ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i sku dang zhing dang / gzhal yas khang dang rgyan rta bab kha dog sna tshogs pa sogs yod zer dgos ni red/ bod phyi rab pas mchog gi sprul sku sangs rgyas dngos yin zer ni red/ snga rab pas dngos min zer nas rtsod ni red/ ces gsungs so/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis/ chos nyid ka dag klong chen phyam brdal bar/ /lhun grub sku gsum dbyings snang dasdil 'khor zloo/sduja/ ༵/ hūoṃ //nga ye she//sa snang sems ye grol ba/ /nges don bla ma' rang zhal 189

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄7/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i zhal rgyun tshig gsum gnad brdeg gi don bsdus man ngag gser gyi thig le bzhugs so/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta skom spyod gsum gyi nang nas dang po lta ba ngo sprad pa ni/ skye med chos sku'i klong na 'gag med zang thal rjen pa'i rig cha zhig yod pa de ni/ sems rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad las 'das pa'i rig pa'i ye shes yin la de ni sngon med gsar byung zhig ma yin te/ ye gdod ma nas ji bzhin par bzhugs pa de nyid bla ma'i man ngag gis sad par byas nas ngo sprad pa yin no/ /rang ngo 'phrod pa lta ba yin/ ngo rang thog du spad pa'i gnad dang po'o/ /gnyis pa sgom pas thag bcad pa ni/ rig stong zung 'jug chos sku thig le nyag gcig de nyid kyi rang ngo bskyang ba de ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde'i nyams len thams cad kyi snying po/ dbang bzhi pa'i don gyi ye shes/sgrub brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i khyad chos/ rgya bod gsar rnying gi grub brnyes kyi dgongs pa rma med pa yin pas na yid ches kyis kho thag nang nas bcad/ nges shes gting nas skyes nas blo thag bod kyis bcad dgos te/ nges don bsdus rgyud las/ de phyir chos sku 'gyur ba med/ /'dzin bral sems med ye shes sku/ /de don 'bral med byang chub klong / /sems bral ting 'dzin rgyun du gnas//de las gzhan med kho thag bcad/ /de ltar chos sku rang gnas kyi ye shes rjen pa 'khrul ma myong ba'i sangs rgyas su blo thag bcad nas de'i rgyun skyong ba 'di 190

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgal che/ ngang la gnas pa bsgom pa yin/ thag gcig thog du bcad pa'i gnad gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa spyod pa rang grol du 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ gser gling du phyin dus sa rdo phal ba btsal kyang mi rnyed pa bzhin du gang shar rang grol gyi gnad 'di dang ldan na gnas 'gyu rnam rtog gang skyes sgom du shar nas 'khrul ba rang mtshan pa btsal kyang mi rnyed par 'gyur bas na gdengs grol thog du bca' ba yin no/ /gang shar rang grol spyod pa yin/ gdengs grol thog du bca' ba'i gnad gsum pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gnad gsum rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi ka dag rig pa zang thal gyi ngang du chig chod du 'khyer ba'i gnad yin pas theg pa thams cad kyi rtse rgyal snying thig rdo rje snying po'i lam gnad 'bras bu'i thus ka 'di las lhag pa med pas na/ sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu yin/ lta sgom spyod 'bras gang gi dus su rig stong zung 'jug chos sku thig le nyag gcig gi ngang de las 'da' ba med pas na/ de las mi 'da' dam tshig yin/ ces pa 'di ni dung dkar dgon nas ming du mkhan po dge bzang zer ba don du chos 'jig rten gang thad nas /skon tan sna gcig med pa'i sprang rgan mdo med blun po dug hrul can gyis tshig gsum gnad brdeg gi nang nas don gyi gnad bri ma shes rung mgo mjug med pa'i tshig bla ma'i zhal rgyun ltar bris pa yin no// ༈ bde sdug thams cad nyams kyis rdzun ris la/ /ngo shes tsam na gegs sel gnad du che/ /spang blang bcos bslad med par rang sar zhog /bcas bcos re dogs gegs dang gol sa yin/ /rtogs pa rkyen med lam gyi ngo bo ni/ /ci yang ma yin spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /ma bltas ma 191

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā bsgom ma bzung rang yan no/ khugs 'byung har sangs de ni yang dag go/rtog pas dpyad mtha' las 'das stong pa nyid/ /tshig dpe don gyis mi mtshon mtshan ma med/ /rang las grol ba med pa'i smon pa med/ /nyams snang phyin ci log tu bsgyur ba'i rkyen/ /'dre gdon bgegs kyi gnod par 'dzin pa yi/ /sman dbyad rim gro ci phan bsgrub gyur na/ /thams cad gnod pa por 'gyur ba las/ /phan pa mi 'byung srog gi gshed du 'babs/ /de phyir rnal 'byor lam du zhugs pa dag /bde sdug na tsha nyams su shes gyur na/ /sa lam gyis bslang nyams ni ma yin kyang / /'khor ba 'brul ba'i gshis nyams yin pa'i phyir/ /rkyen ngan dngos grub mchog tu bsgyur ba dang / /ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i man ngag yin/de phyir 'khrul ba'i sems snang bde sdug kun/ /thams cad nyams su shes pa gnad du gces/ /chos nyid sgyu mar bden pa'i mngon sum rig pa yis/ /'khor 'das sgyu ma rol pa'i rgan pos smras/ /bla ma'i rgyud 'di mi shes par/nyams su len par 'dod par de/ kha brag lam du phur ba 'dra/ /zhes so// //

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄0/ /tshig gsum gnad brdeg gi zin bris kyi don bkrol ba/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod par brjod pa'i dang po dkon mchog ku na 'dus zhes pa'i skabs su/ spyir gsang sngags rnying ma ba zhig yin dus gu ru rin po che bla mar bzung dgos pas chos sku rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad mar bsdu/ da lta'i ka kha sum cu slob pa'i slob dpon thams cad yar bsdus nas ngo bo rtswa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa o rgyan chen po skyabs gnas kun 'dus su shes pa sngags ltar gyi yin/ thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/sku dge 'dun/ mchog gsum kun 'dus/ sku bla ma/ gsung yi dam/ thugs mkha' 'gro ste/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus/ sku sprul sku/ gsung longs sku/ thugs chos sku ste sku gsum kun 'dus su shes dgos pa dang / 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa skyabs 'gro dgu'i bdag nyid du dmigs nas de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / skyabs su 'gro ba kho nas kyang de rnams la phyag 'tshal ba dang skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon yod par gsungs te/blo bla mar gtod pa skyabs 'gro yi mthar thug /ces dang / khams 'dus dad pas gso nus pa sogs gsungs/ dran pas gdung ba sel ba zhes so/ /log lta byas na yang de dang 'dra ba'i nyes pa mtshungs gsungs/ ༈ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma'i skabs rgyal ba dgongs brgyud klong chen rab 'byams/ rig 'dzin brda rgyud 'jigs med gling ba/ gang zag snyan rgyud rdza khra ma bla ma gsum gyi mtshan don 193

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdang 'brel nas rang sems/ de'i phyir brgyud gsum 'du ba yin te/ ji ltar 'du snyam na brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma'i dgongs pa'i thugs bcud rtogs shing rgyud na bzhugs pa'i cha nasader 'du ba yin gsungs/ ༈ dang po lta ba mdor bstan ni/ dbyings spros pa dbyings de la dbye na phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyi nyan rang dang byang sems rnams kyis ka ba dang bum pa sogs kyi bden grub bkag tsam gyi stong nyid tha shal ba'am phyang chad pa de ni ka ba yod pa'i dus su stong nyid yang yod/ rdzas rgyun zhig pa'i dus su stong nyid yang med/ stong nyid dang dbyings de'ang / stong gzhi'i sems bag chags ma zhabrul ba las grub pa yin pas na/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'o na mdo'i snyong nyid la dgos pa med do snyam na ma yin te/ srid rtse'i dngos gnyen stong nyid bdud rtsi lta bu de yin/ rdzogs chen ltar na dbyings spros bral 'di ni gdod ma'i stong chen gyi dbyings sam rig pa ka dag gi dbyings de la 'pho 'gyur med pa/sngags ltar na sku dang ye shes kyis brgyan pa'i dbyings/ de nyid las/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de dang 'dra ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid mi pham la sogs pas gsungs pa yin no/ /dbyings spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos nyid de'i yin lugs bde bar gshegs pa zhes sangs rgyas kyi mtshan yin la/ rang gdangs 'gags pa med pa'i ye shes ni snying po/ de gnyis zung 'dug gi cha nas klong chen po na zhes pa'i 'char gzhi bstan/ de las 'char chos ni ma dag 'khor ba dang / dag 194

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpa myang 'das gnyis kyi snang ba rab 'byams sam/ yang na chags sdang sogs dus gsum yid kyi 'khrul rtog dang nyams zhen sogs ma dag 'khor ba dang /dag pa myang 'das lhun grub thod rgal gyi snang cha dbyings dang ye shes thig le sogs kyi snang ba rabs 'byams/ ༈ de lta bu'i lta ba spros bral gyi rang bzhin 'di lam sgom pas nyams su blangs na/ de la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ skyob pa'i nus mthu sogs yod la/ mkhyen cha ni 'gag pa med pa kun shes kun rig gi cha rig stong zung 'jug gi lta ba de nyid/ shes rab lhag mthong gis gtan la 'bebs pa'i gzhi bdun skyon can dang / skyon med rang gzhung gi gzhi bshad na legs gsungs so/ /stong nyid de'ang snying rje brtse ba chen po'i bdag nyid du bzhugs yod pa ni brtse ba snying rje/ dus skad cig la dus gsum yid kyi 'khrul rtog las snyob pas na skyob pa'i nus mthu/ dbyings spros bral shes rab lhag mthong gi cha zhi gnas/ thabs brtse ba'i snying rje'am/dus gsum yid kyi 'khrul rtog zhi ba thabs dang / rig pa'i ngang du rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i mnyam par/ ༈ spyod pa rgyal ba'i myu gu zhes pa'i skabs/ myu gu bzang po las 17nga po me tog 'bras bu sogs 'khrungs pa ltar/ mnyam bzhag skabs tshogs chen ye rdzogs ni phyin drug tshang ba yin pas de'i stobs kyi rjes thob spyod lam gyi skabs su'ang phyin drug 'bad med rang shugs kyi 'byung ba ni rig stong zung 'jug rtogs byed kyi grogs su byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ ༈ tshe 'dir ka dag zhes pa'i skabs/ rab tshe 'dir grol ba 'chi med gnyug ma'i btsan sa zin pa/ thim rim gyi mgo rtsom pa'i grol ba tshe 'dir grol ba'i phyogs 195

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbasdu/ 'bring 'chi srid chos sku'i 'od gsal shar ba'i tshe grol ba khregs chod kyi grol pa/ chos nyid bar do thod rgal gyi grol pa/ tha ma srid pa bar do/ yang tha skye ba phyi ma/ lo bcu drug gam min kyang rang lo nyer lnga'i dus 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi chos dang 'phrad nas tshe de nyid la grol ba rdzogs chen ltar bka' gter spyi'i 'dod lugs yin no// ༈ lta ba rgyas bshad skabs/ lta ba klong chen rab 'byams ni/ la bzla gsum gyi nyams len gyis sems kyi gsang la brdeg pa zhes gnad la brdeg pa/ dper na shan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa bzhin 'khrul ba'i srog gcod par/ spyir mtshan nyid theg pa'i lta ba lung rigs kyis gtan la phab pa zhes lung rgyal ba'i bka'/ rjes 'jug gi bstan bcos rnams dang / rigs pa ni/ shing rta rnam bdun/ dbu ma'i gnad bzhi/ yod med skye 'gog /mtha' bzhi skye 'gog rdo rje gzegs ma/ gcig du bral sogs kyi gtan la 'bebs pa dang / gsang sngags thun mong pa'i thabs lam dbang gsum pa'i dpe'i ye shes la brten nas/ ༈ 'dir sgrub rgyud dam pa zhes pa'i skabs/ rang lugs 'dir chos sku rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ni/ sems kyi yal sa 'am 'gyu ba'i yal sa ngo sprod pa yin la/ ngo sprod lugs ni/ sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshig pa'i man ngag la brten nas rags pa'i rnam rtog yun ring po'i bar du dwangs su bzhag pa'i tshe/des shul de na gnas cha bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum yod pa las/ de gsum gang rung las mi 'das/ de gsum dang bral dgos te/ gtor byed kyi yi ge phaṭaX sgra drag po byas pa'i tshe nyams zhen gyi shun pa rnams 'thor ba'i tshe skye 196

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmed chos sku'i ngang nas 'gag med zang thal rjen pa'i rig cha/ sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad ma yin pa/ de las 'das pa'i ye shes sngar med gsar byung rgyud la skyes pa ma yin pas/ ye nas ji bzhin par bzhugs pa de bla ma'i man ngag gis ngo sprod pa yin pas na/ zhes so/ /sems rig bye brag phyed pa tsam yin/bye brag rig pa ngos bzung ba tsam yin gsungs/ 'di yan chos dbyings mdzod le'u dgu pa'o/ /ngo sprad pa'i rig pa de yang skye ba med pa yin te/ rgyu dang rkyen gang gis ma bskyed pa spros pa'i mtha' yod med gnyis ka gnyis min sogs mtha' bzhi'am brgyad las 'das pa'i ye shes le'u bcu pa'i shan 'byed kyi 'phyongs yin no/ /ngo bo stong pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ rang bzhin gsal bas chad pa'i zung du 'jug pas tha dad kyi— rtsal snang sna tshogs su 'char ba'i cha nas gcig pu'i mtha' dang bral ba yin no/ /sems kyi shes pa skad cig cha med/ gzung ba rdul phran cha med lta bu ni ma yin la/ rig pa ni ngag gi brngod bya'i yul las 'das pa/ rtsol med de rtog med yin/ rig pa rang gi ngo bo la 'khrul grol med pa'i rang gnas ye shes brjod bral/ sems ni skad cig skye 'gag can/ rgyu gsum rkyen bzhi las grub pa yin no/ /klong chen dang mi pham sogs kyi bzhed lugs phar phyin theg pa'i lam nas 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag skabs rig pa mngon sum/ sngags kyi rig pa mngon sum ngo 'phrod pa gnyis la dgongs nas/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /zhes gsungs yang mdo lam nas tshogs sbyor lam dang / sngags kyi lta ba don spyi tsam yid ngor shar ba gnyis la dgongs nas/ don dam blo yi spyod yul yin/ /zhes pa ltar 'brel/197

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsems can thams cad kyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po ye nas bzhugs pa la chos sku gzhi gnas kyi rig pa zer/ de bla ma'i man ngag gi ngo sprod/ de la goms nas sgrib pa ci rigs pa dag pa'i rnal 'byuor lam sgyu lta ba yin/ ngo sprad pa de ni gzhi'i 'od gsal de las gzhan ma yin pas 'di kho na'o / /༈ rdzogs skabs tshogs sbyor gyi dus su/ yid kyi shes pa rdzing bu lta bu la/rig stong zung 'jug don spyi zla gzugs chu la 'phos pa lta bu yin/ mngon sum rtogs dus yid shes nub tshe zla ba dngos shar ba bzhin no/ /dang po lta ba lta yul gnyis/ lta mkhan yid shes/ lta yul rig stong gi ye shes gnyis dbyer med du gyur ba'i tshe/ bsgom med 'od gsal gyi spubor lo'i de'ang lasadang po pa'i tshe rig pa skad cig de mngon sum shar ba'i tshe/ de'i ngang la yod skabs de las gzhan bsgom tu med pas 'od gsal/ ma bsgom na ye chog snyam na/zhabrul ba rgya 'byams su song ba'i tha mal dang khyad med/ rig pa rang gi ngo bo la 'pho 'gyur med kyang / glo bur rnam rtog gi dri mas bsgribs te/ dri ma dag tshe sku gsum ston pa'i skur bzhengs pa yin no gsungs/ rig pa mthong ba'i cha nas skad cig ma/ gnas pa'i cha nas dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa yin gsungs/༈ lta ba'i ngo ma 'phrod na bsgom pa'i ngang— rnal 'byor lam pa bas lta thog nas sgom pa btsal ba ni/ dang po lta ba ngo sprad nas de la goms pa sgom pa yin/sgom thog nas lta ba btsal ba ni ngo mi 'phrod pa rnams yun ring po'i bar sgom du bcug nas mthar ngo ma sprad na rtsa khams kyis ngo mi 'phrod pa'ang yod pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ rang ngo 'phrod pa lta ba/ ngang la gnas pa sgom pa/ gang 198

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'burma / āḥshar rang grol spyod pa zhes gsungs/ ༈ de nas sgom pa rgyas bshad ni/ ngang bzhag chu bo'i rgyun gyis sgom pa'am/ rang bzhin bab kyi bsam gtan ni/ rig pa rang gi ngo bo la 'khrul grol med pa thog med nas da lta'i bar dang / da nas sangs rgyas kyi bar dus gsum du 'pho 'gyur med pa/ bcos ma ma yin pas rig pa'i ngang bzhag dpe chu bo'i rgyun lta bu gsungs/ bsam gtan thabs lam ma brten bying rgod bral/ zhes gsungs/ klong drug pa las/ ma btsal bzhag pa'i sgom pa dang / /rtsa rlung sems kyi ngal gso gnyis/ /'dra'o 'dra'o nor ra re/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ rig pa'i rang dus de na gnas pa la bsgrub rgyu med/'phro ba la dgag bya med par/ rtsa thig rlung sems kyi thabs la brten pa ni 'pho 'gyur can no// ༈ kun 'byung gi bden paḥ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum 'khor ba'i phyogs kyi rgyu/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa khams gsum snod bcung/ myang 'das phyogs kyi rgyu lam bden/ 'bras bu 'gog bden no/ /rnam rtog de ga'i rang bzhin zhes pa 'char gzhi la chos sku gzhi'i 'od gsal gzhi gnas pa'i 'od gsal zhesapa'i don/ rgyud na bzhugs pa'i cha nas gzhi/ sad par bya ba'i cha nas lam/ sgrib pa dag pa'i cha nas 'bras smi 'od gsal zhes brjod pa yin/ 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pa zhes bya ba'ang de nyid yin no/ / de ltar nam yang bla mas ngo sprad pa'i lta ba rang gi ngo bo shes pa'i 'od gsal gyi rig pa de dran par byas ༈ rig pa de nyid rjen la shar ba'i tshe rnam rtog dge mi dge lung ma bstan gang shar yang ngan pa dgag pa dang spang mi dgos/ bzang po bsgrub pa'am blang mi dgos pa gnad dam pa yin pas/ las dang po pas 199
