g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥcad ched du mi bkag /rjes su mi 'brang bar rang babs su lhod de mnyam par bzhag pa de goms na zhi lhag yang dag rgyud la skye ba'i gzhi man ngag yang dag pa'o/ /de la man ngag yod med ji ltar yang thugs yid bsres nas mnyam par bzhag dus dran shes lung ma bstan tu ma shor ba gal che/ gal te 'khrul 'byams su shor chas byed na ni mnyam bzhag de las lang te/ dge sdig gtong len byed pa sogs la kha spo dgos/ lung ma bstan la 'byams yod bzhin sgom gi go bcad lob slob mi nyan/ yun thung grangs mang byas nas sgom rgyu 'di la gnad chen po rim bzhin go rgyu yod/ yun ring por mnyam bzhag la 'dug thub pa los bzang de yun ring spyad kyi brtan cha yod ni ma red/ brjed ngas dang bying rgod kyis bcad 'gro ni red/ de 'dra'i lung ma bstan la shor grab byed dus mnyam bzhag de las ldang nas rjes thob du/ rang gi dbugs phar 'gro ba dang mnyam du bdag gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad/ de'i 'bras bu dad pa snying rje nges 'byung thos bsam sgom gsum bslab pa gsum sogs yon tan 'jig rten phyogs kyi tshe ring ba/ gzugs mdzes pa longs spyod snyan grags sogs yid du 'ong ba'i bde dge ci yod thams cad/ rlung dkar po'i rnam par song ste/ rang gi tshe rabs thog med kyi dgra bgegs gnyis kyi gtso bo byas pa'i sems can thams cad la byin pas/ de yang gcig kho na thams cad la bgo bsha' byed pa lta bu min par/ bde dge ci yod de sems can gyi grangs bzhin cha tshang re thob nas ma sems can thams cad bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan par bsam/ dbugs tshur sdud dus sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyi 25‘1

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsdig pa mi dge ba bcu mtshams med pa lnga sogs dang so byang sngags gsum gyi dam tshig 'das nyams ral ba/ chos spangs mna' zos sogs dang / 'bras bu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal thams cad 'od nag po'i rnam par byung nas rang gi sna bug gnyis nas zhugs te/ snying nang na thog med nas da bar du bdag med la bdag tu bzung nga med nga ru 'dzin mkhan gyi ngo bo thig le khams nag gi ngo bor yod pa la thim pas/ de ma lcog pa'i rnam pas thig le de nyid zhig ste dmigs med ka dag gi dbyings su gtor nas gzhi med rtsa bral du gyur par bsams nas yang mnyam par 'jog /slar yang sngar bzhin 'khrul 'go rtsom dus rjes thob la ldang nas/ o rgyan chen po slar yang sngar bzhin mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs nas bsngo ba'i dpang po mdzad pa'i dgong gsol zhus/ da ci bsngo na bdag gi sngar bsags tshad kyi dge ba thun shar 'di'i mtshon te da lta bsags yod kyi dge ba ma 'ongs pa na bsags 'gyur gyi dge ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang dang bcas pa rnams kyi zag med kyi dge ba sems can thams cad kyi zag bcas kyi dge ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus blo yi blangs nas dge ba'i phud de o rgyan chen po skyabs gnas kun 'dus la rab sgrub pa'i mchod pa phul/ de ltar mchod pa'i dge rtsa dang bcas pa pha ma gnyis dang dgra bgegs gnyis kyi gtsos sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob nas thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /de ltar bsngo ba dang smon lam btab pa de myur du 'a/༷ par o rgyan chen po khyed kyis thugs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrjes byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bsngo smon byas nas rjes thob du/ bag yang cung zad byas/ de nas slar yang sngar ltar dam pa gsum grangs gsog /kha grangs yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig na brgya dang brgyad bcu 'am brgya dang lnga bcu tsam re 'gro dgos par gsungs kyang spyir de ltar las bye brag gang zag gi khyad par dang goms pa che chung gnyis mtha' gcig tu nges dka' yang /las dang po ba ni gom rim bzhin dang po je mang la 'gro ba zhig nges par dgos gsungs so/ /zhes skyabs rje bya bral chos dbyings rang grol gyi zhal rgyun dang bla ma dam pa mkhan dri med 'od zer gyi gsung rgyun yid la gang zin 'ga' zhig da phan ci nas nyams len la brtson par bzhed pa'i chos grogs dam pa'i thugs kyi bsnyel gsor dmigs te/ ci dran der bcos bsgyur yag bdam ci yang ma byas par thub bstan nor bu nas bris pa yi ge bas sgrub pa don ldan gyi cha rkyen du gyur cig /dam pa gsum grangs bsags lugs ni/ sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad ma nyi zla'i gdan la bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma man chod nas ka kha slob pa'i slob dpon yan chad rdo rje'i mched grogs rnams dang bcas snyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo o rgyan rin po che dngos su bzhugs yod pa gsal dus 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bdag gzhan ma rgan sems can thams cad/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che khyed la blo gtad gcig chog gi dad gus kyis/ skyabs su mchi zhing skyabs gnas mthar thug gi ngo bor dam bca' byed pa yin pas/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis kyi 'jigs pa las 256

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbaskyabs tu gsol snyam du skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ de nas 'khor ba na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gis pha ma sha stag yin kyang da sngon ma shes pas dgra gnyen ris chad du bzung ste rang gis ngo ma shes pas ma rgan sems can thams cad snying re rje/ bdag gis sems can gcig kyang ma lus par 'khor ba las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod par bya/ de'i ched du bla ma/'i gdams ngag gi khrid don nyams su blang bar bya'o zhes nges 'byung gi blos zin pa'i smon 'jug gi sems gnyis bskyed par bya/de nas dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa ni/ kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i gu ru yid bzhin nor bu la yid khyed shes blo gtad ling basmyur gyi dad pas gsol ba snying nas btab pas/ o rgyan chen po'i thugs rgyud bskul te 'od du zhu ba thig le dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa yi ge hūṃ gi rnam pa can du gyur ba rang gi snying gar thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med du gyur bar bsam nas sems rang babs su lhod de rnam rtog la bkag 'brang dang ngo lta med par ci gnas su 'jog /de nas khrid skabs yin na zhakhrul ba lung ma bstan la shor grab byed dus/ slar yang rang gi dus gsum gyi dge rtsa dang / lus longs spyod tshe bsod kha rje dbang thang ngag nus byin rlabs sogs lugs gnyis kyi dpal yon ci yod/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum chos skyong gi thugs rje phrin las thams cad rang gi kha sna nas rlung dkar po'i rnam par phyir song nas/ dgra bgegs sogs mi 'dod pa gtso bor byas pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad la byin pas bgo bsha' byas pa lta bu ma 257

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥyin par sems can re re la bde ba rgyu 'bras bu re re thob par bsam nas rlung phyir bsal/ de nas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud na yod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu nyon mongasadug lnga/ las mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ nye ba lnga/ lci bzhi log brgyad sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba/ mtshams dang 'gal ba/ dam dzig nyam chags chos spangs/ dam sel sogs 'bras bu ngan song gsum rigs drug rgyud lnga/ sdug bsngal gsum/ na tsha rkyen bgegs dbul phong bkres skom/nad dang dgra sogs mi 'dod pa thams cad rlung nang du 'ong ba dang mnyam du 'od nag po'i rnam par byung nas/ kha sna'i lam rgyud de rang gi snying nang na thog med nas nga med la ngar 'dzin pa'i gces 'dzin gyi ngo bo thig le khams nag gi rnam par yod pa la thim pas thig le de nyid dmigs med kyi dbyings su gtor bar bsam nas rlung nang du rdub sems can rnams sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral nas thams cad sangs rgyas par bsam la/ thugs yid bsres de mnyam par 'jog pa sogs byed pa gong ltar byas/ yang 'khrul dbang la 'chor grab byed 'ong dus/rjes bsngo ba dam pa ni/ bla ma o rgyan chen po sngar ltar mdun mkhar gsal ba bsngo ba'i dbang po byed par zhu/ ji ltar bsngo na/ bdag gis da res thun 'dis dge rtsas mtshon/ bdag gis sngar bsags kyi dge ba/ ma 'ongs par bsags 'gyur gyi dge ba/ da lta'i bsags yod kyi dge ba/ sangasargyas byang sems nyan rang sogs kyi zag med kyi dge ba/ sems can thams cad kyis bsags pa'i zag bcas kyi da/ 5༷ thams cad bsres te bsdoms nas/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrjes su yi rang dang bcas dge rtsa'i phud o rgyan chen po la mchod par phul/de'i dge rtsa dang bcas ma rgan sems can thams cad la bsngos te byin pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par shog cig snyam du bsngo ba dang smon lam snying nas 'debs/ smon lam de nyid 'grub par o rgyan pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam du yang yang bsam/ de nas rjes thob du cung zad gu yang ba bya/ 'khrul dbang la shor chas byed dus yang dam pa gsum po yang bskyar byas/ de ltar thun re la byed srol khams dang bstun dgos so/ /de la mdo sngag sa kyi lam gnad thams cad 'dus par gsungs/ ༈ dang po mdun gyi nam mkhar o rgyan chen po bzhugs yod bsam/ de nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du o rgyan rin po che khyed la skyabs su mchi 'o bsam/ de nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas sa la 'god par byas de'i ched du bdag gis thun 'di gcad pa yin bsam/ de nas bdag la skyid sdug legs nyes bzang ngan ci byung yang o rgyan chen po khyed mkhyen/ khyed las gzhan pa'i skyabs gzhan med bsam/ o rgyan chen po 'od du zhu nas thig le dkar dmar gyi rnams pas bdag gi snying khar thim pas gu ru'i thugs dang bdag gi sems dbyer med 'dres par bsam/de nas thugs yid dbyer med kyi ngang nas rang sems ma bcos par mnyam par bzhag /rnam rtog bkag mi nyan/ rnam rtog gi rjes su 'brang mi nyan/ yang 'khrul chus byed dus kha gdangs nas sgom mdog byed mi nyan/ rjes thob la ldang nas dge sdig gtong len byed dgos/ rang gi tshe rabs snga ma dang / da lta 259

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdang rjes mar bsags pa'i dge ba dang / 'bras bu bde ba thams cad dbugs phar 'gro ba dang mnyam du rlung dkar po'i rnam par phar song bas sems can thams cad la dge rtsa bde 'bras cha tshang re thob nas bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan par bsam/ dbugs tshur rngub dus sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras thams cad rlung nag po'i rnam par tshur byung nas rang gi sna bug nas zhugs te snying nang na bdag gces 'dzin gyi ngo bo thig le khams nag lathim pas dmigalda med kadagagidabyi/sdusu gtorarsha/bsamalayang ṭwāoṃṭwāṃ ོ༵ pa/ra/ ༵shādītre/ ṭwāṃkṣiṃ ma/dun du o rgyan na po sngar ba gsal nas bsngo 260

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄tsho/ /rdzogs chen gyi lam nyams su len pa'i man ngagalam zab mo 'di nyid nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes thob gsum du yod pa las/ dang po sngon 'gro la yang sgo gsum sbyangs pa'i rim pa las/ dang po lus kyi mngon zhen bzlog cing bar chad kyi gegs bsal ba'i phyir gnas dben pa mi med lung stong du 'gro ste/ ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi srung ma gsol zhing sa lam gyi bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol/ de nas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad srid pa sdug bsngal gyi khri mun las 'don pa'i phyir/ ngas 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed cing tshe gcig lus gcig tu rgyal ba kun tu bzang rngo 'i go 'phang la bgrod par bya'o zhes sems bskyed/ de nas bla ma spyi bor bsgom pa'i sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/rang gi spyi bo nas lus la zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po dang bcas pa dngos med du gzhig par bsam de nas ye shes lnga ldan gyi thig le chen po'i nang khungs su rang lus rdo rje sngon po rwa gdeng ba zhig tu bsgos te lag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar zhing gru mo phyir bsgrad rkang pa'i mthil sprad de pus mo yang bsgrad/ thig le'i phyi rim du me dpung 'bar zhing tsha tsha 'phro bar bsgom/ de la dag pa dran pa ni/ yar rtse gsum du ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum dang / mar rtse gsum chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum dang / rked pa gcig tu dril ba ni thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i mtshon 261

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'burma / āḥbyed du shes par bya'o/ /de ni snga ma dang phyi ma ni lus kan rkyal du log nas snga ma ltar lus kyis bya ba dang dag pa dran par bya'o/ /de ltar zhag bzhi bcur gnad du bsnun pas skabs su lus rdo rje me 'bar ba mthong nas bgegs dang bar chad zhi/ mthar thug lus sgrib dag cing lus rdo rje sku yi rol bar sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ngag gi zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir ngag sbyang ba la/ spyi bor bla ma bsnom pa'i gsung gi gsang ba chen po 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par rang gi mgrin par thim ste ma dag pa'i rtsa dang rlung khams nad gdon sgrib pa'i bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sangs kyis dag par byas te/rang lus gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje sku che la yan lag rags pa nam mala'i mtha' dang mnyam par snang la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu zhig tu bsgom sa te/ hūṃ gi sgra bsgrags pas hūṃ yig kha dog mthing ga nas rim pa bzhin tu dkar ser dmar ljang 'phros pas srid khams kyi brtan g.yo thams cad hūṃ gi rol par gyur nas snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu'i stong khams thams cad hūṃ gis khengs par bsam zhing / ngag tu yang hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes hūṃ glu dal bur brjod cing hūṃ thams cad rang gi zhal tu zhugs te lus kyi rtsa dang rlung khams thams cad hūṃḥgi rang bzhin du gyur te rang lus hūṃḥgi yi ge rdul phran gyi cha tsam tshogs pa'i phung por bsgom sa te hūṃḥgi dal bus snyan pa'i glu len/ 'di yi dus dmigs pa gzhan du mi yengs pa gnad dam pa'o/ de yang zhag bcur gnas de nas nyams su blangs nas gnas skabs rtsa rlung las su mi rung ba'i gegs sel/ mthar thugs ngag gi sgrib pa dag cing dbyangs snyan pa 262

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdang rdo rje gsung gi rol par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa yid sbyang ba ni/ lus dur khrod kyi mi ro ltar g.yo 'gul dang bral bar bzhag ngag smra brjod dang bral ba lhugs pa lta bur bzhagaX sems ni sprin dngas ba'i nam mkha' lta bur bzo mi 'chos par bzhag /res 'ga' khro bo'i lta stangs byas nas hūṃḥhūṃḥzhes drag tu brjod cing snang ba gtad med du btang / res 'ga' rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pa'i ngang nas sems ma bcos par lhod de shig ger bzhag/de ltar gzhig la nyams su blangs bas yid sgrib dag cing / rig pa rang byung gi ngang mthong ste chos yang dag pa'i dgos pa yod/ kyai rig pa'i rdo rje khyed legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang dngos gzhi nyams su len pa'i rim pa nga'i spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul rlabs po che'i bdag nyid 'pho ba chen po'i sa/dmas pa nyams su len pa ni/ lus gnad seng ges 'brug la rngams pa lta bu dang / glang bde lugs su nyal ba lta bu dang / drang srong gis yul dpyod byed pa'i 'dug stangs lta bu'i bzhugs stangs la brten nas gzigs stangs yang dang po gyen/ gnyis pa thad/ gsum pa thur blta ba yin par shes par gyis/ngag gi gnad ni mchu so ma reg pa'i bar nas rlung gi 'gro 'ong dal ba bslab/smra brngod bzlas pa thams cad cog ger bzhag nas bde lugs su rang bab tu gnas pa dang / sems kyi gnad lhod de shig ger bzhag pa dang gsum ni sku gsum gyi rnal du dbab pa yin/ lus dur khrod kyi mi ro lta bur bskul bskyod dang bral bar sdod pa dang / ngag lkugs pa lta bu smra bcad du sdod pa dang /sems dbyings rig mi 'gyur ba'i ngang du sdod pa dag ni sdod pa gsum gyi sa 263

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdabab pa yin no/ /lus la lhod chags pa mi bsgrim zhing chun mi btsal bar bab kyi bzhag /ngag la lhod chags pa dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong dgag sgrub med par bzhag pa dang / sems la lhod chags pa yid dpyod byed dang dgag sgrub med par bzhag pa ni sdod pa gsum gyis ngang chags pa zhes bya'o/ /yang lus dang ngag mi 'gul bas rtsa dang rlung mi 'gul de ma 'gul bas sgo dang snang serma sa mi 'gul ba ste/ mi 'gul pa gsum gyi gnad bstun pa'i lus po'i rtsa drang rtsa drang pas bde lugs su rgyu zhing drang pa yin te drang pa gsum gyi gzer gdab pa zhes bya'o/ /dang po lus kyi gsang lam sgron ma drug du yod pa las/drug ni 'di lta ste/ rang gi snying tsitta sha yi sgron ma'i dbus su dwangs ma rtsa yi sgron ma zhes bya ba rta rnga brgyad gshags kyi cha gcig tsam la/ dwangs gsal shel gyi sbu gu lta bu'i yar rtse rgyang zhag chu yi sgron ma'i a 'bras su kha phye ba'i nang khongs su dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma 'ja' ris kyi gang ba za 'og kha phye ba lta bu'i klong du thig le stong pa'i sgron ma ko mo'i chu la rdo bskyur ba lta bu dang / shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma rig pa bder gshegs snying po sgron ma lnga yi 'char gzhi gnas pa ni lam rang byung ba'o/ /gsang ba chen po rang byung ba'i lam de la brten nas 'bras bu bla na med pa'i sa la brdal ba ni lam myur zhing chod che ba bla na med pa'o/ /de la las dang po pas sursā dang tsand+ra la gru gang ma reg pa'i sar blta ba dang / man shel a lo ke la tsakyu phyed btsum gyis bltas na rig pa mdung tshugs su mig la gtad cing sdod pa'i snang ba ni/ 'od gsal dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma za 'og kha phye ba lta bu'i klong du thig le stong pa'i sgron 264

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥm 'od lnga'i mu khyud can kyi rnam par 'char te/ de dag gi go mtshams su rig pa'i gdengs rdo rje lu gu rgyud ces bya ba/ gser gyi skud pa ldang ba lta bur gsal la 'tsher ba phra la 'khyogs par 'char ro/ /sgo yi gnad la brten pa'i phyir dang so so'i gnas skabs su 'dar 'phrig dang 'gro 'ong can gyi rnam par 'char ro/ /de nas cung zad goms pa'i stobs kyis sgron ma'i snang ba thams cad brtan cing gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de yi tshe snga dro nub phyogs dang phyi dro shar phyogs su kha bltas te sdod pa dang / dkar khung gsal lam la bltas pas chog pa yin no/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i skyes bu de lam ma nor ba dad pa brtan pa dam tshig thub par ngo skog dang g.yo rgyu med pa dag la brgyud rim gnyis tshun chad du nga'i dgongs rgyud 'phos te nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing / gol shol gegs dang 'phrang las grol te tshe gcig lus gcig gi 'ja' lus 'od skur grol ba'i gtan tshig go/ /༄༅/ /thod rgal nyams len byed tshul/ rang byung rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal/ de yang zab pa thod rgal gyi nyams len bya tshul mdor bsdus ni/dang po ka dag khregs chod kyi lta ba skyon med du thag bcad pa'i steng du sgo yul sogs kyi gnad la/ dang po sgron ma drug ni/ dang po sha yi sgron ma ni rang gi snying nang du rten dwangs ma lnga ye shes lnga dang / snyigs ma lnga 'byung lnga ye shes rigs lngar lhun grub du shar ba de'o/ /gnyis pa dkar 'jam rtsa'i sgron ma ni/ ka ti shel sbubs can snying nas mig tu brgyud pa de'o/ /gsum pa rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma ni mig gi dbang rten gyi go sar 'od rtsa dwangs pa 'khrul ba mi 'dzin cing 265

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥye shes kyi snang ba 'dzin pa de'o/ /bzhi pa thig le stong pa'i sgron ma ni/ rgyang zhags kyi 'od rtsas mthong ba'i thig le stong pa'i sgron ma lam du byed dgos pa de'o/ /lnga pa dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma ni/ dbyings nam mkha' nam mkha'i stong pa dang / nang gi gsang lam dang gdangs sngon po phyir shar ba dang / gsang ba'i dbyings mig gi 'od rtsa'i snang ba la snang rgyu'i dbyings gdangs lnga ldan thig le stong pa'o/ /drug pa shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma ni/ 'khor gsum rnal 'byor dag pa shes pa'i shes rab rig pa rang gsal de ka'o/ /de ltar sgron ma drug gi blta bya gnas dus sgo yul gnad dang lnga ste/ dang po ni rnam g.yeng dang 'du 'dzi med pa'i gnas su bsgom/ gnyis pa ni nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dus su bsgom/ gsum pa ni chos sku'i gzigs stangs kyis gtsug tor gyi thad kar blta/longs sku'i padma'i spyan gyis zur g.yas g.yon du blta/ sprul sku'i chos kyi mig gis sna rtse'i nam mkhar blta'o/ /bzhi pa ni chos sku nyi ma longs sku zla ba sprul sku snang gsal rnams la byed/ lnga pa lus ngag yid gsum gnad du bcun te bsgom pa gal che/ de yang sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs bya'o// de la snang ba'i 'char tshul ni bzhi las/ dang po chos nyid mngon sum ni dbyings ngogs su thig le rnams kha dog rdzogs pa nas bzung thig le sum 'brel tshun chad pa dang / lu gu rgyud gser skud ltar 'gul 'phrig gi rnam pa can skabs 'gar mngon skabs 'gar 'chad pa de nyid rig pa ye shes kyi gdangs dngos yin pas thig le'i ra bar tshud dgos gsungs/ gnyis pa gong 'phel gyi dus snang nyams la dbyings dang thig le'i kha dog sngar bas je gsal la song zhing / 'od snang gyen 'greng 266

g.yu khog bla ma chospodabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdang rtsibs shar la sogs pa sna tshogs 'char ba dang / shes nyams yang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob pa sogs 'byung ba yin no/ /gang 'phel na 'od snang dang ting 'dzin gong du 'phel dgos pa yin no/ /gsum pa tshad phebs kyi dus rim gyis bsgoms mthar/ snang nyams la thig le'i klong du yi ge dang phyag mtshan lha sku sogs 'char zhing shes nyams gzhir gnas kyi rig pa rang thog tu phebs pas brtson 'grus bya mi dgos par/thod rgal gyi rig pa nyams su len pa tshad du phyin nas gong 'phel tshad la phebs pa'o/ /bzhi pa chos nyid zad pa'i skabs su phyi'i nyams snang gi 'phel kha zad/nang tshogs drug gi nyer len ldog pa sgyu lus kyi chos zad/ gsang ba rtog tshogs 'phro 'du'i sems zad nas snang dang mi snang gi 'dzin pa'i blo zad de/ 'od kyi snang ba las 'khor 'das kyi 'du shes bral nas 'byung ba la sogs dgras mi tshugs pa 'byung zhing / thig le'i ye shes mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par snang ngo / /de la mi 'gul gsum gyi gnad ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad brtan pa/gdod ma gzhi'i dbyings su gnas pa'i dgos pa yin no/ /sdod pa gsum gyi tshad ni/ phyi'i snang ba sdod pas rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ba dang / nang sgyu lus sdod pas 'brul ba'i bya ba dang bral/ bar rlung sems sdod pas rnam rtog 'du rgyun chad pa yin no// ༈ thob pa gsum ni/ phyi snang la dbang thob pas snang yul zhing khams su grol/ nang sgyu lus la dbang thob pas sgru lus 'od gsal du 'gro/gsang ba rlung sems la dbang thob pas 'khrul pa'i snang cha rang 'gags su song pas gang snang thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa nyid du grol ba'o/ /gdengs bzhi 267

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥni/ rang rig las sangs rgyas logs na med par thag chod pas sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i re dogs bral ba ni yar gyi gdengs gnyis/ rnam par rtog pa chos nyid du grol nas 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi rgyu med pas 'khor bar lhung pa dang ma lhung pa'i re dogs bral ba'i gdengs rnyed pa ni mar gyi gdengs gnyis ste gdengs bzhi'o/ /snang bzhi'i 'phel tshad rdzogs pa'i rtags sgo gsum la 'char la/ dang po chos nyid mngon sum gyi skabs lus rus sbal mkhar gzhong du gnas pa lta bu dang / ngag brjod bral lhags pa dang / sems mkha' 'gro snyi la zin pa ltar rtog med du gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa gong 'phel dus lus skyes bu nad kyis gdung ba ltar spros med dang / ngag spyon pa 'ur lang ltar gang shar zang thal rjes med dang / sems dug nad kyi thebs pa bzhin rtog pa'i 'phro 'du chad pa yin no// ༈ gsum pa tshad phebs dus glang chen 'dam du mi bying pa ltar ri brag la thogs med du 'gro ba dang / ngag grul bum gyi phru gu ltar snyan cing ci smras gzhan la phan pa dang / sems snying la mda' phog pa ltar dran bsam 'phro 'du'i rtog pa'i rgyun chad pa'o/ /bzhi pa chos nyid zad pa'i dus/ lus dur khrod kyi mi ro ltar sor bzhag dgag sgrub kyi 'brul pa'i yul med/ ngag brag cha ltar gzhan gyi ci smras rjes su zlos/ sems rims nad byang ba'i skyes bu ltar rtog tshogs dbyings su dag nas rig pa rang gsal chen por gnas pa yin no// ༈ de ltar snang ba bzhi'i 'char tshul snga ma rnams ni snang nyams dang shes nyams kyi shar tshul mdor bsdus dang / phyi ma ni bum gsang sher dbang gi nus pa thebs pas sgo gsum gyi rtags tshad rdzogs tshul yin no//268

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༈ mdor na khregs chod kyi lta bas thag bcad/ sgom pas ngang bskyangs/ spyod pas la dor/ rig pa khyab brdal du 'jog /shes pa bzo med du skyong / dran rtog mkha' la sbul mdud bor ba ltar rang grol du bzhag pas skye med kyi don rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bla ma'i gsung gi zin bris byas pa la 'khrul pa ci mchis pa thams cad dpal ldan bla mar bshags/ dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog cig /༈ lta ba dpa' dgos/ spyod pa sdar dgos/ lta ba ye 'babs/ spyod pa mas 'dzegs/ snang ba 'od kyi khyad par/ nyams len lag len dang 'brel ba'i khyad par/ rang snang mngon sum gzigs pa'i khyad par/ lus gnad rtsa'i khyad par/ snang byed sgo'i khyad par/ mthong ba dbang po'i khyad par/ nyams myong 'phel snang ba'i khyad par dang bdun no// ༈ stong gsal phyi'i nam mkha' g.ya' dag /rtog med nang gi nam mkha' kun rtog dag pa/ zang thal gsang ba'i nam mkha' rig pa rjen la bud pa/ thod rgal skabs dbyings thig rig gsum snying dbus na gnas pa nang rtsa/ nas phar phyir 'char ba phyi/ de'i snga phyi'i nam mkha' sum sprug shes par bya gsungs// ༈sgron ma drug ni/ gnas lugs rang byung gi sgron ma/tsitta sha yi sgron ma/ rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma/ thig le stong pa'i sgron ma/bar do dus kyi sgron ma/ mthar thugs 'bras bu'i sgron ma dang drug go// ༈chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seṅge lta bu/ longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang chen nyal ba lta bu/ sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong lta bu/ mngon par byang chub bya rgod lta bu/mi 'gyur rdo rje rdo rje lta bu/ sangs rgyaX 9'gro ba rnam snang gi chos bdun/'od

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasal rnam sbyong rgyal ba'i gzim lugs/ mkha' mnyam dag pa skyes bu'i 'gying stabs/ gnam gzer dag pa lcags sdong gi 'gril lugs/ drag shul po gyad kyi dor stabs/ dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs/ ༈ bla ma'i man ngag gi rig pa ngo sprad tshe/ sgo lnga cha mnyam pa/ dper na rgya mtsho lham me lta bu rgya mtsho cog bzhag yin/ rig pa rjen cer rig pa cog bzhag yin/ shar ba ltar snang ba cer bzhag yin/ mi g.yo ba ri bo cog bzhag yin/ra༅ོ/ /nyag bla'i zhal rgyun/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyag gter rin po ches/ sangs rgyas mngon sum du rnyed yod pa'i dus 'dir/ ri khrod dben pa zhig la/ rang nyid gcig pur grogs med par bsdad nas g.yas su dbyug tho/g.yon du khug lu/ sprun du rdza zangs/ rgyab brag phug zhig la gtad nas/ 'di nas byang chub kyi bar du yar gtad de bla ma dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la gtad/ mar gtad de rig stong zung 'jug rjen pa de la gtad nas/dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du lta ba'i rdzong de rdo rje pha lam gyi rdzong lta bu zhig bzung nas mig sngo ce re dbugs chad ma song bar bsgom dgos gsungs/༄7/ /yang skyabs rje bla ma rin po ches zhal nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems man chad/ ka kha sum cu slob pa'i slob dpon yan chad skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rig stong zung 'jug 'di kho na yin par shes pa'i blo thag bcad nas/ mtho la kha ru song rung / dma' lung khung du song rung / nyi ma nyin phyed zla ba mtshan phyed/ 'di phyi bar do gsum dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin par blo thag bod kyis bcad nas 270

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrig stong zung 'jug de nyams su blang / phyi nang snod bcud kyi snang ba'i chos thams cad rang snang rang bzhin med par bden med sgyu ma'i rnam rol rmi lam gyi 'khrul snang tsam las bden grub med par blo thag rbad kyis bcad nas/ lta ba'i rdzong bzung dgos/ rig pa rkyang rkyang de rjen ded ma byas na/ sgom pa'i 'phrang bgrod dka' mo yin/ zhi gnas steng na gol sa gsum dang / lhag mthong steng na shor sa bzhi dang / nor sa brgyad sogs kyi 'phrang gi ra bas bskor yod ni red/ shin tu gzab ste dus gsum gyi 'khrul pa la mi skur/ nyams bde gsal sogs kyi shun pa bskon mi bcug /bying rmugs kyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i rig pa gshis thog tu phebs nas lta ba'i rdzong zin na spyod pas srog 'phrog sgom pas la dor ba yin pas (nyon mongs pa'i )snying po blangs nas rang rkya mi thub par grol ba ni/ me tshan nang du spu nyag lhung ba ltar rjes med du 'gro ba yin/rig pa gsal ngar dang ldan pa'i lta ba'i rdzong gtan nas shor mi nyan/ dper na mi dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs dus ral gri lag gis bzung nas zhugs/ ral gri sa la lhung na de ma thag tu yar la blang ba ltar/ rjes thob spyod lam gyi skabs su lta ba'i gdengs ma shor/ bsgom pa'i ngang ma shor ba'i ngang nas zhugs dgos pas gal che ste/ lta ba'i rdzong shor na de ma thag yang dag gnyug ma'i dran pas zin dgos/ dran pas zin kyang lta ba'i rdzong ma zin na/ chab rom steng du 'gyel ma ling lta bu'i cang mi 'ong / yang dag gnyug ma'i dran pas zin tsam nas dran mkhan ye shes kyi rnam ldan du 'char ba'i rig pa gshis thog tu slebs na/ nyi ma re la dran pa lnga brgya tsam re bsten na bzang / chos chen po phan yon los yod 271

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥm gtogs bka' brgyad khram shing zhig 'don ni bas nyams len ba zhig gis dran pa gcig bsten nas rig pa'i rang sa zin na des dga' gsungs/ rig ngo 'phrod phan chod dran pas mi 'ching / da rig ngo 'phrod nas bzung ste yeng ba med par bsgom dgos/ min dus zhig la bsgom rtsis byed ni bas ni/ rig ngo 'phrod dus bsod nams zad song na ma gtogs bsgom/ dgos ni red/ sangasargyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum 'di ni/ zhing la so nam/ phyugs kyi 'tsho skyong / dkor kha grong chog gor li sha skal/ja tho nas spar/ 'khor ba'i bya bzhag sogs kyi bya ba gang la'ang brje mi bra nges pa red/ rig cha rjen pa de'i sa shor dus ni/ kho bya bral ba yin zer nas sa thag ring mo zhig la song nis tsha ma med/ rgyu zas med nis tsha ma med/ sa mtho sa zhig la bsdad nis tsha ma med/ gnyen grogs med nis tsha ma med/ thob mtho nis tsha ma med/ gdugs dkar po bcu gsum gyi zhabs na yod nis tsha ma med/gser khri ser po zhig gi steng na yod nis tsha ma med/ mdor na kun gzhi sems gsum dang ma bral na/ lus can sems kyi dri ma tshur rol 'khor ba'i sa yin pas cis kyang shes dgos so/ /bya ba gang bral dgos na nang nyon mongs pa'i g.yul chen po kun gzhi sems gsum dang bral nas rig pa lam byed pha rol myang 'das kyi 'bras bu lam byed dam lam rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'o/ /khregs chod kyi lam shar grol dang / thod rgal gyi lam 'od snang ste lam bden dngos yin/ dad pa dag snang byams snying rje sogs kyang de'i phyogs su bsdu dgos/ des sems rig gi la shan zer ba rig dang ma rig lag pa'i mdun 272

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsu nga 'bum/ āḥrgyab lta bu yin par shes nas/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i yar mar gyi sa mtshams/ dpe ral gri so rdeb lta bur byed nas nyams len da lta da lta byed pa gal che/ sang bya gnang bya zhig tu ngas ri khrod bsten nas sgom bsgrub dge sbyor zhig byed bsam pa'i 'du shes ring mo de ni phung 'dre ltas ngan rtag 'dzin bdud kyis bslus pa yin/ de bas ri khrod zhig 'dzin dgos bsam na ni/ grogs 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang sbyar nas da lta da lta nas rig pa'i rang sa zin na sgo gsum dben khrod gsang gsum dang ldan pa yin/ lha chos lus dang yan lag 'dra/ /nam dgos rang gi drung na yod/ /gsungs pa de ni rang gi shes rgyud steng na yod ni red/ mnyam bzhag tu rig pa sku gsum gyi bdag nyid gshis kyi bzhugs tshul gzhi las ma g.yos par bzhugs pa dang / rjes thob tu bzhengs pa'i tshe na rin chen gser gling du phyin pa lta bu/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad yang rig pa'i rnam ldan du gyur nas snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba'i dur khrod kyi 'dre la sogs pa thams cad kyi rgyud na de 'dra'i rig pa sku gsum gyi bdag nyid de mngon sum du bzhugs yod par gzigs nas snang srid bla mar 'char ba'i dag snang ma bral bar de ltar rgyud na yod par ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la dmigs pa med pa'i brtse ba'i snying rje chen po phyogs ris med par nyi ma'i zer ltar 'char dgos/ de ltar dmigs med kyi dag snang dang snying rje sogs yon tan gyi cha rnams yang dag pa'i lam du 'gro dang mi 'gro'i 'bras rtags yin pas yod dgos/ sbal ba chung yang rkang lag bzhi po yod pa ltar dza dzug zhig yod dgos ni red/ nyi ma shar yang drod sang nyin bas med 273

g.yu khog bla ma chos da byings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āoḥzer ba ni mi srid/ mnyam bzhag tu nyams len a mas bu chung skyar skyar byas kyang / rig pa gsal ngar dang mi ldan na/ rnam rtog gcig grol mi thub/ gasda grol na bzang rkyen dang ngan rkyen gnyis grol dgos ni red/ bzang rkyen ni lus sems gnyis ka dga' ya le 'gro ba'i zag bcas kyi rkyen gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs dang rnyed bkur snyan grags bstod bkur byed pa de rnams kyis bslangs nas lus sems bde bas khyab pa de ni mi mngon par skog tu 'jab ste 'ong ba dang 'dra ste/ de grol ma thub na lha yi bu yi bdud yin/ ngan rkyen ni/dngos su dpung shed kyi sgo nas bcom par byed pa yul bud med sogs la 'dod chags skye ba dang / dgra lta bu'i phyogs la zhe sdang skye ba sogs yin pas/de'i sna mi rten/ de thag tshad zhig la 'phen nas rta brgyug tshar rdul dwangs tshar rjes zhig la phyi ltas zhig byas rung tshar song ni red/ grol ba'i ming mi thogadab bu dub be dang / 'bral ru zhasbul res ngang nas rnam rtog med song ni 'dra 'dra de rgan rgon tshos de 'dra'i rnam rtog thams cad cang lag len du theb ni ma red/ de lta bu'i gang zag des ni spyod lam skabs su 'phong mgo grog tshang nang duo bzhag ni 'dra 'dra ma gotogaso nyams len stu re g.yug gi so gdan ni ga la yad/ las rgyu 'bras 'chal nyag tu spyad pa dag gi rang rkub rang gis phud nas 'di ltar zer/ las rgyu 'bras kyi kho bo la mi gnod pas khyed cag la des ci gnod zer ba de ni/ lto le 'chi kha ma tshos 'chi mi thub nas 'chi 'phags byed pa ltar ngo tsha rgyu med pa'i skad cha red/ o ma ṇi padme hūṃḥ slob dpon padmas/dge stong sdig stong nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi lta ba zhig dar gsungs lung 2 74

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbastan thog tu bab pa red/ de 'dra min pa'i bu snying yod yar 'gro zhig yin na/mnyam bzhag tu rig pa sku gsum gyi bzhugs tshul ni khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid can de ngo bo stong nyams ngar cha dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin gsal nyams sangs cha dang ldan pa/ thugs rje rig nyams grol cha dang ldan pas rtog pa gang shar kyang bag chags bsags long mi 'dug /rjes thob skabs su las rgyu 'bras de la de bas ni zhib cha che ba yin/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar nas nyams len pa zhig yin na las rgyu 'bras kyi gnas la mi zhib thabs gtan nas med/ slob dpon padmas/ nga lta ba nam mkha' bas kyang mtho/ las rgyu 'bras bag phye bas kyang zhib/ gsungs pa ltar/ de lta bu zhig la zer ba yin/rtog pa rang sar grol dang mi grol ni rkyen ngan pa dang 'phrad nas rnam rtog me 'bar 'bar chu khol khol yong dus su grol thub na grub rtags zhig dang khyad med/ chags sdang ngan pa gcig grol thub na bskal pa mang po'i sdig sgrib 'dag ni red/ grub rtags ni de yin/ khong la bla ma nyag blas pha bsad lag dmar lta bu 'phrad dus/ lus ngag yid gsum lhod shig ge/ ngo gdong khong nas 'dzum mol le yod dgos ni red gsungs/ de lta bu'i rkyen ngan dang 'phrad dus dran pas gcig zin na phan yon dpag tu med pa yod nges yin gsungs/ rig pa dngos gshis thog tu pheb dus ni/ dpyod byed kyi mkhan po 'gyel/ rlung sems dbyings su dengs/ nyams zhen gyi shun pa 'thor/ yin min gyi rtsis gdab thams cad se lung lcags kyi rgya mdud 'thor ba bzhin du grol ba ni/snang ba'i mdun na mun pa 'dug long med pa bzhin no gsungs pa de/ bla ma rin 275

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpo che'i zhal rgyun nor ba med pa dge legs 'phel/ ༈ nyid kyis 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len par 'dod na glen sgom u tshugs byas pa la snying po med pa ma zad srog rtsar las rlung 'jug pa'i gegs su 'gro ba las lo brgyar bsgoms kyang grol ba med lags/ de phyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zab mo la brten nas 'khor 'das gnyis kyi spyi gzhi gtan la dbab nas 'khor 'das dag mnyam gyi lta ba rtogs dgos pa yin/ de yang 'di nyid rtogs na gdod ma'i grol gzhi byed pa dang / ma rtogs na sems can gyi 'khrul gzhi byed pas spyi gzhi zer ba yin/ mdor na ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i dus gsum yid kyi 'khrul pa las gzhan pa'i 'khor ba med pa dang /'khrul pa'i rtog tshogs zhi ba las gzhan pa'i zhi ba myang 'das med pa shes par gyis la zhib du gtan la dbab dgos zhes/ bla ma rin po che nas so/ /༈ nyams len gyi snying po ni/ mnyam bzhag gi skabs su nyams zhen gyi shun pa dang bral ba'i rig stong zang thal gyi ngang nas dus gsum gyi rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad bag chags gsog long med par rang shar dang rang grol du 'gro dgos pas lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pa gal che/ rjes thob kyi dus su dran pas zin pa tsam nas dran mkhan chos nyid kyi dbyings su grol nas chos nyid kyi ngang du rgya 'byams dgos pas yengs ba'i tshe dran pas zin pa gal che zhes mdo pa gdams ngag rgya mtsho rang yul du pheb dus chos dbyings rang grol nas gces nor du gdams pa yin no// ༈ blos phar ma bsgoms pas cog bzha garig pas tshur ma bcings pas rgya yan/ bcings grol gnyis ka las 'das 276

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpas mtha' grol/ sgom 'dzin gyi blo dang bral bas blo bral/ rang bzhin gdod nas dag pas ye dag /nyams zhen gyi shun pa 'thor bas rjen pa/ gzung 'dzin rang grol du song bas rig stong / rnam rtog gi gos dang bral bas gcer smi/gdod ma nas gnas pas gnyug ma/ blo gnyis 'dzin gyi dri mas ma gos pas so ma/ rgyu rkyen dang bral bas rang byung / 'khrul grol dang bral bas ka dag /spang blang dang bral bas blo 'das so// ༈ byang chub kyi sems de la/ ngo bo dang /rtsal dang / rol pa gsum yin la/ de yang kun gzhi lung ma bstan gyi ngo bo las khyad du 'phags pa'i chos sku gzhir gnas kyi rig pa spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba dpe nam mkha' lta bu de la ngo bo/ 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhi ma 'gags kyang kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang bral ba'i tshogs drug dus mnyam du 'char ba'i longs sku'i ye shes dpe me long la gzugs brnyan 'char ba lta bu de la rtsal/ kun nyon zhabrul ba'i rtog tshogs ma spangs rang grol du song ba'i thugs rje rig gdangs sna tshogs su 'phro ba dpe chu la ri mo bris pa lta bu de la rol ba'o// ༈ gzhir gnas kyi ye shes gsum ngo bo stong pa'i ye shes rang bzhin gsal ba'i ye shes thugasarje kun khyab kyi ye shes/ mtshan nyid med pa'i ye shes lnga/ yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes gnyis ji lta ji snyed ye shes/ ༈ shes rig rang tshig rig pa sku gsum de ngo rang thog tu sprad pa thag gcig thog tu bcad pa gdengs grol thog tu bca' ba'o zhes/ don bzang rtog tu shar yang rang shar rang grol/ ngan rtog tu shar yang mtha' grol klong yangs/ lung ma bstan gyi cha rang dwangs/ ༈ dus rgya che ba nam mkha' ji srid/ dmigs pa rgya che ba sems can thams cad kyi don/ don rgya che ba sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang / blo 277
ri du mnar med du 'jug kyang padma'i makṣe

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄༅/ /gzhi'i 'od gsal las grol 'khrul 'byung tshul sogs mdor bsdus/'dir 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs la/ gzhon nu bum pa'i sku zhes nang gsal thim la ma rmugs pa phra ba'i ye shes de nyid/ dur khrod kyi 'dre mo yan chad kyi rgyud la yod gsungs/ gzhon nu bum sku zhes pa ni/ 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i ye shes la skye 'chi dang bgres rgud med pas na gzhon nu/lhun grub kyi rgya ma ral bas na bum sku/ sku dang ye shes ma 'gags pas nang gsal/ kun gyis rtogs dka' bas phra ba'i ye shes/ dper na bag chags gsum gyis bsgrib pa ni bum pa lta bu'o/ /phra ba'i ye shes de nyid sku gsum gyi bdag nyid bum nang gi mar me lta bu'o/ /thim rim thams cad rdzogs nas 'chi srid chos sku'i bar do'i skabs gzhi'i 'od gsal la bsam gtan gyi zhag lnga la gnas/ de las ldang tshe gzhi'i 'od gsal rang snang yin par spyod cig dang po 'i dus ka dag gdod ma'i ye gzhi'i gnas lugs ngo shes na spyod cig gnyis pa'i dus ngo shes mkhan dbyings su dwangs/ skad cig gsum pa'i dus gdod ma'i dbyings su btsan sa zin nas 'chi srid chos sku'i zhing du grol/ bar do der ma grol na/ chos nyid bar do'i skabs su gzhon nu bum sku'i rgya ral nas lhun grub kyi gsang ba'i sgo phyes nas 'od lnga shar ba/ dag pa ltar na/ skad cig dang po la rang snang yin pa ngo shes/ skad cig gnyis pa'i dus rang snang rang bzhin med 279

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpar ngo shes/ skad cig gsum pa'i dus ngo shes pa'am dpyod mkhan chos sku'i klong du grol/ de tshe phyi gsal gyi shes pa nang du ldog /nang gsal dpyod byed kyi shes pa gdod ma'i dbyings su grol/ gdod ma'i gzhi la g.yo ba med par dar cig gnas/ de nas sku gsum gyi ston pa'i skur bzhengs pa ni/ ngo bo stong pa la ye shes kyi snying po can gyi chos kyi skur bzhengs/ rang bzhin gsal ba 'od kyi snying po can gyi longs sku'i skur bzhengs/ thugs rje kun khyab la rig pa'i snying po can gyi sprul ba'i skur bzhengs/ dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma las zhing khams kyi cha 'dzin/ thig le stong sgron las zhi drag gnyis kyi gzhal yas khang gi cha 'dzin/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyis zhi drag gnyis kyi sku'i cha 'dzin/ chos nyid rang sgra las gsung gi cha 'dzin/ thugs rje'i rig gdangs las thugs rnam mkhyen ye shes kyi cha 'dzin/ rang snang longs spyod rdzogs skur grol/ ma dag pa ltar/chos nyid yul gyi 'khrul gzhi/ 'od lnga snod bcud kyi zhabrul gzhi/ rig pa sems kyi 'khrul gzhi byas nas 'od lnga las 'byung ba lnga ru snang / thig le la khang khyim du snang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud la rang gi lus su snang / thugs rje rnam mkhyen las nd+ram shes tshogs ṭārgyad rgyu gsum/ hūm̐n bzhis 'khrulade gzhi semasasu / zlo/ zlo/ོ dī /khro ༵nga bsgrayi snas// ra/ga/ sa drug so so skad du snang / — nas lkor ba 280

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄༅/ /rdzogs chen lugs kyi 'chi srid chos sku'i bar do da lta nas sbyong tshul sogs kyi skor/'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs la 'chi srid chos sku'i bar do da lta sbyangs na 'dir gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs la rgyud lung man ngag gsum ste rgyud bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i dgongs pa ni snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos skur 'dod/ zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gnyen po'o/ /lung a nu yo ga'i dgongs pa ni snod bcud snang stong ngam bde stong zung 'jug tu 'dod/ 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen po'o/ /man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa ni/snod bcud dbyings dang thig le sku dang ye shes su 'dod/ gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen po'o/ /'chi srid chos sku'i bar do da lta sbyang skabs/ gzhi'i gnas lugs de grol ba bzhi'i bdag nyid can du grol ba yin la/ skad cigu dang po la/ka dag gdod ma'i ye gzhi'i gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bu'o/ /skad cig gnyis pa la ngo shes mkhan dbyings su dwangs/mi gsal ba gsal ba sgeg mo me long la bltas pa lta bu'o/ /skad cig gsum pa la gdod ma'i dbyings su btsan sa zin pa la gdengs bya/ mi 'gyur ba gser gyi thur ma lta bu'o/ /chos nyid bar do da lta nas sbyangs tshe thod rgal la brten nas stag seng khug mchong gi lam yin pas/ skad cig dang por 'od lnga shar ba ye shes kyi rang gdangs yin par ngo shes/ skad cig gnyis par rang 281

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsnang la rang bzhin med par bden med ngo shes/ skad cig gsum par rang bzhin med par shes mkhan dbyings su dwangs/ ye shes kyi rlung rgyu dus dus gsum gyi 'khrul ba bral ba'am rtog tshogs thams cad ma spangs rang shar rang grol du 'gro/ las rlung rgyu dus nyams bde gsal mi rtog gi nyams la chags nas dus gsum 'brul ba'i mgo brtsam/ nyon rlung rgyu dus chags sdang bskyed nas dus gsum zhakhrul ba la 'byams/ ngo bo brjod du med pa la ka dag tu ma shes pas rgyu bdag nyid gcig pu'i ma rig ye ldan pa'o/ /rang bzhin gsal ba rang snang 'od gsal du ma shes pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig dus mnyam pa'o/ /thugs rje kun khyab la rang rig tu ma shes pas kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig sogs phyi 'byung gi tshul du yod pa'o/ /gzhi ka dag khregs chod kyi lta ba ngo 'phrod pas rgyu bdag nyid gcig pu'i ma rig pa rang sar dwangs/ lam thod rgal snang bzhi la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa rang sar dwangs/ thugs rjes rig gdangs shar grol du song bas kun tu btags pa'i ma rig pa rang sar dwangs/ gzhi'i 'od gsal ngo ma shes na kun gzhi rtog med du shar ba las gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol/ de nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes la ngar 'dzin gyis gsos btab pa'i 'od snang las gzugs khams su gol/ nyon yid dang yid kyi rnam shes shar ba las 'dod khams su gol/ de gsum dag pas srid gsum ka dag gi lta ba'am srid pa drung 'byin gyi lta ba/ khams gsum yongs grol gyi sgom pa/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa/ sku gsum lhun grub kyi 'bras bu'o/ /ye shes ni ngo bo stong ba'i ye shes/ rang bzhin gsal ba'i ye 282

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥshes/ thugs rje kun khyab kyi ye shes de gsum chos sku'i ye shesaso/ /ye shes lnga ni longs sku'i ye shes so/ /lam gyi dus su mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni sprul sku'i ye shes/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su mkhyen gzigs gnyis so/ /khams gsum yongs grol gyi sgom pa ni ngo bo mi rtog kyang ye shes kyi rang gdangs mi 'gag pa'i cha nas gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi las grol/ ye shes gsal yang mi 'dzin pa'i cha nas gzugs khams las grol/ thugs rje'i cha nas rig kyang mi 'phro bas 'dod khams las grol/ grol ba bzhi'i bdag nyid can bag chags gsog long med par chos nyid ngang du rgya 'byams/ ye shes lnga ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i ngo bo brjod du med pa de nyid chos sku'i thugs chos dbyings ye shes/ chos thams cad kyi snang tshul ma 'dres par gsal yang gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i longs sku'i thugs me long ye shes so/ /'khor ba'i chos ma spangs/ 'das pa'i chos ma blangs pa'i spang blang med par mi 'gyur rdo rje'i thugs mnyam nyid ye shes/ shes bya thams cad ma 'dres par cig char mkhyen pa'i ngo bo nyid sku'i thugs sor rtog ye shes/dmigs med snying rje chen pos 'gro don thogs pa med par mkhyen pa'i sprul sku'i thugs bya grub ye shes so/ /yang khams gsum yongs grol gyi sgom pa ni/kun gzhi dang chos sku gnyis rtog med ngos nas 'dra yang / kun gzhi ni lung ma bstan 'dus byas dag bya/ chos sku ni zang thal 'dus ma byas shing ngo bo mi rtog kyang ye shes kyi rang gdangs mi 'gag pa'i cha nas gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi las grol/ dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pas zil gyis mi 283

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnon pa seng ge dar ma lta bu'i rig pa/ ka dag ye grol gyi klong du rang gdangs 'gag med du ji ltar shar yang chags thogs med par grol bas geg dang gol sa med pa ni dper na nam mkha'i dbyings su mkha' lding rgyal po lding ba lta bu'i rig pa/ phyi nang snod bcud kyi chos ji ltar snang yang chags zhen gyi geg dang gol sa med pa padma lta bu'i rig pa/ de lta bu'i rig pa gsum gyi gnad dang ldan na/ dbyings rig zung 'jug gi ngang du nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu gnas kyang sems 'dzin rtse gcig gi rtod phur med pa dang gcig /tshogs brgyad las 'das kyang rang rig 'od gsal gyi rang gdangs mi 'gag pa dang gnyis/ zang thal rgya yan du 'dug kyang bsal bzhag spro bsdu mi dgos pa dang gsum yin no/ /phar la blo yis ma bcos/ tshur la dran pas ma bcings/ gnyis ka'i dbus la mi gnas zang thal/ thibs kyis 'gog pa 'du byed kyi rtog pa/ dal gyis shar ba 'od gsal gyi dkyil 'khor/ hrig ge rig pa rang byung gi ye shes/cham gyis brdal ba gdod ma yi gzhi dbyings/ gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi ye shes 'di nye che bas ngo ma shes/ sla che bas yid ma tshim/ zab drags pas blo ru ma shedzeng / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs 'di la gzhi lam 'bras gsum yod/de la dngos gzhi ngo sprad/ lam rgyud la brten/ 'bras bu mngon du bya dgos gsungs/ gzhi bde gshegs snying po khams gsum sems can gyi rgyud la til la mar gyis khyab pa bzhin tu gnas/ mdo ltar rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang sngags ltar chos sku rdo rje 'chang gnyis ngo bo gcig pa la/ rnam pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i skur bzhengs nas mdo dang / rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs nas sngags gsungs 284

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpa yin gsungs/ ston pa thugs rje can gyis bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyangs mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas tshe sangs rgyas de'i gzhi de je bzang du ma song dper na nyi ma de sprin gyis ma bsgribs kyang nyi ma'i snying po dang 'od zer je bzang du ma song ba lta bu'o/ /ma rungs pa dur khrod kyi 'dre mo de zas su sems can gyi sha za/ skom du sems can gyi khrag 'thung las su sems can gyi srog gcod pa sogs sdig pa byas pas 'dre de'i gzhi je ngan du ma song / dper na nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs kyang je ngan du ma song ba lta bu yin gsungs/ 'o de na sems can sangs rgyas khyad par med pa ma yin nam zhe na/ sangs rgyas ni bag chags gsum gyi sgrib pa dang bral nas/dper na sprin ye zad kyi nyi ma lta bu'o/ /sems can ni bag chags gsum gyis bsgrib pas/ dper na nyi ma sprin gyis bsgrib pa lta bu'i khyad par shes dgos/rang byung gdod ma'i ye gzhi 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa de ni skye rga gnas 'jig dang bral bas rtag pa/ sangs rgyas bzang pos bcos rgyu ma lon/ sems can ngan pas bsgrur rgyu ma lon/ rgyu rkyen 'du ba med pas 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /'dus byas ni rgyu rkyen gyi tshogs pa las byung ba dngos po'i chos rnams skad cig gcig gnyis phan chad rtag nga med pa/ gzhi de'i ming gi rnam grangs la/rdzogs chen pas rang byung gdod ma'i ye gzhi zer/ phyag chen pas gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi ye shes zer/ sngags thun mong pas rang bzhin gzhi'i gzhi rgyu zer/mdo ltar du gzhi bde gshegs snying po zer/ gang zag rig pa can rnams la thog mar gzhi 'di ngo sprad/ de nas lam bsgom pas nyams su blangs/ spyod 285

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpas la dor/ 'bras bu mngon du bya/ gzhi 'di bag chags gsum gyi sgrib pa can/ de shan 'byed gyis shan phye/ la bzlas la bzla/ gzhi ngo 'phrod/ de nas lam sgom pas nyams su blang ba'i tshe rang gi shes rab bla ma'i man ngag dang tha na thal mo ya gcig snying gar sbyar ba sogs bag chags gsum gtan la phab pa'i gnyen por song ba zhig dgos/ sprin rnams rlung gis gtor ba ltar lam bsgom pas nyams su blang / log rtog 'brul ba'i snang ba 'di spang bya yin/ rnal 'byor lam gyi snang ba 'di bgrod bya yin/ 'bras bu ni bag chags gsum gyi sgrib pa gtan byang du dag nas sprin ye zad nam mkha' lta bu gzhi mngon sum du rtog pa la 'bras bu zhes/ 'khor ba'i chos spang bya dang 'das pa'i chos blang bya med pa yin/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i snang ba 'di thob bya yin gsungs/ mdo ltar du mthar 'dzin gyi 'bras bu mthar thug tu 'dod kyang gsang sngags la mi 'dod gsungs so// ༈ kun gzhi lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa ma rig pa dngos yin/ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i dus gsum yid kyi zhabrul rtog la 'khor ba/de zhi ba la myang 'das/ rtogs na sangs rgyas dang ma rtogs na sems can gyi 'khrul gzhi byed pas grol 'khrul gnyis 'byung rung ba la gdod ma'i spyi gzhi zer/ dang po zhabrul ba'i cha gtan la dbab pa ni/ gnas don lus gsum ste/yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ yul gyi bag chags snod kyi 'jig rten dang / /de la brten pa'i gzugs sogs yul lnga'o/ /don gyi bag chags rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / /de la brten pa'i dge sdig las rtsams so/ /lus kyi bag chags 'gro drug so so'i gzugs/ /de la brten pa'i yan lag nying lag 286

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sems can rang gi zhabrul snang yin tshul ni chu gcig mthong snang mi 'dra ba drug lta bu'o/ /sems can la la'i bde ba la la'i sdug bsngal du snang ba sogs/ 'khrul ba gtan la dbab tshul mang yang ma bris so/ /༈ gnyis pa ma 'khrul ba'i cha gtan la dbab pa la lnga ste/ gsal seng nge ba/dwangs seng nge / stong seng nge ba/ ci yang med pa/ smra bsam brjod med dang lnga'o/ /dang po/ gsal seng nge ba ni yid ngor gsal seng ba zhig red ma bsam na gsal seng nge ba red zer don med/ gsal seng nge bas nga ni gas la seng nge ba yin zer ba e red/ phar la khyod ni gsal seng nge ba bsam pa e red/ gsal seng nge ba de rna bas thos sam mig gis mthong ngam yi ge dod dam gang yin zhib tu brtag dgos/ phyi'i yul gyi gsal seng nge ba de ni nyi zla'i 'od yin pas de gsal ba yin na/ de'i sgom de phyi la yod pas lus sems gnyis tha dad du song ba'o/ /dper na byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas mig gnyis long ba rna ba gnyis ka 'on pa zhig yod na des yar lus stobs rdzogs pa'i dus su mi gzhan zhig gis dmus long de la nom pa ci zhig bstan kyang mig gis ni mi mthong rna bas ni mi tshor/ phyi'i yul snang gsal po des bsgom du re ba ni mig gi shes pa yin/ mig btsum na yod pa min de ni gsal ba min/ gsal ba de khog pa'i nang na ye yod bsam na don snod bcu gnyis la sogs gang la bsams kyang gsal ba zhig mi mthong / phyi nang bar gsum la yang yang brtags/gsal seng nge ba bsam pa ni gzung ba yul/ gsal seng nge ba'o bsam mkhan ni 'dzin pa sems/ gzung 'dzin gnyis ni lkor ba'i rtsa ba/ sdug bsngal gyi 287

gaku khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā 'byung khungs/ sa lam gyi gegs so/ /sdig sgrib kyi rten phur yin gsungs so/ /de ltar phyi ma bzhi po'ang gtan la phab pas nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum gyi shun pa rnams bya mo nag mo'i sgong shun thor ba bzhin tu gtor/ dus gsum yid kyi 'ching thag sog ma'i phun thag chad pa ltar chad pa'i tshe blo la gang shar thams cad chos nyid kyi rol ba/ gnas na sku gsum gyi ngang du gnas/'phro na ye shes kyi rol bar 'char/ rin chen gser gling du phyin dus sa rdo phal ba btsal yang mi rnyed pa ltar ro/ /'khor 'das ro mnyam gyi lta ba rtogs pa yin gsungs/ sgom chen gyis sgom btang yang sgom gyis sgom chen mi btang ba'i dus so/ /rnal 'byor ba lta ba rtogs pa dang so skye grub mthas blo ma bsgyur ba gnyis shar lugs 'dra yang / grol lugs khyad par gnad du che/ de min gnad ma shes na/ sgom gyis bsgom chen btang yang sgom chen gyis sgom mi btang ste/thol skyes rbad chod dran pas rjes sleb/ gnas pa'i ngang skyong / gnyen pos 'bur 'joms/ dran pa'i bya ra la sogs pa las mi 'da'o/ /kun gzhi ni rtog med lung ma bstan dge sdig gang gis kyang lung ma bstan pa yin te/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams gyis zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung las/ kun gzhi ni rtog med lung ma bstan/ skyes bu zhig dka' ba'i shugs kyis rnam rtog snga ma rnams 'gags nas/ phyi ma ma skyes kyi bar nang du ma bsgoms phyi ma ma gtad pa'i cha stong had de ba 'di kun gzhi rtog med yin gsungs so/ /kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal las/ ci yang dran med thom me ba/ /de ka ma rig zhakhrul ba'i rgyu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kun gzhi'i khams la bag chags sna tshogs pa 288

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbag nyal gyi tshul du yod pa yul rkyen sna tshogs dang 'phrad pa'i tshe yul du ma la 'jug pa yin te/ dper na me lcags rdo dkar dang 'phrad pa'i gnas skabs su me stag 'byung ba ltar ro/ /kun gzhi de las dar cig snang yul ma 'gags par lam mer gsal yang / der 'dzin ma zhugs pa'i gsal la rtog med kyi rnam pa de kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin gsungs so/ /sgo lnga'i shes pa rtog med des yul snang mi 'dzin/ yid shes rtog bcas kyis yul 'dzin rung gi nus pa yod pas 'di 'o bsams nas 'dzin/ nyon yid kyis yul de la chags sdang bar ma gsum gyis las bsags pa'o// ༈ rang gi snying dbus su rtsa ka ti sheol gyi sbu gu'am a wa rnu ti zhes khrag dang chu ser gyiso ma gos pa phyi gsal 'ad kyi rang bzhin/ rtse ma gsum pa/ rtsa dbu ma spyi bar zug pa/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis mig gnyis la zug pa/ dwangs ma'i 'od rtsa de'i dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi sku grub pa yin/ chos nyid kyi rang sgras gsung 'grub/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i thugs rje'i rig gdangs kyis sangs rgyas kyi thugs 'grub gsungs so// ༈ rtsa thig rlung gsum las/ dang po ni rtsa grangs can bdun cu gnyis/ grangs med ba spu'i grangs dang mnyam pa/ mdor na rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i dang po rtsa gsum ni/ g.yas su ro ma dkar mo chus bskyed/ g.yon du rkyang ma dmar mo sas bskyed/ dbus su kun 'dar ma mthing skya rlung gis bskyed/kun rdzob ltar na/ ro ma dkar mos zhe sdang skyed/ rkyang ma dmar mos 'dod chags skyed/ kun 'dar ma mthing skyas gti mug skyed pa'i rten byed/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi rten byed/ don dam ltar na/ ro ma dkar mo thabs kyi rten/ rkyang 289

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥm dmar mo shes rab kyi rten/ kun 'dar ma gnyis med zung 'jug gi rten/bde gsal mi rtog oṃ aḥhūṃ gsum gyi yi ge rang byung yod/ 'khor lo lnga ni gtso cher chu'i dwangs ma spyi bor bde gyi 'khor lo 32/ sa'i dwangs ma mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo16/ nam mkha'i dwangs ma snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 8/ṭwāoṃ tram̐ gi dwa ོ༵༵ sna /ོrdo ḍi/ sprul pa'i stobor 64/ rlung gi dwangs ma gsang gnas bde gnyis pa rlung la/ ye shes kyi rlung / ma nges pa'i las rlung / pho mo ma ning gi rlung / pho rlung g.yas nas rgyu dus zhe sdang / mo rlung g.yon nas rgyu dus 'dod chags/ ma ning gi rlung mnyam du rgyu dus gti mug go/ /las kyi rlung rgyu ba'i tshe mgo'i skra rtsa dang rkang gi sen rtsa ma gtogs drod cha mnyam/ rlung 'byung chen 'byung chung gnyis/ 'byung chen nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/ 'byung chung ni stong phrag((400dang / rtsa nang ma nges par rgyu ba ni/ 'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gnyis/ /stong phrag drug dang brgya phrag drug /rtsa nang nges par rgyu ba ni/ /'byung ba chung ngus rlung du 'dod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa thig le la/ dwangs snyigs gnyis/ dwangs ma bcu drugadon dam la brgyad/ kun rdzob la brgyad/ snyigs ma las phung po bskyed/ mdor na thabs kyi cha kun rdzob kyi thig le dkar po g.yas ro ma na gnas/ don dam shes rab kyi cha thig le dmar po g.yon rkyang ma na gnas/ dbu ma'i dbus shel sbug can na don dam ye shes kyi thig le 'od gsal du bzhugs/ phyi 'byung lnga/ nang phung lnga/ gsang ba dwangs ma lnga/ yang gsaṭwāṃ9 ṭwāṃ ge lnga/ bla med mkha' 'gro lnga/ rang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbazhin thig le/ rnam pa yi ge/ngo bo ye shes dang gnas tshul sku lnga zhes so/ /sku gsum ka ti'i gser gyi rtsa can/ g.yas dar dkar snar ma sgron ma bzhi/g.yon phra la 'khril ba nyams gong 'phel/ shel sbug rig pa tshad phebs/༈ nam mkha' lnga ni/ spyi kun la khyab pa'i gzhi rig pa dang dbyer med pa'i nam mkha'/ yul med 'od lnga gsal dwangs nam mkha'/ ma 'dres dbyings lnga dag pa'i nam mkha'/ don thig le lnga mtshon byed kyi nam mkha'/ zhi khro'i sku dang dbyer med pa dag pa'i zhing du sgrol bar byed pa'i nam mkha'/ a skye ba med pa/rlung mtshan ma med pa/ sems rang bzhin med pa'o/ /'khrul ba'i cha la kun rtog brgyad cu tham pa yod kyang dug gsum la 'dus so/ /zhabrul tshul gsum ni yul don lus gsum yin/ grol tshul gsum ni rnam grol gsum la mkhas pa po zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ sha khrag gi lus grol ba dang gcig /'gyu byed kyi sems grol ba dang gnyis/ zhakhrul snang gi bag chags grol ba dang gsum yin/gzigs tshul gsum ni/ ye shes kyi spyan ni sangs rgyas la yod do/ /rgyu lta sgom las byung / snod bcud sku dang ye shes su gzigs/ chos kyi spyan ni byang chub sems dpa' la yod do/ /rgyu dmigs med kyi dge ba las byung / snod brgyad sgyu mar gzigs/ shes rab kyi spyan ni rtogs ldan la yod do/ /rgyu bla ma'i drin las byung / 'brul snang bden med du gzigs so/ /sangs rgyas dpal ldan gyis/ phyi snang ba ma spangs snang thog tu grol ba byis chung khras khyer ba lta bu/ nang 'gyu ba ma spangs 'gyu thog tu grol ba chu la ri mo bris pa lta bu/ gsang ba rig stong rjen pa'i ngang mdangs ma shor ba zhig dgos gsungs so/ /gsal ba bzhi 291

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥni/ sems rtog phra rags thams cad gzhi thog du dwangs bas sa le1/ bying rmugs 'thib gsum dang bral bas rig pa gsal ngar dang ldan pas seng nge2/sgo lnga'i gdangs ma 'gags par yul snang ma 'dres par so so rang rig ye shes kyi spyod yul du gyur pa ni hrig ge3/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rig stong gi klong du rang shar rang grol du lhang nge4/ ༈ srid pa e yi spyi mnan ni/ gzhi ka dag gi klong du rang gi gzung 'dzin phra rags thams cad dang / dmigs bya'i dgra bgegs gang yin gzung 'dzin phra rags bag chags dang bcas pa rang dwangs la 'gro ba rig stong ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa ni mnan zhes so/ /sems nyid ces pa ni/ sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi yal sa rig pa'i 'char gzhi ma 'gags pa la nyid ces pa'i sgra sbyar ba yin no// ༈ lta ba'i gnas dor ba'i man ngag yang / rig stong gi lta ba mtshan nyid pa ngo 'phrod pa'i tshe de la 'byar du mi 'dug par lta thog tu spyod pa mi 'khyer bar/ lta ba spyod pa'i thog tu khyer nas skyon dang chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa lhongs su bcugazhabrul du bcug /yin rgyu min rgyu snang du mi snang du bcug pa de la sogs pa byas nas snang ba 'di gtad med cig 'ong gsungs so/ /rig stong gi lta ba ngo 'phrod yod dus de ltar byed mi nyan bsam na de ni mi skyon te/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las ma 'das pa'o/ /ri rgyag thang rgyag tu shes dgos/ chos nyid ngang du rgya 'byams tshul ni sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig rtsal ni ye 'byams/ rmad du byung ba yin pas de ni sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyang ma rig pas sgrib yod rung ye 'byams du yod gsungs/ snang cha'i thog nas 292

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'abyams dgos te bzang ngan gnyis/ chags sdang gnyis/ dgra gnyen gnyis/re dogs gnyis/ skyid sdug gnyis/ dwangs dub gnyis la sogs pas bkag yod pa yin pas/ dper na chu rang grol du yod pa 'khyag gis bsdam pa ltar yin/ de dag gi mtshang rig dgos/ man ngag gi chings lnga ni/ phyi so thar gyi sdom pa'i ngo bo 'khor ba zhen log gi nges 'byung dang gcig /bar byang sems kyi sdom pa'i ngo bo gzhan phan don gnyer gyi sems dang gnyis/ nang gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'i ngo bo snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang dang gsum/ bla ma la yid ches khyed shes kyi dad pa dang bzhi/rdo rje spun grogs la brtse gdung dang lnga yin gsungs/ ༈ gzhi dang gzhi snang phye na/ gzhi ka dag spros pa dang bral ba'i rig stong zung 'jug gi cha de las 'brul grol gang yang mi 'byed/ ma rig pa dang sgrib gnyis bag chags kyis gos ma myong / gzhi snang 'gag pa med pa'i lhun grub kyi cha la grol 'brul dang ma rig pa ye nas med gsungs/ zung 'jug thugs rje rig rtsal gyi rnam pa yul la shar ba'i tshe de nyid rang snang yin par shes na grol gzhi byed pa dang / ma shes na 'khrul gzhi byed pa yin pas 'khrul grol gnyis kyang der 'jog shes dgos gsungs/ gzhi ka dag rig stong gi cha rgyu rkyen las 'das pa yin pa/ ma shes na rig pa'i rgyu ni dngos rgyu brgyud rgyu med kyang / gzhi snang shar ba ngo ma shes pas rtog pa snga mas phyi ma bskyed pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bas na brgyud rgyu yang zer/ sgrib pa glo bur ba yin/ gzhi dang gzhi snang phye ma shes na/ gzhi bdun skyon can tu bzhag pa yin te/ dang po gzhi ngo bo ka dag tu 'dod na/ stong rkyang chad mtha' ru gol sems can gcig kyang mi grol ba 293

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥzhig yin dgos gsungs/ gnyis pa gzhi lhun grub du 'dod na/ ye shes gcig pu zhig 'dod pas khams gsum na 'khor 'khrul las ma 'das pas rtag lta ru gol/ gsum pa gzhi ma nges par 'dod na ni/ gzhi des grol dus grol gzhi byed/ 'khrul dus 'khrul gzhi byed pa lta bu sangs rgyas rung sems can du 'gyur srid pa'i rnal 'byor lam gyi bgrod bya don med yin gsungs/bzhi pa nges pa don gyi dngos gzhir 'dod na/ 'dus ma byas rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med par 'dod pas snang cha rnams gtan spangs yin/ lnga pa gzhi cir yang bsgyur du btub par 'dod pa ni/ 'brul rkyen gyi 'khor bar bsgrur/'das pa'i rkyen gyis sangs rgyas su bsgyur/ dper na gzhi de nyid gru sko lta bu zhig dgos gsungs/ drug pa gzhi cir yang khas blang du btub par 'dod na/gzhi de yod par khas blang / med par khas blang / yod med gnyis ka khas blang ba lta bu yin gsungs/ bdun pa gzhi sna tshogs su 'dod na 'khor 'das kyi chos sna tshogs su snang ba 'di rnams gzhi yin par 'dod pa lta bu yin gsungs/༈ gzhi lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs ni ngo bo ye stong spros dang bral ba'i rang gdangs 'gags pa med pa rig stong zung 'jug gi sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa de na 'khor 'das gnyis ka 'char rung gi gdangs dper na shel rdo la 'od lnga rang chas su shar rung gi gdangs yod pa lta bu de la gzhi yi sbubs zer/ gzhi las gzhi snang shar ba'i rnam pa ma shes pa'i cha der ma rig pa rgyu sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa der 'ardzog shes dgos/ de yan na ma rig pa rgyu sa bon dang bcas pa gtan nas med gsungs/ rig stong gi lta ba nam rtogs 294

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥn rgyu sa bon dang bcas pa drungs 'byin du 'gro'o/ /gzhi klong de na 'khor 'das kyi snang ba 'char rung ba'am/ gzhi'i klong gcig tu 'ub chub pas na gzhi rdzogs pa chen po gzhi de la 'char rung gi nus pa med na gzhi snang gi rtsal las dag ma dag gi snang ba shar ba 'di rgyu med las 'bras bu 'byung ba lta bu'i skyon yod gsungs/ gzhi snang shar ba'i cha de rang snang yin par ngo shes na grol gzhi dang ngo ma shes na 'khrul gzhir 'gyur ba'i 'byung rung gi cha de la spyi gzhi zer/༈ gtso sems mig shes dang 'khor kun 'gro lngasasngagatpal sngon po mthong dus/dang po mig shes yul la g.yo ba'i cha de sems pa/ yul la gtod pa'i cha de yid byed/ yul dang dbang po shes pa gsum 'phrad pa'i cha de reg pa/ gzugs yid 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum gang rung nyams su myong ba'i cha de tshor ba/ sngo ser sogs sosor ma 'dres par shes pa 'du shesadang lnga ni kun 'gro lnga yin/ 'khor 'dasaspyi gzhi zhes pa ni/ khregs chod kyisagazhi de la gzhi snang 'char rung gi gdangs su yod pa la zer/ thod rgal gyi gzhi snang dngos shar ba la zer/thog ma'i gzhi zhes pa ni sngon dang po zhig la bsam blo mi btang ste/ da lta rang nyid 'chi ba'i gnas skabs na snga ma'i rlung sems bsdus zin/ phyi ma'i rlung sems ma mched/'khor 'das gnyis ka'i snang ba shar ba'i sngon rol yin pas na thog ma'o/ /de la zhabor 'dasaganyis ka 'char rung gi gdangs yod pas na gzhi lhun grub rin po che'i sbubasazhes bya/ gzhi de las gzhi snang shar dus rtogs na khyad chos drug gi bye brag phyed nas sangs rgyas/ ma rtogs gzung 'dzin can gyi 'khor ba'o// //295

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam grangs bshad pa/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam grangs cung zad bshad pa la/ dang po la lta ba ngo sprod la ni lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun byas/ kha'i rlung dal gyis rgyu bar byed pa dang /sems 'das pa'i rnam rtog gi rjes mi dpyod/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa bzo mi 'chos par rang babs su lhod kyis zhog dang / de'i dus su sems rang babs su bzhag pa'i gnad kyis dus gsum gyi rtog pa rags pa tsam zhig bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de ma thag de'i shul na yod pa'i shes rig so ma phyi tshogs drug gi yul la zhen pa med cing nang dran 'dzin gnyen pos ma bslad pa rang babs shugs 'byung mngon gyur du yod pa 'di mngon sum du ngo 'phrod na rdzogs chen gyi lta ba'am rig pa tsam ngo 'phrod pa yin/ yang na snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad tha snyad kun rdzob snang tshul tsam du nang rtog pas phar bzos pa tsam mam sems kyi chos cho 'phrul rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bu'i bden med dang / don dam gnas tshul la snang srid de thams cad brtags na rang ngo nas med par ma zad blos phar btags tsam yang shul na lhag rgyu med pas cir yang ma grub pa ste spros bral stong nyid du thag bcad/ de nas 'khor 296

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'adas kyi byed pa po sems kho na yin par shes nas sems kho rang gi thog nas yin lugs ci 'dra red rang ngo nas grub bam ma grub sogs byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi sgo nas brtags pas gzugs dbyibs kha dog mtshan ma sogs blos phar btags tsam yang med pa'i stong pa ru thag chod pa na/ de ma thag stong ngo snyam pa'i zhen 'dzin phra mo zhig yod do/ /stong 'dzin de'i rang ngor bltas pas stong 'dzin de rang sar bzhag pas chu rlabs chur zhig pa bzhin rig pa'i dbyings su rang zhig go/ /de ma thag stong rkyang kho na ma yin par stong pa'i ngang nas shar 'ong ba lta bu'i stong pa rig pa'i snying po can nam stong gsal dbyer med kyi shes pa rang babs su shugs 'byung bzo bcos dang bral ba zhig yod pa de ngo 'phrod na lta ba tsam yin/ yang na lus gnad bsring mig bar snang la ha re gtad de sems yang phar nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings su gtod la 'dzin med du zhog dang / de'i stobs kyis rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du chad nas phyi nam mkha' dang nang sems nyid stong pa gnyis dbyer med lta bu'i rgya che ba yang khro le'i shes pa gsal stong 'dzin med zhig mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de yang rig pa yin/ mdor na rnam rtog gang shar gyi sngon bsu/ rjes snyeg mi byed par shar mkhan kho rang gi ngo bor ltos dang / bltas pa tsam nas rnam rtog gi tshogs rang 'gags su 'gro ba chos nyid yin/ de dus kho nar yod pa'i shes rig dwangs gsal ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba'i stong sangs 'dzin med zhig mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de yang rig pa yin no/ /rnam rtog rang ngor lta ba tsam dang bltas pas stong pa kho na bsgom pa lta bu'i rig pa yin no/ /de'i tshul zhib tu bshad na/ sems lhod de 297

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbazhag pas sems kyi 'phro 'du chad nas yul mi rtog tsam dang / gsal sa ler yod pa tsam dang nges mkhan dang stong sang nger yod pa lta bu gang yang rig pa min/de'i dus su de dag dang ma 'dres pa'i gsal dag zang ma thal gyi shes pa rjen nee ba'am mi rtog pa'i cha nges mkhan nam mthong mkhan zhig rang shugs kyis yod pa de rig pa yin/ gang bshad de dag gi mdo 'gag ngo 'phrod thabs mthar thug ni 'di yin te rnam rtog rang ngor bltas te rang sar bzhag pa'i stabs kyis phyi tshogs drug gi yul la ma zhen/ nang dran 'dzin gnyen pos ma bcings bar btang snyoms lung ma bstan du'ang ma gol ba'i stong gsal 'dzin med kyi shes pa de rig pa yin/ de'i don ni phyi tshogs drug gi yul gzugs sgra sogs 'a mi zhen par zhen mkhan kho rang rang babs su bzhag ste bskyang ba na phyi gzugs sgra sogs la mi zhen kyang nang bde gsal mi rtog gsum gyi ro la zhen pa'ang nang snang stong gi chos la zhen pa'i blo'am rtog pa phra mo zhig yin/ de'i tshe ro myong mkhan de kho rang rang babs su ma bor tsam du bskyang ba'i tshe nyams kyi ro myong med kyang bskyang bya skyong byed kyi tshul du skyong dgos pa ni/ nang dran 'dzin gnyen pos bcings pa'i blo ste/ go myong rtogs gsum las myong ba tsam las rtogs pa dngos min pa/ de nyid gnyen po la zhen pa'i blo yang yin/ de'i gnyen po mchog 'dzin dang nges shes kyi 'dzin pa sogs drang ngo / /de dag gi skabs su rtsol bcas kyi dran pa'am/ 'jur bu'i dran pa/ 'du byed dran pa/ 'du shes kyi dmigs pa/ ming bcas kyi dran pa sogs brngod do/ /de ltar 'jur dran la gom 'dris su song ba na/ bskyang bya skyong byed kyi 'jur dran de rang sar 298

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbazhag pas ci yang mi bsgom par yang yang lhod kyis bzhag na/ nam zhig bskyang bya skyong byed kyi dran 'dzin rang zhig du song nas bsgom bya sgom byed kyi gtad so 'dzin pa nges shes thams cad kyi shubs nas 'thon te nyi ma sprin las grol ba bzhin bsgom kyang skyong rgyu med la ma bsgoms kyang 'khrul du med pa zhig 'ong ste rtogs pa slad med yin/ de'i tshe rang ngo ma mthong ba'i ma rig pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi rtog med had po kun gzhi lta bu yang min pas btang snyoms lung ma bstan dang bral lo/ /de dus gnyug ma'i dran pa'am chos nyid kyi dran pa dang / lhun grub kyi dran pa'am rtsol med kyi dran pa yang zer ro/ /de slar yang rtse gcig tu gos nus na dbyings rig dbyer med du 'dres te 'phags lam thob par 'gyur ro/ /go thob bshad na da lta'i shes pa ma bcos rang babs su bzhag pa 'di nyid rig pa yin/ de ngo ma 'phrod na rnam rtog phaṭa kyis gtor na rig cha mngon/ de'ang gang shar re dogs mi byed par thol byung phaṭa sgra drag po ngar thung zhig brngod pa dang de ma thag tu rnam rtog dang bral ba'i shes pa stong gsal 'dzin med cig shar ba de rig pa red/ bying rmugs 'thib gsum du mi gtong bar de'i rgyun bskyang ba sgom pa red/ de nyid rkyen dang bsre ba spyod pa red/ rkyen dang bsre tshul la ni rnam rtog bzang ngan gang shar yang spang blang re dogs mi byed par rig thog tu bzhag pas chu la ri mo bris pa ltar rnam rtog rnams gnyen po gzhan la ma ltos par rang yal du 'gro bar byed pa'am/ rjes thob kyi skabs ma gtogs rig pa rgya bskyed dpang bstod sogs ci yang mi bya bar dang po de 'dra'am rig pa tsam ste ngo 'phrod na rgyun du bsgoms na rig pa je gsal je 299

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'athug tu 'gro'o/ /'di ni ngo bo lam byed yin/ rnam pa lam byed ces drug stong bzhi'i grangs bas 'chi srid chos sku'i 'od gsal gyi rnam pa'am don spyi bsgom pa'i tshul de ni rig pa dngos sgom tshul dkyus ma'i rnal ma yin par gsungs pas bzhag go/ /zhes bya bral chos dbyings rang grol pas so/ /༄7ོ/ /bla ma/ rin po che'i zhal rgyun ni/ rang gi spyi bor gdan padma nyi zla'i steng du bla ma gu ru rin po che mchog gsum kun 'dus/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus/sku gsum kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid/ mdor na phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas nas bzung ste/ nye ba'i mched/ ring ba'i mched/ 'dres pa'i mched/rdo rje'i mched po yan chad kyi skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal btab la/'di ni kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom ni red/ skyabs su song /sems bskyed/ gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab ste/ dad pa med na ci red ni ma red/ don dam pa ni dad pa kho nas rtogs par bya ba'o/ /dad pa med na mdo nas sngags kyi bar gyi gnad rtogs ni ma red/ dad pa bzhag /dbang bzhi blangs/ 'od zhu byas nas thugs yid dbyer med du bsres na dad pa de nyid kyi stobs kyis 'ong ste/ 'khrul ba'i rtogs tshogs thams cad se lung lcags kyi rgya mdud 'thor ba ltar/ bying rmugs 'thib gsum po ri sprug pa dwangs ni 'dra 'dra/ thams cad dbyings su dengs u mi 'gro/ de'i ma chog rgyu ci yod/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dang dbyer med bsre rgyu red/skal ba can red/ zab gnad cig red/ de'i bzang ci dgos/ thog mar kun slong bcos/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi gsol ri00

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'adebs dang thugs yid bsre ba/ rjes la bsngo ba dang smon lam/ ngal bso de ltar nyin re thun brgya dang drug cu re lnga re bcad dgos pa yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig gi dgongs pa red/ thun brgya re'am/ brgyad cu re tsam bcad/ yun thung grangs mang byas na dga'/ de min yun thung rgyu la ci dga' da/yun ring por mnyam bzhag gis nyin mtshan 'da' nus pa yod na los dga' da/ring skyad duyod ni ma red/ pha bo ②yun ring na bying rmugs 'thib gsum gyis ri chen sprug pas g.yog ni 'dra 'dra mgo re snyes btum ni 'dra 'dra zhig gis ngang nas thugs yid dbyer med kyi sa nam shor ma go dus tshar ni red/ de dus bsngo ba byed ye buci yod mi byed ye ci yod o pha bo/ kho bo de ltar ma yin par yun ring por mnyam bzhag gi sa zin gi zer ba ni gcig lha mi dga' na zhugog dang mnyam du bgro gleng byed ya/ de min yun thung thung mi du'adug thub ni ma red/bcad 'gro ni red rnam rtog shar dgos ni red/ dper na rgad po zhig gis bo'i lo zhukhur nas phyi bda' la song na phyi ba khung sgor 'bud ma bcug na ci zhig sod/ma sod na ci zhig za/ de bzhin du rnam rtog shar dgos ni red/ rnam rtog 'char ma bcug na ci zhig grol/ ma grol na ci zhig bsgom ma grol na sangs rgyas ni ma red/ khregs chod lam shar grol thod rgal lam 'od snang red/ sde gzhan rjizhig yin na 'dod chags sogs dug gsum gyi rtog pa cher shar 'jug /dbul bo'i lag mthil du nor bu rnyed pa ltar rgyab ri brag ri 'dra ba bla ma dkon mchog gsum yod ni red/ de tshe bla ma la gsol ba btab nas mnyam par bzhag na 'dod chags bde stong du grol 'gro ni red/ de la sogs rnam rtog shar tshad sdu sna/togapyi/ nga~X ṭī/ ñtsha/ yi dang don gcisdu1 las/ mo /rsharno ོ༵ kā lhospru rnyi ṅgi'i don

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥthams cad shar grol du song na rdzogs chen lam sne zin yong ni red/ e go e sgrub khyed tshos shes/ deng sang la las nyams len byed mdog byed/ bshad bcug na mgo na skyabs sems med mjug na bsngo ba med thugs yid bsre mi dgos rgya rgan tshong ba ha rdib ni bu'adra 'dra/ sprang po tshos ngal gso ni 'dra 'dra had de bltas bsdad ni gi nye lam rdzogs pa chen po phar zhog sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu tsam yang e yin mi go/ de las chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi yang snying chos kyi rgyal po yi ge drug ma bzlas brjod yag po re byas na de'i dum pa buli dga' na/ o pha bo la las rnam rtog 'phro mi 'jug par mig rtsa tsho dmar long long ma song bar bkag /rnam rtog gcig shar na blo ma bde zing zing song / thun grol tshe rgyud tsho rtsub hrag ge/ shes pa tsho khro lang nge yod rgyu des ci lo ni ma red/ nga'i kha la nyan na sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i thun grangs mang re chod dang de cig yag ni red/ ma nyan na sa thag ring thung kun nas 'dir nga la nog btso ni la 'ong ni i yin/ 'dug bcug /kha dro/ bla ma bsten nas bzung ste ci gsung gi bka' ci bzhin du ma bsgrub pas bka' bcag na dmyal ba la 'gro ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas sdig pa'i steng du sdig pa khur ni la 'dir ci la 'ong ni yin/bed cang yod ni ma red/ de las rang khyim gi bud nas bzung ci gsung gi bka' ci bzhin du sdod/ smyung gnas rdog re bsrung thub na rab/ min kyang ma ṇi thon/ sdig pa la 'gyod bshags byas te sdod/ kha dro sku tshe ring / o badzra sa twa hūṃ/ban rgan cha ga zhukhyed rnams la khyad gsod lha yin na/ go na drang gtam yin/shi zas za ba 'di ni bar do'i yid lus la mngon shes phran bu yod pas ci :tā / ༈/sa bu lon can du gyur pa/ ②yum 3ptospyi dpang por bzhag pa'i don/ khyarnams zhes

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbasam go/ /bsam nyes re byas na rang gzhan gnyis la gnod 'gro ni red/ de bas bde sdug gtong len re byas na bzang / rang gi spyi bor bla ma bsgom bzhin pa'i ngang nas rang gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba 'od dkar po'i rnam par thon/ de tshe 'das sogs sems can thams cad kyi snying gar thim/ de rnams bde ba dang ldan par bsam/ tshe 'das sogs de rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad 'od nag po'i rnam par byung nas/ rang gi thog med nas da bar nga med ngar bzung ba bdag med la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ngar 'dzin thig le nag po'i rnam par snying dkyil na gnas pa de la phog ma thag tu gtor nas gar yal cha med du gyur te bla mas gsungs pa'i nyams len gyi ngang du bzhag na mi'i gdan thog nas rang gi sgrib pa sbyong zer ba de red/ de cig yag ni red/ ces gsungs so/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis par gyur cig /༄tsho/ /bsgrub bya mthar thug ni/ rang byung gdod ma'i ye gzhi 'od gsal 'dus ma byas skye rga gnas 'jig dang bral ba'i bdag nyid/ rgyu las ma byung ba'i 'bras bu/ sems las ma byung ba'i sangs rgyas/ lung las ma byung ba'i man ngag rang byung gi chos gsum dang ldan pa/ rgyu rkyen las 'das pa/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa de nyid kyi thugs grub/ rtsa dbu ma de la phra rags gnyis phye nas phra ba de nyid 'od kyi rang bzhin 'dus ma byas pa lus gnas rang byung lus las ma skyes pa yin pas ba spru'i cha thams cad 'od rtsa de yis khyab yod/dwangs ma'i de nyid rtogs tshe sku grub/ 'bad rtsol las 'das pa ye shes kyi rlung de nyid 'dus ma byas pa rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa brjod med brjod pa chen po de 303

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnyid kyi gsung grub pa yin gsungs/ de gsum ni dbyer mi phyed pa'i bdag nyid can no/ /de dag sgrib byed ni gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pas rig stong gi cha bsgrib/snyigs ma'i sha khrag gis 'od lus bsgrib/ las rlung dang nyon rlung gis ye shes kyi rlung bsgrib pa yin/ sgrib byed kyi cha de gsum dag pa na gzer bu rnams shārnyisna ༵'o yi/ na/ gsungs so/ /sgrib pa ni glo bur ba 'dus byas mi rtag pa mi ༈ yul gsum gyad du gyur ba ni/ yid kyi yul du gyur pa/ dbang po'i yul du gyur pa/ yul gyi yul du gyur pa ste/ dang po yid kyi yul du gyad du gyur pa ni/rgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma/ bla ma'i man ngag tshad ma/ rang gi rig pa tshad ma gsum gyi sgo nas phyi snod gzhal yas khang dang nang bcud sems can rnams snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pa dang po nges shes skyes/ bar du nges shes brtan/ tha mar 'khrul 'dzin las log /de ltar thag chod pa yid kyi yul du gyur pa yin/ gnyis pa/ dbang po'i yul du gyad du gyur pa ni 'di ni lha'o sngags so chos nyid do bsam pa'i gzung ba'i yul dang de ltar du thag bcad pa 'dzin pa sems dang / yul yul can du 'dzin pa'i shes pa gzhi dbyings su dwangs tshe/ tha ma nges shes dag pa yin pas de dus lha gsal zhe na yul yul can du 'dzin pa'i shes pa rang dwangs la song / ma gsal zhe na sgo lnga'i gdangs ma 'gags pa rang yan tshogs drug dus gcig la so sor bkra lam mer snang ba dbang po'i yul du gyur pa yin/ de nyid la gdangs thob dgos so/ /gsum pa yul gyi yul du gyad du gyur pa ni/ de ltar du goms pa'i 304

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum / āḥtshe mthar dper na tshangs pa ral pa can gyi gzigs ngor lta bu mngon sum du snod bcud zhing dang gzhal yas khang sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin du snang ba ni yul gyi yul du gyur ba'o/ /rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi skabs su/ sa chu spyan dang ma mā ki/ /me rlung gos dkar dam tshig sgrol/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /2 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ shes pa gsum po gcig nyid du/ /'dres par gyur pa bdag smra'o/ /zhes rang snang dbyings su dag pa/ dbyings snang chos nyid du dag pa/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med 'dres pa/ 'og min rang snang du grub pa'o// ༈ mthar thug gi chos nyid bar do'i skabs su phyi gsal gyi shes pa nang du ldog /nang gsal dpyod byed kyi shes pa gzhi thog tu dwangs pa'am thim pa zhes pa'o/ /ma rmugs pa zhes pa ni phra ba'i ye shes de nyid rtog med kyi tshul du ma 'gags par phyam brdal du snang ba yin gsungs/ gzhi de las ldang ba'i tshe sku gsum gyi ston pa'i skur bzhengs pa yin gsungs so// ༈ dper na rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba'i cha rig pa lta bu/ rlabs de nyid rlung gis bskyod nas bral ba'i chos can dus gsum gyi rtog pa lta bu yin/ gnad rtogs pa'i tshe rlabs nyid rgya mtsho las byung slar chu la thim pas spang blang med pa yin no// ༈ yang dper na rgya mtsho dwangs pa kha gting med pa lta bu rig pa'i cha'o/ /dwangs ba'i dkyil du rdo 'phang ba'i tshe rim bzhin du ri mo rnams skad cig kyang tshugs mi thub par rang grol du song ba lta bu de bzhin du shar cha rnams rang grol yin gsungs so// ༈ mdo padma dkar po las/ byis pa'i rtsed mor de dang de dag tu/ /gang gis rgyal ba de'i phyir mchod 305
