g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrtenadag /byemalasaniphungabyeobyasapayang/ /de rnams kyis kyang byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /gang gis rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dag /bsoke nams rgyal mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ /bdag gis bris sam 'bri ru bcug kyang rung / /de dag thams cad byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /skyes bu dag gam 'on te gzhon nu 'ang rung / /gang dag la la de ni slob pa'i tshe/ /rtsed mo dga' dang bsad par byed pa ni/ /rtsig ngos sen mo shing bus gzugs bris pa/ /de dag thams cad byang chub thob 'gyur te/ /de dag thams cad snying rje can du 'gyur/ /༈ dkon mchog gi za ma tog las/ ji ltar du ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa la mngon par brtson pa de srid du mngon pa'i nga rgyal lo gsungs/ /༈ ye grol ni/ rig stong zung 'jug sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa de nyid bya bas ma byas rtsol bas ma bsgrubs par rang byung gi chos gsum/ dang ldan pa/ rang byung gdod ma'i ye gzhi de nyid ye gdod ma nas grol gzhi rdul tsam med pa yin/ ye grol zhes pa'i don nyid/ gang zag rnams da gzod 'bad pas grol ba min pa'i don no/ /ye shes kyi rang gdangs kyi phyi'i snang cha 'gags kyang gsal cha mi 'gag pas ye grol/ thugs rje'i rig gdangs las ji ltar shar yang ye shar ye gnas yin pas gnas bya gnas byed bral ba'i ye grol gyi rang bzhin yin/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong yang / dper na bya brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rkang pa la tshon sna mang po bskus nas bya de dag rnams bar snang la 'phur tshe tshon rjes mi dod pa lta bu/ de bzhin du ye nas shar cha rnams ye grol gyi rang bzhin yin par thag bcad pa'o// ༈ rang grol ni/ rig stong zung 306

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'ajug gi klong de na snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid las ma 'das pa yin pas phyi nang snod bcud dang / dus dang gsang ba nyon mongs pa'i rtog tshogs shar ba thams cad rang grol ba'i chos can gnyen po bsten long med par rang tshugs mi thub par rang grol yin te/ klong pas/ shar ba'i tshe na ma/nyam shar rang sa zin/ /gnas pa'i tshe na mnyam gnas rang sa zin/ /grol ba'i tshe na mnyam grol rang sa zin/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ rgya grol ni/ rig stong zung 'jug gi klong na 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams spang blang med par thams cad mnyam nyid khyab brdal du rtogs pa la rdzogs pa chen por ma grol ba med pas nas rgya grol zhes so/ /dha zhi badzra gyis/ rgya grol rnal 'byor nam langs nyi shar 'dra/ /chos sku'i snang ba yin no e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ cer grol ni/ rig stong gi lta ba'i ngang der chos can gyi snang ba thams cad chos nyid kyi klong du phyam brdal du rtogs kyang / rjes thob kyi skabs su yul rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i dus su yul skad cig la khol bur bzung yang / bla ma dran pa dang mig gis blta snyangs dang / lus gnad bsring ba tsam nyid nas lta thog tu phyin pas na cer grol yin te/ thog babs chen po'i lta stangs kyis/ /cer gyis bltas pas mthong sar yal/ /ces so// ༈ mtha' grol ni/ngo bo brjod du med pa ka dag ye stong spros pa dang bral bas rtag pa'i mtha' las grol/ ye shes kyi gdangasa'agags pa med pas chad pa'i mtha' las grol/ thugs rje zung du 'jug pas gnyis kyi mtha' las grol/ gcig dang du ma'i mtha' las grol bas na mtha' grol yin no// ༈ yongs grol ni/ lhag lus med par grol bas yongs grol 307

'i g.yukhogablam chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥya/ spyasu/nga/ṭwāṃg so / / snying po'i lugs su khrid tshul/ phyag de la mdo lugs su khrid pa/ sngags lugs su khrid pa/ snying po'i lugs su khrid pa/ zung 'jug du khrid tshul 'di brtsis na bzhi yod do/ /de dag las mdo lugs su khrid pa ni sa bcu lam lnga dang sbyar nas rnal 'byor bzhi'i tshul gyis 'jug pa yin/sngags lugs su khrid pa ni sngags bla med spyi'i tshul dang mthun par bskyed rdzogs kyi lam nas stong bzhis drangs ba'i 'od gsal dang / dga' bzhis drangs ba'i ye shes la bslab pa yin/ snying po'i lugs su khrid pa ni khregs chod dang phyogs mthun par bslabs pa/ 'dir ni snying po'i lugs su khrid pa yin te/gnas 'gyu rig gsum tsam la nyams len byed thub mthar chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba yin kyang / de'i tshul mi shes pa'i gang zag gis kho bos gnas 'gyu rig gsum tsam las cang mi shes zer nas rtsis med byed kyang / gnas 'gyu rig gsum gyi lam gnad yang dag par zin na pha rol 'phags pa'i lam la sbyor bar byed ni red/ de las lhag pa'i lam yang dag ci dgos/ mthong lam chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba'i gnad ni/ sgom pa po gang zag gi rgyud na sems kyi chos nyid bde gshegs snying po yod pa'i gnad kyis yin/ 'di la ming gi rnam grangs mdo na khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/ sngags ltar bla med spyi na gnyug ma'i sems dang / stong bzhis drangs ba'i 'od gsal sogs dang / phyag chen na gzhug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ rdzogs chen na rang byung gi ye shes zhes bstan pa'i don de nyid man ngag khyad par can gyi sgo 308

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnas sad par byed pa yin te/ 'di ltar chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems la thug pa ni/ khams gsum gyi byed pa po sems yin pas/ de yin tshul ni/ ma rig bden 'dzin des ma drangs ba'i nyon mongs pa zhig shes bya la mi srid/ nyon mongs pa med na las bsags pa yang shes bya la mi srid/ las ma bsags na 'gro drug gi 'khrul ba'i snang ba shes bya la mi srid ni red/ des na ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs ba'i dus gsum yid kyi zhabru' ba 'di las 'khor ba logs na med/ ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i dus gsum yid kyi 'byul ba zhi ba las myang 'das logs na med tshul shes dgos gsungs/ mdor na ma rig bden 'dzin 'di sgyu ma mkhan lta bu/ 'brul snang 'di dag sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i grong khyer lta bu yin tshul gsungs pa'i don/ mi pham rin po che'i bstan bcos khyi rgan gser skyugs du lung dang rigs pa du ma'i sgo nas tshul de dang mthun par gsungs/ sgru ma mkhan sod na sgyu ma'i grong khyer ldog pa bzhin du/sems kyi chos nyid 'od gsal stong pa chen po'i don rtags nas/ ma rig bden 'dzin 'di sod na zhakhrul ba'i snang cha ldog pa yin/ 'byul snang 'di dag yod ring la rgyus 'bras bu la bya ba byed pa dang / 'bras bu rgyu la ltos dgos pas las 'bras bslu med 'di 'khrul snang dbyings su ma ldog bar du yod pas/'gro ba rigs drug gi chu gcig la las snang gis mthong tshul mi 'dra ba drug tu snang ba 'di rgyu med rkyen med du snang ba ma yin pas/ las snang ma zad bar du gnas tshul ji bzhin mi mthong / phyin ci log gi las snang 'di dag thog ma'i gzhi dang mthar phyin 'bras bu'i dus na med pa'i zhabrul snang 'di dag med snang 309

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā stong pa'i rang gzugs stong gzugs nyag gcig yin par shes dgos/ 'bras bu'i dus na 'brul snang 'di dag med tshul mdo sngags gang yin kyang mthun no/ /thog ma'i gzhi zhes pa ni lus can rnams 'chi ba'i tshe snga ma'i rlung sems bsdus zin/ phyi ma'i rlung sems ma mched pa'i 'od gsal la zer/ sems kyi gnad gsang chos nyid 'od gsal ba'i rig pa 'di rtogs na chos thams cad la mkhas shing bdag med gnyis rtogs kyi don tshang ba rang lugs su bzhed pa'o//'dir rigs dpyad mang po dor te zhes kha mtshams bcad pa ni man ngag sgom pa'i lugs 'di'i sems kyi gnad gsang rtogs tshul bstan/ spyir thosabasam lta ba'i lugs kyi lta ba gtan la 'bebs tshul ni rigs dpyad mang po'i sgo nas thun mong phyi nang gi sngon 'gro nas bzung dngos gzhi'i bar dang / dngos gzhi ngo sprad nas ma nyam bzhag du 'jog sgom/ rjes thob tu dpyad sgom byas nas chos dang chos min gyi rnam dbye 'byed pa'i shes rab lhag mthong drangs pa yin pas/'ardzog snom dpyad sgom gnyis bya pho mo'i gso res lta bu yin tshul gsungs/goms pa klong du gyur dus 'jog sgom kho nas chog /blo rtsing nas kha phyir mi bskor bar kha nang du phyogs nas sems kyi gnad gsang la bltas pa'i tshe gnas pa'i thabs la spyir dmigs pa rten bcas dang rten med gnyis/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med gnyis yod pas zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ zhi gnas sngon du 'gro ba'i khrid tshul yod par gsungs kyang / 'dir thog ma nas zhi lhag zung 'brel yin/ mdo sngags gang gi lugs la zhi lhag zung du ma 'brel ba'i lta ba rnam dag zhig med/ gnas pa'i 310

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥthabs gdams ngag thams cad kyi rgyal po ni dad pa kho na yin/ gang zag thun mong yin pa'i dad pa can des ni bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang bka' drin dran pa dang / yang gsang bla med kyi zab gnad shes pa'i dad pa de'i stobs las/ ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i dus gsum yi da kyi zhabrul ba dang / nyams zhen gyi shun pa thams cad sprin chen nam mkhar dengs pa ltar dbyings su dengs nas/ rkyen dbang du mi 'gro bar rtse gcig tu dga' spro dang bcas pas 'jug pa ni/ dper na padma can gyi mtsho ru ngang pa zhugs pa dang / dri zhim padmo'i tshal du bung ba rgyu ba ltar ro/ /de ltar min pa'i gang zag gzhan ma rnams khams dang mthun par khrid tshul nyi shu rtsa gcig bdun lnga gsum sogs bstan/ dmigs pa'i rten la rnam rtog 'don byed hūṃ/ gcod byed phaṭa bag chags bsreg byed re: sogs la bslab tshul bstan/ gnas pa'i go skabs gtan nas mi rnyed pa'i gang zag rnams la/ lha min g.yul 'gyed kyi khrid 'jog tshul gsungs/ slob ma g.yo med drang po rdzun mi bshad pa zhig yin na/bla ma des khams kyi rnam dbye phyed shes na/ sa khams pa dub cha che bas dwangs cha 'don dgos/ rlung khams pa 'tshubs cha dang 'phro 'thor che bas lhod thabs bstan dgos/ me khams pa de ring go na sang nyin gling na med pas de la gang yang yin mdog dang brtan pa'i thabs dgos/ snyi khams pa gtan zhen che bas nyams snang sna tshogs 'char na'ang / de la nam mkha' lhas gang / bar snang bdud srin gyis gang / sa gzhi 'dres gang ba'i nyams snang shar na yang spang blang med par rang snang yin tshul bstan nas rig thog tu skor dgos/ na ma 311

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmakha'i khams ni 'bad rtsol drag po byas kyang 'ching zhen med par dbyings su zhig par 'gyur bas rang lam la bzhag chog /des na gnas pa'i tshe dwangs snyigs gnyis phye nas dwangs cha thon dgos/ dwangs cha la gsal cha thon dgos/med na bying bas dwangs cha sgrib/ rmugs pas gsal cha sgrib ni red/ gsal cha la lhod cha yod dgos/ dwangs gsal gyi dbyings la shar cha 'gag med cig yod dgos/ med na gnas cha yod kyang grol cha med pa'i bsam gtan gyi lha dang 'dra bar gsungs/ des na dwangs gsal gyi dbyings la shar cha 'gag med cig yod pa ni phyi nang gang du'ang gtan zhen gyi 'dzin stangs med pa'i lam rtags yang dag yin/ las dang po pa'i phan gnod med pa'i rtog pa rnams rjes mthud med par grol na lhag mthong tsam po zhig yin/ lhag mthong thams cad kyi rgyal po ni 'od gsal ba'i rig pa la zer/ dran shes kyi rtsis zin pa'i shar cha rnams rjes mthud med par grol ba 'di la 'khrul pa gtan nas mi zer/'khrul ba zhes pa ni nyams len brjed rjes 'byams su shor bas nyon mongs rang rgyud pa de la zhabrul pa zer ba yin/ des na 'gyu cha la grol cha yod dgos/de ltar gnas 'gyu gnyis res mos tshul du shes pa de la phyag chen pas rig par btags kyang / sems rig la shan 'byed pa'i gzhi'i rig pa dngos min/blo rig shes gsum don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pas rdzogs chen pas 'di la dran shes zer/ spyir kun rtog thams cad la gzhi'i dbyings dang rig pa'i khyab cha yod pas rtsal gyi rig pa dngos yin/ de ltar snod bcud 'di dag dbyings dang rig pas khyab tshul shes nas rba rlabs rgya mtshor bskor ba'i man 312

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥngag thugasarje kun khyab kyi rig pa'i don phyogs tsam shes pa yin/ de yang bying rmugs sel thabs/ rgod na lhod thabs/ khams gsum dang sku gsum gyi rnam dbye sogs yin min gyi stangs legs par phye nas rgyun tu bskyangs na dga' sdug gi snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba de nyid rang sems las shar zhing de nyid du thim pa'i gnad shes/ dga' sdug gi snang ba ni phyi nang gang du'ang rang mtshan du grub pa rdul tsam med kyang / yul rkyen gyis bslangs ba'i sems kyi nyer len las skye ba yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba lung las/ skye bo mdza' bo mthong na— sogs gsungs so/ /des na dga' sdug gi snang ba 'di dag thams cad 'od gsal gyi dbyings las shar ba'i stong gzugs nyag gcig yin par shes dgos/ de nyid du thim tshul dus 'khor lung drangs/ thim zhesapa ni sa rdo sogs bem po 'di dag sems la thim pa lta bu min te/ bzang ngan bar ma'i rtog pa rnams dbyings las shar zhing dbyings su rang dengs la 'gro ba'am grol ba'i tshul yin/ snang ba thams cad sems kyi rang snang du ngo 'phrod zhes pa ni phar phyin theg pa dang / sngags bla med gnyis ka'i snang sems gnyis gcig yin par 'dod/ yul snang ba la dbyibs dang kha dog yod pa'i phyir dang yul can sems la med pa'i phyir de gnyis tshul mi mtshungs so/ /gnas sam 'gyu ba'i tshe zhes pa ni gnas pa'i steng du yul can yid shes kyi ngor yul snyong pa/ bde ba gsal ba/ dwangs dub ma phye ba'i hang hang ba dang bzhi yod/ 'gyu ba la mang du yod kyang / bzang ngan bar ma'i rtog pa gsum la 'du bas/ gong du skyon yon bshad pa ltar yin min gyi stangs legs par phye nas 'char gzhi 'od gsal 313

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥba'i rig pa'i rgyun yang nas yang du bskyang ba'i tshe/ chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa'i rang bzhin du rtogs/ stong pa de yang nam mkha' lta bu'i chad stong zhig min/ nam mkha' zhes pa ni steng gi rgyan de la mi zer te/ bar snang stong pa bem shes gnyis kyi chas stong pa de la zer/ 'od gsal stong pa chen po 'di ni kun shes kun rig gi bdag nyid can/ kun shes kun rig dam pa po/ /zhes pa ltar dang / dus 'khor na stong nyid blun pa min pa gsungs pa ltar/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid sku dang ye shes kyis brgyan pa'i bdag nyid/ phyag chen na gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ rdzogs chen na/ gdod ma'i stong chen gyi dbyings sku dang ye shes kyi 'char gzhi zer ba yin/ rdzogs gyi gzhi bshad pa'i skabs su/ gzhi bdun skyon can bshad pa ni/ long ba bdun gyis glang po'i skye mched bshad pa ltar/ 'od gsal gyi gzhi'i phyogs rer bzung ba'i cha nas bshad pa yin/ skyon med rang gzhung gi gzhi sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa 'di ni/ngo bo stong pa la ye shes kyi snying po can/ rang bzhin gsal ba la 'od kyi snying po can/ thugs rje kun khyab la rig pa'i snying po can de nyid 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi chos thams cad la dbyings rig 'du 'bral med par khyab pa yin kyang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems byung dang bcas pa rnam shes sems kyi rgyas gcig sgrib/ nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum gyi zhen pas gcig sgrib/ kun gzhi ma rig lung ma bstan gyi chas gcig sgrib/ de gsum gyis sgrib tshul ni/ ral gri shubs dang / nor bu 'dam dang / me long sgrom ltar sgrib pas bsgribs kyang rang bzhin rnam dag gi tshul du gnas 314

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥskabs kun tu 'pho 'gyur med pa yin/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum gyis snod bcud ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin du 'dod tshul 'dra yang / ma hās snod bcud rnams sgyu dang 'phrul gyi tshul du 'dod/ a nus rtsal/ a tis rig pa nyid rang snang bar 'dod/ dang po 'char gzhi sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa'i steng du sems rig la shan legs par phyes nas yang nas yang du goms shing 'dris par byas pa'i snying dbus su 'od gsal gyi rig pa sad pa'i stobs kyis rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems byung dang bcas pa 'od gsal nyag gcig gi na ma ldan du 'char ba ni/ dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba'i tshe zer thams cad drod kyis khyab pa ltar/ drod dang zer rnams nyi ma'i snying po 'od gsal ba la ltos kyang / nyi ma'i snying po 'od ga la ba ni drod dang zer la ltos mi dgos pa ltar/ 'char chos thams cad 'char gzhi 'od gsal dbyings rig la ltos kyang / 'char gzhi dbyings rig de nyid 'char chos la ltos mi dgos par gnas skabs kun tu 'pho 'gyur med tshul shes dgos/ngo bo stong pa la ye shes kyi snying po can gyi steng nas chos sku lam byed/ rang bzhin gsal ba la 'od kyi snying po can gzugs sku lam byed/ rang gdangs 'od gsal ni dus 'khor gyi lugs la stong gzugs dang / rdzogs chen gyi lugs la thod rgal gnyis gang las 'char na/ sha las 'char ba min/ khrag las 'char ba min/ rus pa las 'char ba min te/ 'od kyi snying po de las 'char ba yin/ de'i tshe na ma dag pa'i chos zhig gtan nas phye rgyu med/ don la dag pa yin pa dang / bsgoms stobs kyis rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nyag gcig tu sad pa na/ sems rtog 315

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥskyon cio cha rnams bsal rgyu dang / rig pa ye shes kyi cha yon tan gyi phyogs bzhag rgyu med par rtogs pa ni gnad dam pa yin no/ /de ltar rig pa tshad phebs kyi skabs 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu rtogs pa ni/ sha khams dang sa khams 'od ser po'i rnam par snang 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin du snang ba'i mthar/rin chen 'byung ldan ston 'khor dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs/ de bzhin du 'byung chen lnga dang phung khams skye mched thams cad 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin du snang ba'i mthar rgyal ba rigs lnga zhing sku pho brang gi rnam par shar ba yin no/ /chos sku'i steng na ye shes gsum/ longs sku'i steng na ye shes lnga/ sprul sku'i steng na ye shes gnyis/ de las ldog chas dbye na ye shes nyer lnga dang / drug bcu re lnga re dbye tshul yod/ sku gsum dbyer med ldog chas dbye ba ni ral gri rno ngar mnyen gsum ltar ro/ /sgom byed yul can yid kyi shes pa yin yang / sems sdug mi dgos te yul yul can gnyis su med tshul ni/ dper na mdo yi chos thams cad stong nyid gcig gi rang bzhin tu gtan la phab nas yul can yid kyi shes pas yul stong nyid don spyi'i tshul la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ yid shes de stong nyid gcig gi rnam ldan du 'char ba dang / yul can yid kyi shes pa'i yul 'od gsal gyi rig pa la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ 'od gsal gyi rig pa shar ba'i stobs shugs kyis yul can yid kyi shes pa'ang 'od gsal gyi rnam ldan du 'char bas yul yul can tha dad pa'i tshul du yod pa ma yin pa'i tshul shes dgos so/ /de ltar yang nas yang du goms shing 'dris par byas nas brtan pa thob rim gyis 'khrul ba'i snang ba je dag dang / dag pa'i snang ba je 316

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥcher 'gro ba ni lam rtags yin par gsungs so// ༈ shes bya yul dang shes byed blo/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni/ /mnyam pa nyid du shar ba'i tshe yeng yul chos nyid sangs ba zhes/ dpal mgon bla ma'i zhal rgyun yin/ /༄༅/ /bying rgod rmugs gsum sogs bshad pa'i skor/ bying ni rig pa'i gsal ngar gyi cha lhod pa dang / rgod pa ni 'dod pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i 'phro ba'i cha'o/ /rmugs pa ni sems la mun pa babs pa'i rnam pa can no/ /༈ 'od gsal zhes pa ni/ med dgag stong rkyang min te/ dbyingasaspros bral la rig gdangs kyi cha yod pa'o/ /gzhi las gzhi snang 'char tshul dang / de las 'khrul grol 'byung tshul 'khrul pa gzhi la ldog nas slar 'khrul mi srid pa'i tshul shes par bya'o// ༈ 'khor lo bar ba'i bstan don chos thams cad dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i stong pa chen po dang / 'ukhor lo tha ma'i bstan don sku dang ye shes bstan pa de gnyis/ dbyer med zung 'jug chen por kun mkhyen klong chen dang / 'jam mgon mi pham rnam rgyal sogs kyis bzhed pa yin la gsang sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud sde rnams su/ gdod ma'i ye gzhi 'am chos sku gzhi gnas kyi rig pa zhes gsungs/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i skabs su gzhi bcing grol med/ gnas lugs chos zad ka dag gi dgongs pa ngo 'phrod/lhun grub rang gdangs 'gag pa med pas 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhi ma 'gags par ngo shes/ thugs rje'i rol pa yul thog tu shar nas bag chags gsog long med par dran rtog rjes med du grol bas yid ches/ de gsum gdod nas dbyer med du bzhugs pa la sku gsum dbyer med kyi rig pa'am 317

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrig stong zung 'jug ces snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud pa rnams kyis bzhed pa yin no/ /de rnams g.yu khog bya bral gsung yin/ /༄tsho/ /sems rig la shan phyes te nyams su len tshul sogs kyi skor/ dang po sems rig gi la shan phyes nas rig thog tu mnyam par bzhag /bar du rtsal sbyong sogs kyis sems rtog gang shar rig pa'i klong du grol ba la bslab/mthar sems sems byung mtha' dag rig pa'i rnam ldan du 'char gsung /༈ gang zag las dang po pa'i dus su rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad po'i gseb nas 'od gsal gyi rig pa de sha nang gi rmen bsal bsal/ sa nang nas gser btsag btsag byas te ngos zin dgos/ de dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/gang zag gcig gi rgyud la dus mnyam du rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'od gas la dang dgu po shar yod de/ 'od gsal ni sems can thams cad kyi shes rgyud la rjen par shar yod kyang ngos mi zin pa red/ sems kyi cha rnams 'gag pa'i skabs re yod kyang / de ni 'di ltar gnyid dang brgyal ba la sogs pas mi zin/mdo rang lam gyi byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum las/byang sems dbang rab kyis kyang bskal chen grangs med gcig gi tshogs bsags dang 'brel bar yul can rnam shes kyi yul stong nyid don spyi tsam sgom pa'i mthar/ sa dang po 'phags lam chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong dus su yul can dang yul tha dad med pa'i tshul du stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa yin te/ji skad du/ smra bsam brngod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /ces pas yul stong nyid bstan/ so so rang rig ye shes spyod 318

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥyul ba/ /zhes pas yul can ye shes bstan te/ de ltar 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi rang dus der tshogs brgyad 'gags nas ye shes rjen par 'char/ de dus kyang rjes thob du ni dag pa sa gsum la ma slebs bar tu kun gzhi dang sgo lnga'i shes pa sogs mi 'gag /sngags bla med kyis mtshan bcas rdzogs rim bsgom tshe rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pas yid shes kyi ngor dpe'i ye shes shar tshe shes pa gzhan 'gags kyang yid shes tsam mam kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang mi 'gag pa'i skabs yod/ phyag chen mdo lugs kyi skabs sa bcu sogs kyi rim pas spang bya sems kyi dri ma ci rigs dag rim gyis ye shes mthong tshul gsungs/ phyag chen stags phywags gong gi sngags lam ltar/ phyag chen snying po'i lugs dang rdzogs chen gyi skabs su sems rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad po de dang ma nor bar 'char gzhi 'od gsal gyi rig pa rjen pa de ngo shes dgos/ de ltar ngo shes pa la phyag chen pas gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zer/ rdzogs chen pas 'od gsal gyi rig pa zer te don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so// ༈ mdor na rang gi shes rgyud 'di'i steng nas 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i gzhi 'jog ste/ bde nyams kyis 'dod lha rigs drug gi thog ma/ gsal nyams kyis gzugs khams/ stong nyams dang mi rtog pa'i nyam/sa kyis gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir 'phen/ bying rmugs bsags pas ri bong dang phyi ba sogs su skye/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis ngan song gsum/dge ba yang byang chub sems kyis ma zin/ dngos gzhi lta bas ma zin/ rjes bsngo bas ma zin pa'i sbyin sogs kyi dge rtsa de log ltas ma bcom/ khong khros 319

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā ma bsreg /ma bsngos nga dang log par bsngos pa sogs dge rtsa 'dzad pa'i rgyu bzhis ma bzhig par yod na de dag gi 'bras bu sbyin pas longs spyod dang /khrims gyis bde 'gro/ bzod pas gzugs bzang ba sogs 'byung ba ste/ de dag ni kun nyon 'khor phyogs kyi rgyu yin la/ rig ngo sad de gzugs khams dang gzugs med du skye ba'i rgyu nyams zhen gyi shun pa 'thor/ 'dod khams su skye ba'i rgyu dus gsum gyi zhabrul rtog dag nas rig pa rkyang 'ded dang / ye shes rjen 'ded byas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje/ 'khor bar zhen log gi nges 'byung / gzhan phan don gnyer gyi byang sems/ snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang sogs rang shugs kyis 'char nas rnam byang myang 'das kyi rgyu 'jog par mkhas pa'i bstan bcos dang / rtogs ldan gyi myong khrid thams cad mthun no// ༈ rig pa ni yul la gtad pa med pas/ 'char gzhi 'od gsal shar ba des shar chos rtog pa gzhan 'char ba'i go mi bkag pa ni/ nyi ma shar bas 'od mi 'gag pa bzhin/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad la yul yul can gnyis re yod pas yul can yid shes lta bus yul bzang ngan bar ma gang rung zhig bzung ba na rtog pa gzhan 'char ba'i go skabs 'phrog pa ste/ des na rig pa sems kyi ngang las mi 'char la/ sems rig pa'i ngang nas 'char ba'i tshul shes na nor mi dgos so/ /de lta bu'i gdod ma'i gshis kyi bzhugs tshul de go bas mi chog myong ba thon dgos pas/ rig pa zang thal gyi ngo bo'i steng du rang sa bzung /rjen la bton/ khur byung nas lta thog tu myong bas slebs dgos so// ༈ yang mnyam bzhag gi rang sa zin kyang de nyid rkyen dang bsres nas rtogs pa'i rtsal 320

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsbyang ma byas na gnyen pos rkyen mi thub pas/ mnyam bzhag legs po de'i klong na rtog ngan gyi dug sprul 'jigs su rung ba mang po gnas gcig du tshogs nas sdod pa lta bu yin pas/ mdzes ma'i gzugs sogs chags yul yid du 'ong ba dang / gzhan gyis brnyas smod sogs sdang ba'i yul rkyen gang rung re'i dbang gis khong khro dang 'dod chags sogs mngon du gyur 'ong ba de/ rang rgyud kyi sgom de'i klong nas byung ba min na sha las mi 'byung / khrag dang pags pa dang rus dang rkang sogs gang las byung soms shig /des na de dag spyong ma thub zhe sdang gi dbang gis dmyal ba/ 'dod chags kyi dbang gi yi dwags/ gti mug gi dud 'gro/ phrag dog gis lha min/ nga rgyal gyis lha sogs su skye ba thos grol gyi gzhung na gsal ba ltar yin pas de dag spyang dgos/ de yang ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul ni/ rgya gar grub chen tshos/ dang po dben pa'i gnas su mnyam bzhag la brtan pa thob pa'i rjes su tshong 'dus soṭa su song nas mi mang gi rgyu 'grul dang bde sdug sogs la bltas nas rtsal sbyang / de nas grong dgu'i mi gtsang ba slog ste gtsang sme'i gnyis rtog la rtsal sbyang pa dang / de nas rgyal pos chad pa gcod pa'i sar phyin te mig 'byin pa dang rkang lag gcod pa gsod pa sogs la bltas te sems can rang rgyud pa dang snying rje rang rgyud pa la rtsal sbyang / de nas dur khrod du phyin te gcan gzan gtum po dang mi ma yin gdug pa can sogs mthong ba na 'jigs sgrags la sbyangs pa sogs mdzad pa ltar/ gnas ri rtse'am/mtsho gling / skyed mo'i tshal sogs su phyin nas/ mig gis gzugs mthong na de la yang yang blta/ rna bas sgra thos na yang yang nyan pa sogs dang / yid la ci 321

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥshar yang 'char du bcug ste ngag nas ming brjod/ sems rtog med kyang yul la 'phror bcug ste/ yul ka ba lta bu gcig gi steng du 'byams pa gcod pa 'i phyir du ka ba'o snyam pa'i de ma thag bum pa'o/ rdo rje'o/ shing ngo zhes pa lta bur kha spo zhing rtsa ba rig pa'i rang sa ma shor bzhin shes pa yul la 'phror gzhug ste rig thog tu grol ba la bslabs pas rkyen ngan dang rnam rtog gang shar rig pa'i rtsal sbyong du 'char nus pa ni bla ma zhang rin po ches dbu brag phug la brdab pa dang /zhabs rkang la tsher ma zugs pa yang bde stong 'char nus pa bzhin no/ /de ltar rtsal sbyang bya ba 'di/ las dang po pa la rig pa ngo sprad pa'i dus su shun pa gtor ba'i thabs dang / nyams len la brtan cha thob pa'i gang zag gis rkyen thub kyi rtogs pa 'phel ba'i ched du bya ba ste/ ma mtha'ang zhag po brgya re tsam la nges par slob dgos so// ༈ dus dang rnam pa kun tu dam tshig la sel ma zhugs shing / dad pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis dkon mchog gsum gyi snang ba dang ma bral bar res 'ga' bla ma spyi bor bsgom gsol ba btab dbang bzhi blangs/res 'ga' snying dbus su bsgom thugs yid dbyer med du bsre ba sogs byed pa ni gnad gal bo che ste/ thugs yid bsre ba'i gnad 'di kho nas rang gi bsgom rgyu de lam rnam dag zhig min rung 'chi kha tshun la mi grol mi srid pa zhabs drung rin po che'i zhal rgyun yin no// ༈ sgo lnga 'i rnam shes gsal ba la/ /yid kyi zhen rtog ma zhugs pa/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de ka yin/ /༄7/ /rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rang dang dbyer med pa ni/ rig stong zung 'jug gi klong chen po nas 'khor 'das kyi snang cha rab 'byams ji snyed pa dang po shar/322

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbar du gnas/ mthar grol bar 'gyur na lta ba klong chen rab 'byams ni mtshon bya don gyi bla ma yin/ sngar zhal phyag sku gzugs kyi rnam par byon pa ni mtshon byed dpe'i bla ma'o/ /de bzhin du rig pa'i ye shesal mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i snying rje zung 'jug tu yod pa ni/ 'jigs gling / myu gu nas 'bras sogs bskyed pa bzhin gang shar gyi rtog pa grol tshul gyi na ma pa gang rung du grol nas rgyal ba'i 'bras chos ma lus par bskyed par 'gyur bas de skad du smra'o/ /༈ mnyam bzhag tu tshogs chen ye rdzogs kyi phar phyin drug ni/ chags pa med pa'am 'dzin pa med pa ni sgyin pa'i mchog spyin pa'i phar phyin/ las dang bag chags dus gsum gyi 'khrul rtog gis ma gos pa tshul khrims/ sngags kyi dbang rnon gyis ye shes rtogs bzhin stong nyid la mi skrags par ma zad stong nyid la je dga' je dga' nyid du 'gyur na ni/ don la mi skrags pa'i bzod pa'am/ mi 'khrugs pa'i bzod pa'o/ /'du byed rtsol ba'i brtson 'grus ma yin par/ mi brtson pa'i brtson pa chen po brtson pa mthar thug pa'o/ /bsam bya bsam byed dang bral ba'i gdod ma gzhi'i bzhugs tshul la mnyam par 'jog pa bsam gtan nam/ yang na yeng 'khrul dang bral ba'i phyir na de skad du smra'o// rig pa'i ye shes thig le nyag gcig spros pa dang bral ba ni/ gzhi gnas rang byung bi shes rab mnyam bzhag tu mkhyen cha 'gag med kyi tshul du yod la rjes thob du rtsal bsgoms byung gi shes rab sogs su 'bar ba yin gsungs so/ /rjes thob tyā snga sna'i shugs kyis phyin drug la slob par 'gyur ba ni spyod pa rgyal ba'i myu gu yan —sa so/ / 323

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄7/ /gzhi las gzhi snang 'char tshul gyi skor/ gzhi lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs na 'khor 'das gnyis kyi snang ba 'char rung gi gdangs ma 'gags par yod/ gzhi snang lam lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs ni 'khor 'das su snang ba'i 'khrul gzhi dang grol gzhi gnyis ka yin/ 'bras bu lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs la sku dang zhing khams sogs 'char rung du yod/ gzhi la dag ma dag gnyis ka mi srid kyang gzhi snang lhun grub la 'khor 'das gnyis su 'char ba'i sgo yod pa la lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi snang ba zhes bya ste/ thugs rje ltar shar ba med na gdul bya 'dul byed du mi 'brel/ 'od ltar shar ba med na rig pa nang du chad/ 'byung ba phyir rgya chad pas snod bcud kyi snang ba'ang mi 'byung la/gnyis med ltar shar ba med na sems can gyi snyo gsum dang sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su 'brel mi shes pas sems can sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur/ sku ltar shar ba med na 'gro ba'i lus dang rgyal ba'i skur snang ba'ang mi rigs/ ye shes ltar shar ba med na shes bya rang mtshan par gyur bas gzhi lam 'brel mtshams mi sbyor/ mtha' grol ltar shar ba med na 'bras bu rgyur ldog pas nges pa'i sa zin mi thob/ ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo med na sems can du 'khrul mi shes pas 'khor 'das kyi bsti gnas su mi rung / dag pa ye shes kyi sgo med na rig ngo la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na de rnams lhun grub tu yod pa ni lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi yon tan no/ /sgo brgyad po dus cig char la 'char/ cig char la nub par gsungs/ ༈ theg mchog mdzod ltar na/ thugs rje ltar 'char ba'i go ma 'gags pas sems can la snying rje 'byung / 'od ltar 324

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥshar ba'i go ma 'gags pas ye shes lnga'i rang 'od 'ja' tshon lta bus khengs/ye shes ltar 'char ba'i go ma 'gags pas mi rtog par nang na gnas/ sku ltar 'char ba'i go ma 'gags pas zhi khro 'od gsal gyi sku nam mkha' khengs/gnyis med ltar 'char ba'i go ma 'gags pas gcig dang du ma mi dbyod pa/mtha' grol ltar 'char ba'i go ma 'gags pas lhun grub rang ngo na gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ 'od ltar shar ba dang sku ltar shar ba gnyis yul ltar shar/ thugs rje dang ye shes gnyis yul can ltar shar/ gnyis med dang mtha' grol ltar shar ba gnyis yul can des yul la bya ba byed tshul ltar shar bas/snang ba la yod ces sgro 'dogs pa'i blo med pas yod 'dzin 'khor ba'i mtha' sel/ rig pa la med ces skur ba 'debs pa'i blo med pas stong 'dzin mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' sel/ 'di ltar snang dus kyi 'od snang stong gzugs thams cad rig pa'i rang gdangs ye shes kyi snang ba yin no/ /gdangs phyir shar ba rkyen bzhi'i yar grol te/ rgyu'i rkyen dngos po'i gnas lugs/ bdag po'i rkyen rang rig pa'i ye shes/ dmigs pa'i rkyen rang snang du shes pa/mtshungs med pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen de rnams dus mtshungs su 'byung ba'i skad cig la sangs rgyas pa'o/ /de'i tshe ka dag gi rig pas tshur rang ngo shes pas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs/ lhun grub kyi snang ba de rang snang yin pa dang / de rang bzhin med par shes pas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa yin te/ zag med rang ngo shes pa'i dge tshogs kyis zhes gsungs/ de yang kun tu bzang pos dge ba spu tsam ma byas par sangs rgyas zhes brjod kyang legs par brtags na zag 325

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmed rang ngo shes pa de 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa gang gis kyang mi mtshon zhing thams cad kyang de rtogs pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu zad pas don la sgrib gnyis ma spangs ye sangs/ tshogs gnyis ma bsags ye rdzogs su gyur ba'o/ /glog sgron las/ rgyu'i rkyen rig pa rang byung gi ye shesarang la gsal ba/ dmigs rkyen 'od snang sna tshogs su shar ba/ bdag po'i rkyen de nyid rang snang du ngo shes pa/de ma thag rkyen rang byung ye shes chen po des ma dag 'khrul ba'i sa bon gtan bcom du song nas gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings ka dag gi klong du grol ba la grol ba snga phyir grol ba dang da lta dang bar do sogs su grol ba la khyad med par/ gzhi snang shar ba ngo shes pa'i skad cig la gdod mar grol te dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa nang gsal chos nyid kyi dgongs par bzhugs/༄7/ /cog bzhag bzhi'i rnam bzhag /cog bzhag bzhi ni khregs chod thod rgal gnyis ka'i bzhag thabs su chos dbyings mdzod 'grel du gsungs/ 'di la 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang / lugs gcig la/ lta ba ri bo cog bzhag ces pa la/ gzhi'i bzhugs tshul dang /ngo sprod kyi man ngag dang /ngo 'phrod pa'i cha nas bzhag pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ rig stong chos sku thig le nyag gcig de sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la bzhugs pa rnam pa thams cad du 'pho 'gyur med par ri rgyal ltar brtan pa'i cha nas 'jog /gnyis pa ni rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang gi brgyud pa'i man ngag rnams tshig la lhag chad dang don la nor 'khrul med pa'i cha nas 'jog /gsum pa ni/ngo 'phrod pa'i gang zag des rang rgyud kyi ye shes sad stobs kyis gzhan gyi rgol ba dang phyin ci log gi 326

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥblo ngan sogs kyis bskyed du med par yid gting nas ches pa la bya'o/ /sgom pa rgya mtsho cog bzhag ni/ tshogs drug lhug par bzhag na yul lnga 'gag med du tshul rgya mtshor gza' skar bkra ba bzhin shar yang snang ba'i yul gyis ma gos/'dzin pa'i sems kyis ma bcings pa'o/ /spyod pa man ngag cog bzhag ni/yul drug la yul can gyi shes pas rol ba'i tshe/ dang por rtsal sbyang ba/ bar du shar grol du song / tha mar rin po che'i gser gling ltar gang snang ye shes kyi rnam rol du 'char ba'i bar du bslab pa'o/ /'bras bu rig pa cog bzhag ni/lam gyur gyi 'bras bu ste gong gi lta sgom spyod gsum la goms 'dris byas pas gzhi'i yon tan je mngon du gyur pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/༄tsho/ /thod rgal gyi skabs su khregs chod las 'phags pa'i khyad chos bdun ni/ /nyams len lag len dang 'brel ba'i khyad par/ lus gnad rtsa yi khyad par/ snang byed sgo yi khyad par/ mthong ba dbang po'i khyad par/ rang gnad mngon sum gyi khyad par/ snang ba 'od kyi khyad par/ nyams snang gong 'phel gyi khyad par dang bdun no/ /dang po ni/ phyi'i dbyings nam mkha' stong pa la dbyings rig pa lu gu rgyud dngos su cer mthong du ston pa'i lag khrid zam ma chad pas yid dbyod rtog pa'i shes rab la rag ma las te/ gdams pa'i ngo bo la bar du bsre bslad dang rtog bzos zab mi zab byar med pas ches 'phags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ khregs chod du rags pa'i rtsa rlung la brten pa las/ thod rgal du 'od rtsa dwangs ba ngos bzung nas sgron ma dngos lam du byed pas 'phags so/ /gsum pa ni/ rig pa mi rtog par gnas pa la khregs chod du yid 327

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsgo rtog bcas kyi gdengs las ye shes 'tshol ba la/ 'dir rig pa rtog med 'od gsal gyi gdangs mig nas 'char ba ngos 'dzin pas 'phags so/ /bzhi pa ni/ khregs chod du yul snang tshogs drug gi snang ba 'dzin pa'i dbang pos mthong bas rtog pa sna tshogs su 'char ba rgyun mi 'chad pa las/ 'dir 'od rtsa dwangs ba'i dbang pos lu gu rgyud cer mthong du mthong dus/ rtog pa dus gcig la 'gag cing ye shes kyi snang cha dpag tu med pa 'char bas 'phags so/ /lnga pa ni/ khregs chod du ye shes dngos su bltar med la 'dir dngos su mthong bas phyis mngal gyi grong khyer rgyun gcod par byed pas 'phags so/ /drug pa ni/khregs chod du zhakhrul snang las mi snang la/ zhabrul snang 'dzin pa'i shes pa ni 'bru' shes su 'gyur bas don la gzung 'dzin las mi 'da' la/ 'dir ni rig pa'i ye shes la 'byung ba dag pas 'khrul snang mi snang bar rang 'od snang bas khyad par du 'phags so/ /bdun pa ni/ khregs chod du shes pa gcod khams je brtan du 'gro ba tsam las nang shes pa'i nyams ting nge 'dzin du ma dwangs/ spyan dang mngon shes dang / phyi snang ba'i nyams 'od dang sku la sogs pa med la 'dir nyams snang khyad par can gong nas gong du 'char te snang ba bzhi tshad du phyin nas myur du grol bas khyad par 'phags so/ /'di dag gi khyad par zhib mor phye na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / che long tsam brjod pa ste/ mdor na rig pa'i don dngos su mthong zhing bltar yod pas zhabrul ba skad cig la dag pa dang / yid dpyod la lus pas zhakhrul snang la lam byas nas/ ma zhabrul ba'i 'bras bus 'tshol ba'i khyad par gyis che bar shes rab kyi mig dang ldan pa 328

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrnams kyis rtogs par bya'o//༄༅/ /sgo gsum gyi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang ba ni/ lus kyi snyi'i bya ba tshong dang so nam la sogs pa 'du 'dzi dang g.yeng ba/ nang gi bya ba thun mong gi chos phyag dang skor ba la sogs pa/ gsang ba'i bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag rgya gar la sogs pa ste/ mdor na g.yo byed lus kyi spros pa mtha' dag btang zhing /ngag gi sgyi'i bya ba long gtam tshig rtsub la soṭa pa 'jig rten tha mal ba'i ngag gi smra brngod/ nang gi bya ba thun mong gi 'don zlos kha rtan/ gsang ba'i bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i bzlas brjod bsnyen sngags la sogs pa ste/ mdor na smra brjod ngag gi 'jug pa mtha' dag btang la/ sems kyi phyi'i bya ba 'jig rten gyi rnam rtog /nang gi bya ba thun mong gi chos la rtog daspyuod dang bsam mno/gsang ba'i bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i bskyed rim la sogs pa'i blos byas kyi sgom pa thams cad de/ mdor na dran bsam yid kyi 'phro 'du thams cad btang la/ sgo gsum dal ba bsten par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/༄7/ / sems dang ye shes kyi dbye ba la gnyis/ dang po semasakyi dbye ba brgyad de/ gnas/ngo bo/ lam/ sgo/ yul/ rtsal/ byed las/ 'bras bu'o//gnas ni/ glo ba na rtsa gro sog gi sbu gu tsam rlung gis gang ba las dbugs thams cad mched pa'i rten byed pa snying ga dang 'brel ba na gnas so/ /ngo bo ni snying gi rig gdangs rlung dang 'dres pas rnam par rtog pa'o/ /lam ni/ glo ba nas rtsa 'dab so so la song ba'i rlung gis sgo lnga'i yul rtogs pa'i phyir kha sna sogs dbang po so so'i rlung rgyu bsdi 2rdo rnams yin no/ /sgro ni/ dbang po so

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥso dang kha sna'o/ /yul ni/ gzugs la sogs pa tshogis drug gi yul drug go/ /rtsal ni/ gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub la sogs pa'i rnam rtog rnams so/ /bhed las ni/ nyon mongs dang bag chags du ma gsog par byed do/ /'bras gyu ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed par byed do/ /༈ gnyis pa ye shes kyi dbye ba brgyad las/ gnas ni/ tsitta rin po che mchong gur phub pa 'dra ba'i dbus/ 'od gsal gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi'i lte ba la dwangs ma nyung 'bru tsam la brten pa'o/ /ngo bo ni/ rig pa'i ye shes te/ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ thugs rje 'gag pa med par mar me'i snying po lta bu 'od dang skur 'bar ba dang de'i rtsal dung khang na khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pa'o/ /lam ni/ snying nas mig tu 'brel ba'i rtsa ka ti shel gyi sbu gu can de/ 'brel lugs ni snying gi rtse nas sgal tshigs 'dabs la 'khril te/ mgrin pa'i rtse'u chung g.yas g.yon gyi 'dab nas rna ba gnyis la 'khril te/ klad pa nas mig gi a 'bras chu'i sgron ma gnyis la zug nas gnas so/ /sgyuo gang nas 'char ba ni/ mig gnyis nas 'char ro/ /mig gi rtsa'i rtsa ba ni lte ba dang snying gar 'brel lo/ /snying ga nas mgrin pa 'brel lo/ /mgrin pa nas dung khang du g.yas 'khyil ba rtsa 'dab bzhir gyes pa'i dbang po yul la 'char bar byed pa'i rtsa 'dab gcig las rtse mo lngar gyes te/ sgo lnga so so'i rten byed pa'i las skyon yon dbang po dwangs byed kyi rtsa zhes bya ba kha che la rtsa ba phrab ba men gyi rwa lta bu'i yal ga gnyis mig gi a 'bras kyi dwangs ma gnyis la zug nas dkar nag phyed ma chu'i rang bzhin dwangs la gsal ba byung bas rgyang zhags chu'i sgron 330

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥm zhes bya'o/ /de la brten nas thig le stong ba'i sgron ma rma bya'i mdongs lta bur 'char ro/ /de'i gdangs dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma yi ge na ro lta bur 'char ro/ /de'i rtsal shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma shes pa'i rtsal du mar 'char ro/ /de yang shel sbug can ni 'od rtsa yin la/ dbang po dwangs byed ni mig gi dbang rten zar ma'i me tog lta bu'i rtsa yin no/ /mig gi nang rig pa dngos phyir lta ba dang / phyi nang snang ba gzugs khams kyi snang ba nang du lta ba'i bar gyi sgo me shel dri ma med pas chod pa lta bu ste/ nang gi 'od mdangs phyir gsal dang /phyi'i gzugs brnyan nang du shar ba gnyis mi bsgrib par gsal bar mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /rig pa dngos kyi gdangs 'char ba'i rtsa sgo bzhi ste/ mig gnyis nas 'od snang dngos su phyir 'char ba dang / snying nas dbu ma'i dbus su snying po 'od gsal gyi rtsa las dung khang gi khro bo dang / de'i gdangs rtsa rnams kyi thig le dang /dbu ma'i 'od rtsa las 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus kyi 'od gsal thig le chen po dang /spyi bo nas rtog pa med pa'i sku tshangs bug la 'char ro/ /tshad phebs kyi thig le lnga brtsegs sam dgu brtsegs su 'char ba'i rten can 'pho ba'i rtsa sgo dam pa de dang / snying nas glo bar rig gdangs sems su 'char ba ste/ de ltar mig gnyis dbu ma'i 'od rtsa glo ba'i gdangs rtsa dang bcas pa rnams so/ /phal gyis mig rtsa gnyis lam du ngos bzung ba ni/ rgya chung bas ma go bar zad do/ /gdangs bzhi 'char ba'i rtsa bzhi ngos bzung la/ nyams len gyi tshe mig nas rig pa thon cing / de'ang mig gnyis nas rig pa'i rang bzhin 'od mdangs 'char la/ dbu ma'i 'od rtsa las ngo bo stong gdangs 'char zhing glo ba'i rtsa nas 331

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥthugs rje rig gdangs 'char ba yin no/ /yul gang la 'char na phyi'i dbyings nam mkha' la/ nang gi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma 'od lngar snang ba'i nang du 'char ro/ /rig pa'i rtswal ni/ nang gsal thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga dang / phyi gsal ji lta dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam par shar ro/ /byed las ni/ 'khor ba'i zhabrul snang zhakhrul 'dzin thams cad dang bral bar byas te dbyings gdod ma'i ngang la sbyor ba'o/ /'bras smi ni/ khams la sgrib pa'i dri ma bag chags sna tshogs pa'i kun gzhi la brten pa'i cha dang bcas pa dag nas nyi ma sprin dang bral ba ltar/ shes rab rig pa'i ye shes dri ma med pas rang rig byang chub tu mthar phyin par byas nas sku dang ye shes kyi dgongs pa la rtag tu bzhugs pa'o/ /sems dang ye shes 'phrad pa'i dus ni gnyis te phyi 'phrad dang / nang 'phrad do/ /phyi 'phrad ni/ blo spros pa dang bral ba'i tshe sems ṭwāṃ ོ༵/'i/ rig gdangarsā snying gar thim nas/ nang rig thog tu sems 'phrad pa zhes ༄99/ /bzhugs stangs sogs kyi skor/ bzhugs stangs kyi skabs su/theg mchog mdzod du/ bca' ba spren gyi zhes rtsa ba'i sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs gsum dang / ngal gso ye shes kyi gnad ces sprul sku'i skabs su lag sor bsnol te pus rgyab nas 'khyud pa dang / longs sku'i skabs lag mthil mdun gyi sa la phab pa dang / chos sku'i skabs lag mthil sar phab pa tsam gyi khyad par rnams gsungs la/ gzhan yang yan lag gi 'dug stangs mang po ya bzhi sogs su gsungs pa yod kyang sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs de kho nas mi 332

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥchog pa med cing / de'i nang nas chos nyid mngon sum man chad du sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang phrong tsog pu nyid gtso bor bya dgos gsungs/ ༈ ngag gi gnad la/ bslab pa dang / gnas pa/ la bzla ba rnams bsten par bya zhes gnad gsum du 'brel ba'i lugs yod kyang / theg mchog mdzod du/ bslab pa ni smra ba je nyung tha mal gyi smra ba bcad pa la thun thung ngu bslab/ de nas ring du bslab/ skabs su smra rgyu med kyang gcig pu smra'o/ /gnas pa ni sngags dang brngod pa la sogs dge ba'i brjod pa mi dgag /gzhan dang tshig 'bru gcig kyang mi 'dre'o/ /'di'i dus na lus kyi brdas don go bar byed pa'o/ /la bzla ba ni sngags la sogs pa brngod pa thams cad mi bya'o/ /brtan pa ni/ ci yang mi brjod pa'i ngang las mi 'da' bar byed pa ste/ lus kyi brda tsam yang mi bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// ༈ spyir 'od snang spu nyag tsam dang thig le nyung 'bru tsam tshun chad thig le'i phyogs su bsdu dgos la/ thig le stong sgron dngos ni/ nar mo phyi 'od lnga'i mu khyud can pad 'dab kyis bskor ba rang gi tshon gang gi tshad tsam 'char ba sogs dbyings thig rig gsum snang ba dngos mthong tshul gyi khyad par mang du yod gsungs/ ༈ phyi'i 'od snang la rtog dpyod zhugs pa sogs kyis lug rgyud dngos por gol ba'i skyon dang / khyad par rlung sems kyi sbur ba'i stong gzugs la mchog 'dzin byas pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi dbang gis stong gzugs bdud kyi rnam par shar ba sogs 'byung ba ni lam gyi gnad legs par ma zin pas yin la/ sngon 'gro'i phyi'i ru shan gyi skabs su gzung 'dzin gyi 'ching zhen legs par bzhig thub yod na 'dir dngos gzhi'i skabs 333

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsu rtsol bas ci tsam du gtad kyang mi 'ching ba 'ong bas de 'dra la sngon 'gros dngos gzhi drangs pa zhes zer te/ 'di la ni lug rgyud dngos por gol ba sogs kyi gol sa gtan mi 'byung / zhes gsungs/ ༈ shes nyams dang snang nyams mthar 'gyur gyi nyams gsum gyi khyad par ni shes nyams zhes pa bde gsal mi rtog sogs dang / snang nyams ni dbyings rnam dag dang thig le stong sgron la sogs pa'o/ /mthar 'gyur gyi nyams ni rig gdangs las gzhan pa'i nyi zla 'ja' tshon 'dra ba 'a sogs pa rlung rtags kyi snang ba rnams so// ༈ skye 'jug la dbang thob pa'i skabs sems can stong grol bar mdzad pa ni rgya gar grub chen rnams tshogs sgrub mdzad pa'i dus su'ang nam tshod 'dzin nga 'i bya dang mdzo mo la sogs pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa dang dngos grub thob pa'i lo rgyus bzhin no// ༈ rjes dran gyi skabs su bla ma mchog la gdung ba dang ldan pa zhesabla slob kyi 'brel ba ma bcad pa'i gang zag des mos gus dran pa'i mod la bla ma mngon sum du byon nas dbang bskur gdams ngag btab pas mi thebs mi srid/ thob nas mi grol mi srid pa'i gnad khyad par can yod pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi lta ba snang stong zung 'jug nges pa'i nges shes kyi ngo na dgag rtog yod 'dzin med 'dzin chos kyi bdag 'dzin dang gang zag gi bdag 'dzin rnams kyang grol/ yul yod med/ bdag gnyis sogs kyang 'gags/ snang cha spangs ba'i stong rkyang chad pa'am/ stong cha spangs ba'i snang rkyang rtag pa zhig ga la yin te min no/ /gnas lugs la shin tu nye ba'i dpe yi 'od gsal zer chog rgyu red/ ces gsungs/ ༈ la las bcos mi nyan 334

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥzer yang bying rmugs gnyid gsum chags sdang meongs gsum dus gsum gyi 'khrul ba'i dbang du song yang bcos mi nyan ni e red gsungs/ nam mkha' gsum sprugs kyi gdams pa ni bal bo ka ma shi la/ shrī seng / lcags skong /kun mkhyen/ zhabs drung / dgongs pa zang thal sogs na yod gsungs/༈ 'chi kha dur khrod kha tshun chad la brjed mi nyan rgyu bo nyams len red ni ma nor ba zhig e shes blta dgos ni red/ rkang pa'i rten sa/ lag pa'i 'ju sa zhig med na o ha bo/ khyed rnams sha e tsha go/ snying e rje 'i/ yi e mug gi/༄tsho/ /khregs thod kyi man ngag zab mo spyir 'od gsal rdzogs sogs kyi skor/ /spyir 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po 'dir/ dang po brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / de las byung ba'i man ngag gnyis las/ dang po brgyud pa'i lo rgyus gzhan las shes/ gnyis pa gdam sa ngag la smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa gnyis las/ dang po la gzhi'i dbang / lam dbang / 'bras bu'i dbang dang gsum/ dang po gzhi dbang la ni/ bum dbang / gsang dbang sher dbang / tshig dbang dang bzhi/ gnyisapa lam dbang ni/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nasadabang bzhi blang ba'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i dbang ni/rig pa tshad phebs kyi skabs su bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa grol byed kyi gdams ngag la khregs chod thod rgal gnyis/ dang po khregs chod la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshig pa la gsum/ dang po rtog pa rtsad bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtag pa gsum/ dang po rtog pa rtsad bcad pa ni/ 'khor ba'i ya 33ca

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmatha' thog med nas da lta'i bar du/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su zo chun gyi 'gyud mo/ rdza mkhan gyi 'phang lo bzhin du/ lus ngag yid gsum dbang med du 'khrid mkhan dang 'ded mkhan med par 'khyams pa la/ lus ngag yid gsum gtso gang che brtags pas/ lus ngag med pa'i sems rang rkya thub pa zhig yod kyang des thog mar dge sdig ngo mi shes/ bar du bsgrub mi shes/ tha ma grub 'bras smin yul med pa dang / yar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dang /mar sems can gyi lus ngag yid gsum/ rmi lam yul gyi lus ngag yid gsum sogs la brtags pas gtso gang che mi rtogs pa'o/ /de las rig pa kha spo nas/'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar skye shi'i kha brgyud nas/ lus ngag gnyis grangs med 'dor len byas kyang de la rgyun ma chad pa tsam la brtags na cung zad rtogs pa yin no/ /de las rig pa kha spo ste/ 'chi ba'i dus snga ma'i rlung sems bsdus nas/ 'chi srid chos sku'i 'od gsal las/ rlung sems thog mar mched pa'i dus su lus ngag ma grub kyang / slar 'khrul ba'i dbang gis/ lus ngag glo bur du grub nas gsum ka tshogs te las dkar nag dang mi g.yo ba'i las gsum gyi khams gsum gyi gnas ris grub pas 'khor ba'i byed po sems yin par rtogs nas/ kun nyon 'khor ba'i phyogs su sems dang / rnam byang myang 'das kyi phyogs su sems nyid gtso che bar rtogs pa ni rkun ma ngos 'dzin lta bu'i gdams ngag yin no/ /gnyis pa mtshang btsal ba ni/ ri mo mkhan lta bu'i sems des gcig dang tha dad kyi tshul du 'dzin pa yin te/ res chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar lus ngag la nga zhes gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin/ res phyugs 336

g.yu khog bla ma chotshodabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdang phyugs rdzi lta bu nga'i lus ngag ces chos kyi bdag du 'dzin pa ste/ gcig dang tha dad kyi tshul du 'dzin pa yin/ de ltar na lus ngag bem po dang /dbyibs kha dog yod pa bzhin du/ sems la yod dgos pa dang / yang na sems shes pa yin pa dang / mthong thos kyi yul du ma gyur ba bzhin du/ lus ngag kyang shes par 'gyur ba dang / mthong thos mi rung bar 'gyur dgos kyang de ltar ma grub/ de bzhin gzhan khro chags kyi sems dang / dgra gnyen gyi rtog pa sogs gcig tha dad du brtags pas/ gcig tha dad gang yang ma grub pa'o/ /gsum pa byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtags pa ni/ dang po byung sa dang byung mkhan la brtags pa ni/ rdza ma/'o snyam pa lta bu'i sems byung ba na yul rdza ma/lus sha khrag sogs snang ba'i yul gang las byung snyam na/ de nyid rdul phran bsregs gtor du byas nas yul gzhi med rtsa bral du gtan la phab/ byung mkhan rang gi ngo bor brtags shing dpyad nas shes pa yul med zang thal du gtan la phab/ bar du gnas sa gnas mkhan med par yul dang yul can gang zag gtan la phab/ tha ma 'gro sa'i yul steng 'og phyogs bzhi sogs dang /yul can rang gi ngo bo gtan la dbab pas/ yul shes gnyis ka ma grub par rtogs/ de ltar byung gnas 'gro gsum gtan la dbab pas rtog pa dang po skye ba med pa'i chos sku/ gnyis pa 'gags pa med pas longs sku/ gsum pa shar grol 'gags med kyi sprul skur gtan la phab pa'o/ /de ltar gtan la phab pas/snod bcud zhabrul snang dang bcas pa med pa gsal snang / skra shad dang rmi lam sgru ma lta bu/ med snang nyag gcig gzhi med rtsa bral/ shes pa yul med/ zang 337

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥthal byar med kyi ngang du/ nges shes mar me lta bu'i ngang du mnyam pade 'jog pa ni dbu ma'i lta ba las/ khyad du 'phags pa/ khyad gzhi'i steng nas khyad chos ni/gnas cha la dwangs cha yod pa/ dwangs cha la shar cha yod pa/ shar cha la grol cha yod pa ste/ mtha' bzhi'i spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang du 'jog pa ni/byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi lta ba yang dag pa'o/ /dbu ma ni stong 'dzin gyi 'du shes sam/ 'dzin stangs ma nyams pa lcags skud bsgrim pa lta bu dgosazhes pa dang khyad par yod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi rig pa'i rang ngo sprad pa la/ snang ba yul gyi blo can dang / rig pa rang snang gi blo can gnyis las/ dang po snang ba yul gyi blo can ni/ rig pa thad kar lam du khyer mi nus pas/rtog pa gang skyes thams cad dran pas bzung nas/ ma bcos par bzhag pa la 'gyu ba gnas dag gi dgongs pa bskyangs pa yin/ de la mtshan bcas dang / mtshan med kyi zhi gnas gnyis/ dang po mtshan bcas kyis mtshan ma āḥdakar la sems bzung ba/rnam rtog gtor ba/ yi ge phaṭa la sems bzung ba/ khro bo dgyes nga 'i gad mo yi ge ha la sems bzung ba dang / 'ded pa hūṃ la sems bzung ba sogs la bslab/mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim ni/snang srid bla ma ra 'char ba'i bskyed rim dang /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pas rdzogs rim gnyis la bslabs nas/ngo sprod pa sogs yin pa'o/ /gnyis pa rig pa rang snang gi blo can ni/ byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi lta ba'i steng nas ngo sprad pas/ rig pa rkyang 'ded/ ye shes lam byed/ye shes rjen 'ded byas nas rig ngo skyong nus pa yin no/ /rig pa ngo sprad pa la/rig pa ngos 'dzin tshul dang / de nyid sku gsum du ngo sprad pa gnyis las/ dang 338

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpo ngos 'dzin tshul ni/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i stobs kyis ngo sprad pa/ gnas lugs lta ba'i steng du ngo sprad pa/ nyams myong sgom pa'i steng du ngo sprad pa rnams ni chos dbyings mdzod le'u dgu par gnad la ma brten par ngo sprad tshul dang /gnad la brten te ngo sprad tshul drug las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa de nyid sku gsum du ngo sprad pa la gzhi bshad pa/ gzhi snang bshad pa/ kun tu bzang po'i grol tshul bshad pa/ ma dag sems can gyi 'khrul tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gzhi bdun skyon can du bstan pa dang / bye brag bla med rang gzhung gi gzhi bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po gzhi bdun skyon can du bshad pa ni/ dang po gzhi ka dag tu 'dod pa can ni/ gzhi ni rang bzhin gdod nas spros pa thams cad bral ba'i bdag nyid can du smra ba las/ ye gdangs 'gag pa med pa'i lhun grub kyi snang cha ma bzung ba'o/ /ngo bo stong pa'i cha nas 'thad kyang / ka dag stong rkyang de la ma rig pa mi ldan pas 'khor ba ma grub/ ye shes med pas myang 'das mi srid de chad par 'gyur ro/ /rnam rtog med shul gyi stong pa zhig la dmigs nas bsgom pa ni rdzogs chen gyi spyi 'byams gshis shor gyi gol sar bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa gzhi lhun grub tu 'dod pa ni/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka gzhi la lhun grub par 'dod pa'o/ /de yang gdangs 'gags med kyi rtsal snang sna tshogs su 'char ba'i cha nas 'thad kyang / mtha' gcig tu de ltar 'dod na/yod pa rtag pa'i dngos po so sor 'gyur bas/ gzhi ma spangs bar 'khor ba spang mi nus/ tshogs rdzogs pa sogs kyis myang 'das rtogs mi srid/ sems rgyud gcig la 'khor 'das gzhi mthun du mi srid do/ /gsum pa gzhi ma nges 339

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpar 'dod pa ni/ gzhi sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'khor 'das gang du'ang 'gyur rung bas mtha' gcig tu ma nges par 'dod pa'o/ /de yang gzhi spros bral la 'khor 'das ma grub pa'i cha nas ma nges pa 'thad kyang / rnam pa kun tu don la ma nges na/ dri ma dag kyang ma dag par ldog pa'am ma dag kyang dag pa'i rang bzhin du 'thad par 'gyur te sa zin med pas 'khor 'das 'chol bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa gzhi nges pa don gyi dngos gzhi 'dod pa ni/ gzhi rang bzhin 'dus ma byas 'pho 'gyur med pa zhig tu 'dod pa'o/ /de yang glo bur gyi dri ma med snang yin pa'i cha nas gzhi nges med yin par 'thad kyang / rnam pa kun tu de ltar 'dod na/ 'khor ba snang mi srid la/ myang 'das gzhi la nges par yod na lam la mi ltos par 'gyur ro/ /lnga ba gzhi cir yang bsgyur du btub par 'dod pa ni/ gzhi'i rang bzhin la rkyen 'jug pas de 'bor 'das gang du'ang bsgyur rung bar 'dod pa'o/ /de yang gzhi las gzhi snang 'char ba na/ngo shes ma shes las grol 'khrul du 'gyur ba la bsgyur ba'i tha snyad tsam 'thad kyi/ gzhis ngo bo bsgyur du yod par 'dod na/ bsgyur rgyu'i dngos po zhig 'dod dgos/ de ltar na rtag pa yin na bsgyur du mi rung / mi rtag pa bsgrur mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa gzhi cir yang khas blang du btub pa ni/ gzhi sems kyi rang bzhin 'di/'khor 'das dang yod med sogs gang yang rnam pa kun tu gang rung rung khas blang du btub na/ grol gzhi yang 'khrul gzhi dang / 'khrul gzhi grol gzhir khas blang dgos shing / ri rwa dang mo gsham gyi bus kyang 'khor 'das byed par khas blang dgos so/ /bdun pa gzhi sna tshogs su 'dod pa ni/ gzhi las 'khor 340

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'adas kyi chos sna tshogasapa 'char bas chos de rnams gzhi'i chos nyid do zhes 'dod pa'o/ /lhun grub dang 'di gnyis kyis khyad par ni/ gzhi la zhabor 'das grub ces pa dang gzhi nyid 'khor 'das gnyis ka yin zhes pa'i khyad par ro/ /de yang thugs rje 'gag med las rol pa sna tshogs su shar ba sems nyid kyi cha las gzhan ma yin pa'i cha nas 'thad kyang / rnam pa kun tu de ltar 'dod na sems nyid gcig pu 'di dag ma dag gnyis ka yin pa dang / snang ba la 'dod na gzhi bem po yin pa dang / shes pa la 'dod na gzhi rnam shes su thal ba dang /de gnyis tshogs pa la 'dod na/ gzhi gzung 'dzin can du thal ba dang /dbyings gcig gi rang bzhin yin par mi rung bas mi 'thad do/ /de ltar bdun ni/ dpe dmus long gis glang po che'i skye mched la gzhal ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa skyon med bla med kyi gzhi rang banazhung du bshad pa/ de yang rig stong zung du 'ardug pa'i ye shes sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa/ ngo bo stong pa la ye shes kyi snying po can chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba 'od kyi snying po can longs sku/thugs rje kun khyab la rig pa'i snying po can sprul sku ste/ngo bo mi rtog kyang gdangs ma 'gag pas gzugs med kyi sems las grol/ gsal la mi 'dzin pas gzugs khams kyi sems las grol/ rig kyang mi 'phro bas 'dod khams kyi sems las grol bas/ srid gsum ka dag gi lta ba/ khams gsum yongs grol gyi sgom pa/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa/ rang ngo 'phrod pa lta ba/ ngang la gnas pa sgom pa/ gang shar rang grol spyod pa/ sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu/de las mi 'da' ba dam tshig ste/ de ltar gzhi rig stong zung 'jug gi lta ba de la/341

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥphu thag nang nas chod/ nges shes gting nas skyes/ go yul tsam du ma song bar/khregs chod chos sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bstan pa yin pas gzhi la ma du byed pa/ da lta'i thad ka'i shes pa shar yod pa de nyid rig pa chos sku chen por ngo sbrad pa yin no/ /mnyam bzhag lta bu la mtshon na/ phyi sgo lnga'i shes pa/ nang dus gsum yid kyi zhabrul rtog /nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa'i shun pa dang bral nas gdod ma'i gshis thog tu phebs pas/ shes rig go ma 'gags pa kun shes kun rig gi bdag nyid can de la bzo bcos med pa la da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa'am/ rig stong tha mal gyi shes pa zer ba yin/ 'khrul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa/ nyams zhen tha mal gyi shes pa dang mi 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa gzhi snang bshad pa la/ lhun grub kyi snang ba dang / gzhi snang chen mo longs sku dang /sprul sku 'char tshul sogs bar do bshad pa'i skabs las shes so/ /gsum pa kun tu bzang po'i grol tshul ni/ sems can thams cad 'chi ba'i tshe/ snga ma'i lus sems thams cad sdud cing khams dkar dmar nag gsum gyi snang ba dang bcas/ bde gsal mi rtog gi nyamasadang kun rtog brgyad cu sogs 'khrul rtog thams cad 'gags nas/ 'chi srid chos sku'i 'od gsal/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi spyi gzhi rtogs te sangs rgyas ma byung / sku gsum ston pa'i skur ma bzhengs/ ma rtogs te sems can ma byung / zhakhrul ba'i rlung sems ma mched/ngo bo stong kyang gdangs ma 'gags/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka 'char ba'i gzhir gnas pa ni/ gzhi lhun grub rin po che'i sbubasayin no/ /nang gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i sku'i tshul te/ gdangs phyir ma shar bas bum pa/ gting gsal phra ba'i 342

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥye shes ma 'gags pas sku zhes brjod pa yin/ thugs rje'i rig pa nang du g.yos pa las/ gzhon nu bum sku'i rgya ral te thog ma'i gzhi las gzhi snang shar ba ni/ngo bo'i stong gdangs nam mkha' lta bu/ steng dang 'og med pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa/ rang bzhin 'od gdangs sgra 'od zer gsum gyi rnam pa/thugs rje'i rig gdangs dpyod byed shes rab kyi rang bzhin du shar ba las/'khrul grol gnyis ka 'byung rung bas lam lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs zhes brngod pa yin/ gzhi snang shar ba la rang snang du shes/ rang snang rang bzhin med par shes pa rang ngor snang ba/ gzhi 'khyul grol gang yang lung du ma bstan pa'i cha nas grol ba'i gzhi las 'phags pa/ ma rig pa'i bag chags dag rig pa'i rang ngo mthong bas 'khor 'das kyi bye brag phyed pa dang / daphyod byed kyi shes rab nyid kyang chos kyi skur smin pas snang gsum 'pho ba'i bag chags rang zad rang dag /shes sgrib phra ba'i bag chags gtan dag phyed thog tu grol ba/ de ltar rtogs pa gzhan rkyen la ma ltos pas rang stobs kyi rtogs pas lung las ma byung ba'i man ngag /sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad las ma byung ba'i sangs rgyas /rgyu dge sdig las ma byung ba'i 'bras bu ste/ khyad chos drug gi bye brag phyes nas/gzhi snang thams cad shel 'od nang du thim pa ltar/ thog ma'i grol sa'i gzhi dbyings su dal gcig gnas pa ni/ 'bras bu lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs te grol tshul lo/ /khyad chos drug gi brjod tshul gzhan du/ gzhi snang dngos shar dus/ snang ba lhun grub/ lhun grub rang snang / rang snang ye shes/ ye shesaye grol/ ye grol rang rig /rang rig chos sku yin pas thugs rjes rig pa phyir 343

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥskad cig ma zhug tsam shar bas chos drug po de rtogs nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa dang / yang lung las ma byung ba'i man ngag /semalolas ma byung ba'i sangs rgyas/ rgyu las ma byung ba'i 'bras bu/ rang snang rang shar/ rang grol du sangs rgyas so zhes brjod tshul tha dad pa rnams kyang don la gcig go/ /bzhi pa ma dag sems can gyi 'khrul tshul bshad pa la gsum/ 'khrul ba'i rgyu rkyen bshad pa/ zhabrul ba'i snang lugs bshad pa/ snang sems kyi dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po 'khrul ba'i rgyu rkyen bshad pa ni/ gzhi las gzhi snang shar ba'i tshe/rig pa rang gi rtsal rang la sgrib byed du song ba/ rlung sems shin tu phra ba/ rig pa las ldog tsam ma rig pa meongs cha can/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes pa lung ma bstan de rgyu bdag nyid gcig pu'i ma rig pa ste 'khor ba'i rtsa ba the/sa sgrib phra ba'am shes sgrib kyi lhag ro la/ ye shes rang 'grib/las rlung sbun po ste/ 'khor ba'i rgyu ma nor bar song ba yin/ de nyid nus stobs cher song bas dpyod byed kyis shes pa phra mo sgo lnga'i shes pa dang mtshungs ldan/ yul snang yang 'dzin mi nus pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa/de las nus pa cher 'phel nas dmigs don bdag rtog gi mgo brtsam sa te ma rig pa yid shes dang mtshungs ldan de kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa ste/ de gsum tshogs shing 'dus pa las rkyen bzhi ji ltar mched tshul ni/ chos nyid yul gyi 'khrul gzhi/ 'od lnga snod bcud kyi 'khrul gzhi/ rig pa sems kyi 'khrul gzhi/ngo bo'i stong gdangs rang bzhin 'od gdangs gnyis yul rgyu'i rkyen/thugs rjes rig gdangs dpyod byed kyi rnam par shar ba yul can bdag po'i 344

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrkyen/ yul can rig gdangs kyis yul 'od gdangs la dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i rkyen/ rkyen gsum po dus gcig tu mtshungs par ldan pa las 'khrul ba rgyun ma chad par 'byung ba'i rkyen byed pas de ma thag pa'i rkyen te/ rgyu gsum rkyen bzhi'i dbang gis las dge ba'i 'bras bu mtho ris/ mi dge ba'i las kyis ngan song /mi g.yo ba'i las kyis khams gong ma gnyis te 'khor ba la rgyu de gsum las yod par mdo sngags kyi ston pas ma gsungs so/ /༈ gnyis pa 'khrul ba'i snang lugs ni/ de ltar 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas snod kyi 'jig rten/ bcud kyi sems can/ gnas lus longs spyod dang /'khrul ba 'khrul snang dang bcas pa 'di thog ma'i gzhi la ma grub/ mthar thug 'bras bur ma grub/ da lta lam gyi gnas tshul la ma grub/ 'grul gzhi ma rig pa tsam yang ma grub pas nam mkha'i skra shad tsam las ngo bo rdul phran tsam du kyā~X / /ོོ/nga // stong gzugs nyag gcig gi snang ba yin pas phyi rol don du grub ༈ gsum pa snang sems kyi dbye ba bshad pa ni/ 'o na snod bcud yod yod grub grub tu snang ba 'di/ sems yin nam zer na/ sems ma yin te sems kyi 'khrul snang gi bag chags yin pas/ sems dang sems las gzhan du grub pa rdul tsam yang med/ dpe rmi lam gyi snang ba gnyid kyi ngang las ma 'das pa lta bu'o/ /rmi lam gyi skabs su nor bu rnyed nas longs sbyad de sad pa'i tshe thog mar nor bu rnyed ma myong / bar du longs spyod pa'i gzhir ma grub/ tha ma 'gag pa'am stor ba med pa ltar snang shes gnyis ka gzhir ma grub pa'o//345

g.yu khog bla ma chos dpyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༈ rjes nyams len gyi skyong tshul ni/ lam gyi khyad par bshad pa dang / lam dngos bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum gyi khyad par ni/ dang po sems sde bas/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ni gang du'ang ma grub la/ gang gi yang gzhir gyur pa/ 'od gsal ba'i ye shes nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de'i rtsal gdangs ma 'gags pa tshogs drug gi yul la cha mnyam pa bkra lam mer gsal ba/ me long la gzugs brnyan lta bu/ bying rmugs kyi skyo na thams cad dang bral ba de yin/ rol ba yul snang gang yin yang sbru ma'i rnam rol du rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa klong sde bas/ chos can phyi nang gi snang ba ji snyed pa thams cad chos nyid skye ba med pa kun tu bzang mo'i klong las grol sa gzhan med pas gnyen po mtha' las grol ba byatshobral klong gi sde ba'o/ /gsum pa man ngag gi sde ni/ de gnyis rig stong zung 'jug tu rtogs shing / yin lugs gshisathog tu phebs pa/ spang gnyen gnyis kyi mtha' las grol ba zab pa man ngag gi sde ba'o/ /ye shes gtso bor byed pa sems sde/ dbyings gtso bor byed pa klong sde/ zung 'jug gtso bor byed pa man ngag sde ba yin no/ /༈ gnyis pa lam dngos bshad pa la gsum ste/ grol lugs kyi gdangs bshad pa/ shan 'byed kyi 'phyong bshad pa/ bzhag thabs kyi gnad bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lnga las/ dang po ye grol ni/ 'char gzhi rig stong zung 'jug de nyid/ phung lnga dang rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi nyer len dge sdig sogs gang gis ma gos pas/ 'ching grol las 'dasapas/ gzod 'bad de bsgyur nas grol mi dgong pa dang / 'char chos snang shes gnyis ka gzhi'i thog mtha' bar 346

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasum na grub ma myong bas/ yul yul can gnyis ka ye nas grol ba/ yang grol mi dgos pa/ sngar nas grol tshar ba lta bu yin/ dang po skye rgyu'i steng shar gnas grol gsum/ bar du gnas sa gnas pa ngo bosastong / tha ma 'gags pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyi stong pa'o/ /gnyisapa rang grol ni/ gnyen po la ltos pa med pas rkyen gzhan gyis grol ba'ang min/ rang gis rang la grol ba'i bya ba byed pa'ang ma yin te/ rig pa rkyen thub dus rtog pas tshugs mi thub par sbrul mdud bzhin rang yal rjes med du dag pa yin/ gsum pa cer grol ni/ snang shes kyi rtog pa mthong thos chos spyi la bslab/ chos can dum bu la bslab pa/ka ba sogasaḥ tham/sa cad mgo 'bur tsam nas mig gi lta stangs thog bab chen po'i gnad kyis gzir te cer gyis grol ba ni shes pa yul la ma zhen/ snang bas shes pa la ma gos/ snang shes kyi 'brel thag chad/ gnas 'gyu'i b.racilag 'gyel/ snang ba bden med la rig pa rten med du shar/ 'gag me da du shar/zhen med du rol/ rten med du grol nas/ snang shes gnyis po mthong sar yal ba'o/ /bzhi pa mtha' grol ni/ rig pa'i ngo bo skye med kyi cha nas yod mtha' las grol yang / 'gag med kyi cha nasamed mtha' la mi gnas/ rgyun mi chad pas med mtha' las grol yang rtag dngos ma yin pas yod mtha' la mi gnas/rtsal snang sna tshogs su 'char bas gcig pur ma grub pa dang /ngo bo spros pa dang bral bas du mar gdags pa'i mtha' las grol ba'i rang bzhin ni kun tu bzang po ste/ phyi yul la phar mi bsam/ nang sems la tshur mi rtog /bar skye med la rang sar mi 'jog par rig pa rjen la phud nas 'jog pa'o/ /lnga pa 347

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgacig grol ni/ bden gnyis dbyer med rig pa spros bral/ chos sku thig le nyag gcig /ye shes zang thal gcig pa'i ngang ma shor na lus kyi 'gro 'dug/ngag gi smra brngod/ yid kyi bsam rtog thams cad med pa gsal snang tsam las rig pa'i ngo bor ma grub pas/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su rang shar ba'o/ /༈ gnyis pa shan 'byed kyi 'phyong bshad pa la bcu ste/ sems rig don gyi shan 'byed/ gnas pa ngo bo'i/ 'phro ba rtsal gyi/ grol tshul gnad kyi/ kun gzhi chosasku'i/ 'khrul grol skabs kyi/ gzhi 'bras lhun grub kyi/ lam 'bras ka dag gi bar do lha yi/ dbugs 'byin zhing gi shan 'byed bshad pa'o/ /dang po sems rig don gyi shan 'byed ni/ sems gnas pa dang 'phro ba lta bu la dbye ba ma yin te/ da lta'i thad ka'i shes pa gsal rig gi cha gnyis la shan 'byed pa ste/ sems ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig kun rtog brgyad bcu dang bcas pa ni/ 'dus byas skad cig ma// ma rig pa/ skye 'gag can/ rkyen kha la ltos pa/ grol 'khrul can/ dus gsum la ltos pa sogs yin la/ rig pa ni de dag las 'das pa/ 'dus ma byas/ zang thal rjen pa'i ye shes yin te/ nor sa dang 'dzol sa med do/ /de rnams zhag bdun re bsgom pa bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes yin no/ /sems rig gnyis shes pa gnyis phye ba yin/ sems dang ye shes rlung dang sbyar ba yin no/ /༈ gnyis pa gnas pa ngo bo'i shan 'byed ni/ sems rtog med rtse gcig tu gnas pa dang / rig pa rtog med rtse gcig du gnas pa gnyis gnas pa tsam du 'dra yang sems bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams zhen dang mi 'bral/ rig pa 348

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥyul med zang thal du gnas pa yin/ sems ni lteng ka'am rdzing bu lta bur ltem me gnas pa yin/ rig pa ni lhag mthong gsal ba'i ye shes yul la ma shar ba'o/ /'dra gzhi bcu drug las dang po gsum 'dir sbyar ro/ /༈ gsum pa 'phro ba rtsal gyi shan 'byed ni/ rig pa dang ma rig pa gnyis kyi rtsal yul la 'char tshul tsam du 'dra yang / grol tshul mi 'dra ste/ rig pa'i dpe dngul chu sa la lhung ba ltar yul mi 'dzin/ sems kyi dpe bco lnga'i zla 'od sems dang 'dres pa'am/ sa skam dang chu thigs 'phrad pa ltar yul 'dzin pa'o/ /'dra gzhi nas bzhi pa dang bcu gsum bcu bzhi 'dir bya'o/ /༈ bzhi pa grol tshu'/ gnad kyi shan 'byed ni/ de ltar sems dang rig pa gnyis po'i khyad par shes nas 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sems kyi cha rang grol du dag nas/ rig pa'i ngo bo mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/ theg brgyad kyi shar chosanyams su blangs te lam du byed/ rdzogs chen pas 'char gzhi nyams su blangs te lam du byed pa yin/ de yang nyan thos pas spang / byang chub sems dpas sbyang /sngags phyi pas basbrur/ nang pa ma hā dang a nus dang du blangs nas thabs kyis lam du byed/ sems sde bas rtsal dang de las shar ba ngo shes nas grol bar byed/klong sde bas stong chen dbyings kyi rgyan du rtogs nas rang sar bzhag nas grol bar 'dod/ man ngag sde bsarig stong zung 'jug gi ngang du spang gnyen med par grol ba yin/ sems sde bas sems kyis sems mi mthong bas sems kyis sems mi grol/ klong sde ba ltar na/ snang ba'i mdun na mun pa mi gnasapa ltar/ dbyings dang rig pa'i ngo bo la ma rig pa'i sems med pa'i phyir ye shes 349

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥkyis sems mi mthong bas dbyings kyi ngang du grol ba'ang mi 'dod/ man ngag sde bas rig pa'i chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi klong na chos can rang ngo nas stong pa dang / chos nyid gzhan ngos nas stong pa'i grub mtha' dang 'dod zhen thams cad tshugs mi thub par spang gnyen kun rang grol rjes med du zhig pa ni shin tu ngo mtshar bas na lam gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /༈ lnga pa kun gzhi chos sku'i shan 'byed ni/ kun gzhi dang chos sku gnyis ngo bo rtog med tsam du 'dra yang / kun gzhi ni ma rig pa dngos yin/ sems dang sems byung thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi/ khams gsum gyi bag chags thams cad thog mar 'jog pa'i rten/ bar du 'dzin pa'i lam/ tha ma smin pa'i snod du gyur ba kun gzhi rtog med/ngo bo lung ma bstan/ rnam pa shes pa rmun po/ bde gsal mi rtogs pa'i nyams gang rung las ma 'das pa'o/ /dpe ma rig pa gru lta bu/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad mi lta bu/ gnas don lus gsum yo byad lta bu/ngo bo'i dbyings la meongs pa'i ma rig pa ye don gyi kun gzhi/ rang ngo rig na grol bar sbyor zhing / ma rig na 'khor bar sbyor bas sbyor ba don gyi kun gzhi/gdos bcas sha khrag gi lus 'dod khams/ gzugs khams 'od kyi lus/gzugs med yid rig gi lus gsum gyi bag chags yod pa'i cha nas bag chags lus kyi kun gzhi/ las dge sdig dang mi g.yo ba'i las te khamasagasum gyi bag chags dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i bag chags 5 tshogs pa'i kun gzhi'o/ /chos sku ni ma rig pa'i gzhan dbang du ma gyur pa' ye shes kyi rten chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo gzung 'dzin dang lhan cig mi gnas pa/ las dang bag 350

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥṭwāṃkyāos/ /kyis ma sbags pa'i cha ni chos sku yin te/ de rgya mtsho gting gsal lta ༈ drug pa 'khrul grol skabs kyi shan 'byed ni/ da lta'i rig pa rjen pa la 'khrul grol gnyis ka mi srid kyang / gzhi snang shar ba'i skabs su ngo shes na grol ba/ ma shes na 'khrul bar 'gyur bas/ 'khrul grol gyi shan dbye ba'o/ /da lta'i rig pa rjen pa la mnyam par bzhag pa des/ mnyam bzhag la brtan pa thob cing / gnyid 'thug gi bag chagasasbyangasanas 'thug po'i 'od gsal zin/'chi srid chos sku'i 'od gsal sbyang zhing chos skur grol bar byed/ rjes thob rtog pa rtsal sbyang gis mnyam bzhag gi bsgom pa rjes thob dang bsre/ rmi lam gyi bag chags spyang zhing / chos nyid bar dor gzhi snang gi snang ba rang snang du rtogs shing longs skur grol ba dang / srid pa bar dor rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du ṭā /ga zlo' hādri zlo paswāo/sa da lho~Xs so le/na/ thams cad la mda' sngon du 'ben bzhag ༈ bdun pa gzhi 'bras lhun grub kyi shan 'byed ni/ 'khor 'das ma byung ba'i thog ma'i spyi gzhi dang / mthar thug grol sa'i thog ma'i gzhi gnyis gzhi yin pa tsam du 'dra yang / 'byul gzhi byed mi byed kyi khyad par yod pa'o/ /༈ brgyad pa lam 'bras ka dag gi shan 'byed ni/ rig pa gnas tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs kyang / gang zag gis mthong ba'i dbang du byas na da lta rig pa skad cig tsam las mi mthong ba'i 351

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥd lta'i lam gyi rig pa dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i rig pa gnyis dbyings ༵/ sa/ yojerdoo/ tsa/ma du 'dra yang las rlung gis shan zhugs ma zhugs kyi ༈ dgu pa bar do lha yi shan 'byed ni/ chos nyid bar dor rig gdangs lhun gyis grub pa'i lha sku dang / srid pa bar dor rlung sems tsam gyi sgyu lus kyi lha sku ༵sdo sbya/'olha/ /sku snang ba tsam du mtshungs kyang / rgya che chung dang / grol mi grol gyi ༈ bcu pa dbugs 'byin zhing gi shan 'byed ni/ theg pa 'og mas grangs med gcig la sogs pa'i yun ring pos mthar sa dang po thob nas sa bcu pa'i bar sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mthong ba dang / rdzogs chen gyi lam la zhugs pa'i gang zag skal ba dang ldan pas tshe 'di brjes ma thag rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du rmi lam sad pa'i tshul du dbugs dbyung ba gnyis zhing snang tsam du 'dra yang / lam snang gi rtsal rdzogs nus mi nus shes nyams kyi khyad par yod do/ /gsum pa bzhag thabs kyi gnad bshad pa ni/ la bzla gsum/bzhag thabs bzhi/ gzer bu bdun gyi 'das rjes dang sbyar nas gsungs pa ni/ngo rang thog tu sprad pa lta ba/ thag gcig thag tu bcad pa sgom pa/ gdengs grol thog tu bca' ba spyod pa dang gsum du gsungs/ 'og ma'i lta ba thams cad las grol bar 'dod na lta ba ri bo cog bzhag bsgom pa'i nus pa stobs dang ldan pa'am 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du 'gyur bar 'dod na sgom pa rgya mtsho cog bzhag /spyod pa'i rtsal sbyang bar 'dod na spyod pa snang ba cog bzhag /352

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āX 'bras bu sku gsum mngon tu gyur bar 'dod na 'bras bu rig pa cog bzhag bya'o/ /lta ba ri bo cog bzhag ni/ 'char gzhi'i rig pa zang thal rjen pa nyid phung po lnga dang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rtog pa sogs kyis g.yo mi nus par/ri rgyal ltar sdod tshugs pa dang /ngo sprod kyi man ngag kyang / tshig la lhag chad dang / don la nor 'brul gyi g.yo ba med pa/ brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes dang ldan pa/slob mas kyang yin min gyi the tshom gzhan gyi gol ba dang / zhakhrul rtog nyams zhen gyi g.yo ba med par da lta'i rig pa thad kar ngo 'phrod na rab/ min kyang rjes dpag gi nges shes khyad par can gyis drangs pa zhig dgos nges/ sgom pa rgya mtsho cog bzhag ni/ rig stong zung 'jug gi lta ba rang gsal sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ sgo lnga har sang rgya yan la/tshogs drug gi snang ba ma 'gags pa lhug par cha mnyam par gnas pa ni/ dpe rgya mtsho la rkyen sogs kyis ma dkrugs par gza' skar sogs snang yul bkra lam mer gsal ba bzhin 'jog pa yin/ spyod pa snang ba cog bzhag ni/ blo gzu bor gnas pa'i gang zag gis lha khang mjal ba ltar snang shes thams cad mnyam par rang grol du song ba ste grol tshul lnga dang 'dra'o/ /'bras bu rig pa cog bzhag ni/ mthar thug sgrib gnyis yongs su dag nas 'bras bu sku gsum mngon tu gyur pa dang / gnas skabs rig pa'i rang tshugs zin na slar shar grol du song ba 'brum nad byang ba'i skyes bu'am/ bse shing gi 'bras bu slar rgyur mi ldog pa lta bu'o// ༈ ye shes zang thal gyi gzer dang / lta ba grol yan gyi gzer gnyis lta ba/ sgron ma rang dag gi gzer dang / sgo lnga rang yan gyi 353

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgazer gnyis sgom pa/ ngo bo rang dag gi gzer dang / rig pa chos min gyi gzer gnyis spyod pa/ chos sku rang rdzogs kyi gzer 'bras bu ste cog bzhag bzhi la sbyar ro/ /lko gnyis pa thod rgal la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi ru shan sngon 'gro sogasagazhan las shes/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du ngo sprad nga/ ni/ lus gnad bzhugs stangs gsum dang / ngag gnad bslab gnas la bzla brtan pa bzhi/ sems gnad rlung sems kyi shan ma zhugs pa nam mkhar gtad pa ste/ sgo gsum gyi gnad la gzir nas/ sgo gnad rgyang zhags mi 'gul ba dang / yul gnad smin mtshams dang nam mkha' la gtad pa/ rlung rig gi gnad shin tu dal ba/ dbye na/ 'gro 'ong las kyi rlung /rtog tshogasanyon mongs pa'i rlung / rig pa ye shes kyi rlung ste/ rlung phar glo bar dengs/ rig pa tshur snying khar thim pas/ sems dang ye shes rgyab gyes/ phyi dbyings kyi ra bar thig le dang rig gdangs 'gul 'phrig med par sdod pa'i skabs/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong ba ni/ lnga tshan la sogs pa'i sgo nas ngo sprad pa yin no/ /gsum pa la/ sgron ma bzhi/ snang ba bzhi/ mtha' rten gyi man ngag bar rda'i gdams pa dang bzhi las/ dang po la bzhi las/ rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma ni/ snying nas mig tu 'brel ba'i rtsa ba men gyi rwa 'dra ba sko rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma ste/ rten ma dag pa'i rgyang zhag gi zhabrul snang dang brten pa ye shes kyi rgyangs zhag sam dag pa'i rgyang zhags gi 'od gsal gyi snang ba 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa thig le stong pa'i sgron ma ni/ 'od lnga'i zlum bskor dbus 354

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdamar ser gyi rang bzhin can dang thig phran yung 'bru tsam pa sogs yin no/ /gsum pa/ dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma ni/ sgron ma'i yul nam mkha' dang /smin mtshams su rig pa gtad pas/ phyi dbyings sngo ri ba thog mar shar nas/de lasamached pa'i nang dbyings za 'og gi ber khyim lta bu/ rig gdangs kyi ra bar byung ba'o/ /bzhi pa shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma ni/ nang gi rig pa shin tu dwangs la/ yul med pa zhig nyams su myong ba ngo bo dang / chos kyi tshig don klong rdol ba rtsal dang / gser gyi skud pa dang / me tog gi drwa ba/ rta rnga la mdud pa bor ba/ mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu rnams ni rig gdangs lu gu rgyud do/ /gzhan yang tsitta sha yi sgron ma rig pa bzhugs pa'i gnas dang / gnas lugs gzhi'i sgron ma rig pa rang gi ngo bo/ dkar 'jam rtsa yi sgron ma lam/'od gsal ye shes kyi sgron ma dbyings rig 'dres pa'i dus/ bar do dus kyi sgron ma rang snang chos nyid bar do shar ba'i dus su brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po chos nyid mngon sum ni/ yid dpyod kyi tshig las 'dasapas rjes dpag dang don spyi ma yin pas phyi yi 'od gsal la bltas pas nang rnam rtog bral te/ ris med mnyam par grol ba'i ka dag gi gdangs dang / lhun grub kyi 'od gdangs gnyis phyi nang zung du 'brel bas dbyings 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyams gong 'phel ni/ zhakhrul ba'i snang ba nub nas/ nyams sna tshogs skye bar byed pa ste/ shes nyams dang / snang nyams/shes nyams la dga' bde'i nyams dang shes pa mthar 'gyur gyi nyams gnyis yod kyang / 'dir snang nyams 'od gsal gyi rang gdangs gong nas gong du 355

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'aphel bar byed pa'o/ /gsum pa rig pa tshad phebs ni/ snang ba sku gsum du rtogs pa'i dus yin te/ phyi'i snang ba 'od du grol/ nang phung po gdos bcas las grol/ gsang ba sems kyi 'khrul rtog gzung 'dzin las grol bas gzhir gnas rig pa'i yon tan thams cad mngon tu gyur nas zla ba nya gang ba dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa chos nyid zad pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i skye rgyun chad pa ste/ gong gi tshad phebs kyi skabs kyi rang gdangs lhun grub 'char sgo thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i 'jug pa la dbang thob pa dang / rang gi lag sor la rig pa gtad pas skye ba la dbang thob pas bskal par sems can gyi don du bzhugs pa yin no/ /gsum pa la bzhi las/ dang po mi 'gul ba gsum ni/lus mi 'gul ba bzhugs stangs gsum dang gzigs stangs gsum/ ngag mi 'gul ba ni/ ngag ni bslab dang gnas pa dang / /la bzla brtan par bya ba'o/ /zhes dang / sems mi 'gul ba ni/ sems bzo med las mi 'gul bas dbyings rig zung du chud nga 'i gnad do/ /de yang mi 'gul bas 'gyu la 'gyu bas rtog pa 'char bas/rtog pas 'khor ba'i las bsogs pas 'gyu ba'i rten rtsa rlung gnad du gcun pas/rtog pa rgyun 'chad pa'i rang gnad gal po che'o/ /gnyis pa sdod pa gsum ni/ lus sdod pa lus kyi bya ba la mi gnas pa/ ngag sdod pa rlung gi 'gro 'ong sdod pa/ snang ba'i sdod pa dbyings rig 'gul 'phrig med pa'o/ /'di'i dus su rtags lus ngag la 'char ba/ tshad rmi lam gyis bzung ba gnyis byung ngo/ /gsum pa ni skye ba la dbang thob pas gzhan don dngos su byed/ 'jug pa la dbang thob pas zag bcas mi snang bar 'tshang rgya/356
