g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrlung sems la dbang thob pas khams gsum du ldog mi srid pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/yar 'bras bu skyabs gsum rang snang du byon pa mthong bas sangs rgyas pa la re ba dang / mi rgyas pa la dogs pa med/ mar las nyon ye shes su dag pas/'khor ba myang 'das su rtogs pas 'khor ba las thar gyi re ba dang / lhung gi dogs pa med pa'o/ /bzhi pa la bzhi las/ dang po rang bzhin bar do la shes bya'i gros thag bcad pa thi bya tshang la 'jug pa lta bu'i man ngag ni the tshom can gyi gang zag gis dang po thos pas blo sbyong / bar du bsam pas thag bcad/tha mar bsgom pas la bzla ba gsum gyi sno nas rdzogs chen la 'jug /gang zag the tshom med pa'i brtson 'grus dang shes rab ldan pas/ bla ma'i man ngag la yid ches nas nges shes khyad par can gyi rdzogs chen la 'jug pa gnyis yod/gang ltar yang gzhi khregs chod kyi lta ba ngo 'phrod nas/ lta ba la mnyam par bzhag pa thog mar 'dir snang gi snang b.ribakag nas/ rmi lam kṣe/ma chos nyid bar do dngos yin snyam pa 'dun pas yang yang sbyangs pas/ 'thug po'i 'od gsal lam 'chi srid chos sku'i 'od gsal dngos shar nas yong snyam pa'i skyabs sems bsngo ba dang bcas yang yang sbyang / thod rgal gyi dbyings rig shar ba'i skabs su rmi lam gyi grong khyer ram/ chos nyid bar do dngos shar ba'i 'dun pa'i ngang sbyang ba dang / de bzhin du rang bzhin sprul sku'i lam khyer nyin dus rang snang mngon sum la goms pa dang / mtshan mo 'od lnga snying nang du goms pas sprul sku'i zhing du blta ba/ thun bar 'pho lugs gnyis kyi rtsal sbyang yang yang byed cing snang ba dpal ri'i pho brang na bla ma pad 'byung dbyer med kyi 357

—— g.yukhogablam chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'burma / āḥsnang ba dang mi 'bral bar byas nas bar do nyams 'og tu tshud pa zhig ci nas kyang bya dgos so/ /༈ gnyis pa 'chi kha bar do la mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa sgeg mo la me long bstan pa lta bu'i man ngag ni/ rab dbyings rig sor bzhag 'od gsal sbubs 'jug gi gdams pa dbyings rig la gtad pas 'chi ba dang / 'bring 'pho ba'i gnad rnam shes rlung zhon gyi gdams pas chos kyi dbyings su 'pho ba dang / tha mas gzhan rkyen la ltos pas grogs sam bla mas bar de'i 'char tshul rnams ngo sprad pa dang / tha mal ba 'chi khar yi ge āḥyi sbyor bas gnas gong nas gong du spar ba dang / ro la sbyang ba dang / rjes la sbyang ba sogs bya'o/ /༈ gsum pa chos nyid bar do ru rang snang la yid ches pa sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bu'am/ ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la/ rnam shes nam mkhar thim pa'i tshe/ brgyal ba dang / 'chi srid chos sku'i 'od gsal gnyis yod/ nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim pa'i tshe/rdo rje sems dpa'i sna thag dang / 'od lnga'i sna nga ba shar ba gnyis dang / 'od gsal zung 'jug la thim pa'i tshe/ zung 'jug chung ngu sgra 'od zer gsum khro bo'i dkyil 'khor dang /zung 'jug chen po rigs lnga'i tshom bu rim gyis shar ba/ 'jug pa shes pa'i gnad/ grol ba lus kyi gnad/ mthar phyin ngo shes pa'i gnad/ zung 'jug ye shes la thim tshe ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi snang ba 'od snam bu brkyang ba lta bu/ dkar ser dmar mthing bzhi'i steng du rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig le che ba gcig la thig phran bzhi bzhis brgyan sdu ḍing / de dus lus gdos bcas las

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgrol/ rig pa nyon mongs pa lasagrol/ 'od gsal gzung 'dzin las grol ba ngo shes par bya'o/ /ye shes lhun grub la thim pa'i skabs/ steng du ka dag gi snang ba/ bar du longs sku'i zhid khams/ phyogs mtshams su sprul sku/ 'og tu rigs drug /de 'dul byed thub pa drug dang bcas pa 'char ba ngo shes na/'char lugs brgyad dang / mngon shesadrug dang / rjes dran drug dang / shesarab dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / thim lugs brgyad kyi snang ba sogs 'char ro//2 lhun grub sgo brgyad lam snang dang spyar na/ ma dag lubor ba'i sgo ltar shar ba chos nyid mngon sum/ 'od ltar shar ba nyams gong 'phel/ sku ltar shar ba rig pa tshad phebs/ gnyis med dang mtha' grol chos nyid zad pa/ ye shes ltar shar ba nyams len gyi dus shes nyams dang snang nyams/ thugs rje ltar shar ba de dag gi dusan shes rab dang snying rje shar ba rnams so/ /3 bar do dang sbyar na/ sku ltar shar ba tshom bu/ ye shes dang 'od ltar shar ba bzhi sbyor dag pa ye shes dang ma dag pa 'khor ba'i sgo gnyis lhun grub rang ngo shes na /kā trī ṭwāṃ hāo~X /ga/nyis med dang mtha' grol ltar shar nas/ rtsal gzhi la thim ༈ bzhi pa srid pa bar do la/ las kyi 'phro mthud pa yur ba rkang chad la wa 'dzugs pa lta bu'i gdams ngag ni/ chos 'di'i sgo mthong ba rnams kyi bar de'i rang snang ngos zin nas phyogs bcur sprul ba'i zhing yid la byas pa tsam gyis chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs dang sngar byang chub sems dpa'i 'pho lugs 369

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥganyis la sbyangs stobs kyis rang snang sprul pa'i zhing dang dpal ri sogs su snye ba yin/ chos 'di'i sgo ma mthong ba rnams kyis zhing dag par smon lam 'debs pa/ skyabs 'gro byed pas mngal sgo ngan pa dgag bzang po 'dems pa sogs bya ba yin no// ༈ lus kyi gnad gzer ni rig pa'i yul btsal ba/ 'gro 'ong gi lam bcad pa/ gtad sa'i 'phen la gzud pa/ mi 'gul ba la gzhi bca' ba/ rgya che ba nam mkha' spar gyis bzung ba drug go/ /de yan gcig gi tshig zin ma rnyed/ maṅga lam/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ bkra shis par gyur cig/༄༅/ /'khyil ba bshig sogs zin bris 'ga'/ 'khyil ba bshig dgos/'byams pa gcod dgos gsungs/ ༈ bsgom ma myong dang zhes pa ni gang shar tshad sgom du shar nas sgom mkhan gyi blo yang shar grol du song bas na'o/ /'bral ma myong zhes pa ni don med du phyal ba stong nyid gshis shor dang rgyas 'debs ma yin par shes rig rang tshugs ma shor ba la go dgos/ de lta bu'i mi bsgom don dang mi 'bral ba gnyis kyis bde sdug gi snang ba dang sems sems byung gi rtogs pa thams cad sgom du shar nas grol ba'o/ /de yang gol sa gsum po 'di zhi gnas kyi steng nas bzhag ni red/ shor ba bzhi po 'di lhag mthong gi steng nas 'jog pa yin gsungs/ shes bya'i gshis la shor ba snyong nyid gshis su shor ba stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba tshogs drug lam 'khyer dug lnga lam 'khyer sgo lnga lam 'khyer sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshig pas gtan la phab bya shes rab lhag mthong / rang sa'i rnam rtog zhi ba zhi gnas/gnas cha dwangs ma zhi gnas/ 'phro cha bar ma'irtog pa shar grol du 'gro ba lhag 360

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmathong / shar grol zhesapa gzung rtog de nyid 'dzin rtog la ma 'phos par yal ba la go gsungs/ snang ba yul gyi blo can ni mnyam bzhag nas 'khrul 'gro tshe 'khrul ba de shes nas 'char gzhi ngos bzung nas 'gyu ba gnas dag gi dgongs pa bskyang ba la zer/ rig pa rang snang gi blo can 'khrul tshe sngon la 'brul ba mi dran rig pa de dran pa tsam gyis grol ba la zer/ dper na khyi dang seng ge lta bu'o// ༈ rkyen ni phyi slong lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul/ nang slong lus kyi na tsha/gsang slong chags sdang rmongs gsum sogs rkyen chen po grol thub dka' gsungs/ dper na sgom rkub g.yeng bas phud/ lta rkub spyod pas phud gsungs so// ༈ rang lta mchog 'dzin bdud kyis bslus pa yin/ /zhi gnas had ser lo brgyar bsgom pa las/ /zhi lhag zung 'jug skad cig bsnom pa mchog /sems gnalotsam ni bsam gtan lha dang 'dra/ /zhes so// ༈ dang po kun gzhi las kun gzhi'i rnam shes de las sgo lnga'i shes pa/ de las nyon yid snga ma snga ma 'gags nas phyi ma phyi ma shar ba'o// ༈ 'dod chags zhesapa bud med kho nas mi tshad de/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la chags pa/ nang bcud kyi sems can la chags pa/ bar 'dod yon lnga la chags pa/ zhe sdang skye yul yang dgra gcig pus mi tshad de/ yid du mi 'ong ba'i cha thams cad do/ /rtsal lhong ba zhes pa shar ba'am 'char ba la'o// ༈ sgro skur zhes pa ni/ bdag nyid kyis gnas lugs ji lta bar ma rtogs bzhin tu nga rang rtogs so zhes sgro 'dogs pa'o/ /sems can khyi lta bu'i tha chad pa de'i rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mi bzhugs zhes pa ni skur ba 'debs pa yin gsungs so// ༈ dang po sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad 361

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpa lta bu'i grol tshul 'dis rjes thob 'khrul ba'i rjes su yengs song ba go dgos/de tshe skad cig dang po 'khrul ba ngos zin gnyis pa 'char ba ngos zin gsum pa'i tshe zhagrul ba dengs nas bskyang pa de la/ las dang po'i snyong tshul tsam nyan gi gsungs/ gnyis pa sprul mdud lta bu'i grol tshul ni mnyam bzhag skabs rnam rtog shar yang mgo 'bur tsam gyi rang tshugs mi thub par grol ba/ sbrul gyi khug 'go lta bu'i rnam rtog shar/ yang mi rtsal chen zhig 'gyel tshad zhig byas kyang 'gyel mi thub pa lta bu yin gsungs/ gsum pa khang stong rkun ma'i dpe ni mnyam bzhag rang sa zin tshe rig pa rjen la bud nas gang shar tshad rig pa'i rnam ldan du shar nas rig pa shor rgyu dang rnam rtog thob rgyu med rin po che'i gser gling du phyin pa lta bu'i zhabrul pa rang mtshan pa med gang shar dag pa rab 'byams yin gsungs/ grol tshul gsum po de gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum/ gi steng nas bzhag lugs yod/ yang na gang zag gcig gi steng nas bzhag na chog gsungs/ ༈ chos skur ltong rnam rtog gnas gyur nas zhakhrul rtog ye shes su shar/ ༈ gzhi ka dag khregs chod kyi rig pa rang byung gi sgron ma gzhi la bzhugs pa dang / lam nyams su myong ba'i cha nas shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma'i rang zhal/ ༈ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi larma gnad mngon tu gyur pa nyi ma'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / lam phar phyin drug gi bsdus pa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu 'od zer gyi gzugs su bkod pa yin no// ༈ bsdus don ni/ rang ngo 'phrod pa lta ba rig pa rjen la phud pa/ snom pas nyams su len tshe nyams zhen gyi shun pa dang bral rjen la phud pa'o/ /gang shar rang grol spyod pa ni thams cad 362

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingarsārang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥchos skur grol ba'o/ /rig stong zang thal rjen pa de nyid bla ma dang dbyer med pa skyabs 'gro dgu'i bdag nyid du shes na gegs dang gol sa med cing / lta ba'i bogs thon pa bla ma'i man ngag zhal shes yin no/ /grol sa dbyings dang grol gzhi lhun grub/ ༈ gzung 'dzin byung na phaṭa kyis gtor/ /thug 'phrad shes pa de ru 'char/ /zhes so/ /skad cig dang por snang grags rtog gsum tha mal ma dag pa rang mtshan pa shar/ skad cig gnyis par tha mal ma dag pa'i snang gragasartog gsum dag nas dag pa bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su shar/ skad cig gsum par dag pa bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su yal nas rig stong zung 'jug gi bla ma'i rang zhal la blta'o/ /don du mtshon byed dpe'i bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su shar ba de'i stobs kyis/mtshon bya don gyi bla ma rig stong zung 'jug sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i bdag nyid 'di yin pa la nges shesarnyed dgos/ lta ba yan thub pa ni/ rig stong chos sku thig le nyag gcig de nyid rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral bar bzhugs pa de'i klong du phyi'i yul nang gi rnam rtog bzang ngan ci shar yang mi gnod par lta ba tshur mngon 'ong / bsgom pa yeng thub pa ni gang shar gang snang thams cad rig pa'i klong de las shar/ de la gnas/ mthar de la thim pa'o/ /sbyod pa'i rkyen thub pa ni yul rkyen gyis rig pa'i mal sa mi 'phrog par rkyen gang gi tshe na rig pa dran tsam gyis grol ba'o// ༈ shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma la dbye na gzhi gnas rang byung gi shes rab ni ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi bdag nyid yin/ snang ba cer 'dzin gyi shes rab ni/ thod rgal yin te/363

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnang gdangs phyir shar ba rig gdangs rdo rje lu gu rgyud la sogs pa rnams nang gi rig stong zung 'jug gi yul yul can gnyis su med pas 'od snang mngon du snang ba yin/ drag pa 'gags med kyi shes rab ni/ gang snang gang shar gyi chos thams cad rig pa rjen par shar ba'i tshe rig stong zung 'jug gi klong du grol ba'am/ snod bcud du grub pa'i snang ba thams cad rig pa nyag gcig gi klong du sdud pa'i cha la zer/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab ni/ chos dang chos nyid rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid 'byed par byed pa/ rjes thob skabs su yang gnas don lus gsum gyi snang ba 'di thams cad bden med du shes par byed pa'o/ /'jug byed rnam gsum gyi shes rab ni/ rang bzhin bar dor skyes nas 'chi nad kyis ma thebs bar gyi thos pas gtan la dbab/ bsam pas nges par byed/ sgom pas ro myong bar byed pa 'di ka'o/ khes rab snga ma bzhi rig cha dang phyi ma sems kyi cha'o// ༈ spyir thod rgal nyams su len pa'i skabs su dbyings thig sogs rang snang yin par shes pas gzhan du 'dzin pa ldog /rang bzhin med par shes pas dngos po'i blo ldog /rang bzhin med snyam pa yang 'od gsal gyi klong du grol song ba ni khyad chos drug gi gnad bsdus pa'o// ༈ 'od gsal sbubs 'jug skabs gzhi snang gi snang cha 'di rnams zhing khams dang gzhal yas khang ston pa rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan gyi rnam par bzhengs pa yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang bcas phyi nang gi dbyings rig bsres te ka dag gi ngang la spro bsdu med par btsan sa 'dzin pa yin/ ༈ grong 'pho grong 'jug ni grong 'di nas 'pho ste chos sku'i grong du 'jug pa la zer/ de yang 364

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbadag ni nges par 'chi ba yin snyam ste chags zhen skye ba'i dngos po rnams yar mchod mar sbyin thub na rab yin kyang yid kyis bla ma dkon mchog la 'bul te chags zhen bcad/ de nas spyi bor dpa' bo stobs ldan gyi rnam par bla ma bzhugs yod par mos la rang gi snying dbus su rig pa a dkar po'am bla ma'i sku tshon gang ba zhig tu dmigs la skar mda' bzhin du song ste bla ma'i thugs kar bstims te thugs yid dbyer med du bsre ba gnad yin/ de gnyis gnad che bas da lta nas rtsal 'byongs ba shin tu gal che/ nub mo nyal khar gnyid ran dus snying dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan gyi skur bzhengs te ston 'khor gzhal yas khang zhing gsum gyi bkod pa dang bcas gsal te rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du 'gro ba'i dmigs 'dun drag po bya ste sbyangs dgos/ dus nam yang nyin re la thugs yid bsre ba brgya re tsam sems bskyed sogs bsngo smon bcas bya dgos gsungs / snga dre'i dus o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / phyi dro rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs dgos gsungs// zlozhin nyin re bzhin phyi'i ṭwāṃ shan dang rigs drug bsregs lha~Xkā ghri rnyi byi zlog / sha/na/ tu gal che bas chag — nyan gsungs// dge'o/ /bkra 365

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄༅/ /dbang don sogs kyi zhal rgyun/lar dbang zhes pa ni sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa la dbang thob dgos kyang / ye thog ma med pa nas ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i dus gsum yid kyi 'brul ba'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa yin te/ sngar dbang ma thob pa de shan 'byed kyis shan phye/ la bzlas/ la bzla bsarig pa ngo sprad nas/dper na rgyal bu rgyal sa la bkod pa lta bu sngar ma dbang ba de da dbang bar byas pa yin gsungs/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa la dbang dang mi dbang med kyang thugs rje'i rig rtsal gyi cha las 'khrul ba'i gzhan dbang du bskyod pa yin no/ /dper na chu rlabs kyis shing bsnod pa lta bu yin gsungs/gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa gnyis yod de/ ji ltar smin zhe na/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe lusalha ru smin/ ngag sngags su smin/ sems dran rtog ye shes su smin pa yin/ snod zhing dang gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin/ bcud lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du shes pa yin gsungs/ dkyil 'khor zhes gtso dang 'khor du 'jug bo// /dbang don sogs dbang don gyi ye shes rang byung gdod ma'i ye gzhi sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rig pa ngo 'phrod/ rang lus gdan tshang gi dkyil 'khor du ngo 'phrod/ snod bcud 'di zhing dang gzhal yas khang sku dang ye shes sam lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du ngo 'phrod pa'i tshe dbang thob pa yin 366

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasungs/ de tshe chos nyid la chos nyid rol/ ye shes la ye shes rol ba yin no/ /dbang po sgo lnga'i yul du gzuspru/sa sgra sogs 'gag med du shar/ snang ba zhen med du rol thub nas rten med du grol 'gro gsungs/ de ltar dbang po sgo lnga'i yul du gyur pa gzugs sgra sogs ngo shes rtsal rdzogs brtan pa thob pa gsum gyis dang po rang snang du ngo shes dgos/ngo shes dus gzhan du 'dzin pa'i yul yul can dag pa yin/ gnyis pa'i dus rang snang rang bzhin med par shes nasathag chod pa yin/ bden grub tu 'dzin pa'i cha rang bzhin med par dag pa'o/ /gsum pa'i dus med pa'o snyam du 'dzin mkhan gyi rtog pa dang / yul med pa rlung sems dang bcas pa'i rtsal rig stong chos nyid kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i tshe de la brtan pa thob dgosapa yin gsungs/ dang po ngo shes/bar du nges shes brtan/ tha ma nges shes dag dgos pa yin pas nges pa rnyed kyang ngesashes sgrog gis bcings zer ba yin pas dag dgos gsungs/ rlung sems kyi rgyu ba cha dang bcas pa gdod ma'i gshis thog tu dwangs pa'i tshe rig stong zung 'jug gi lta ba de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i mnyam bzhag gi lta ba yin gsungs/ dbang srog dam drig gis 'dzin zer ba'ang lta ba'i ngang de las mi g.yeng ba dam tshig gi srog yin/ de las 'da' dus srog chad lta bu dam tshig 'gal nyams 'das ral du song ba yin/ de min pa'i dam tshig gzhan du bsrung 'dod pa gnad ma go ba yin/ lta ba'i gdeng sgom pa'i ngang ma shor ba'i dran shes bzhin bag yod dgos gsungs/ mkha' 'gro sdom pa'i rgyud las/ mi shes pa dang bag med dang / /nyon mongs mang dang ma gus pa/ /brjed ngas dran 367

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpa mi gsal drug /'di drug dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu/ /zhes gsungs/ rjes thob du dbang bzhi gang rung gi bum dbang lta bus rjes thob snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid du lta ba dang / gsang shwer gnyis lta bus rjes thob tshor ba bde sdug bar ma gsum po bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du lta ba dang / 'dod yon lnga 'gag med du snang / zhen med du rol nas rten med du grol dgos pa yin/ mi dmigs bsgom pa sogs yin/ tshig dbang gis rjes thob kyi lam khyer sgo yul rlung rig gi gnad la brten nas thod rga' bsgom pa dang / rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor zhing dang gzhal yas khang sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin du lta ba yin gsungs/ de dag la'ang dam tshig lnga lngar dbye na nyi shu tham pa yod/ ༈ gsang ba sems nyid rang byung gi dkyil 'khor ni rig stong 'dus ma byas pa'i ye shes 'di yin/ ༈ rig stong zung 'jug gi cha gtso bo'i tshul dang thugs rje'i rig rtsal las shar ba'i rtog tshogs 'khor gyi tshul du yod pa yin/ ye shes kyi rang mdangs ma 'gags pa gtso bo dang / de las shar ba'i 'od lnga dbyings dang thig le ni zhabor gyi tshul du gnas pa yin gsungs/༈ sngon snang ba dang mun pa'i cha 'di yang med pa yin gyi/ mi rnams kyi khams rags pa'i zas zos tshe dub nas gti mug gi dbang du song tshe rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin pas phyi rtags la mun pa 'thibs/ de ngo shes na chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang mdangs yin/ 'dod chags kyi cha nas rten cing 'brel 'byung du khams dmar raktas bskyed pa'i phyi rtags la nyi ma shar ba dang / zhe sdang dang khams dkar pos bskyed pa'i rtags la zla ba shar ba yin gsungs/ ༈ sems 368

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgang yin brjod du med pa'i rig pa stong pa'i ye shes de byin ye shes dbab pa yin gsungs/ ༈ ru shan zhes/ ru ni gnyis la 'jug /'khor 'das shan phye ba yin/ ma dag rgyud lnga'i sa bon rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes kyi mes bsreg nas lus dang snod sprul skur dag /ngag hūṃ sbyang dang 'phro 'du rnam pa bzhi la brten nas gsung longs spyod rdzogs skur thob/ yid grol ba bzhi'i rang bzhin du rtogs nas thugs chos sku thob pa yin gsungs/ lam dus su 'khrul ba bshig zin kyang stong pa cang med ma yin par 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char dgos/gang ltar yin na/ khregs chod kyis snod bcud 'di dag rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du gzigs/ thod rgal bas snod bcud 'di sku dang zhing khams ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gzigs pa yin gsungs/ ༈ rtsad bcad pa/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams mkhan lus ngag yid gsum la rag las kyang de gsum gtso gang che/ sangs rgyas mkhan/ 'khor bar 'khyams(mkhan/ bde sdugadro grang / brgyag ltog na tsha/ skye 'chi sogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin par thag chod pa rkun po ngos zin pa lta bu dgag bya'i snang tshul nges pa yin gsungs/ ༈ mtshang btsal ba ni dbyibs dang / kha dog yod med/ snang stong /rtag chad/ gcig tha dad gang yang ma yin par thag chod nas lus snang stong me long gi gzugs brnyan dang chu zla lta bu/ ngag grags stong brag cha lta bu/ yid dran stong nam mkha'i bya rjes dang chu yi ri mo lta bu yin par shes nas kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad stong nyid du shes/ stong pa nyid phyang chad du ma song bar rgyu 'bras su shar ba'o// ༈ byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa/ sogasaḥ bla rnam 369

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbasgom/ sogs5ngo sprod dang / ༈ 'khor lo bar ba'i bstan don dbyings spros pa dang bral ba de yin/ zhabor lo tha ma'i bstan don ni sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin dbyings rig zung 'jug yin gsungs/ ༈ lam lnga dang 'brel na/nyams len byed pa'i tshe/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi tshogs pa tshang dgos pas tshogs lam/ ma rig pa'i dbang du song tshe dran pa de yis rig stong zung 'jug gi lta ba de nyid la sbyor bas na sbyor lam/ rig stong ye shes de nyid mngon sum mthong bas mthong lam yin no/ /de nyid yang yang goms par byed pas sgom lam/ mi slob pa sangs rgyas yin gsungs/ sngon khro skyabs rgyal po'i gdan sa ru rdzogs chen dge mang dang / mdo mkhyen brtse gnyis zhal 'phrad pa'i tshe rdzogs chen dge mang gis mdo mkhyen brtse la khyed kyi rten ci yin gsung tshe/khong gi rten rab byung yin gsungs/ khyed lta bu gang zag bzhi po'i mdun nas brjod pa gsum gyis mthar rab tu byung ba min gsungs pa/ khong rang byung gi ye shes rtogs nas rab tu byung ba yin gsungs tshe/ de ma thag rdzogs chen dge mang gis phyag 'tshal ba yin/ de chos nyid rgyu mtshan du byas nas gang zag gi rjes su zhugs pa yin/ mdo mkhyen brtse de spyod pa khyim pa chags can lta bu'o/ /༈ dad pa yang gzhi lta ba la tshang / sems rtog phra rags dang nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa'i cha thams cad gzhi thog tu dwangs pa dang ba'i dad pa/ de la spro bzhin tu 'jug par mos pa mos pa'i dad pa/ de nyid yin min gyi the tshom dang bral nas yid ches pa yid ches pa'i dad pa/ de dga' bzhin tu sgrub par 'dod pa 'dod pa'i dad pa/ de ltar rang gi nges pa rnyed pa nges pa'i dad pa/ rang byung 370

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgi ye shes de nyid ye nas 'bral med du shes nas de la mi phyed pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas pa de las gzhan tu mi ldog pa de phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa'o/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pas de la brten nas dad pa skye dgos pa yin/de gsum yang sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun gnyis khyad par can bya mkhan de chos yin par shes dgos gsungs/ ༈ mos gus de yang bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma de la byas pa yin/ de min gang rung rung gi ban rgan zhig la zer ba min/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ dbang bskur bas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du smin par byas/ man ngag gnang bas dus gsum yid kyi zhabrul ba thams cad sog ma'i phon thag chad pa bzhin du chad pa yin/ mtha' brten lung gi rim pa dang bcas pa gnang bas rdo rje rgyal po'i go 'phang la bkod/ de yis rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob/ mdzod kyi lde mig 'dzin/ zhabor gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba yin/zhabs drung rin po ches/ rwa shal kun bzang bsod nams la ngur smig bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i brda rtags snam sbyar zhig gnang / theg gsum chos 'khor bskor ba'i brda rtags su dung dkar zhig gnang / 'khor gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba'i brda rtags ja bag 'bru gnyis zhig gnang ba yin gsungs/jo bo rjes/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gzhan rnams mtshan brjod tshe thal mo snying gar sbyar/jo bo gser gling pa'i mtshan nas brjod tshe thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan zhus tshe khong la byang chub kyi sems nyag gcig skyes pa jo bo gser gling pa'i bka' drin yin gsungs/ yon tan gyi ngos nas min/ bka' drin gyi khyad par yin gsungs/ ༈ sngags ltar na tshogs drug lam du 'khyer ba yin te/ lta 371

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥba'i gdengs sgom pa'i ngang las mi 'da' bzhin tu sred len bral ba'i yul drug 'gag med du snang nas zhen med du rol bas rten med du grol tshe rig pas rkyen thub/shar cha rnams gdong bzlog mi bya bar shar du bcug nas yul rkyen grogs su shar/ ye shes ches cher rgyas/ sgrib pa'i dngos gnyen du gyur ba yin pas/ dper na nyi ma shar ba dang mun pa sangs ba ltar thug 'phrad rang grol du song ba yin/ de ltar min par ye shes de nyid rtogs nas gzod sgrib pa dag pa yin bsam na/ sgrib pa spang ba dgos med du gyur ba dang / sgrib pa sngon du dag nas ye shes rjes su rtogs na sgrib pa'i dngos gnyen du ma song bar yin par gsungs so// ༈ sngar ltar tshogs drug lam du khyer tshe dper na dngul chu'i thig pa rdul rdzas phal ba'i khrod du lhung kyang rdul dang ma 'dres pa lta bu dang / me tog padma 'dam dang chu las skye yang chu dang 'dam gyis gos pa med pa lta bu dang / bya nam mkhar 'phur tshe chags thogs dang lhung dogs med pa lta bu dang / nya chu la gnas kyang 'tshub pa med par kha gting du chags thogs med par 'gro ba lta bu/de bzhin du tshogs drug gis bsdus pa'i yul dang yul can thams cad yul yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings dang / yul can thams cad yongs su dag pa rig pa'i ye shes yin pas/ 'gag med du snang zhen med du rol na rten med du grol ba yin/ 'on kyang ye shes dang ldan pa'i spyod yul yin gsungs/༈thabs rdzas dang shes rdzas gnyis bza' rigs thams cad thabs rdzas dang /btung ba'i rigs shes rab kyi rdzas yin no/ /chang lta bu la mtshon na/ yul chang de sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs nas bdud rtsi ru bsgyur nas 372

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥlta ba'i ngang nas rol tshe sred len med pas/ gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug rnams mi tshang ba yin pas sngags lam du thabs shes kyi rdzas med du mi rung la log lta'ang mi byed gsungs/ ༈ de lta bu'i mnyam bzhag lta ba'i ngang der mdo hril gyis dril na/ngo bos shar cha'i go mi bkag pa dang gcig /shar cha 'char yang ngo bo la phan gnod dang bral ba gnyis/ dbyings kyis shar cha ma spangs pa dang / shar chas dbyings ma spangs ba ni gnad dam pa yin no// ༈ rig stong gi lta ba ngo 'phrod pa'i gang zag zhig yin na/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i gnas skabs sngon 'gro'i chos rnams lta ba'i klong du rdzogs pa yin te/ ji ltar zhe na/ kun slong la'ang sngags ltar na gnas tshul snod bcud 'di zhing dang gzhal yas khang sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa yin pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams kyi rgyu sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur nas tshe lus gcig gis rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du stong nyid zab mo mngon du gyur nas tshe lus gcig gis bsgom par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed/ chos dang mthun pa'i las byed pa la kun spyod zer/༈ blo ldog rnam bzhi'i dal ba'i lus rten la snying po len tshul ni/ lus snang stong rgyal ba'i sku/ ngag grags stong rgyal ba'i gsung / yid dran stong rgyal ba'i thugs kyi rang bzhin sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bdag nyid can des snying po de ltar du len pa yin pas de las lhag pa'i snying po len tshul ni rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis mdo rgyud bstan bcos gang nas ma gsungs so/ /rig stong gi 373

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥlta ba la nor 'brul med pa zhig ngo 'phrod nas/ de yi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba sgrub pa rnams chams se bzhag nas stong nyid kyi don sgom pa yin pas tshe 'dir snang gi bya ba bsgrub pa las blo ldog yod/dal 'byor chud zos su ma song bas dal 'byor gyi snying po lon pa yin pas rnyed par dka' ba'i khrid bsgom yod/ de lta bu rig stong chos nyid kyi klong na chos can gyi snang cha thams cad rtsal gdangs ma 'gags par bden med du yangs khrol le gzigs pasartag 'dzin las blo ldog yod/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i snom khrid kyang yin pas 'chi med gnyug ma'i btsan sa yin/ byang chub sems la skye 'chi ye nas med gsungs/ rang byung ye shes kyi rtsal las dmigs med lta ba'i klong du bzang ngan gyi rtog tshogs thams cad ji ltar shar yang bag chags gsog long med par shar grol du 'gro bas sdig pa mi dge ba'i cha las blo ldog yod/ las rgyu 'bras kyi 'asnatogs pa mi tshang bas las rgyu 'bras mig bzhin tu bsrung ba de la zer ro/ /phyi nang snod bcud kyi gnas tshul sku dang zhing khams kyi rang bzhin du shes pas mtho ris thob 'dod las blo ldog pa yin gsungs/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos 'di dag rnams/ snod dag pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor/ bcud dag pa rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs/ rgyud dag pa ye shes kyi rol ba/ sgra dag pa chos nyid kyi rang sgra/ de ltar yin pas spang blang med par 'khor 'das dag mnyam gyi lta ba zhes zer ba yin no// ༈ chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus rmi lam gyi snang ba dang 'dra/ de dus phan btags pa dang 'dren ston byed pa lta bur snang yang rmi lam gyi snang 374

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥcha lta bu'o/ /de tshe rang snang du shes/ rang snang rang bzhin med par thag chod/shes mkhan gdod ma'i dbyings su dwangs ba'i tshe/ phyi'i snang cha shar ba thams cad shel 'od nang du ldog pa bzhin du gzhi thog tu dwangs ba'o// ༈ khams bde gshegs snying po mngon du gyur dus thar pa'i lam sna zin pa yin/ ༈ sngags thun mong pas rang bzhin gzhi'i rgyud zer/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud sde rnams su rang byung ye shes zer/ rang byung gdod ma'i ye gzhi la dbang 'byor ba ni thar ba thob pa yin gsungs/ ༈ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang sngar gyi dge 'brasazhig gis da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di snang ba yin/ rmi lam du bla ma snang ba lta bu rang snang yin gsungs/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen de yang bsam pa'i sgo nas ci mdzad chos su mthong / sbyor ba'i sgo nas ci gsung kyi bka' bsgrub dgos pa yin/ rab sgrub pa'i mchod pa/ 'bring lus ngag gi bran du bkol ba/tha ma 'khor gsum yang dag gi mchod pa/ rang gi yo byad lhag lus med par 'bul dgos gsungs/ bla ma yang rang byung gi ye shes kyi rtsal las shar ba yin pas rig stong gi lta ba rtogs dus dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yin gsungs so// ༈ mnyam bzhag gi skabs su dper na mtha'i rgya mtsho'i klong der chu phran thams cad thim pa bzhin tu/ rig stong gi klong du chos can gyi snang ba thams cad ma spang ye grol du gzigs pa yin/ gnad de ltar rtogs na chu brgya zam 'og tu 'dus pa lta bu yin/ mnyam bzhag las ldang ba'i tshe/ dper na mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i ngang nas chu phran thams cad mched pa bzhin du/ rig stong zung 'jug gi ngang nas rig rtsal lam bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis chos 375

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥcan dngos por snang ba thams cad kyi mtshang mtshan nyid shes nas gnas lugs rtogs pa yin/ dper na rang byung gi me shes de nyid nam mkha' lta bu dang /kun 'byung las nyon gyi rtog tshogs thams cad sprin lta bu/ rang byung gi ye shes de nyid nyi ma lta bu dang / kun 'byung las nyon rtog tshogs rnams nyi ma'i zer lta bu/ rang byung ye shes de nyid ri bo lta bu dang / kun 'byung gi rtog tshogs rnams rtsi shing lta bu/ rang byung gi ye shes rgya mtsho kha gting dang bral ba lta bu/ kun 'byung las nyon rnams chu rlabs lta bu/ rang byung gi ye shes de nyid me long lta bu dang / kun 'byung las nyon thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu'o// ༈ maṇḍal ni/gzhi ka dag spros bral chos sku'i maṇḍal/ rang gdangs 'gag pa med pa longs sku'i maṇḍal/ thugs rje rig gdangs kyi shar cha rnams grol ba'i rang bzhin yin pa sprul sku'i maṇḍal yin gsungs/ de min yang na stong gsum ri rab gling bzhi lha gnas dang bcas pa rnams blos blangs nas/ rang gis 'bul nus na/ bla ma dkon mchog la bzhes pa'i nus pa yod pas de ltar du 'bul dgos gsungs/༈ gcod ni mdor na ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs ba'i dus gsum yid kyi 'khrul rtog dbyings su dwangs ba'i tshe gcod zer ba yin gsungs so/ /rje mi las/ ya gi dga' ldan lha yul na/ /'bras da lta btab pa da lta smin/ /khong so nam mkhas pas ma yin te/ /sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /zhes dang / ma gi ngan song gnasanyid na/ /mtshon da lta btab pa da lta sos/ /khong me las mkhas pas ma yin te/ sngon las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ 'dod pa med na 'phags pa dngos/ /'dod pa 376

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥchung na 'phags pa'i rigs/ /zhes so/ ༈ sa paṇa gyis/rtogs pa med pa'i grub thob kyis/ /rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag kyang ngan song rgyu/ /2 snyan gyi gong rgyan las/ lnga brgya'i tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid yi ge'i gzugs su sprul/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus pa gyis/ /zhes dang / de skad du/ ma 'ongs thub pa'i bstan pa nub pa'i tshe/ /dmar dang ser po'i gos kyi ras ma kun/ /lha rnams kyis bsdus dad pa'i rten du khyer/ /ri rab rtse ru mchod rten byed par gsungs// ༈ dpal sprul pas/ sangasargyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rin po che/ /dmar ser ngur smig chos gos rnam pa gsum/ /mthong na dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i zhing / /tshul ldan na bzas nyin gcig dkor sgrib dag /tshul ldan nga rgyal che ba las/ /tshul 'chal 'gyod pa che na dga'// ༈ chos ni skyes bus snying la mda' phog pa bzhin/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro na chos yin gsungs/ phyi rol dpe yi bla ma ni sngon dkar po dge ba bsgrubs pa las byung ba'i bla ma 'di rnams yin gsungs/ de yang las las byung ba yin pas rang snang yin gsungs/ de yang bden med rmi lam lta bu'i rang bzhin yin tshul la blo sbyang dgos/ de min 'dzin stangs dam hrang nge bar bzung na shes sgrib yin gsung / gnas lugs gzhi yi bla ma ni gnas lugs rang zhal mthong ba 'di nyid yin pas dpe yi bla ma dang mi 'dra gsungs/ bla ma 'od zhu byas nas thugs yid dbyer med bsres skabs snang ba sku yi bla ma/ sgra grags gsung gi bla ma/dran rtog thugs kyi bla ma yin pas dag ma dag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i dag snang lta bu ma yin pas/ dran snang bla ma'i gsang gsum dang ma bral ba gal che 377

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasungs so/ /mdo ltar na ldan gol tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ shes pas rgyud grol ba sogs/ sngags ltar na bskyed rdzogs sogs— ༈ dbyig gnyen gyis/ldan dang grol la med rta dang ba glang bong bu dag tu skye/ /rdo dang dbyug pa dag gis brdeg par 'gyur// ༈ mi slob pas ni bdag por spyod/ /slob pas sbyin pa spyod pa ste/ /bsam gtan klog dang ldan pa la/ /rjes gnang spyod pas nyes pa med/ /ces so/ /sa paṇa gyis/ blun pos phyag rgya cher sogs/༈ 'jigs gling gis/ skabs shig bsgom rgas gnyid du song ba'i tshe 'chi dus dud 'gror skye ba mkhyen par mdzod/ /ces so/ /blun po chu yi ri mo bzhin//gang byas de nyid myur du 'jig /mkhas pa rdo la ri mo bzhin/ khren tu phra yang brtan par gnas// ༈ bying bas dwangs cha sgrib/ rmugs pas gsal cha sgrib/gnyid kyis lus ngag yid gsum skyon can byed/ ༈ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/bla mas dbang bskur chos bshad byed/ /thugs la med do sa ma ya/ /ci gsung tshad mar ma bzung na/ /legs so mang po ci la phan/ /slob ma mig btsum thal mo sbyar/ /yid la med do sa ma ya/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu ni/ /dran rig so ma'i ngang na yod// ༈mi zhig la khang pa bzang po yod na nga yi khang pa bzang snyam pa'i zhen chags yod la/ re zhig khang pa de me yis tshig par gyur na de'i tshe khang pa bzang snyam pa'i zhen chags ga la yod de med/ de bzhin du sems sems byung thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin khang pa rnam dpyod shes rab kyis thal gyis btang ba'i tshe/ ngar 'dzin rnam par rtog pa'i 'phreng ba bde sdug re dogs thams cad rang zhig la mi 'gro ba'i thabs med gsungs/ ༈ hūṃ 378

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmatshan nyid bzhi ldan ni/ reg bya tsha ba me lta bu/rno ba spu gri lta bu/ myur ba glog lta bu/shugs dang ldan pa gnam lcags kyi thog lta bu ste bzhi'o/ /rlung dmigs sems gsum po gcig du dril pa la/ sems rtse gcig tu gtad pa gal che ba zhig dgos gsungs/ ༈ phyogs ris med pa'i dad pa/ nye ring med pa'i snying rje zhig shugasa'abyung la 'char na/ lta ba ngo 'phrod pa'i rtags yin gsungs/ lam zhugs kyi skabs su rnam rtog 'gag stobs gzhan las che bar gsungs pas skabs su dmigs yul la gtad tshe/ de las gzhan pa'i rnam rtog gi bar gcod mi 'byung bas zhi lhag zung 'brel la dbang 'byor ba'i yon tan thob pa las/ rnam rtog gtan 'gags su gyur pa la go mi nyan gsungs/ ༈ rnal dbab ni/ skyid po byas pa lta bu sems bag pheb par bzhag pa'o gsungs/ ru shan gyi skabs 'gro ba drug gi bsam spyod sogs la bslabs pa 'di/ mtshan ma gzhig pa'i don du sgom tshul yin pa gzhir bzhag tu go dgos gsungs/ rig pa ka dag gi rang bzhin can gyi lta ba ngo legs par 'phrod pa'i gang zag gis yun ci ring bar bsgoms kyang gegs gol sa la mi 'gro gsungs/ ༈ngo ma 'phrod pa'i gang zag gis yun thung grang mangs khang rgan thig pa ltar ma bsgoms mi 'ong gsungs/ ༈ bzlas pas rlung 'phel/ rig stong gi lta ba'i thog tu mi khel/ rig gdengs sems kyi rnam rtog kha 'byams su 'gro nyen che bas/ de bas gal khe che ba mnyam bzhag la brtson/ khe chung ba mtshan ma'i bsam spyod rnams spongs gsungs/ gzhi yi bzhugs tshul la phyogs tsam las mngon sum ma mthong ba la gzhi yin dngos ma yin gsungs/ ༈ rig pa dbyings kyi ra bar 379

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbatsud zer yang don la thig le'i dbus su gtad dgos gsungs/ lam zhugs kyi skabs su bla ma 'od zhu byas nas lus la thim pas lus hūṃ du gyur bar gsungs/ ༈ rdzogs chen skabs sku gsum dbye tshul/ dpe ni/ bum pa'i ngo bo stong cha chos sku/ ma 'gags pa longs sku/ snang cha sprul sku/ dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku'o zhes ldog chas phye gsungs/ ༈ chos zad dus mi sdig can la chos bstan yang de ltar mi bsgrub par thabs med gsungs/ ༈ rig pa'i ngar ma shor ba'i ngang nas a yig la gtad nas gnyid 'od gsal du sba sogs bya dgos gsungs/ nyin mo ma goms par nub mo ji ltar dmigs pa bzung yang gnyid 'od gsal du mi 'char gsungs/ ༈ rdzogs chen shin tu zab kyang / gang zag rdzogs chen du ma song na mi phan gsungs/ ༈ dbu ma'i yid dpyod kyi go ba rjes dpag la brten nas gzhi'i gnas tshul gtan la 'beb pa tsam yang med par thams cad stong pa'o snyam pa'i deng sang gi sgom chen phal cher lta bu'o/ /gsungs/༈ 'khor 'das dag mnyam lta ba'i go ba tsam thon kyang / /gomasapa'i myong thog ma slebs go yul la ltos dang / stong lta'i 'ur sgra ldir yang shes rgyud ni sngar bzhin/ /sgo gsum tha mal ngang du nyin mtshan kun 'da' 'dug /gsungs/༈ snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa na snang ba snang yul ma phyed par sems su 'dod na/dper na bum pa sems yin na bum pa'i yul sems par thal ba sogs skyon yod pas/ de ltar min par kun mkhyen gyis bzhed pa'i gnas don lus kyi bag chags de'i dbang gis grub pa'i snang ba 'di grub pas/ de ni bag chags de'i dbang gis grub pa'i lus yin sems min gnas kyi bag chags gis 380

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdabang gis grub pa gnas yin sems min kyang / bag chags gsog mkhan de sems yin pas sems gtso cher gyur bas/ mdo sde lang kar gshegs pa las khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo gsungs/ ༈ da ni bdag 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa yin pas/ chos kyi dbyings spros pa med pa'i klong du mya ngan las 'da' bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / ngag gis na zhes brjod la sems nyid rang gi rig pa rlung dang 'grogs nas phyi'i dbyings la thim pa dar cig bsgom pa'i rjes la rig thog tu 'jog ces dpal sprul lta bu'o// ༈ thug phrad ces pa rdo tshan la kha ba 'phrad pa bzhin phrad pa'i rig pa tsam gyis grol ba la go dgos gsungs/cer grol zhes pa ni tshogs drug gi yul gang blo la shar na de thog tu lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis rang yal la 'gro ba dang / rig pa'i klong nas rnam rtog gi mgo 'bur ba'am cer ba tsam gyis slar rig thog tu grol ba/ dper na chu las nya'i mgo 'bur ba'am cer ba lta bu yin zhes/ bla ma 'brug pas bzhed gsungs/las dang po pa la rtsal med thabs chag yin pas goms dgos gsungs/༈ thog ma'i gzhi skor la 'khor 'das gnyis ka ma grub pas gzhi gnyis ka 'char rung gi gdangs tsam yod pa la go dgos gsungs/ ༈ rig pa'i ye shes 'dren pa la 'gro 'ong las kyi rlung rang sar bzhag dgos gsungs/ rtog tshogs nyon mongs pa'i rlung dwangs dgos gsungs/ yid kyi shesapa ni/ yul dang po spyi 'dzin pas gzung ba dang / nyon yid ni/ rjes la bye brag 'dzin pas 'dzin pa'o/ /gsungs/ de gnyis la rtog bcas rtog med ci rigs dang dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnams yod/ sgo lnga dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni rtog med kho na 381

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥyin gsungs/ rnam rtog mi bkra dgu bkra 'dis 'gyu cha rlung yin la/ rig cha rig gdangs yin gsungs/ rig gdangs rlung gis bskyod rang ngo ma mthong ba'i cha rig pa la ltos nas ma rig pa'i cha tsam zhig la rgyu bdag nyid gcig pa'o sogasatre ༈ gzhi lasagazhi snang g.yos tshe rang snang rang ngo shes te grol ba de la thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po zer la/ de las sngon zhig la sems can ma byung ba'i thog ma/ sangs rgyas ma byung ba'i thog ma zhig la kun tu bzang po zer ba zhig yod pa la go mi nyan/ de la da cang mi go rgyu med khi a/ 'di yin na myong thog gi bslabs na mi go rgyu med pas/ 'di ltar dag ma dag gi snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di dag thams cad gzhi snang las shar ba red ta/ yin dgos ni red a/ de yin na gzhi snang rang snang yin pas rang snang nyag gcig las med pa de rang ngo shes pas shes mkhan gzhi thog tu grol nas 'gro ba 'di la/ ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul gyi rgyu gsum rkyen bzhi 'byung lugs med pas rang log la 'gro lugs shes dgos la/ da mdor bsdu na rang snang rang ngo shes pas de yang shar gzhi shar chos gnyis ka rang snang du ngo shes pas 'brul ba'i rgyu gsum rgyu'i rkyen dang bcas pa rang log tu 'gro ni red/ ngo shes mkhan gyi shes rab de gzhi thog tu rtsal rdzogs pas bdag po'i rkyen rang log tu 'gro ni red/de ltar gzhan la ma ltos par rang ngo rang gi rig pas rig pa rang grol gyi cha la ston byed kyi slob dpon med par rang byung gi sangs rgyas rang sar gnas pas brtan pa thob pa la 'khrul ba'i dmigs rkyen dang de ma thag rkyen rang log yin pas/ 'di yin na mnyam bzhag la 'dug nas bltas na legs pa zhig yin ni 382

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥred gsungs/ ༈ gzhi snang ngo shes na grol byed/ngo ma shes na zhabrul byed ces zer yang / ma rtogs na yid dpyod ldang bas log par zhakhrul ba'i gzhir song na 'khrul gzhir te lam goms pa la cha de ltar sbyar rgyu yod ni red/ 'bras bu dang cha 'dra ba yin ni red/ thugs rje'i rig pa ni rang gi rig pa la go dgos te thugs rje'i rig pa gsungs yod pas/ de gzhi snang shar ba ngo ma shes na zhabrul pa'i yid dpyod kyi mgo 'dzin pas/ de yang ma rig pa dngos ci yin ta/ ma rig pa'i rgyur grub pa'i dpe ma rig pa'i char gyur pa'i mgo yin te/ rang snang yin par ma shes so/ /de'i ma rig 'byul ba'i gzhi 'dzin la/ rang snang yin par shes na grol gzhi ru gyur bas chos sku dbyer med du bzhugs pa yin ni red/de ltar gzhi lhun grub dang de'i gdangs shes par shar tshul 'di la gzhi snang lhun grub kyi snang ba lhun grub zer ba red/ de'i 'char gzhi la gzhi zer ba red/snang ba thams cad rang snang yin te/ gzhi las shar ba'i gzhi snang red/ de shes mkhan gzhi thog tu grol ni red/ de ltar rang grol du gyur pa de ye shes yin ni red/ rang snang ye shes su shar ba la gnad 'di go dgos/ 'di go na rtsal las shar ba'i rol ba ye shes sam rig pa ru shar ba yin zhes yang yang gsungs/ ༈ 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char ba'i man ngag ni/ ka dag khregs chod kyi lta ba dbyings ye zung 'jug rtogs pa dang / lhun grub thod rgal gyis 'khrul yul zhakhrul mkhan thams cad rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por ngo sprad nas/ snang bzhi sgron drug gi lam mchog la brten nas tshe lus gcig gis rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa yin gsungs/ ༈ bskyed pa 383

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥm hā yo ga ltar na/ snang phyogs nas chos thams cad dag pa sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ stong phyogs nas don dam dkor bdun lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med du rtogs dgos pa yin gsungs/ ༈ lung a nu yo ga ltar na/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba'i chos thams cad yab kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor/ stong pa yum kun tu bzang mo'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa sras bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du rtogs dgos gsungs/ ༈ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po ltar na/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chos sku thig le nyag gcig ngo sprod pa yin gsungs/ ༈ gzhi la mang yang mi zhig shi tshe gzhi thog tu dar gcig gnas pa thog ma'i gzhi zer gsungs/ ci zhig gi thog ma yin snyam na sangs rgyas sems can gnyis ka ma byung ba'i snga rol yin pas thog ma zer gsungs/༈ snang ba 'gags kyang snang yul ma 'gags pa zer ba yid shes kyi ngor dpe'i 'od gsal don spyi'i tshul du 'char ni red/ de la snang ba zer ni red/ tshogs sbyor skabs na de ltar yin ni red/ mthong lam skabs don gyi 'od gsal dngos yin pas de shar tshe/ snang ba yid shes kyi ngor shar ba'i don spyi dag nas snang yul mngon sum du myong ba yin ni red/ dper na nam mkha'i zla ba snang yul/gzugs brnyan rdzing bur shar ba snang ba/ gzugs brnyan snang ba de 'gags kyang nam mkha'i zla ba snang yul 'gags mi dgos gsungs/ rdzogs chen skabs 'dir snang ba snang yul de ltar shes dgos/ de las phyi nang gnyis su bzhag rgyu i rnyed ma lta gsungs/ phyi nang ltar bzhag na khyod kyis grogs kyi don spyi blo yul la shar ba snang ba/ grogs dngos snang yul/ de bzhin tu ka ba 384

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsnang yul/ de'i rnam pa yid ngor shar ba la snang ba zer yang de yis dgos rgyu skabs 'dir med khi a/ ༈ thog ma'i gzhi zer ba de 'khor 'das gnyis ka ma grub pa'i gzhi dbyings lo lo bo'i klong na yod/ 'chi srid sogs mtshan gzhir 'jog gsungs/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka 'char rung gi gdangs tsam yod pa la go dgos gsungs/ thog ma'i gzhi ka dag gi ngo na 'khor 'das gang yang ma grub pa'i gzhi lo lo bo de la gzhi gcig zer/ gzhi las gzhi snang mched dus rang snang ngo shes na sangs rgyas kyi lam/ ma rtogs na 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i lam gnyis byung ba 'di gzhi snang gi steng nas ngos 'dzin dgos gsungs/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad yid la lan gcig dran na sangs rgyas rnams ni sa chen po'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa yod pas sangs rgyas de'i grangs dang mnyam pa la tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu thob pa yin la/ sems can gyi khams la yang snying rje lan gcig skyes pas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams thob gsungs/phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad du sangs rgyas rnams mi bzhugs pa'i yul dus skra yi rtse mo lan brgyar bgos pa'i cha tsam yod pa ma yin kyang / sems can gyis rang rang gi las ngan gyis bsgribs yod pas mthong bar mi nus te/ sgyu 'phrul las/ yang dag shes pa'i rang rig blo med na/ /bde gshegs zhid yang ngan song gnas su mthong / /zhes gsungs/ sngon tshangs pa ral pa can zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi mdun du byon tshe sha ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal bu sogs rtsod pa byas pas tshangs pa ral pa can gyis zhing 'di shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i 385

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥzhing nges par mthong ba sogs rgyu mtshan bshad pas mo'u 'gal bu dang sha ri'i bu sogs kyis yin don med/ khyim bdag dpal skyes lta bu lo brgya ba dang /sor phreng can sogs sdig can zhig dang / dge slong ma ud pa la lta bu sogs zhing khams na yod don med zer nas/ mthar ston pa la zhus tshe tshangs pa ral pa can gyis mthong ba ni legs so gsungs nas sangs rgyas kyis byin rlabs kyi mthu las 'khor thams cad re zhig tsam la shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams mngon sum mthong ba lta bu'o/ /dngul chu'i thig pa sa la lhung dus rdul dang ma 'dres pa bzhin shar gzhi shar chos gnyis 'byed dgos/ de byed na shar gzhi shar chos gnyis gcig tu mi 'dod pa'i ldog cha 'di shes dgos/chos thams cad rig pa rjen par rtogs dgos gsungs/ de la sems dang rig pa gcig tu ma gsungs/ de gsungs na sems la skye 'gag yod pa bzhin rig pa skye 'gag can du thal/ yang na yul rig pa gnyis gcig du bsam na/ phyi rol dngos por grub pa bzhin rig pa dngos po can du thal/ yang na rig pa 'dum byas pa bzhin/ phyi rol tshogs drug gi yul 'di 'dus ma byas yin par thal/ rig pa 'dus ma byas dang rdzas gcig tu 'dod pa'i phyir sogs skyon du ma yod pas ldog chas phye ma shes na cha ga ro log rgyab 'gal la 'gro ni red/ de bas ldog chas phye shes dgos/ rig pa rjen par gsungs pa de yang go rgyu chen po yod la/ 'char gzhi'i rig pa rjen la phud nas bskyangs na/ de la yul gyi snang cha ma 'gags kyang yul la rig pa g.yo ba med/ yul gyis rig pa la gos pa med/ de med dngul chu'i thig pa rdul dang mi 'dres pa bzhin/ yul la 'dres pa 386

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmed pas rig pa rjen pa la/ gnam stong gi zla ba dang dngul chu'i thig pa'i dpe sogs kyi mtshon pa yin ni red/ de 'dra'i rig pa legs par skyong shes na/'dzin pa thams cad rang grol la 'gro ba'i rang gshis kyi bab la gnas ni red/de la rig pa rang bab kyi bsam gtan zer ni red/ sems 'dzin bsam gtan thabs bcas red/ ༈ spyir rig pa'i ye shes kyi ldog cha tsam la lta sgom spyod gsum ming du btags pa las lta sgom spyod gsum tha dad du med pas/ rang ngo 'phrod pa'i cha nas lta ba/ ngang la gnas pa'i cha nas sgom pa/ gang shar rang grol du gyur pa'i cha nas spyod pa/ sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu/ de las mi 'da' ba dam tshig yin pas/ rig stong chos sku'i 'od gsal gyi rang sa ma shor na gang shar bag chags gsog long med par grol ba las mi grol ba shes bya la mi srid pa yin te/ grol ba rang gis rang grol la gzhan rkyen med par bzang ngan bar ma'i rtog tshogs thams cad sprul gyi mdud pa bzhin du grol bas skad cig de nyid la gang zag de'i shes rgyud dag pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin du sad pa yin pas/ de ltar rig pa'i ye shes snying dbusasu sad na/ dad pa/ snying rje/shes rab gsum bcos med du 'char ba chos nyid yin pas/ go rgyu myong rgyu med pa zhig i yod ha bo/ ji ltar bsgoms kyang na ning gi be'u li/ da lo yang be'u li 'dra 'dra/ yar skyed med pa 'di mnyam bzhag rjes thob la bsres nas spyod pa shar grol gyis rtsal sbyang ma shes pas yin nam gnad kyi rig ngo ma shes pas lan pa yin no/ /des na rig stong chos sku'i 'od gsal gyi lta ba'am/ lhag mthong gi rtsal rdzogs nas bzang rtog ngan rtog lung ma bstan gsum rig stong 387

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgi klong du rang grol du 'gro ba/ dper na khyung gi phru gu gshog rtsal rdzogs pa lta bu dgos gsungs/ shed med cig khur rgyas non pa lta bu'i bsgom go ci yang ma chod pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na lta sgom spyod gsum tha dad du mi 'dzin la rig stong gnyug ma'i rang bab rang grol du skyong ba las gzhan med de/ mi pham pas/ rten 'byung sna tshogs byed po sems nyid yin/ /sems kyi rgyal po rang sar rang grol na/ /bya spyod gzhan la re ltos ci zhig dgos/ /gsungs/༈ rig stong zung 'dug 'od gsal gyi lta ba de ngos bzung ba/ de'i ngang gtad med zang thal du skyong ba/ de gnyis kyi grogs spyod pa rang grol gyi rtsal sbyang ba gsum ye gdod ma nas rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa'i rang byung lhun grub kyi rig pa 'od gsal ba'i ye shes 'di'i steng na/ spang blang gis bcos bsgrur skyon phar bsal rgyu/ yon tan tshur bsgrub rgyu med la/ med dgag dang ma yin dgag la sogs blos byas kyi lta ba las 'das pa'i chos sku thig le nyag gcig gi lta ba ngo 'phrod dgos gsungs/ ༈ de lta bu'i lta ba de'i rtsal ma rdzogs na rig ngo yi dwags gi sen kha lta bu'i ngo sprod zhig la/ gnas cha sgrin bar gyi nyi 'od lta bu'am rlung gseb kyi mar me lta bus rkyen mi theg ste/ kun mkhyen chen pos/rang ngo 'phrod kyang goms 'dris ma byas na/ /rnam rtog dgras khyer g.yul ngo'i bu chung 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bzang rtog dang dga' brod lha bu'i bdud gang shar thams cad zhen med du ngos zin dgos gsungs/ bla ma dang mched grogs sogs la log lta skyes na a kha kha snyam pas skyon can du dam breng nge bzung nas gnyen po gzhan zhig bsten nas phar spang rgyu i rnyed lta ba sogs chags sdang 388

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmeongs gsum gyi dbang gis rtog pa gang shar yang de la skyon du bzung nas gnyen po gzhan rkyen la brten nas spang rgyu i rnyed re ba gnyen por shor ba'o/ /gdod ma'i stong chen gyi dbyings rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid ma shes par phung sogs kyi stong nyid la 'jog pa stong nyid blos byas su re bas gshis shor du zhabs drung rin po che'i bzhed par 'brug pa'i zhal rgyun yin gsungs/ mdor na mnyam bzhag rjes spyod la bsres/ rjes spyod rmi lam la bsres/ rmi lam 'od gsal du sbyangs pa 'di phyag rdzogs gnyis kas thun mong du bzhed pa yin gsungs/ spyod pa rang grol gyi gnad med na chags sdang sogs kyis lta rkub spyod pas phud/ sgom rkub g.yeng bas phud nas/ a khus rtogs khul bzung yang / nyi ma re la rang mtshang sba gsang med par mang po ston 'ong ba red/ des na spyod pa rang grol gyi gnad yod na yul yul can gnyis ka rig pa'i ye shes su 'char/ gal te yul rang grol ye shes su 'char ma nus kyang /yul can rnam rtog bzang ngan bar ma gsum po yang skye grol dus mnyam du 'gro ba zhig ni ci nas 'ong dgos te/ de ma 'ongs na gzhan zhig la kho bo ji ltar red 'dug zer ba ni yi mug byed du 'dug pas/ des na rang rig zang thal rjen par shar ba'i klong du rang sar snang ba dag pa rab 'byams su rang grol gnyug ma'i rtsal 'byongs ba zhig dgos par 'dug gsungs/ mdor na rtsis zin gyi rnam rtog chu la ri mo 'dra tshul dang / 'og 'gyu'i rnam rtog rdo la ri mo 'dra tshul mang po gsungs 'dug /tshe mjug lug gi rnga ma lta bu thung had de ba 'di la dkor la mi 'byams par brtson 'grus gzhu 'gengs ba lta bu zhig dgos 389

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasungs/ mnyam bzhag las yeng zhabrul nam byung na de tshe dang po kun gzhi'i ngang la mi lhung ba'i thabs med/ thun gcig bsdad na skad cig gis zhabrul 'gro rgyu 'di kun gzhi'i khams la 'dug pa'i skyon red/ cung zad yun ring na kun gzhi ru 'dug ni red/ de ltar ma byed ma gtogs je 'thib 'thib yin ni red/rang rig gser zhun ma lta bu de legs par skyong dgos ni red/ de yang i tsi ma zhig gi kha la blta ma 'dug la/ dpe cha legs par bslabs nas thang yangs por rta bzang gi sgrog gtor ni 'dra 'dra zhig dgos gsungs/ ༈ mnyam bzhag la skyong sgom med kyang rjes thob la rig cha yod pas ri sul du mi tshe bskyal ba yin zhes so/ /'khrul rtog tha mal gyi shes pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ nyams zhen tha mal gyi shes pa bde gsal mi rtog gsum/ gzhi gnas tha mal gyi shes pa shes rig go ma 'gags pa yin gsungs/ ༈ thog mar kun slong bcos/skyabs sems bzhag /dngos gzhi thugs yid dbyer med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su rtog pa gang shar thams cad grol kha zhog dang khregs chod lam shar grol yin gsungs/ rnam rtog ma shar na cang grol gyi yod ni ma reke gsungs/ dper na rgad po zhig gis phyi ba bsad dgos na phyi ba khong sgo la ma bud na gsad rgyu med/ phyir bud ka bzhag nas gzod gsad ni red/ zhabrul ba bzhig lugs la dad pa'i sko nas thugs yid dbyer med du bzhag na 'khrul ba dwangs 'gro ni red/ rnam rtog shar ka bzhag nas 'khor ba zhen log gi sgo nas zhabrul ba bshig na chog gsungs/ gnyen po bsten ma dgos par 'khrul ba rang dwangs la song na 'dra 'dra yin gsungs/ nyams len gyi dus thugs yid dbyer 390

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā med bsre ba'i skabs su rnam rtog shar ni de la 'khrul ba zer ni ma red/ shar grol zer ni red gsungs/ rnam rtog shar ka bzhag nas grol ka 'jog ni red gsungs/ dper na dbul bo zhig gi lag nas gter rdol ba bzhin rnam rtog spang blang gnyis ka ma red grol ka zhog gsungs/ sde zig yin na nyams len gyi dus su chags sdang rmongs gsum 'char ga bzhag nas nyams len gyi rang tshugs ma shor ba'i ngang nas shar tshad thams cad dper na sprin chen nam mkha' la dwangs ba bzhin tu grol 'gro ni red gsungs/ rnam rtog shar gyi med nas sra mo rdo 'dra 'dra de ni gol sa ngan pa red gsungs/ rnam rtog shar bzhin grol na yag ni red gsungs/ bsngo ba ni 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi bsngo ba rjesamathun paḥ gang shes sogs bsngo tshul gsungs/ yang na dge sdig gtong len gyi dmigs pa byas na chog gi gsungs// //391

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā ༄༅/ /ma ṇi 'don lugs sogs tshig zin 'ga'/rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo spyan ras gzigs gsal btab la/ mos pa tsam gyis chog gsungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros rang gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas rgyu mi dge ba dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad dag nas sangs rgyas par bsam/ de'i ngang nas ma ṇi bzlas na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba smon lam rnams tshang gsungs/ dus rtag tu dge ba gang yin kyang tha na dge sems skad cig ma gcig yan chad thal mo ya gcig sbyar ba thams cad gang yin yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum gal che gsungs/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis zin pa'i dge rtsa khong khros mi 'joms/ log ltas mi gcod gsungs/ 2'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su dmigs pa ni/ 'khor lo'i yig 'bru las ye shes kyi 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod par bsam/ tshur 'dus pas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dang mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub 'khor lor thim par bsam/ phar 'phros pas rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas rgyu mi dge ba dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad sangs sangs dag nas sangs rgyas par bsam/ de'i ngang nas 'khoor lo bskor na phan yon dpag tu med pa yod gsungs/ de lta bu'i dmigs rnam gyis zin dgos gsungs/ ༈ shi gson gang yin kyang 'dra/ gson po'am nad pa'i rim 392

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgro yin na nad bdag gi gtsor byas sems bskyed dgos/ khyad par tshe 'das kyi sngas mgor 'gro ba'i gnas skabs chags sdang rmongs gsum bsam na/ des yar 'phen ni ma red mar 'phen ni red/ des na tshe 'das kyi mngon shes kyis go nas log lta skyes nas mar ngan song du 'gro ni red/ nyams len pa zhig yin na nyams len gyi ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags khyad par ba brjod nas mi 'khrul bar 'pho ba btab na phan thog gsungs/ ༈ rang man na yod pa gang yin na rang gi lus nas skyes pa'i bu phrug lta bu gang yin na shig yin/ shig gcig gi srog bcad na so byang sngags gsum la 'gal tshul dang sha nye pha ma sogs chags zhen gyis dbang gis skyes pa yin gsungs/ shig gcig grang 'khyag la gsod na grang dmyal brgyad kyi rgyu ma nor ba yin gsungs/ sen mo'i steng nas bcur na dmyal ba bsdus 'joms kyi rgyu ma nor ba yin gsungs/khyad par du ban ser mo ba rnams kyis 'di la 'dzem bag byed pa gal che gsungs/ ༈ rig pa yin pa'i rtags su rtog pa rang rgyud pa gcig 'char ni ma red gsungs/ gol sa thams cad dang sems kyi dri ma tsam yod rung ni ma red gsungs/ rnam rtog thams cad rig pa'i rnam ldan du 'char dgos gsungs/dper na nyi ma shar na mun pa 'dug long med pa bzhin tu rig pa kho rang shar dusarnam rtog thams cad rig pa'i rnam ldan du shar 'gro ni red gsungs/༈ dran shes bsten tshul ni/ dran pa rnyed na sgom rnyed/ dran pa stor na sgom stor/dran shes zhes pa shes bzhin go bzhin pa de'i ngang du dran pa bsten gyi red gsungs/ mnyam bzhag la lhod yod dgos/ de'i ngang nas rtsal gang shar 393

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥthams cad bag chags gsog long med par grol bas rjes thob zer/ spyod lam gyi skabs rig pa bsgrim dgos gsungs/ mi pham pas/ man ngag byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /dgos pa ri rab rgya mtsho 'dra/ /gsungs/ ༈ mnyam bzhag mtshan nyid pa'i skabs su yul can rlung sems dag stobs kyis des bskyed zhabrul ba'i cha 'di dag kyang dag 'gro ni red gsungs/ de 'dra'i zhagrul ba'i cha 'di dag gsar byung glo bur ba yin te/ 'di thog ma'i gzhi dus na med/ mthar thug 'bras dus na med/ rnal 'byor lam dus na med/ rig pa gshis su phebs skabs zhakhrul snang 'di dag khral ma khrol/ ya ma yengs/ ban ma bun/med snang glo bur tsam ma gtogs med par shes nas/ 'grul snang glo bur ba 'di dag med gsungs/ dper na mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por snang ba dang/mig la rab rib nad can gyis mig lam du skra shad snang ba ltar dang / yi dwags kyis chu la rnag khrag tu mthong ba bzhin/ de yang 'khrul snang bag chags dag skabs gnas tshul chu gtsang ma mthong ba bzhin/ gnas tshul gzigs skabs 'khrul snang rang log tu dag 'gro ni red gsungs/ mi dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs nas zhe sdang gis ral gri phyar nas g.yug bzhin pa'i gnas skabs na'ang gnas tshul rig stong chos sku'i bzhugs tshul mngon du gyur nas shar yod gsungs/ lam dus skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med gsungs/ rig stong chos sku'i ye shes kyi nyi ma nam shar kyang ma rig gzung 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i sems sems byung dang bcas pa rig pa ye shes kyi rnam ldan du sad 'gro ba yin pas de go dgos gsungs/ de min sems dang rig pa gnyis gnas skabs ma gtogs 394

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmathar thug tha dad du go mi nyan gsungs/ dper na nyi ma shar tshe mun pa rang yal du 'gro ba bzhin rnam rtog gang shar kyang rig stong chos sku'i rgyal khab tu grol dgos gsungs/ rnam rtog gi rjes ded nas grol bar 'dod pa ni khyi la rdo 'phen skabs mi la mi 'ju bar rdo rjes ded pa bzhin no/ /rnam rtog shar kyang dran pas zin tsam gyis rig pa'i rnam ldan du grol ba ni gcan gzan gyi rgyal po seng ge la rdo 'phangs na rdo la mi 'ju bar 'phen mi la 'ju ba bzhin no/ /༈ yang rig pa'i snang cha ni yab tshe dpag med/ ye stong gi cha ni yum chos nyid don gyi gzung ma/ zung 'jug gi cha yab yum 'khril sbyor du go dgos gsungs/de skabs gzugs snang sku/ sgra grags gsung / dran rtog thugs kyi 'khyer so gsum dang ma bral ba dgos gsungs/ de yang mthar thug dbyings ye zung 'jug de nyid lha yab yum gang yin kyang de'i skur bzhengs pa go dgos gsungs/༈ man ngag zab mo la brten nas zang thal gyi rig pa mngon sum rtogs shing tshad du phyin pas sngon gyi bla ma dam pa 'od gsal snying po'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams ni 'di ltar yin par gsungs te/ yul snang rig ngo la mi 'gag kyang rig pa yul thog tu ma 'dres pa gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i chos thams cad chu la ri mo bris pa bzhin rang grol du song bas spang bya'i mtha' zad/ yul thog tu ma shor ba'i rig ngo la chags zhen dang dgag sgrub mi mngon pas gnyen po'i 'dzin pa las grol/ rig pa chos skur grub pa la chos can gyis gtan drigs med pas mtha' bral chen po'i ye shes su zang thal/ rnam rtog rig par grol bas lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi rdzun phug rdib nas cho ga dang chos spyod kyis mi gdung yang 395

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥspros pa med pa'i chos nyid byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral/ chos brgyad kyi rtog pa med kyang dkon mchog dang las 'bras la gus pa mi lhod pas bya byed thams cad sems can gyi don du song / re dogs yul med du sangs/ khrel yod dang ngo tsha shes pas chags sdang dang tho co'i sbyod pas gzhan sun mi 'byin/tha snyad dang grub mtha' la ma sbyangs kyang rang bzhin rig pa'i rtsal ye shes su rgyas pas tha snyad kyi rnam bzhag kun la ma meongs kyang / nga rgyal dang 'gran sems med/ mnyam bzhag la skyong sgom med kyang rjes thob rig cha yod pas mi tshe ri la skyel ba yin gsungs/ da lta rang re'i bla ma rnams kyang de 'dra ba sha stag tu bzhugs pa mngon sum yin na rang cag rnams chos rgyud 'di lta bu la 'jug tu yod pa skal ba re bzang / pha rjes bu yis zin pa zhig nges par dgos gsungs/ dbyings spros pa dang bral ba la mnyam par bzhag na lar yin kyang lung ma bstan kun gzhi ru 'chor nye bas rig pa gsal ngar dang ldan pa ngos 'dzin dgos gsungs/ 'di 'brug pa'i zhal rgyun yin gsungs/ mi pham rin po ches rtogs ldan la dbyings smras kyang rig pa/ rig pa bsdood kyang dbyings su go bas rtogs na don gcig ming gi bye brag las khyad par med ces gsungs/yang mnyam bzhag legs par byas nas rang re nang nas ye shes sad nas snang yul ye shes su ma shar na/ rang nga thams cad ye shes so snyam na rgyas 'debs su shor 'gro ni red/ de ltar ma byed zhib cha gyis gsungs/ yang thog ma'i gzhi shes dgos/ gzhi de la 'khor 'das 'byung rung gi gdangs tsam yod pa shes dgos/ de 'dra'i gzhi snang ye nas lhun grub shes dgos/ de la grol 'khrul 396

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'abyung ba'i rgyu rkyen tshang ba shes dgos/ de 'dra'i lhun grub kyi sbubs gsum 'di gcig ma shes na rdzogs chen gyi dgongs pa legs par shes rgyu ma red gsungs/sems can phal ba rnams ni nga dang nga yir 'dzin pas/ yod ma myong bas zhabrul snang glo bur ba la zhen nas bslus pa yin pas/ rnal 'byor ba rnams kyis ngo bo ye stong rtsa bral/ ltos gzhi las 'das pa/ sgyu lus rjes med nam mkha' lta bu de'i ngang las rtsal snang ji ltar mched kyang / med snang stong pa'i rang gzugs shar grol ris med du dwangs su bcug pa tsam las rnam 'gyur gzhan du song ma myong bar thag chod par bya'o/ /de yang dper na smig rgyu chu nyid du snang ba'i dus chur ye nas med pas chu ma yin par grol zin pa la de ltar shes nas thag chod pa tsam las gzod grol mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /chos dbyings mdzod las/ mi 'gyur spros dang bral ba'i rig pa la/ /shar ba ye shar gnas pa ye gnas la/ /grol ba ye grol nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /rang grol ni/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad rang shar rang grol rang yal lam rig pa zang ka chos sku'i nang dbyings su ka dag rjen par gnas pa der ngo shes nas rang sa zin na rtsal las shar ba'i rnam rtog thams cad sbul gyi mdud pa bzhin rang yal rjes med du dag pa ste/ snga ma las/ shar ba'i dus na rang shar rang sa zin/ /gnas pa'i dus na rang gnas rang sa zin/ /grol ba'i dus na rang grol rang sa zin/ /zhes so/ /cer grol ni/ rtag tu rig pa rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin yod pa de'i rtsal ma 'gags pa las chags yul lam sdang yul sogs gang yang rung ba zhig mig lam du mthong ba'i tshe chags sdang gi rnam rtog 'phro bar rtsom pa na/397

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥde la ma zhen par cer gyis rig thog tu rjen par bzhag pas gzung 'dzin du 'brel nas 'khor ba'i bag chags sogs pa'i sgyu lus kyi gzhi kun dang bral te shar grol rgyun chad med par shugs kyis 'byung ste/ klong drug pa las/ thog bab po'i sems nyid la/ /snang ba thad kar rang sar dag /ces dang / snga ma las/ shar gnas grol gsum shar grol rgyun chad med/ /rgyun chad med pas sgyu lus bar ma chod/ /sogs so/ /chos sku thig le nyag gcig ye shes zang thal gcig po 'og ma'i lam gyi thabs shes rab lta bu'i rkyen la ma ltos par rjen par rig pa'i ngang der ma grol ba'i rtog pa gang yang med pas de'i ngang ma shor na lus kyi 'gro 'dug dang / ngag gi smra brjod yid kyi bsam rtog thams cad med pa gsal snang tsam las rig pa'i ngo bor ma grub pas mtshan nyid med pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su rang shar ba ste/ snga ma las/ ji ltar 'dug kyang rang gi ngang la 'dug /ji ltar gnas kyang rang gi ngang la gnas/ /ji ltar 'gro yang sogs bsam rtog bral ba dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs/ /zhes gsungs/ don la rig pa'i ngang las ma g.yos pas rig pa 'gro 'ong smra brjod dran rtog thams cad kyi yul las 'das par bzhugs pa'o/ /de ltar rig pa gcig pu'i ngang las ma g.yos na sku gsum gyi dgongs pa yang de las gzhan na med de/ de nyid las/ med la cir yang 'byung ba sprul ba'i sku/ /sogs nas 'bras bu'i sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i klong / /zhes so/ /la bzla zhes pa ni/shes shing thag chod pa'i don te 'di ltar me gcig gi mtshan nyid shes pa dang bu ram gcig gi ro shes pas bu ram thams cad mngar ba dang me thams cad tsha ba 398

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥste/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ /me yi rang bzhin tsha ba dang / /bu ram rang bzhin mngar ba ltar/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gcig /ces so/ /gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa tsam nyid la/ /sangs rgyas zhes su ming du btags par zad/ /ces so// ༈ dang po 'char gzhi khregs chod kyi gleng gzhi ni/ snying tsitta rin po che mchong gur phub pa lta bu gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ rig stong chos sku thig le nyag gcig ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/rang snang ye shes kyi tshom bu 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ rig stong chos sku thig le nyag gcig mngon sum rtogs nas nyams su myong ba'i cha nas chos phun sum tshogs pa/ lus kyi rten 'brel tshang ba'i cha dus phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'char ba yul gyi gleng gzhi ni/ phyi 'dus byas rdul bral nam mkha'i dbyings su dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ rig gdangs rdo rje lu gu rgyud ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/ sku dang ye shes 'khor— rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du rtogs nas nyams su myong ba'i cha nas chos bzhugs stangs dang gzigs stangs 'dzoms pa dus phun tshogs pa'o//༄tsho/ /gol sa gsum ni kun gzhi ni shes pa lung ma bstan kha phyi bltas kyi shes pa ngo bo rtog med/ rnam pa dwangs gsal/ snod bcud po la dmigs pa/i snang na snang / i 'dzin na mi 'dzin/ phyi'i yul la gtad/ nang du ma bsgom bar ma bzhag /zhabrul ni ma yin dub cha dang 'thib cha sogs gang yang med pa ngo bo kun gzhi shin tu rtog med/ rnam pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes gsal rig rig pa dper na btsas ma thag pa'i byis pa'i snang ba bzhin tu yul snang sgo lnga'i rnam 399

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥshes yul la ma mched pas bum sogs yul la 'dzin pa'i skru ris kyi bye brag mi phyed pas 'di yin 'di min gyi stangs ma byed pa yin/ klong chen pas/ mi zhig dka' ba'i shugs kyis rtog pa rgyun 'gags pa kun gzhi yin gsungs/ tha mal ba rnams dka' ba'i shugs dang / 'jigs snang dang / dran brjod kyi dus su kun gzhi de nyid rkyen gyis bskyed ni red/ rnal 'byor pas sgom stobs kyis bskyed ni red/ lhag mthong dang 'od gsal rig pa'i rgyal po snying dbus su sad pa'i tshe de min/ gzhan du chos thams cad bden stong gi shes rab dang 'gyu cha la grol cha yod pa sogs lhag mthong la rnam grangs mang gsungs/ ci la gnas dang ting nge 'dzin skyon med pa bdag med gnyis rtogs kyi stong nyid dang /rdzogs chen pas/ 'od gsal gyi ngang la gnas pa sogs ci yang med pas so//dbang shes nang nas mig shes la yid shes kyi grogs byas nas nam mkha' la gtad pas phyi'i nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i nyams 'char gsungs/ de yang rig pa'i ngang bskyangs kyang sgom thun ring na rig pa'i sa phud nas mig shes la zhen te nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i nyams 'char rtags ni/ ri mthon po'i rtse dang nam mkha' dwangs pa dang khang pa'i sgo dang skar khung phye ba'i dus su sngar bas kyang dwangs gsal gyi rnam pa 'char ni red gsungs/ mig btsum pa dang / gnam ngo zhabrugs pa dang / mun rub kyi dusadang / sgo dang skar khung bcad dus 'thib cha byung ba ni mig shes la gol ba'i 'bras rtags yin/ stong gsum mun par zhakhrugs kyang nga mi 'thib/ /stong gsum me ltar 'bar kyang nga mi 'tshig /ces gsungs pa'i don ni/ rmi lam dang bar do'i 'od gsal sogs gang du zang thal 400

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsu nga 'bum/ āḥdu shar ba yin te/ de 'dra'i yul rkyen 'jigs skrag sogs kyis gos pa'i g.yo ba med gsungs/ gegs sel ni/ ri mthon po'i rtse dang / mig btsum pa dang /sngon du gyang log gis bcad nas bsgom dgos gsungs/ /yid shes ni/dbang shes mngon sum la ma brten par/ /yid shes rjes dpag 'byung ba mi srid do/ /zhes gsungs/ dbang yul shes gsum 'phrad dus dbang shes kyis mngon sum red/ yid shes kyi yul rjes dpag yin pas yid shes kyi yul rnams rang gi mngon sum yin snang shar kyang mngon sum ma red/ rjes dpag red/ rjes dpag gi yul shes ni de shes rgyud gcig yin ni gi yin gsungs/yid shes kyi nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum dang / de gsum gang yang shan ma byed pas ltong had had po dang bzhi po 'di yid kyi yul du myong bya yin/ myong byed de rnams 'dzin mkhan gyi yul can yid shes yin gsungs/ nyon yid ni/nyams rnams gang rung la chags shing zhen pa'i 'bral mi phod pa lta bu 'dod chags/ rtsub nyams dang yid mi bde ba sogs byung na de 'dor ba'i rnam pas mnar sems can zhe sdang / 'dor len gyi rnam pa min pa'i bar ma'i rnam par rtog pa gti mug /de lta bu'i kun gzhi lung ma bstan dang / sgo lnga'i rnam shes/mig shes shas che ba'i mig shes dang / yid bde gsal mi rtog gsum dang /de gsum shan ma byed pas stong had had po dang bzhi po 'di gol sa chen po gsum yin te/ rang gi nyams len dang gol sa de rnams nor mi nor brtags dpyad legs par shin tu byed pa gal che/ res 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag res gong gi gsum po sems thog tu blangs te bsgoms nas res mos 401

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbyasatebasgomasaṅgesagongarngashergeolasadernams dang 'dres ma 'dres sdo/na legs par 'byed pa yin no gsungs/sems can gsar skye yod med ces/theg pa 'og ma spyi'i chos skad dang /snga rabs kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig rnams kyis gsar skyes med par bzhed/ rang lugs la yod de spyi gzhi thog ma'i klong dang 'char lugs drug yan chod la sems kyi ming ma grub pas so/ /rang ngo la rig ma rig gi tha snyad las 'das pa'i phyir ro//'dzin lugs la rig gdangs shar ba de nyid ngo ma shes pas rgyu bdag nyid gcig pa'i ma rig pa sogs sems la gnyilha 'dzin skyesna pas sems canā red//yulayulacan gnyis po glo bur byung //ོṅgi ོ༵/ /'ashāṭwāṃ snabye la//sa ma /byu/nga /phyas 'ane pa las byung bas gsar skyes so/ /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lam nyams su len tshul/spyir 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum yod pa las/ dang po sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bzhig pa'i man ngag /de la rtsad bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtag pa dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po rtsad bcad pa ni/ rkun po ngos 'dzin lta bu'i man ngag khams gsum zhabor ba'i zhabor rtsa ngos zin dgos pa yin/ 'di'i skabs su deng sang gi khrid mkhan phal cher gyis slob bu rnams la khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum gtso gang che dpyod kyis zer/ des kyang kha kha rgyug mchu mchu rgyug tsam gyis khos cig bsam 'dug gi thog mar 'khrul mkhan sogs sems yin pas sems gtso che zer/ yang de la khyod kyi sems la kha dog dang dbyibs gzugs sogs yod med dang byung gnas 'gro gsum la rtog dpyod gyis dang zer/ des kyang ci yang med gi zer ba tsam na khyod shes yod gi da ma bcos par zhog la a gtad sogs su ltos nas bsgom zer na'ang / de 'dra 'chad pa la phyi sgo phyi nas bsdam/ nang sgo nang nas bsdams te gsang rgya dam por byed mi dgos/ de phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gang gi yang lugs ma red/de lta bu zhig jo rgan ma zhig gis kyang shes nus pas de tsam ston pa'i ched rdo rje 'chang byon yang mi dgos pas srol ngan de phyin chad snub thub dgos gsungs/rang lugs la gang zag gi bdag 'dzin 'khor rtsar bzhed pas blo phyin ci log 403

g.yu khog bla ma chos dgings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgi ngor phung po lnga'am lus ngag yid gsum la bdag gam ngar snang ngo / /de la bdag tu 'dzin pa'am ngar 'dzin par byed pas de nyid dgag bya'i snang tshul nges pa zer ba yin pas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin 'khor rtsar bzhed pa yin/chos kyi bdag 'dzin shes sgrib yin par 'dod do/ /rgyal tshab byams pas/'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib pa ra 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa de mdo nas sngags kyi bar du de ltar khas len pa las/ gzhan du sgyur mi dgos/ gzhan gyi lhan po rgyab mi dgos gzhan dang bsre mi dgos bsre na mi 'grigs/ ji ltar mi 'grigs na/ phyi rabs pa dag gis dgag bya la bden grub sbyar nas de nyid dgag bya nges par bzhed nas bden 'dzin nyon sgrib tu 'dod pas chos kyi bdag 'dzin yang 'khor rtsar bzhed pas gang zag gcig gis blo ngor 'khor rtsar 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis bzung mi bde bas mi 'grigs/ gzhan yang rang lugs la nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med yongs su rdzogs par ma rtogs par 'dod pa dang / gzhan gyis nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med rdzogs par rtogs par 'dod pa sogs yin pas de gnyis bsre na mi 'grigs/ nga sa/ dper na gro ma dang mar khu bsres ba lta bu'i gcig la gcig gis phan thog pa gcig grogs gcig gis byed pa zhig yin na bsre chog pa la de min pas bsre mi dgos/ dper na rang lugs la nges shes gting nas skye/phu thag nang nas chod par byed pa gal che/ gzhan lugs la yang deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar du dad pa dag snang byed pa gal che bas de ni skye bo ya rabs kyi lugs yin gsungs/ spyir bod 'dir grub mtha' nyi tshe zhig dang bdun yod 404

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpas de dag thams cad la rang rang gi lam nas rnam grol byang chub sgrub pa'i ṅgiṭwāṃ /mi/ la ma nor ba re yod pa yin pas de rnams phan tshun bsre mi dgos ༈ gnyis pa mtshang btsal ba ni/ bdag 'dzin des ji ltar 'dzin na ril po gcig bden du 'dzin/ de nyid ldog byed gcig gi gnyen po du ma yin pas phung po lnga dang / de yang gzugs kyi phung po lta bu la mtshon na rdul phran cha med du bshig na gcig yin pa dang 'gal la/ bden pa'i gnyen po rdzun pa dang mi rtag pa yin pas skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba'i bdag nyid can de phra ba chos nyid kyi mi rtag pa dang / rags pa rgyun gyi mi rtag pa yin pas rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tsam las bden par grub pa med pa'i phyir na de ltar rtogs tshe bdag 'dzin rang log tu 'gro bas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa red/ lus ngag yid gsum gtso gang che brtags pa'i skabs 'dir sems gtso che bar 'dod kyang / zhib par brtags na lus kyang gtso che ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa la sor byang sngags gsum min pa'i sgor 'jug tshul med pas des na dang por so sor thar pa'i sdom pa rgyud la skye ba la gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med dang / de'i nang nas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling gi lus rten khyad pa ra can dgos te/ gzhan lha dang / klu dang / nam mkha' lding sogasal mi skye/ sangs rgyas dngos su byon kyang phan pa'i thabs med/ lha dang klu la sogs pa la byang sems kyi sdom pa tsam skye ba yod kyang sems kho nas mi yong / lus ngag yid gsum tshogs dgos/ sngags bla med kyi sgor 'jug pa la khams drug ldan gyi 405

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmi'i lus rten zhig min na dbang bzhi'i snod du mi rung ste mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu med pa'i phyir/ de bzhin tu dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba la yang lus gtso che ste dper na byis pa btsas ma thag pa zhig la mig dang rna ba gnyis ka med na mthong thos gang yang med pas chos dang 'jig rten gnyis kyi bya ba cung zad tsam yang bsgrub mi shes pas lus kyang gtso che ste/ de bzhin du ngag kyang gtso che bar gsungs te spang blang gi gnas ston pa la ngag mtshan nyid tshang ba smra shes shing brda 'phrod pa zhig nges par dgos te/ de med na dud 'gro'i sgra skad tsam gyis mi phan/ lus ngag yid gsum la brten nas 'byung ste/ lus kyi brang dang mid pa lce dang so rkan sogs la brten te sems kyis kun nas bslang te rlung gi rta la ngag yi ge phreng ba la brten pa tshig don thams cad 'byung bas ngag gtso che/sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang 'khor sems byung lnga bcu dang bcas pa de med na ro red/ thog mar 'khor bar skye ba po sems red/ lus ngag gnyis 'dor len byed 'gro ni red/ bdag 'dzin ma rig zhabrul ba'i dbang gis snang /snang ba ltar du zhen/ zhen pa ltar du a 'thas bden 'dzin gyis bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'am nga dang nga yi bar 'dzin pa sogs 'byung ba yin pas phyugs dang phyugs rdzi lta bu'i tshul gyis bdag gir 'dzin pa'am nga yi bar 'dzin ni red/spyir 'khor ba ya mtha' thug med/ skye ba ya mtha' thug med/ 'khrul ba ya mtha' thug med nas tha ma de rang da lta la ma thug gi bar du srid pa 'khor ba 'dir 'khyam ni red/ de'i gnas skabs na'ang 'khyams pa po'i gang zag de la ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas na lus ngag yid gsum mi tshang ba'i sems zhig med/406

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgang du 'byams pa'i gnas de la rigs drug 'khor ba'i gnas ris drug yong pas lus kyang tha dad do//'dod khams kyi lus ni gdos bcas sha khrag gi lus/gzugs khams rnams su dwangs ma 'od kyi lus/gzugs med na ting nge 'dzin yid rig gi lus yod par theg chen pa'i bzhed pa ltar lus ngag yid gsum tshogs pa la brten nas las bsags/las kyi dbang gis khams gsum 'khor bar skye ni red ma gtogs las ma bsags par sems rkyang ba 'khor bar skye ba mi srid do//dper na las ma bsags par sems kho na sngun nas nya lcags kyus 'dren pa lta bu khrid 'ong mkhan zhig dang /rjes nas sha ba khyis ded pa lta bu'i ded 'ong mkhan gtan nas yod pa min/las 'ba' zhig gis byed pa yin te/'jig rten las kyis byas shing las kyis sprul//lasani kun byed ri mo mkhan dang mtshungs//zhes zag bcas kyi las de la dge mi dge mi g.yo ba'i las dang gsum yod/de gang bsgrub kyang lus ngag yid gsum tshogs pa la brten dgos/sems rkyang bas mi 'grub/dag pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing na sku gsung thugs gsum mi tshang ba'i thugs rkyang ba zhig mi srid pas de ltar lus ngag yid gsum snyed pu sum tshugs lta bu yin pas gtso gang che ngos zin dka' na'ang mdo nas sngags kyi bar du sems 'di gtso che bar gsungs yod pas dpyad sgo tsam zhig btod nas da rang rang gis brtags shing dpyad nas lung rigs man ngag rnams dang mi 'gal ba zhig nges shes gting nas 'drong ba zhig ma skyes na rnam pa mi dag ni red gsungs/༈gsum pa byung gnas 'gro gsuX0 pya brtags pa ni/khregs chod ye bab

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsor bzhag dang de'i yang yig sogs sngon byon gyi rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung srol mang po yod kyang / skabs 'dir rdo grub rin po che'i zhal nas nyag bla rin po che la gsungs pa ltar 'chad pa la/ chos thams cad yul dang yul can gnyis su bsdu ni red/ dper na shes bya'i chos thams cad bden pa gnyis su bsdus nas bstan pa ltar yul thams cad byung sa gnas sa 'gro sa gsum du bsdus/ yum can thams cad byung mkhan gnas mkhan 'gro mkhan gsum du bsdus pa yin la/ dang po byung sa brtags pa'i tshe gzhi zhig la sbyar dgos pas/dper na mdun gyi ka ba lta bu dmigs tshe/ ka 'dzin mig shes kyis skad cig dang po ka ba'o snyam pa'i tshe nga'i shes pa 'di ka ba las byung ba yin nam min snyam nas/ de'i tshe yul can la mi dpyod par yul la dpyad nas ka ba rang gi ngo bo ye nas stong bzhin du snang cha ma 'gags par snang ba dang / snang bzhin du ngo bo ye stong spros pa dang bral ba'i bdag nyid du gnas pa yin te/ snang ba'i snang tshugs ma shor bzhin du stong / stong pa'i stong tshugs ma shor bzhin snang ba'i snang stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid du nges dgos/ gzhan gyis ka ba rang gi ngo bos mi stong ka ba bden grub kyis snyong par 'dod/ des na bden grub shes bya la mi srid pa dang / don dam dpyod pa'i ngor mi stong ba gnyis snang stong zung 'jug dang / thabs thabs byung dang / chos nyid chos can du 'brel ba med do/ /bden grub shes bya la mi srid pas/ des stong pa'i stong nyid kyang mi srid de/ rta ba lang gis stong zer ba lta bu yin/ gal te srid na yang snang stong zung 'jug mi rung ste/ngo bo tha dad 'dod pa'i snang stong zung 'jug skud pa dkar nag sbrel ba bzhin du 408
