g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir mdo laṅkar gshegs pa na/ stong nyid tha shal ba zhig dang bdun gsungs yod pas gcig gcig gis stong pa dang / mo ga ma bus stong pa dang / ri bong rwas stong / dbul bo nor gyis stong ba sogs stong nyid tha shal ba yin pas/ 'di lta bu ni thar 'dod kyi skyes bus nyams su len bya'am bsgom bya min no/ /ka ba don dpyod kyi ngor mi stong par bden grub kyis stong par 'dod pas ni/ bden grub sogs zhig snang skye yod kyang ma stong bar ka ba bden grub rtag brtan ther zug gi rnam par yod gi gsungs so/ /bla ma rgya sde bas/ ka ba rang gi ngo bos stong par bzhed kyang stong nyid spros bral yin par bzhed pas snang cha spangs pa'i stong cha de spros bral yin par go rgyu med/ des rjes 'brang rnams kyis mi pham la snang stong zung 'jug nam du yang yod dgos na 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi ngor ka ba skya shing gi rnam par yod dgos so zer na yang / dngos su de la lan gsungs med kyang rang lugs 'dod tshul gyis khegs pa yin gsungs/ yul can la dpyad tshe mig shes lta bu la mtshon na yul gsal zhing rig pa'i cha de 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi 'bras rtags phyi la shar ba yin pas/ gsal zhing rig pa shes pa'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa yin te/ ma go ba go/ ma shes pa shes/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa zer ni red ma gtogs mar me lta bu gsal dkar bzhag ni 'dra 'dra zhig yod ni ma red/ dbyings spros bral stong chen gyi 'bras rtags phyi la shar bas ngo bo ye stong spros pa dang bral ba/ dbyings ye zung 'jug gi cha nas shar ba'i 'bras rtags su de gnyis zung 'jug dbyer med kyi bdag nyid can yin pas 409

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'adi ni seng ge dkar mo'i bu rgyud lta bu yin gsungs/ des na rdo grub rin po ches dbyings ye zung 'jug 'di chos thams cad kyi dbus na gnas yod/ srog tu zhugs yod/ phyag rgyas btab yod gsungs pas na da lta'i snang ba 'di dag thams cad bdes gshegs snying po'am gnyug ma'i 'od gsal gyi bar na gcig gis kyang chod yod ni ma red phyag gi mdzub mo bsgrongs te 'di'i 'ba' ri 'bu ra ka si ko se 'di cig yin ni red gsungs te bzhad song gsungs so/ /rdo grub rin po ches sbyor dngos rjes gsum zhig tshang dgos/ de tshang nas lo gsum bar tu byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi lta ba 'di bsgom nus na dngos gzhi khregs chod sogs bsgom rgyu ma byung bar shi song na bar dor grol thub gsungs ni red/'di ni shin tu yag ste/ 'di 'dra go rgyu zhig yod ni ma red/ gang zag des bar do'i snang cha thams cad snang stong zung 'jug la sogs par nges pas mnyam bzhag gi ring dus der mtha' bzhi'i 'dzin pa dang / rtag chad du 'dzin pa dang /chos dang bdag 'dzin sogs gang yang mi 'dzin/ 'di ni lam zhugs kyang yin/rdzogs pa chen po yang yin/ mdor na 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad dbyings ye zung 'jug gam snang stong zung 'jug min pa gcig kyang med/ ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas na sa/nga snang gi chos thamasacad snang stong zung 'jug min pa gcig kyang med/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i dus na gdod ma'i stong chen gyi dbyings las shar ba'i snang cha zhing sku sogs ye shes rang snang gi bkod pa mtha' yas par snang ba yin gsungs/ rnal 'byor lam pa'i gnas skabs na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs dbyings ye zung 'jug mngon sum du 410

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrtogs nas rjes thob du gang snang snang stong zung 'jug du bun bun shig shig tu shar thub pa yen gsungs/ bla ma nyag blas rdo grub rin po che la skabs 'di'i byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi lta ba dang / dbu ma'i lta ba gnyis la mtho dman yod dam med zhus tshe/ mtho dman los yod/ dbu ma mdo red/ de yan chad na sngags kyi rgyud sde gsum yod/ de yan na yang sngags nang rgyud sde gsum de'i nang nas kyang theg dgu'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga yin pas khyad los yod/ gter ston tshang khyad gzhi'i steng nas khyad chos chen po zhig 'jog rgyu yod ni red gsungs/ 'o na 'dzin stangs yod dgos sam mi dgos zhus tshe de dgos na sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshig pa ma red brtsigs pa red gsungs/ bla ma lung rtogs tshang gis ni 'dzin stangs yod dgos gsungs ni yin zhus tshe/ 'o gsungs pa yin gsungs/ bla ma nyag blas rin po ches 'jin stangs med gsungs pa yin/ bla ma lung rtogs tshang gis yod dgos gsungs ni yin/ bla ma tshang khyed kyis gang ltar bzhed pa yin gsungs pas/ khong gi 'dzin stangs 'jog ni min zhus/ ༈ de na khyad gzhi'i steng gi khyad chos ji ltar yod lags zhus tshe/ snang stong zung 'jug nges pa'i nges shes mar me lta bu'i steng nas mnyam bzhag la ltod se bzhag pa'i dus der mtha' bzhi'i 'dzin stangs gang yang med pas de'i 'bras rtags la ngo bo'i dbyings la shar cha 'gags med du 'char thub pa 'di dbu ma la med pa'i khyad chos yin/ spyir khregs chod kyi lam shar grol dus mnyam yin pas/ de dus shes rgyud la byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi lta bas khyab yod pa'i 'bras rtags su gnyen po gzhan 411

gakhu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbasten mi dgos par rang grol du 'gro ba 'di dbu ma la med pa'i khyad chos yin/spyir khregs chod kyi lam shar grol dus mnyam yin pas 'di dngos gzhi'i shar gro'/ mtshan nyid pa min yang shar grol gyi mgo 'di nas rtsom pa yin pa'i gnad kyis 'di khregs chod kyi sngon 'gror 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin gsungs/gzhan yang byung gnas 'gro gsum brtags tshul ni/ glo bur zhakhrul ba'i snang ba 'di thog ma'i gzhi dus na med pas byung sa'i gnas kyis stong / bar du gnas sa yang med de glo bur gyi mgron po lta bu nyag gcig yin te/ dper na mig nad can gyis nam mkhar skra shad mthong ba dang / mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por snang ba dang / chu chab rom gyis bsdams pa bzhin du glo bur gsar byung gi bdag nyid yin pas gnas pa'i ngo bo stong / mthar phyin 'bras dus na med pas 'gro sa'i yul gyis stong ba yin no/ /rong klong mi pham sogs kyis bzhed pa ltar/snang ba lhar bsgrub pa dang / yul can ye shes su bsgrub pa'i skabs/ tha snyad tshad ma de la tshur rol mthong ba la brten pa'i kun tu tha snyad pa'i tshad ma dang /dag pa'i gzigs pa la brten pa kun tu tha snyad pa'i tshad ma gnyis las/ dang po de la mngon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma sogs kyi ngor ma dag pa'i snang ba las dag par snang mi nus la/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes ngor gnyis snang mtha' dag nub pa'i tshul gyis yul yul can du 'dzin pa'i gzung 'dzin sogs gtan log tu song ba dang / rjes thob kyi skabs na'ang snang ba bden med du 'char ba dang / sa brgyad pa'i gnas skabs na rjes thob tu snang srid dag pa rab 'byams shar thub pa'ang yod/ khyad par sangs 412

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrgyas kyis dag pa'i gzigs ngor chu'i rdul phra rab gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi zhing khams ston 'khor dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gzigs pa ni gnas lugs mthar thug gi gzigs pa tshad ma yin pas na da lta'i so skyes 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'di dag thams cad tshad ma yang dag min par rdzun pa bslu ba'i chos can yin par mthar thug gis tshad ma de dag gis rtogs thub par gsungs pa'o// ༈ rig pa yin pa'i rtags su rtog pa rang rgyud pa gcig 'char ni ma red gsungs/ ༈ gol sa thams cad dang sems kyi dri ma tsam yod rung ni ma red gsungs/ rnam rtog thams cad rig pa'i rnam ldan du 'char dgos gsungs/ dper na nyi ma shar na mun pa 'thib long med pa bzhin du rig pa kho rang shar dus rnam rtog thams cad rig pa'i rnam ldan du shar 'gro ni red gsungs/ ༈ dran shes bsten tshul ni/ dran pa rnyed na sgom rnyed/ dran pa stor na bsgom stor/ dran shes zhes pa ni go bzhin shes bzhin pa de'i ngang nas dran shes bsten gyi red gsungs/ ༈ mnyam bzhag la lhod yod dgos/ de'i ngang nas rtsal gang shar bag chags gsog long med par grol bas rjes thob zer/spyod lam gyi skabs rig pa bsgrim dgos gsungs pas so mi pham pas man ngag byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /sgom pa ri rgyal rgya mtsho bzhin/ /zhes gsungs/༈ ye gzhi 'pho 'gyur med pa gdod ma'i ngangaX blo 'das spros bral ka dag bla ma laX 'khrul med rang rig ngang nas gsol ba 'debasaḥ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobasaḥ zhes soḥ ye nas 'khrul med rig pa ston mdzad pa'iḥ gdod ma'i mgon po ye sangs rgyas de laḥ bka' drin dran pa'i ngang nas 413

gsol ba 'debasaḥsnod bcud chos skur grol bar byin gyis rlobasaX rig stong chos sku'i bla ma yisaX rig pa'i bu yi bzhed don brisaḥ sngags kyi srung mas bya ra gyisaX dam nyams lag tu ma shor byos/ / sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgyaḥ

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ༄༅/ /bsgom ma myong dang zhes sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyi khungs dang don 'grel/gter brgyud rnam thar las/ spa gro gnam thang dkar po sog dmag 'joms: las su dmag zhabrug byed cing lcags cha gyon bum thang rtsis lung sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas byung gter ston bon po brag tshal zhes bya 'byungaḥ zhes gter ston 'di gtsang rong zar gyi phyogs su zhabrungs/ rus bon po yin pas der grags/ bee ro dpal seng zung du 'jug pa'i rnam 'phrul/ rten sngags 'chang / sku gzugs che stobs ldan pa la bla dgas mtshan brag tshal dang / gsang mtshan rdo rje 'bar du grags/bum thang rtsis lung ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku li ma bzhugs pa'i lha khang la/ mon pa rnams kyis dkon mchog gsum gyi lha khang zer/ gter gnas de nas rdzogs chen gu ru zhi ba/ gu ru zhi ba'i lo rgyus kyis mtshon shrī seng ha'i rdzogs rim bla ma dmar khrid zer ba'i pusti gdan drangs/ 'di yi nang na/ sgom ma myong dang bral ma myong : mi sgom don dang mi 'bral ba zer ba'i man ngag de yod gsungs/ 'di byang gter ka dag gi skabs su yang slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas mchims phu'i yang dben na bzhugs dus su/ mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa'i zab mo gnad kyi them bcu las/ o rgyan chen pos sngon rig 'dzin shrī seng ha'i spyan sngar gdams ngag zab mo 'di zhus pa'i dus su 416

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsgom ma myong dang bral ma myong / /mi sgom don dang mi 'bral ba/ /de nyid rang skyong bas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob zin gyi zhes gsungs/ dpal sprul rin po ches gsungs pa'i theg mchog a ti'i man ngag gnas lugs gsal ston du lung drangs pa/ rdzogs chen gu ru zhi ba las/ sgom ma myong dang bral ma myong / /mi sgom don dang mi 'bral ba/ /zhes gsungs pa la gang shar sgom yin pas na blos bcos pa'i sgom tu med pas sgom ma myong / ye nas don med 'chal ba min pas rang thog tu 'jog pa de dang 'bral ma myong / mi sgom don de lta bu dang rgyun du mi 'bral bar gyis zhes pa'i don no/ /zhes gsungs so//༄tsho/ /rigs drug bsreg sbyong gnad bsdus/ /skal ldan 'jug ngogs las/lha'i sa bon nga rgyal te/ de la dbye na bdun/ lha min gyi sa bon lta ba ste de la dbye na lnga/ mi'i sa bon the tshom/ dud 'gro'i sa bon gti mug gam ma rig pa ste 'di gnyis don gcig par mdo las bshad do/ /yi dwags kyi sa bon 'dod chags/ dmyal ba'i sa bon khong khro'am zhe sdang ste/ de dag gi 'khor ni khro ba la sogs pa nye nyon rnams las ci rigs par sbyang ba rnams so/ /zhes gsungs/nga rgyal bdun ni/ rang las yon tan chung ba la dmigs nas 'di las bdag che la mtshungs pa dang mnyam mo snyam pa nga rgyal tsam mam chung ba'i nga rgyal/mtshungs pa bas kyang bdag che'am 'phags la che ba dang mnyam par 'dzin pa che ba'i nga rgyal/ che ba las kyang bdag 'phags snyam pa nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal/nga 'o snyam du nyer len gyi phung po lnga la bdag dang bdag gir lta ba nga 'o snyam 416

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpa'i nga rgyal/ gong ma'i yon tan ma thob pa la thob bo snyam pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal/ches 'phags pa bas bdag cung dman mod kyi 'on kyang bzang ngo snyam pa cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ yon tan min pa'i skyon nyid yon tan du rlom nas nga rgyal ba log pa'i nga rgyal ba'o/ /lta ba lnga ni/ mkhas 'jug rtsa ba las/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba ni/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la bdag dang bdag gi bar lta ba ste/ lta ba gzhan gyi rten byed pa'o/ /mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba ni bdag gam phung po lnga la rtag pa dang chad par 'dzin pa ste/ dbu ma'i lam gyis nges par 'byung ba la bar du gcod pa'i las can no/ /log par lta ba ni/ las rgyu 'bras sogs yod pa'i don la med par lta ba ste/ dge rtsa gcod par byed pa'i las can no/ /lta ba mchog 'dzin ni/gong gi lta ba ngan pa gsum dang lta ba'i gnas nyer len gyi phung po lnga la mchog dang dam par lta ba ste lta ngan la mngon par zhen par byed pa'o/ /tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin ni/ /'dag grol ma yin pa'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs dang de'i gnas phung lnga la 'dag grol nges 'byin du lta ba ste/ngal ba 'bras bu med par byed pa'i las can no/ /zhes dang / the tshom ni/bden pa'i don la yid gnyis za ba ste/ dge ba'i phyogs la mi 'jug pa'i las can no/ /zhes gsungs/ skal ldan 'jug ngogs las/ 'dir sbyong byed kyi gnyen po sgom pa na'ang / brten pa'i sa bon drug po de bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi mes bsreg pa dang / rten kyi sa bon drug po de yi ge gsum las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi mes bsreg pa ṭwāṃ7/ de lta bu'i rigs drug sreg sbyong byas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥn don la gnas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so//༄tsho/ /rmi lam 'dzin tshul gyi zhal gdams nyung bsdus/ spyir rmi lam sogs dang po zin pa la phyis ni mi zin par 'gyur ba'i rigs ni khrid gzhung rnams las ni dge sbyor gyis 'dun pa zhan du thal ba dang / dkor zas kyi rigs dang khyad par dkon mchog gi sku gsung thugs rten btsong ba'i sku glud za ba'i rigs dang / dam tshig nyams chags kyi rigs rang gis ma tshor bar yod pa'i rigs sogs las rmi lam du dge sbyor 'grib 'gro bar bshad kyang / khyed la de 'dra'i rigs 'phral du 'ong don med tshe rang bzhin gyis na so rgan du song bas 'byung ba'i cha thams cad rim gyis rgud du song ba'i stabs kyis dge sbyor rtsal yang chung ngur 'gro bar snang bas de 'dra zhig yin shas che yang 'od gsal gyi gong ltar nyin snang gi dge sbyor dran rig rjen pa skyong ba'i rtsol ba zhan du ma song na rmi lam tsam ma zin kyang skyon chung la/ nyin snang gi thugs dam dngos 'di zhan du 'gro na ni rmi lam zin thabs kyang med la skabs re tsam zin pas phan pa med pas/ gtso bo dran rig yengs med kho rang la dmar 'jus byed pa gal che zhing / de'i ngang la nyin par gyi bya byed smra brngod za 'thung 'gro 'dug sogs snang ba ci shar thams cad rmi lam gyi rang bzhin yin no snyam pa dang / rmi lam gyi snang ba 'di 'khrul ba rang shar btang na mi rung bas thugs dam zin par bya'o snyam pa'i dran 'dun ma chad par byas na rmi lam yang zin par 'gyur la/de la dge sbyor gyis kyang sleb par 'gyur zhing / rmi lam zin yang thugs dam gyi ngo bo ma sleb na dgos ched med pas/ thugs dam nyid la gtso bor ston pa dang /418

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥganyid du 'gro khar rang nyid kyi snying khar 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gyi thig le rma bya'i mdongs tsam gcig gi nang du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'ja' 'od kyi sku lta bu mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad nas bzhugs pa gcig bsgoms la/ dad mos gdung shugs chen pos yid kyis gsol ba btab ste/ rmi lam 'khrul ba zhi nas rang rig 'od gsal mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs shig snyam pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ yang gnyid nam sad du dmigs pa dang mos gus de ka 'phro mthud cing gnyid du nam logs kyang 'di ma brjed par rgyun ldan du byas na byin rlabs che ba yin/ de ltar rgyun ldan du byas pas re 'ga' rmi lam zin pa byung yang dga' brod dang zhen pa mi bya/ gtan nas ma zin kyang sdug bsngal dang sgyid lugs pa sogs mi bya bar/ nyin par gyi snang ba thams cad rmi lam yin par shes pa dang sku thugs rten gnyis dbyer med du 'bung / gnyid du log khar dmigs pa 'di dus rtag tu rgyun mthud na 'phral mar zin thub pa ma byung yang gti mug gi sgrib pa sel ba'i dgos ched yod pa dang / phan yon dpag tu med pas de ltar rgyun brtson gnang bar zhu//༄7/ /phyag rdzogs lugs kyi nyon mongs lam du 'khyer tshul/ slob dpon gang drung gis khar seng a bo la gzer gdams brjod pa'i thugs dam gyi skor la 'phral rkyen zhe sdang drag po lta bu ngo thog tu bzhag kyang myur du rang zhi thub pa dka' ba zhig 'dug gsung pa de shin tu thugs bden te/ de ltar 'phral mar zhi thub pa rang gi thugs dam gyi rtsal dga' rab yod pa ma gtogs gang zag las dang po bas de ltar mi thub cing / spyir4 ༷ rnam rtog 'gyu ba phra mo'i rigs rnams

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥl ngos zin pa tsam gyis rang zhir 'gro ba ma gtogs de las thabs gzhan mi dgos pas ngos zin thog tu bskyar ba kho nas chog /zhe sdang drag po'i sdug bsngal na tsha zug zer sogs las ni/ de lta bu'i tshor ba drag po lhang lhang ba de ka la rang sems kho rang gis rtse gcig gis phur tshugs su hrig ger gtad nas rgyun bsrings bas de lhang lhang bar tshor ba dang tshor mkhan nam ngos 'dzin mkhan gyi sems de gnyis so so ma yin pa'i zhe sdang lhang lhang ba de thugs dam hrig ge ba de dang dbyer med pa'i thog tu bzhag pa la nan tan du yun bsring ba gnad du zab pa lags/ lar nyon mongs kha yan du ma shor bar byed pa 'di chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin na yang / de la gdams ngag lam du khyer tshul mi 'dra ba zhig theg pa'i rim pa'am/ gang zag dbang po'i rim pa'i khyad par yin phyir theg pa 'og ma kun la ni nyon mongs gnyen po bsten nas spang pa'i thabs kho nar gsungs/ theg pa bar ma'i skabasasu ni de dag la lha dang sngags dang dmigs pa'i gnad kyis nyon mongs ye shes su bsgyur ba'i thabs mang du gsung mod kyang / theg pa gong ma'i yang rtse phyag rdzogs kyi nyams len skabs su ni gang shar ci snang thams cad rang sems kyi 'char tshul tsam las ni ma 'das/ de dag la a 'thas dang bden 'dzin gyi rjes 'brang byas na/ chos nyid rnam rtog gi dbang du song ba yin pas chos kyi dgos pa mi 'byung bas na/ rnam rtog gam zhe sdang lta bu de zhi na zhi la/ ma zhi na ma zhi/ de gnyis la dga' mi dga' sogs dgag sgrub gang yang mi bya bar/ de ka'i rang ngo la cer re hrig ge gsal bar bskyang ba nyid la gcig dril du byed pa 'di ni/ nyon mongs na tsha sdug bsngal 420

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥ'ajigs skrag sogs rnam rtog thams cad kyi lam khyer lags//༄tsho/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len gnad bsdus nyag bla bsod rgyal gyis gsungs pa/ sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bzhig pa/ dngos gzhi rig pa ngo sprad pa/ rjes nyams len bshad pa dang gsum/ sngon 'gro la yang sems kyi rtsad bcad pa/ byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa/ rig pa ngosabazung thabs dang gsum las/ rtsad bcad lugs ni/ rgyu dge sdig byed mkhan 'bras bu bde sdug myong mkhan gyi gtso bo sems dang lus ngag gnyis de yi 'khor yin mod/ lus ngag ni sems kyi cho 'phrul chu dang chu bur lta bu yin pas sems gtso che'o/༈ byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag lugs ni/ 'di ltar phyi snod 'byung lnga dang nang bcud skye 'gro'i sgo gsum gyi rnam pa bzang ngan sna tshogs bden bden ltar yod pa 'di thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul rmi lam ltar yin la/ rang sems dus gsum gyi rnam rtog thams cad kyang / da lta'i rnam rtog skad cig ma zhig dang / bden grub yod med tshul mtshungs pas rnam rtog gcig skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar shes na/ chos thams cad bden med kyi don khong du chud pa ste dper na sdong po'i rtsa ba bcad pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na da lta rnam to ga gcig shar dus/ de skye ba'i yul de brtag cing dpyad nas bden med kyi rang bzhin du shes na/ byung sa/ gnas sa/ 'gro sa med pa/ gzung ba'i yul stong pa nyid kyi don mthong ba yin/ gang shar ba'i rnam rtog kho rang legs par brtag nas de yang rang bzhin med pa'i don rtogs tshe/ byung mkhan/ gnas mkhan/ 'gro mkhan gang yang ma grub par 'dzin pa'i sems stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs pa yin/421

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥde ltar gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad/ skye 'gag gnas gsum yod yod ltar 'brul ngor snang yang / brtag cing dpyad na gang yang ma grub par/bden med sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu'i tshul khong du chud dgos so// ༈ rig pa ngos bzung thabs ni/ sems rnam rtog glo bur ba 'di rnams ni yul dang yul can te/ gzung 'dzin gnyis re yod pa/ rgya chung ba/ 'dzin zhen dang bcas pa/'gyur ldog che ba yin/ sems nyid rig pa'i ye shes ni/ yul med rang gsal ba ma gtogs gzung 'dzin tha dad med pa/ gu yangs shing rgya che ba/ 'dzin zhen dang gtad so med pa/ nam yang mi 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin yin pas nor mi dgos so/ /kun gzhi sogs rtog med kyi sems dang rig pa nor mi dgos te/rig pa'i rang bzhin ni/ mkhyen cha lhun grub du yod pas rnam par mi rtog bzhin du kun shesakun rig rmongs pa'i dri ma med pa'o/ /dngos gzhi la/ rig pa'i ngo bo ma bcos rang thog tu ngo sprod pa/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad rig rtsal ro gcig tu ngo sprad nas thag gcig thog tu bcad pa/ rnam rtog gang shar thams cad rig thog tu grol lugs bshad pa'o/ ༈ngo sprod ni/ rnam rtog dang ma nor ba'i shes rig rang bab rang gsal dwangs sang nge ba/ yang ha re ba/ bzo bcos gang yang mi dgos pa/ bzhig rgyu med pa/ ci tsam bshig kyang je gsal je dwangs 'ong ba/ngo bo 'pho 'gyur mi 'gro ba 'di ni rig pa chos sku ma nor ba yin pas 'di las lhag pa'i sems ngo zhig ston rgyu med do// ༈ thag bcad lugs ni yul sna tshogs dang / rnam rtog bzang ngan thams cad rig pa ye shes kyi rang rtsal chu dang rlabs lta bu tha dad gnyis su snang yang / don la gnyis 422

g.yu khog bla ma chospodabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsu med pa yin pas spang blang gang yang mi dgos par rig pa ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin ro gcig tu thag chod pa zhig ni shin tu gal che'o// ༈ grol lugs ni/ rig pa bor shor nas rnam rtog kho na'i dbang du shor dus zhakhrul ba yin/rig pa ma yengs pa'i ngang nas rnam rtog thams cad rig pa nyid las shar/rig pa'i ngang du gnas/ rig pa la thim na grol ba yin/ de yang rnam rtog gis rig pa la phan gnod med par grol na rab yin/ rnam rtog la ngos bzung bzo bcos mi dgos par rang sar grol ba 'bring yin/ rnam rtog gis rig pa la gnod pa byung na yang 'di ni rig pa'i rang rtsal yin no snyam du ngo shes shing rig thog tu bzhag pas grol na ni grol lugs tha ma yin no/ /gang ltar yang / grol ba rig pa'i ye shes/ grol rgyu rnam rtog bzang ngan thams cad/ grol lugs rig pa'i ngang du rnam rtog rang sar dag pa chu la rlabs thim/ pa ltar grol dgos so// ༈ rjes nyams len skyong tshul la yang / sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu'o/ /༈ snom pa la mnyam rjes gnyis las/ mnyam bzhag ni/ gnas dben par/tshams legs par bcad/ sgo gsum gyi bya ba gzhan thams cad btang nas stan bde ba la lus drang po bde lugs su g.yo 'gul med par 'dug /mig mi 'gul bar thad kar ha re blta/ rlung ro legs par bsal zhing rlung kha nang nas phyir dal bus phar btang / kun slong legs par bcos/ bla ma la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas thugs yid bsre/ de nas rig pa bzo bcos med par gsal ye re rang babs su bzhag /de'i ngang du yul snang bzang ngan gang shar spang blang med par rgya mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar 'dzin med du bzhag rnam 423

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrtog bzang ngan gang shar yang rig rtsal chu dang rlabs lta bu yin pas mi spang /rnam rtog gi rjes su mi 'brang / rnam rtog la lta rtog ngos len gang yang med par rig pa ma bcos pa'i ngang du ma yengs 'dzin pa med par bzhag go/ /rmugs 'thib byung na bshig nas rig pa gsal zhing dwangs cha thon pa zhig gnad che/goms 'dris thub na nyams skye yang / nyams bzang ngan thams cad re dogs spang blang med par rig pa'i ngo bo kho na skyong ba gnad yin/ mthar bsngo smon tshad ldan re byas te thun grol bar bya'o/ /mnyam bzhag la nan tan yun bsrings te snying rus ma thub na/ kha lta stong skad kyi lta sgog dang / 'gro 'dug lam khyer gyi bsgom snang tsam gyis sems rgyud grol shin tu dka'o/ /rjes thob la/ rig pa cung zad bsgrims nas ma yengs pa'i ngang du/ 'gro 'dug za nyal/ gtam smra ba/las byed pa/ de thams cad kyang rig pa'i rang rtsal 'dzin med rang grol gyi tshul du re dogs dang bral ba/ sbang blang med par lam du khyer dgos so/ /spyod pa la/ chos brgyad ro snyoms kyi gsang spyod dang / dge sdig blang dor gzhud bzhin du spyod pa'o/ /gsang spyod ni/ rnyed pa/ bstod pa/ snyan grags/ bde ba ste/ 'jig rten mthun phyogs kyi chos bzhi ci tsam byung na yang / desarig pa'i ngo bo la phan pa rdul tsam med pas/ de dag la re ba/ 'bad rtsol chags zhen don gnyer gang yang mi byed par rig thog tu ro snyoms bya/ ma rnyed pa/ smod pa/ mi snyan par grags pa/ sdug bsngal te/ 'jig rten mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi chos bzhi po shugs drag la yun ring ba ci tsam zhig rang thog tu byung yang / des rig pa'i ngo bo la cung zad kyang mi gnod pas/ de dag las dgos pa bzlog thabs/424

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsems nad gnod lan sogs rtsol sgrub gang yang mi byed par rig thog tu ro snyoms thub na gsang spyod de lhag mi dgos so/ /de ma thub lta mtshang spyod pas phud zer ba de dang / lto 'grang nyi mas dro dus chos pa'i gzugs/ /rkyen ngan thog tu bab dus tha mal ba/ /zer ba de yin no/ /dge sdig blang dor gyi spyod pa ni/ bde sdug gi rgyu dge sdig gnyis ka rig rtsal yin mod/ snying rje dang bsgoms byung gi shes rab sogs dge tshogs thams cad gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa rtsol med du 'phel ba dang / gti mug dang bdag 'dzin log lta sogs sbang bya thams cad gnyen po gzhan mi dgos pa rtsad nas dag 'gro ba zhig dgos kyi/ dge ba spang sdig pa blang yang skyon med zer na/ de ni nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi las bcos dka' ba yin te/ rgyu dge ba spangs na de'i rang 'bras mtho ris thar ba'i gegs byed/ rgyu mi dge ba bsgrubs na de'i rang 'bras ngan song 'khor pa'i sdug bsngal gyi gzhi tshugs pa the tshom med des las 'bras bslu med kyi drang lam 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i phyag gis kyang bsgyur du med pas so/ /des na bla ma dkon mchog gsum por blo phug gtad/ rgyu 'bras yid ches kyi dad pa snying la 'chang / lto gos gtam gsum sogs tshe 'di'i bde skyid la gyong bskur/ gnas dben par brten/ grogs chos mthun dang 'grogs/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rjes su bslabs te/ gtong phod snying rus brtson 'grus thams cad dam pa'i chos kho na la byed/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du sgo gsum gyi dge rtsa phra mo tsam yang khyad du mi bsad par rig pa'i ngang nas dam pa gsum ldan rnam par dag pa kha zhe mtshungs pa re byas/ de la brten nas rang 425

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrgyud la yon tan bzang po ci tsam skyes kyang dge ba dang yon tan tshad bzung dang chog shes mi bya/ rang rtsis dang mngon zhen/ rlom sems dang nga rgyal ngom chos mi bya bar/ rang skyon la bsam nas dman sa bzung zhing / mi tshe lhag ma 'di dam pa'i chos kyis 'da' ba zhig la snying nas 'bad dgos lags/ sgo gsum gyi mi dge sdig lhung phra rags thams cad la dug bzhin 'dzem nas sdig sems dang po skye ba'i dus su shar grol dus mnyam du btang / de tsam ma byung yang chos zhus pa'i don sgo sdig sems kha yan du mi gtong ba zhig dgos pas gnyen pos 'phral du spang / gal te sdig pa dbang med du shor ba'am tshe rabs sngon gyi sdig sgrib kyi gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags thabs la 'bad/ tshe 'di'i snang ba skad cig tsam rmi lam ltar yid rton mi rung zhing snying po gang yang med pa 'di yi don du/ tshe phyi mar sdig pa ngan pa zhig rang thog tu khur mi dgos pa re byed dgos lags/ de ltar dge sdig blang dor gyi gnas mi brjed pa dran pa/ rang gi sgo gsum gyi bya ba la brtag pa shes bzhin/ 'jug ldog gi gnas la gzob pa lhur len pa bag yod rnams dang ldan pas dus rtag tu rang gis dge ba sgrub/gzhan la bskul/ byas pa la yi rang yang bya/ rang gi sdig pa spang / gzhan la sdig spang bskul/ byas pa la 'gyod bshags dang sdom sems bya/ mdor na g.yo sgyu med par rgyud drang pos mi tshe nam gnas kyi bar du dge sgrub sdig spang sna re yan chod la ci nus su 'bad par byas na/ rang gzhan kun la phan zhing gtan bde'i gzhi tshugs pa'i spyod pa yang dag ma nor ba yin no// ༈ 'bras bu ni/ spang rtogs kyi yon tan te/ de yang da lta nas rang rgyud kyi spang bya nyon 426

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmongs cung zad je chung la 'gro ba dang / dad pa ngesa'abyung / byams snying rje sogs dge sems gong 'phel du 'ong ba zhig yod dgos/ de ma byung na lta sgom bzang por rloms na yang rang rgyud la ma phan na dgos pa gang yang med de/ de yang mngon shesardzu 'phrul sogs rtags sna tshogs byung na yang / de la brten nas/ rnam g.yeng sogs sdig pa je 'phel chos dang je 'gal/ nyams rtogs je dman/ rang gshis je ngan byung na bar chad bdud kyi rtags yin pas spang dgos/ bzang ngan ma nges sna tshogs byung zhing de dag la re dogs dang zhen pa je che byung na 'phel 'grib nyams kyi rtags yin pas gang la'ang re dogs med pa zhig gal che/ rang 'dod chung zhing snying rje bcos min dang / bsgoms byung rig rtsal gyi shes rab sogs yon tan gong 'phel ji tsam byung yang / de dag la nga rgyal dang zhen pa/ 'dzin chags med cing rtogs pa je bzang je brtan/ rang gshis je bzang / zhabor ba la blo je thong / chos dang bla ma la yid je ches/ rang rgyud dam pa'i chos dang je mthun byung na yang dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /nyin gyi nyams len mnyam rjes gnyis khyad med lta bu brtan pa thob tshe/ mtshan mor gnyid srab 'thug gi 'od gsal ci rigs kyang shugs kyis zin pa'o/ /de las kyang nyams len gzab na nyin mtshan 'od gsal 'khor yug tu 'gro ba yang yod pa 'dra/ gal te mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag gis rmi lam zin pa'am/nub re re tsam la 'od gsal zin pa re byung na yang mnyam bzhag la brtan pa ma thob na/ rtag mi thub par 'ja' yal ba ltar yal 'gro ba mang po yod pa 'dra/'bras bu yon tan la re ba che bas gang yang mi phan/ yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyu 427

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdage sgrub sdig spang re gzab pa dang / nyams len la snying rus kha tsam min pa re bya ba ni gnad ma nor ba yin no/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ spang rtogs mthar phyin dzoogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang nyid yin la/ de yang spang bya sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa lhag med yongs su dag cing / rtogs bya ye shes yon tan ma lus pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas/ rang don chos sku mngon du gyur/ gzhan don gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis kyis gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las tshad med pa rtag khyab lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin/ rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ rgyun ring ba 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'bad rtsol med par 'byung ba yin no/ /'di rnams gnad zab nyung bsdus go bder bris pa yin pas rang gis gzigs rtogs mdzod/ dpe cha'i nang yod snyam nas bskyur ma bzhag /gzhan dag su la'ang ma ston/ dam tshig gi rgya yin no/ /nyag bla bsod rgyal gyi zhal rgyun no/ /dge'o//༄tsho/ /shan 'byed dang la bzla'i don mdo tsam bshad pa nyag bla'i zhal rgyun/rdzogs chen gyi skabs su 'dir sgrib gzhi'i gnas lugs la rig pa zhes bya ba/sgrib byed kyi dri ma la sems zhes bya/ snang tshul tsam la sems 'khrul zhing rig pa ma 'khrul ba'i khyad par shin tu che bas sems rig so sor shan phye nas/ rig pa rang thog tu ngo sprod pa la shan 'byed ces bya/ gnas tshul la ni zhakhrul ba'i sems kyang zhabrul med kyi rig pa nyid las rdul tsam med pas 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus kyi snang sems gang la yang spang blang dbye bsal gang yang mi dgos pa rig stong thig le nyag gcig tu kho thag chod pa la la bzla zhes 428

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbya'o/ /shan 'byed la brten nas grol gzhi ma bcos pa'i rig pa so ma ngo shes/la bzla la brten nas grol rgyu rnam rtog bzang ngan gang shar thams cad grol gzhi'i rig pa nyid las nam yang 'da' ma myong ba'i rang shar rang grol chu dang rlabs bzhin du ngo shes pa la rang grol mngon sum du ston pa zhes bya/ gnas tshul la rnam rtog thams cad rig pa nyag gcig las mi 'da' zhing rig pa de nam yang 'khrul ma myong ba'i ye grol chen po yin pas na/ grol ba rig pa dang chos can tha mi dad pas mi grol rgyu zhig mi srid pas grol tshul dang grol ba zhes kyang med do/ /snang tshul la grol ba ni rig pa nyid du ngo ma shes pa'i dbang gis shar ba'i 'khrul sems yul dang bcas pa'i rnam rtog glo bur du byung ba 'di rnams grol rgyu yin zhing / de'ang dang por rnam rtog gang shar thams cad rig pa las gzhan zhig yin yin ltar shar bas nga zhabrul song snyam du dogs pa shar na yang gnyug ma'i dran pas ngos zin ma thag tu dper na sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa ltar rig pa nyid kyi 'char tshul yin pa ngo shes nas grol ba dang gcigabar du rnam rtog gang shar thams cad rig pa las gzhan du 'dzin pa je chung du song nas dran pas ngos bzung la cher mi ltos/ dper na sprul gyi mdud pa grol ba bzhin du rnam rtog kho rang gnyug ma'i ngo bor rang shar rang grol du dag pa dang gnyis/ mthar rig pa dang rnam rtog gnyis tha mi dad par gang shar tshad gnyug ma'i ngo bor lam gyis stong nas/ snang ba phar ma chad/ rig pa tshur ma chad pa'i gnad kyis yul bzang ngan sna tshogs snang zhing rtog pa bzang ngan sna tshogs shar na yang rig pa la gang yang mi gnod cing / de ga ma snang ma shar yang 429

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ aḥrig pa la gang yang mi phan pa/ dper na khang stong du rkun ma zhugs kyang thob shor gyi phan gnod mi srid pa bzhin du ma shar ba'i tshe rig pa grol che rgyu'i phan pa dang / shar ba'i tshe zhabrul song ba'i shor rgyu'i gnod pa gang yang med par grol ba dang grol rgyu gnyis su med pa'i tshul du grol ba dang gsum po 'di grol tshul yin no/ /de ltar rig pa rang grol gyi nyams len la yang yang goms pas tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du sgrib pa gnyis ka rim gyis grol ba je cher song nas mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis snang gsum 'pho ba'i sgrib pa lhag med yongs su grol ba'i tshe rnam par grol ba mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che mngon du 'gyur pa lags so/ /'di'ang rdzogasapa po'i gsang lam nyams su blangs bas rtogs pa bzang po zhig byung ba de'i ngor gyu~X ṭwāoṃb//nga padma'i rig sngags kyi rigs kyi rtags tsam 'chang ba las rab gling ༄༅/ /'od gsal gyi rig pa de sha nang gi rmen bsal bsal①/ sa nang gi gser btsag ni 'dra 'dra/ sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi nang nas ngos zin dgos ni red/ 'o da dbang po dang shes pa gzhi mthun zhig srid ni ma red/ bem po yang yin pa shes pa yang yin pa zhig ga la srid/ rdul dwangs ba dper na mar me dang shel sbug lta bu zhig gi sgo nas yul mthong ni ma red/ mig btsum na sheru/ pa 'gags ni ma red dbang po'i sgo bkag ni red/ shes pa yang dbang po bkag na med na mi 'byung ba'i gtan tshigs red/ yid shes rtog med kyang skye 'gag byed kyi yod ni ma red/ gtso ()bsalaba'idorne/ 430

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsems yid kyi shes pa de mched pa'i tshe na bde gsal mi rtog gsum yang 'khor ba khams gsum du skye ba'i rgyu red/ yid shes dper na phar yul la gsal ba yin na gsal ba red ces zer ba lta bu min pa gsal bas rang ngo mi shes/sems sems byung dang bcas pa rkyen bzhi la brten nas skye dgos ni red/ rgyu snga ma shes pa de dang 'dra ba sogs sngon song zhig med na skye kha nyan ni ma red/dper na rgyu'i rkyen dang / shes pa snga ma 'gags nas phyi ma skye ba'i go ma phye na mi skye bas na/ de ma thag tu skye ba ni de ma thag ni rkyen nam/ bdag rkyen dbang po de med na mi 'byung ba'i gtan tshigs yin pas na bdag rkyen nam/ yul utpal sngon po lta bu de min na sngo 'dzin mig shes skye ba'i yul med pas na dmigs rkyen nam/ des kyang khyod kun gzhi dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnyis kyang gsal zhing rig pa shes pa'i mtshan nyid can zhig yin yang bye brag mi shes shing / spyi tsam 'dzin pa sna tshogs snang ba'i yul la kha phyir bltas kyi tshul du yod pa blun zhing rmongs pa zhig yin ni red/ yid shes des yul gzugs ka ba lta bu zhig bzung yod dus gzhan gcig skye kha nyan ni ma red/ gtso sems mig gi shes pa dang yid shes gzugs la gtad yod dus gzhan rnams snang la ma nges pa zer rgyu de red/ yid shes ni skye yang med ma song gi bar du gzhan gcig skye kha mi nyan par skye ba'i go bkag ni red/ rnam rtog skye tshad thams cad yid shes gcig pu re skye dus ni bkag ni red/ ma skyes dus ni med ni red/ skye na shes pa rang skyes ni red/ med na rang nyid med 'gro ni red/ de min gzhan zhig yod ni ma red/ 'o da stong sang nge yod rgyu de'i ngang na shes pa 'khrul mi shes ni zhig 431

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingalorang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥyod ni go dgos ni red/ de nyid rkyen bzhi las skye dgosani ma red/ 'dus byas yin ni ma red/ 'dus byas ni rkyen bzhi las byung ni red/ rten cing 'brel 'byung yin ni red/ rig pa yang rten cing 'brel 'byung min zer nyan ni ma red/shar cha 'gag med rten 'brel gyi tshul du 'char ni red/ 'od gsal rig pa'i dbyings nas shar cha shar yang khur durtsal las 'char ni red/ rang nyid yin ni ma red/ dper na mar me'i 'od zer yang / 'od kyis mar mer mi gnod/ mar mes 'od la mi gnod par 'dug ni red/ de bzhin tu 'od gsal rig pa'i dbyings su ci tsam shar yang / 'char gzhi la mi gnod/ gnod ni mi dgos lha mdzes pas rgyan btags ni 'dra 'dra rtsal las shar ba yin pas rtsal je 'bar/ngar cha je bzang du song ni red/ khyed kyi sngon la mi zhig song yang khyod med 'gro kha nyan ni ma red/ de bzhin du ci tsam shar yang zur du 'char gyi yod ni 'dra 'dra zhig yin ni red/ yid shes de dper na mi rang nyid 'gro gi yod ni 'dra 'dra zhig yin ni red/ 'dug na rang 'gro na rang gcig pu lta bu/ shes rig rang tshugs ma shor ba'i dus na bde gsal mi rtog gsum yang sku gsum gyi nyams zhes zer ni red/ sku gsum nyams ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de yi dus na yul dang yul can sems sems byung dang bcas pa ye shes kyi rol pa yin ni red/ rtsal las rol pa zer rgyu de/ dper na mig shes des gzugs de rol ni red/ lha yab yum bzhag na mig shes yab des gzugs yum de tshur rol ni red/ dper na mar me lta bu zhig yin na/ nang du sdong shing dang phyi ru skru nyag khri phrag zhis/ yod kyang / me gcig gi rnam ldan du (lko rang / 432

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi sa/sung 'bum/ āḥ'abar gi yod ni lta bu sems dang rig pa gnyis snang ba dang mun pa'i khyad par tsam zhig yod ni red/ rig pa ni khyim nang mar me bzhag pa lta bu gsal khyer 'khyil le yong ni red/ rtsal las shes rab snying rje dad pa sogs rtsol med du rgyas yongs ni red/ sems ni ma rig pa glo bur dri ma 'dzin zhen can yang gcig gi rgyab gcig yod ni red/ gcig pu ni spus gtsang ba de lta bu zhig gtan nas yin ni ma red/ rig thog tu yod dus sems sems byung dang bcas pa ye shes kyi rnam ldan du shar dgos spyad de/ dper na rtsa phung zhig me la bsreg dgos na/ rtsa de la me len pa'i nus pa zhig yod ni red/ de bzhin du sems sems byung dang bcas pa de gsal zhing rig pa zhig yin rgyu de gang gi cha nas 'jog dgos na/ 'od gsal rig pa'i cha nas 'jog dgos ni red/ me dang tsha ba chu dang rlan bzhin du khyab bya khyab byed kyi tshul du khyab yod nis gnad kyis sgom pa'i tshe na ye shes kyi rnam ldan du 'char ni red/ gnas tshul de'i dbang gis gtso che 'gro ste/ ma rig zhen 'dzin sogs glo bur gyi dri ma yin pas gtso che bar mi 'gro/ bzhugs tshul la ye nas bzhugs kyang mthong tshul la skad cig mar mthong ni red/ de'i ngo de na yul dang yul can gzung 'dzin nam rang rgyud can gcig skye nus ni ma red/ sgo lnga'i shes pa'i steng nas sems dpa' brgyad bzhag na de ltar shes dgos ni red/ rig pa sku gsum ston pa'i sku/'khor sems byung dang bcas pa 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs ni red/ dkyil 'khor gsum ldan dgu ldan sogs kyang de ltar ro/ /dper na lce thog bu ram zhig bzhag na sems sems byung dang bcas pa mngar ba'i rnam ldan du 'gyur ni 433

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥred/ rtogs ldan zhig yin na yul dang yul can ye shes 'ba' zhig tu shar ni red/ rin chen gser gling sogs mthun dpe bzhag yod ni red/ chab rom la chu'i rgyas thebs yod ni 'u nam zhig chu ru 'gyur ba bzhin du chos rnams chos kyi dbyings kyis rgyas ma thebs pa zhig med ni red/ chu gcig la yang sa rdul me rdul sogs rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus drug 'dus sogs yin kyang chu'i shugs che ba bzhin du khyab bya'i shugs mi che'o/ /shar bas gzhi la mi gnod pa me las du ba mched pa lta bu du bas me la mi gnod mes du bar mi gnod do/ /rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil zhabor zer rgyu de red/ rang rig rang shes 'brul ba bral/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ /snang srid dag pa rab 'byams zer rgyu de red/ de min bla ma phal cher la dad pa res 'ga' ba zhig yod rgyu de rgad po rgan mo rnams la'ang yod ni red/ snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang zer rgyu de thog yog brje 'jog ni red/ dang po nges pa 'drong dgos ni red/ nges pa rnyed nas myong ba thon dgos ni red/ dpal sprul gyis/rtogs ldan zhig yin na lus ma spangs nyid du dag pa mkha' spyod na bzhugs yod ni red/ ma dag mi dge'i las byed ni zhig yin na lus ma spangs nyid du srin po'i khrod gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sngon rgyal ba gong ma zhig yin na dam tshig snying ltar bsrung / dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus bzhir gnas bzhi re bsten pa dang / lto yang 'grang ches na dub yong ni red/ lto tshad la phab/ rje btsun mi las/ dbyar dro ba'i dus su gangs rtsar byon/ dgun grang ba'i dus su dma' mo'i lung gzhung du bzhugs ni red/ lus kyi las gsum bla ma'i sku'i dam tshig /ngag gi bzhi gsung gi— yid kyi gsum thugs kyi5 shig 43 1

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgacig bsad na sku'i dam tshig nyams ni red/ lta ba yid la ma byas na/ nyin zhag gcig song na ran ni red/ sngags la zhugs pa'i skyes bu ngan song dang / /sangs rgyas gnyis las 'gro sa gsum pa med/ /ces gsungs ni red/ yang na yar yang na mar de min bar de ni 'dug ni lha red na/ sngags na gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams zhen med du rol/ 'gag med du myong /rtog med du grol/yang mig shes lhod se bzhag te nam mkha' la gtad na nam mkha' dang 'dres pa lta bu'i nyams shar na nor sa gcig /yid shes kyis stong pa'o snyam pa dang /gsal ba dang / bde ba dang / mi rtog pa'o snyam pas nor sa gcig de mi na nor sa med pa dang 'dra/ dge'o/ /bkra shis/ /༄༅/ /kun tu 'gro ba'i lam lnga sob/sa bshad pa'i skor/ lam lnga ni/ dmyal ba gdung ba'i lam/ yi dwags 'gog pa'i lam/ byol song mun pa'i lam mi 'dam pa'i lam/ lha g.yeng ba'i lam mo/ /da lta dang phyis kyi bde sdug tu bgrod cing phyin par byed pas lam/ rigs mi 'dra ba lnga yod pas na lnga'o/ /mi min ni 'dod lhar bsdus pa'o/ /snyan brgyud rgyab chos las so/ /༄tsho/ /ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa ni sde snod gsum dang phyi rgyud gsum/ de nyid longs sku rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs nas sogs/ de nas dga' rab rdo rjes spyir rgyud gsum 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbang dang gdams pa gsan/ bye brag yang gsang bla na med pa'i gdams pa sogs/ de nas 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis rang bzhin rdzogs pa sogs/snyan rgyud la gnyis yod ni red/ gsum yod par gsungs kyang ma mthong 435

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasungs/ ༈ semasaklong man ngag gi dgongs pa'i khyad par la/ sems sde ni/phyi nang snod bcud thams cad byang chub sems kyi ngo bo dang / rtsal dang / rol ba'i 'char tshul yin pas/ de las gzhan gyur gcod pa la dgongs pa'o/ /gang shar thams cad ma bcos par shes mkhan/ go mkhan/ rig mkhan kho rang gi thog tu bzhag dgos gsungs nas 'gyu ba gnas dag gi dgongs pa skyong ba sems sde ba'i lugasayin/ snang phyogs so/ klong sde ni/ chos can gyi snang ba thams cad chos nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong las gzhan byung 'gog pa'am gcod pa la dgongs pa'o/ /klong po ni/ rnam rtog 'gags pa tsam dang rang bzhin gyi rkyen 'ga' res stong pa'i nyams re 'char ba tsam ma yin bsam brngod dang bral ba gdod ma'i stong gyi dbyings yin/ de ni blta rgyu med/ bsgom rgyu med/ bskyang rgyu ci yang med ces gsungs pa ni klong sde pa'o/ /stong phyogs so/zung 'jug rtsal du bton pa man ngag gi sde ni/ sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bzhig nas/ rig stong zung 'jug ngo sprod de mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus na dwangs sang nge ba'i cha sogs phar bzhag la/ tshur rig stong zung 'jug gi rang sa bzung ba yin gsungs/ ༈ phyag mchan ni smyo shul bla ma lung rtogs la gnang ni red/ des su la'ang ma bstan ni red/ deng sang a bses klu mo dgon na mkhan sprul phyag nas blangs pa yin/ zhal rgyun ni a 'dzom 'brug pa tshang la 'phociorta phul ba de yin/ gsum pa gsang ba man ngag gi sde la skor bzhi las/ zhal rgyun las/ de yang phyi skor du sogsྈ ༈ dngos gzhi 'di dag deng sang mkha / pa sus kyang theg pa 'og ma dang sbyar nas bshad ni red/ de ltar mi nyan ni red/436

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgazhi yin la dngos ma yin pa ni/ rdzogs pa chen po kha cig zhes gsungs pa dang /man ngag gi sde'i nang gses phyi skor la sbyar dgos/ de yang gzhi zhes pa gang yin na ka dag khregs chod kyi lta ba red/ de gtan la dbab pa la sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bzhig pa la/ rtsad bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtags pa gsum/ lta ba dbu ma thal 'gyur las khyad par 'phags tshul rin po che'i gsungs ltar khyad gzhi khyad chos bzhag te dngos gzhi ni/ gzhi drug skyon can du phye nas/ bdun pa skyon med rang gzhung gi gzhi sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa rig stong zung 'jug tu ngo 'phrod pa de yin/ dngos ni gang zhe na lhun grub thod rgal red/ de yang thod rgal gyi sngon 'gro phyi nang gsang gsum gyis 'khor 'das ru shan phye nas/ ma dag 'khor ba'i rgyu kun gzhi sems gsum/ dag pa myang 'das kyi rgyu dbyings ye zung 'jug gi klong du gtan log gam gtan grogs byas nas/ dngos gzhi ye shes rang snang gi dkyil 'khor chen por ngo 'phrod pa yin/ de dag zhing sku pho brang gsum gyi rang bzhin 'du bas na/ngo bo stong gdangs dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma zhing khams/ rang bzhin gsal gdangs thig le stong ba'i sgron ma gzhal yas khang/ thugs rje'i rig gdangs rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sgron ma sku red/ des na lhag mthong thams cad kyi rgyal po 'od gsal rig gdangs rtog med rdo rje lu gu rgyud yin tshul mi pham rin po ches gsungs/ lnga tshan lnga'i ngo sprod 'di gnyis khyad par spu tsam yang med pas na/ kha mi mang bar rang gi snying gi dkyil du tsha ra gyis la nyams su longs zhes gdams pa'o/ /dngos yin la gzhi ma yin zhes pa ni/ man ngag rdzogs pa 437

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥchen po zhes 'bur dod du yod pa 'di ni gsang sko ra dang sbyar dgos 'og ma dang sbyar mi nyan no/ /pra yas pa zhes pra'i lha mo bskyonags pa lta bu zhes gsungs pas snying po med pa'o/ /dngos gzhi gnyis ka min pa ni/ theg pa thun mong zhes pa nyan rang na lta sgom re yod pas de dang mdo phar phyin theg pa nas phyi rgyud dang a nu man chad la go dgos/ mdor na gzhi khregs chod kyi sngon sems kyi khang bu bshig pa sngon du ma song / dngos gzhi sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa rig stong zung 'dug ngo ma 'phrod/ lam thod rgal gyi sngon 'gro zhalor 'das ru shan ma phyed/dngos gzhi rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'bor chen po ngo ma 'phrod pa de nyid yin no/ /dngos dang gzhi gnyis ka yin pa ni/ ka dag khregs chod kyi lta ba sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa rig stong zung 'jug dang de'i rang gdangs 'gag pa med pa lhun grub thod rgal/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor po ngo 'phrod pa de nyid yin no/ /theg pa rim dgu'i lta sgom ni gsang skor man chod bzhag /༈ rdo grub rin po ches/ gsang snying gi phug 'di rdzogs la ma gtug gi bar du dag mnyam mtshan nyid pa mi shes te/ phung lnga dang 'byung lnga'i steng du gnas snang re lung rigs kyi dbyad pas bzhag rung go ba'i nges shes tsam las mi 'char des na 'di ltar bzhag dgos te/ snying kha chos kyi pho brang nas 'char gzhi 'od gsal sad de thog mar sems sems byung mtha' dag 'od gsal gyi rnam ldan du shar dus snang srid dag pa rab 'byams snying dbus na dag mnyam du sad yod pas/ gnas snang mthun pa'i mgo de nas rtsom pa yin/ de ltar mthong dus nyi ma sprin sbubs las grol dus 'od zer thams cad drod ldan du yod pa 438

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdang / rin po che'i gser gling du thon pa lta bu yin no/ /'char gzhi 'od gsal don dam dkor bdun dang / 'char chos sems sems byung thams cad 'od gsal gyi rnam ldan du shar ba lhag pa'i kun rdzob bden pa dang / de gnyis dbyer med pa lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med dam zung 'jug red/ yul thog na gnyen pos sbyang bsgyur mi dgos te/ dung ser por mthong dus mkhris nad dag dus dung gi ser snang dag pa dang / mig skyon rab rib dag dus skra shad dag pa ltar/ ma rig pa dag pas des bskyed pa'i ma dag pa'i yul snang thams cad gnyen po gzhan bsten mi dgos par dag par 'gyur ro zhes gdams so/ /des na ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di thog ma'i gzhi dus na med/mthar phyin 'bras bu'i dus na med pas na/ rnal 'byor ba'i rig pa gshis thog tu phebs pa de'i tshe snang ba thams cad hral hrol khral khrol tsam las med par 'gyur ba 'di nyid 'thul snang 'di dag thog mtha' na med pa'i rtags yin zhes rin po ches gsungs/ don dpyod sngon du song ba'i lag rjes las kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'di dag snang tsam btags tsam zhig las med par rtogs pa'i gang zag la/ 'khrul snang ka nas dag pa'i ye shes ngo 'phrod sla ba yin gsungs so/ /༈ gtso sems mig shes dang 'khor kun 'gro lngas yul sngon po mthong dus/dang po mig shes yul la g.yo ba'i cha de sems pa/ yul la gtod pa'i cha de yid byed/ yul dang dbang po shesapa gsum 'phrad pa'i cha de reg pa/ gzugs yid 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum gang rung nyams su myong ba'i cha de tshor ba/ sngo ser sogs so sor ma 'dres par shes pa 'du shes dang lnga ni kun 'gro lnga yin/439

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā ༈ shes rab rno ba spu gri lta bu myur ba glog zhags lta bu yod na/ sngags rdzogs kyi dgongs pa rgya che ba nam mkha'i pha mtha' las kyang ring ba/ gting zab pa rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' bas kyang zab pa/ de nyid kyi gnad don rtogs nus ni red ma gtogs de min dka' ni red/ bya ba'i yul la yod pa phrin las dang / byed pa po la yod pa thugs rje gnyis ldan dgos ni red gsungs/ ༈ 'dun pas 'gro ba ni mtho ris kyi bde ba la don du gnyer ba dang / zhe sdang gis ni gzhan 'byor la sdang ba dang / gti mug gis las 'bras la meongs pas skyabs su 'gro ba'o// ༈ nyag gter rin po che'i mnyam bzhag gcig gi steng du lta ba'i gnas la sgro 'dogs chod pa thi byas tshang btsal ba lta bu'i spyod pa dang / bla ma'i gdams ngag rnams dran pa ni bung ba lta bu'i spyod pa dang / zhabrul rtog las dben pa ri dwags lta bu'i smra brjod kyi rtog pa'i spros pa bskyung ba lkug pa lta bu ngag gi skyod byed kyi rtsa ba las rlung yin pas rlung dengs su bcug ste gang shar rtogs pa'i sna mi bskyil bar shar grol du gtong ba spyon pa lta bu'i mnyam bzhag gi ye shes de mi 'jigs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pa seng ge lta bu'i gtsang smre gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba khyi phag lta bu'i spyod pa bdun no// ༈ dbyings kyi nang du thig le/ thig le'i nang du lug rgyud g.yo 'gul can yin kyang mi 'bral ba chos nyid mngon sum/ de las gong 'phel du song nas cung zad 'gul 'phrig gi rnam pa can nyams gong 'phel/ dbyings thig sogs lhun grub kyi snang cha g.yo 'gul med pa rig pa tshad phebs yin/ spyir snang ba 440

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ ā 'di dag 'od lnga'i rang bzhin yin yang so skyes la ma dag pa ltar snang / snang ba ltar du zhen/ zhen pa ltar a 'thas/ rig pa tshad phebs dus gnas tshul ji bzhin snang ba yin la/ nang du rig stong zung 'jug du 'brel ba'i rtags phyi ru thig le zung 'brel/ ye shes lnga phyogs tsam rtogs pa'i rtags thig le lnga 'brel/'dir ma dag sa bdun gyi spang bya spangs nas dag pa sa gsum dang skal ba mnyam na'ang don la sa dang po yin pa go dgos/ de dag gi 'phel ba zad nas skye 'jug gnyis la dbang thob/ nang dbyings su thim pa ni chos nyid zad pa'o/ /༈ thog mar dge ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ bar du dge ba thugs yid dbyer med/ tha ma dge ba bsngo ba smon lam gsum tshang dgos/ ༈ rdzogs sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum las/ sems sde'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bo dang / rtsal dang / rol pa gsum po gzhung don yin gsungs/ rtsal las rol pa gang shar thams cad kyi ngo la blta/ ngang la bzhag /ma bcos par bzhag pas rtog tshogs dwangs song ba'i cha bsgoms pas stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba'am stong nyid gnyen por shor ba yin gsungs/ ༈ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gsal ba la/ /yid kyis rtog dbyod ma zhugs pa/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de ka rang //zhes so// ༈ gzhi khregs chod kyi ngo sprod bya ba rig stong zung 'jug sku gsum 'du 'bral med tshul lo/ /thod rgal gyi ngo sprod bya zhing sku pho brang gsum po ngo sprod pa yin gsungs/ ༈ snang cha gang shar mi 'gag par spyod pas na spyod pa'o//༄༅/ /nyams len srang la 'jug tshul/ zhar la nyams len srang du 'jug pa'i tshul gnyis las/ spros bcas sogs/ spros med ni/ nyin mo bya ba dgu 441

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥphrugs su btang nas bzhugs stangs dang mi 'bral bas sku dang thig le'i klong du rig pa brjod med du bzhag /mtshan mo cha gsum du byas pas/ srod la drang srong gi 'dug stangs dang bcas pas/ dbang po gnad du bsdu ba ni/ lte bar padma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i steng du sbyang bya me'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs gru gsum gyi rnam pa de'i dkyil na yi ge a thung dmar po a chen lta bu'i kyang chog /min kyang lugs mang ni red/ de'i 'og tu sbyong byed rlung gi 'khor lo gzhu'i dbyibs can gzhu'i mchog gnyis sna bug gnyis la zug pa chang bzung la yi ge yam̐ gyis mtshan pa zhig bsgom te/ spyi bo'i tshogs zhing 'od du zhu nas phyi'i rlung sems la thim/ phyi'i rlung sna bug gnyis nas ro rkyang gnyis brgyud nas lte 'og gi yo la phog pas las rlung g.yos/ rlud a thung la phog pas a thung las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dbu ma nas yar song nas spyi bo'i haṃ yig mgo thur bstan la phog pas de las thig le'i thigs pas me'i gsos byas shin tu 'bar bar bsam/ des las dang bag chags bsregs/ bde stong gi ngang la bzhag ste steng rlung cung zad mnan/ 'og rlung cung zad bsdam/ bar rlung cung zad 'dzin/ rjes thob dus bza' btung sogs spyod lam thams cad bde stong du shar/ gang snang thams cad bde stong du shar/ sor mo'i rtse tshun chad bde drod kyis lus la skra sen min tshad khyab/ lo gcig tsam la de ltar byas pas khams gso ba'am rgyas nus kyang bsdam ma do na khams 'di nyams kyi bsdad na gang zag de'i rgyud der chang 'gag gi sbang ma lta bu zhig ma gtogs yod ni ma red/ dper na rgun dus gser gyi rgod rgan thang na song ni 'dra 'dra zhig yin ni red/ rtsa lhung bcu gnyis pa 'byung /442

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrtogs pa rgyud la mi skye/ shes rab zhan pa sogs so/ /'di mi nyams ched du 'dod chags kyis dbang gis yin na mi sdug pa sgom/ gdon dbang la bsrung ba sogs/ nad la sman/ rtsa rlung dang 'khrul 'khor sogs kyis bcos/ 'di ltar dmigs pa byas na 'bebs pa sla yang phyis su bsrung ma nus na cang phan thog yod ni ma red/ bsrung nus na lus kyi dwangs ma gso nus te/ snying gar khams dkar dmar gnyis kha bsdebs te gzhi'i ngang na gnas/ ban chung khams ma nyams bdag 'dra yin na de ltar cung zad re bzung bas kyang rtags legs par 'char ba sogs so/ /dgung la seng ge'i 'dug stangs dang bcas shes bya bum par bsdu ba sogs so// ༈ a gtum a thung a shad gsum gyi khyad par/ a gtum a thung a shad ces gsum du 'byung la/ de'i dang po ni nyon mongs 'joms pa ste byed las dang / gnyis pa skye ba med pa ste rang bzhin dang /gsum pa a phyis shul gyi a shad dbyibs gsum las btags pa yin no/ /༄༅/ /dwangs ma lnga sogs bshad pa'i skor/ /dwangs ma lnga ni sha'i dwangs ma dbu ma'i rtsa/ khrag gi dwangs ma a thung me/ rus pa'i dwangs ma thig le haṃ//dbugs kyi dwangs ma srog gi rlung / yid kyi dwangs ma kun gzhi'i sems zhes so/༈ tshe la rnam pa gsum yod de/ 'pho zhing g.yo ba thig le'i tshe/ 'gro dang 'ong ba rlung gi tshe/ 'od gsal 'gyur med gnyug ma'i tshe zhes so// ༈ mngon brjod las/ srung bar byed pa basmung gnas ni/ /kha zas nyung ngur za ba'i ming //bsnyung ba nyung ngu med pa'i ming / zhes so// ༈ khams drug ldan ni/ pags pa/sha/ khrag /rus pa/ rkang / khams dkar dmar dang drug go// ༈ nyon sgrib ni 443

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥchags sdang sogs/ shes sgrib ni bden 'dzin/ shes sgrib phra ba bag chags te/snang sems bag chags sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' na skar mda' rgyug pa'i cha tsam des rig ngo la sgrib pas na sgrib pa'o/ /las sgrib ni rang bzhin gyi sdig pa dang bcas pa'i sdig pa'o// ༈ phrin bcol gyi skabs/ rgyal po ltar spyi la khyab pa dang 1/ blon po ltar phyogs la khyab pa dang 2/ pho nya ba ltar gnad thog tu 'bebs pa dang gsum mo3// ༈drod rlung gnyis la srog ces bshad do// ༈spyir 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po la brgyud pa'i lo rgyus zhig dang / de las brgyud pa'i man ngag cig yod ni red/ de yang chos sku rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa gser gyi nyag thag lta bu la dam sel gyi g.ya' yis ma gos pa zhig yin dgos ni red/ brgyud pa byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa zhig dang / de las brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes kyi gnad ma 'chug pa zhig dgos ni red/ brgyud pa'i man ngag ni smin byed dbang bzhi dang grol byed khregs thod do/ /khregs chod la yang / sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshig pa/dngos gzhi rig pa'i ngo sprad pa dang / rjes nyams len gyi skyong tshul dang gsum mo// /sngon 'gro la rtog pa rtsad bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa'o/ /dngos gzhi de la dad pa can la byin rlabs 'pho ba'i stobs kyi ngo sprod pa ni/ gang zag dad pa can la'o/ /shes rab can la gnas lugs lta ba'i steng nas ngo sprod pa ni/ khang bu bshig pa sngon du song nas dngos gzhi ngo sprod pa'o/ /rig pa rang snang gi blo can lta thog nas sgom pa btsal ba yin no/ /brtson 'grus can la nyams myo nga sgom pa'i steng nas ngo sprod pa ni/444

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsnang ba yul gyi blo can yin pas skom thog nas lta ba btsal ba'o/ /rjes nyams len ni/ rmi lam dang bar do lam 'byer ro// ༈ thod rgal la/ sngon 'gro phyi nang gsang gsum gyi ru shan legs par phye ba dang / dngos gzhi rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du ngo sprod pa dang / cog bzhag bzhi dang / lam snang bzhi mthar phyin par byed pa'o// ༈ skabs dang po rig pa rjen la phud nas ngo sprad/ skabs gnyis pa gnas 'phro gnyis po la gnas cha dwangs cha thon pa nyams zhen dang bral ba/ 'phro cha grol cha thon nas zhakhrul cha bral ba'o/ /de la'ang 'phro gnas yang zer rig pa bzhengs bzhugs yang zer ro/ /zhes so// ༈ 'khor 'das rang grol las/ ngo bo gdod nas dag pa yi/ /ka dag phyogs yan ma rtogs bzhin/ /stong pa logs nas bsgrub pa ni/ /gshis la shor ba zhes su bshad//rang rig zang thal chen po la/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub ma shes pa/ /stong nyid lam nas 'bras bu gzhan/ /btsal ba 'a ma du shor ba'o/ /spang gnyen gnyis las rab 'das pa'i/ /sprul ma/dud zhig ltar ngang gnas las/ /nyams myong steng du gnyen po gzhan/ /bsgom pa gnyen por shor ba'o/ /gsal stong lhun grub ma rtogs bzhin/ /blo dang rnam rtog rjes 'brangs nas/ /rgyu 'bras med pa'i skur 'debs pa/ /'di ni rgyas 'debs stong pa'o/ /ru shan skabs/ ༈ mdo las/mi 'dzin pa rig pa'i ngo bo 'dzin pa thams cad bral ba sbyin pa/ mtha' bzhi brgyad gang du'ang mi gnas pa tshul khrims/ khro sems sogs bral nas yul gang la'ang mi skrag pa bzod pa/ mthar thug pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor sogs gang la'ang mi brtson pa brtson 'grus/ yul dang yul can du 'dzin 445

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥpa'i sems med pa'i mi sems pa bsam gtan/ chos dang chos can la'ang dmigs byed bral ba'i ci yang mi dmigs pa shes rab yin zhes so// ༈ mi mthun phyogs byung na/ spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed pa sems pa dang / sems tsam pas/ sems pa rkyang ba la byas na rgyun med cing bag chags tsam la byas na gtong rgyu byung ba'i gnas skabs su'ang rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir ro/ /sems g.yeng ba la sogs pa'i skabs su sems pa de med na sdom dang sdom pa min pa gnyis ji ltar yod ce na/ sdom pa'i khyad par gyis bag chags ma bcom pa'i phyir sdom dang sdom pa ma yin pa gnyis ka yod do/ /dbu ma pa ni spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa la/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad//ces so/ /nyon mongs pa thams cad chos nyid du sbyang nus pas mi gnod pa dang /snying rje po'i thabs mkhas kyis lam grogs su bsgyur nus pa dang / gsang sngags kyis bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don du rnal 'byor bas nyon mongs pa lam du khyer ba'o// ༈ 'jigs med gling bas/ mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu la dran rig so ma'i dbyings na yod ces so// ༈ dran pa gsum ni rang gsal 'gag med kyi dran pa khregs thod gnyis la dgos/ gzhi gnas rang byung khregs chod kyi dran pa/ snang ba cer 'dzin thod rgal gyi dran pa/ man ngag mdzod na dran pa drug gsungs kyang dran pa gsum la 'dus/ ༈ theg mchog mdzod las/ de yang rnam shes tshogs brgyad ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa yul du mi rtog rnam pa 'char ba'i rgyur gyur ba'i rnam shes rtog med dwangs pa dang / de las mched pa'i sno lnga'i shes pa las/ mig gi rnam shes gzugs 'dzin rtog med/446

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥrna ba'i rnam shes sgra 'dzin rtog med/ sna'i rnam shes dri 'dzin rtog med/ lce'i rnam shes ro 'dzin rtog med/ lus kyi rnam shes reg 'dzin rtog med do/ /de las gzung 'dzin gyi yid shes gnyis te/ yul dang por spyi 'dzin pa yid shes dang / rjes la bye brag 'dzin pa nyon yid de/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'o/ /yid shes 'di gnyis la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod la/ rtog bcas rtog med ci rigs su yod do/ /sgo lnga dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes rtog med yin no/ /zhes so// ༈ mngon sum rtags la ma brten par/ /rjes dpag 'byung ba mi srid do/ /zhesaso/ /mos gus dang yengs med lusapo dang / zhen log sgom gyi rkang ba tshang ba na/ sgom gyi mgo rkang tshang bas 'dod don 'grub ces so/ /thams cad btsas ma thag pa bzhin zhes sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi mched pa'o// ༈ khams gsum du skye ba'i gol sa de dag sku gsum gyi klong du grol dgos gsungs so/ /zhabs drung pas/ tha mal pa shesapa rang 'gags su 'gro ba zhig dgobasagasungs// ༈ phyag chen pas/ gnas 'gyur gnyis po rig pa'i rgyun skyong ni red/ rdzogs chen pas/ 'phro gnas gnyis po dran pa'i rgyun skyong ni red/ 'phro ba de la 'khrul grol gnyis dang / gnas pa de la dwangs snyigs gnyis so/ /khregs chod kyi rig gdangs zer ba de shes pa la zer/thod rgal rig gdangs de lu gu rgyud la zer gsungs so/ / ༈ gter ston bon po drag rtsal gyis gsungs pa'i rdzogs chen gu ru bzhi zhes/ dga' rab rdo rje/shri seng ha/ dzña na su tra/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bzhi'i lo rgyus yod ni gi bzhi pa zer gsungs so// ༈ ru shan skabs/ re 'ga' rang gis zhe sdang gi sgo 447

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥnas bsags pa'i las dang sems can thams cad kyis zhe sdang gi sgo nas bsags pa'i las kyi rnam smin rang la smin/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rang thog tu blangs nas/ sgra skad thams cad ngu 'bod/ tshor ba thams cad sdug bsngal/mthar rig snyong chos sku'i ngang la bzhag pas 'khrul sa 'khrul snang dang bcas pa rang sar dag /yi dwags sogs kun la rigs 'gres/ res 'ga' sems can thams cad pha mar shes nas snying rje rang rgyud pa skye bcug mthar rig stong gi ngang la bzhag /dgra gnyen bar ma gsum la de ltar bya'o/ /res 'ga' snod bcud sku dang ye shes su thag bcad/ tha mar ltar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dbyings su lhod/ res 'ga' gang zag gi bdag dang bdag 'dzin sbyang / res 'ga' chos kyi bdag dang bdag 'dzin sbyang / nam yin yang rig thog tu sa ma zin na rgyug mchong 'ur dir byas pas don med yin gsungs/ /༄7/ /gsung rgyun zin bris/ kun gzhi zhes pa de la gnyis las/ dang po ye don gyi kun gzhi ni bde gshegs snying po de la zer ni red/ de ni zag med kyi chos khams rgya mtsho'i rgyu sku dang ye shes kyi 'char gzhi yin ni red/ gnyis pa ma dag 'khor ba'i kun gzhi ni zag bcas kyi chos gtso sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang 'khor sems byung lnga bcu dang / phra ba kun rtog brgyad cu dang bcas pa'i 'char gzhi yin ni red/ kun gzhi de ni rtog pa snga ma'i bag chags bsogs pa'i snod lta bu dang / rtog pa phyi ma rnams mched pa'i rten byed ni red/kun gzhi'i rnam shes de ni sgo lnga'i rnam shes dang / yid shes dang / nyon yid rnams 'phro ba'i gzhir gyur ba yin/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes de ni yod med 448

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsogs gang gi phyogs su ma lhung ba'i snod bcud rgya chen po la dmigs pa/ yul gyi rnam pa dkar sngo so sor spu ris mi 'byed pa/ kun gzhi rang gi ngo bo la rnam rtog rags pa'i rlabs zhi bas na/ de rlabs dang bral ba'i rgya mtsho lta bu/ de la rtse gcig tu gnas shing goms na gzugs med du skye 'gro/ shes pa rang gi ngo bo rang blo rang la skog tu ma gyur pa'i gsal cha la yang goms shugs che na gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun gyi nang tshan 'phags pa'i sa lnga la mi skye/de man gyi so skye'i sa bcu gnyis yod pa'i khams gong ma dang / de bas goms shugs je chung je chung gi dbang gis gzugs khams 'og ma rnams la 'phen ni red/ kun gzhi de ni rtog pa med pas na dper na nam mkha' sprin bral lta bu de nyid shes pa snga ma'i bag chags 'dzin zhing phyi ma'i rten tu gyur ba'i zhi ba zab pa shin tu phra ba'i rang bzhin can yin pas na shin tu rtog dka' tshul bla ma a 'dzom dang / nyag bla dang / lcags skong rnamasakyi gsung rgyun lta bu red/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ skyes bu gcig la bos pa lta bu'i tshe shes pa dar gcig gang du yang mi rtog par lung ma bstan du gnas pa kun gzhi dang / de las dar gcig snang yul ma 'gags par lam me gsal yang der 'dzin ma zhugs pas gsal la rtog med kyi rnam pa de kun gzhi'i rnam shes yin gsungs/ bla ma nyag blas mi zhig gis khur bo chen po zhig khur nas brgyugs brgyugs nas thang chen po zhig gi dkyil na ngal gso ba'i tshe dka' ba'i shugs kyis rtog pa'i rgyun 'gags te rtog med du yod pa de kun gzhi yin gsungs/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes de las sgo lnga'i rnam shes 'char/ de las yid shes rtog bcas mched/ de las nyon yid 449

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥmached ni red/ yid rtog dang nyon yid rnams ma 'gags bar du sgo lnga cha mnyam yod ni mngon ni ma red/ yid rtog dang nyon yid gnyis rags pa/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes phra ba/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes shin tu phra ba yin gsungs/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes mched 'gag gi rnam pa can dang / sgo lnga'i rnam shes skye 'gag gi rnam pa can dang / yid shes dang nyon yid gnyis gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa can yin/ de yang shes pa rnams mig gi shes pa gzugs 'gag med du gsal ba zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i rnam pa can sgo lnga'i shes pa yin/ shes pa de rnams dus nam 'gags na tha mal ba la gnyid dus dang / dbang po 'chor dus dang / 'chi ba'i dus gsum po de la 'gags ni red/ de min gcig 'gag ni ma red/ de rnams 'gag dus dang po nyon yid 'gag de nas yid rtog /de nas sgo lnga/ de nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'gag dgos ni red/ de'i nang nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes tsam ma 'gags na gnyid pa dang / dbang po 'chor ba dang / shi kha nyan ni ma red/ de rnams 'gags dus sngags phyag rdzogs gang gi lugs yin na gzhi'i 'od gsal dngos shar ni yin gsungs/ de dus rang ngo shes na 'od gsal ngos zin zer ni red/ ngo ma shes na ma rig pa meongs pa gti mug gam lung ma bstan yin/ rnal 'byor pas mnyam bzhag dus 'od gsal shar na/ rmi lam du ngos zin/ de la zin na 'chi kha'i 'od gsal ngo shes nas grol 'gro ba yin gsungs/ gzhan yang nyan thos 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi dus dang /byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi dus dang / sngags lam pas gnyis snang nub pa'i dus dang dus gsum po la tshogs brgyad 'gags ni red/ de min 450

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsgo lnga'i shes pa dang yid rtog nyon yid rnams 'gags song na dge sdig gang rung gi bya ba byed kyi yod ni ma red gsungs/ sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ma gol ba yi sgom pa ni/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams gsal ba'o/ /zhes sgo lnga cha mnyam du yod dus/ gnas cha yod ni red/ gnas cha de la dwangs cha ma thon na dud 'gror skye 'gro ni red/ gsal cha thon nas lhod cha ma thon na rang rgyud la zhen 'dzin gyi 'ching bas bcings yod ni red/ de lhod thabs ni/ res lhod/res grim/ de yang yang spel ma byed bcug na nyi ma bdun brgyad tsam re gi lhod shes 'ong ni red gsungs/ ltod cha thon na shar cha yod ni red/ shar cha la rtog pa rjes mthud med par grol 'gro dgos/ ma grol na 'dod khams la gol bas de rnams dang ma ldan na gol sa gsum yod ni red/ yid shes kyi steng na nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum po la 'dzin zhen yod na khams gsum du gol ni red/sgo lnga las mig shes steng nas gol na gzugs khams su skye 'gro/ de ltar gol sa bdun po de dag sgo lnga cha mnyam du legs par bzhag shes na gol sa chod 'gro gsungs/ yang rtog bcas yid kyi shes pa de'i yul phyi 'dzin dang nang 'dzin gnyis byed ni red/ phyi 'dzin ni 'das pa'i rjes gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun bsu/ da lta'i phyi nang gi mtshan 'dzin byed/ yul gzugs sgra la sogs pa la mtshan mar 'dzin ni red/ nang 'dzin ni mnyam bzhag gi dus na yul bde ba la yul can yid shes des yul bde bar 'dzin/ gsal ba gsal bar 'dzin/mi rtog pa la stong par 'dzin/ nyon yid kyis thun bcad dus mnyam bzhag legs par yong na dga' ba'i 'dod chags/ bying rgod sogs skye dus de la mi 451

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥdaga' ba'i rnam pa zhe sdang sogs skye ba yin/ nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum gang skyes tshe/ yul de la yul can yid kyi shes pas yul de la der 'dzin cing zhen nas yang yang goms pa'i stobs kyis yul dang yul can gnyis med du 'dres te rtog med tshul du gnas ni red gsungs/ da ni 'go na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyis zin/ bar du sgo lnga cham brdal du yod dus gnas cha yod na dwangs cha thon/ gsal cha yod na lhod cha thon/ shar cha yod na grol cha dang ldan na mnyam bzhag gi rgya ma ral gong du/ rjes bsngo ba byas na gegs dang gol sa gang yang yod ni ma red gsungs so/ /de min na cha mnyam legs par ngos ma zin na 'go na snyabs sems/ bar du rtog tshogs dag nas gnas cha yod na dwangs cha/ gsal cha yod na lhod cha/ shar cha yod na grol cha thon/ rjes bsngo ba byas na yag ni red/ sgom chog ni red gsungs/ bkra shis shog/༄tsho/ /dam pa'i chos 'di mi sgrub ni red ma gtogs/ chos 'di bun bun shig shig tu 'char gi yod ni red/ dper na ka bum la sogs pas nga sna nga stong zung 'jug yin/ 'di na yod ces zer ba lta bu zhig dang / sgras kyang nga grags stong brag cha lta bu yin zhes zer ba lta bu yin ni red/ sbyin pas longs spyod zhes zer ni red ni dman pa'i sems can dbul bo mthong na ngas 'di nas byang chub kyi bar du khyod la longs spyod 'dzad med du ster zer ba lta bu zhig dang / dgras 'di nas byang chub kyi bar du khyod la gzugs legs pa ster zer ba ltar ro/ /thugs yid dbyer med bsres nas mnyam par bzhag pa don dam byang chub kyi sems dang / de las sems can gyi khams la brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar ba 452

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥkun rdzob byang chub kyi sems/ kun rdzob byang chub sems la smon 'jug gnyis so// ༈ byung gnas 'gro gsum gyis lta ba snang stong zung 'dug nges pa'i nges shes kyi ngor na/ dgag rtog sgrub rtog yod 'dzin med 'dzin bdag 'dzin chos kyi bdag 'dzin dang gang zag gi bdag 'dzin rnams kyang grol/ yul yod med bdag gnyis sogs kyang 'gag /snang cha spangs ba'i stong rkyang chad pa/ stong cha spangs ba'i rtag pa zhig ga la yin te min no/ /gnas lugs la shin tu nye bas de la 'od gsal zer chog gi red gsungs so// ༈ kun slong med na bshad pa'i tshig la mkhas kyang mi phan/ snying rus zhe bcad byas kyang mi phan/ snying rje med na dge bas gshin rje'i 'jig rten tu skye ba'i rgyu mtshan mi pham rin po ches mkhan tshul dga' la gsungs tshul rdo grub rin po ches gsungs/ dpal sprul gyi bskyed rim lha 'i dka' gnad nang na/ stong nyid la go ba yod pa/ bskyed rim gsal snang thon pa/ bzlas pa'i grangs 'khyol ba/ snying rje med pa rnams gshin rje'i 'jig rten tu skye tshul bla ma de dag gi thugs dgongs gcig red/ bshad bshad kyis thos pa bltas/ 'dug 'dug gis 'bol gdan thed/ bton bton gyis phreng ba zad pa ci tsam byas kyang rang rgyud nyon mongs dang ma bral na dka' ni red/ bka' gdams pa rnams kyis rde'u dkar nag gis bsam pa brtag tshul da dung yang chen po gsum gyi grub mtha' la shes snyam gyi rlom sems byas kyang shin tu dka' ni red/ rang skyon ri bo tsam yang mi mthong / gzhan skyon shig tsam yod kyang mthong / tshul 'chal ri na gnas kyang 'chal/ khrims ldan grong na gnas kyang btsun/ ༈ lus lha mi'i tshogs gral na bzhugs kyang sems 453

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥsangs rgyas kyi sa na bzhugs pa'i gang zag yod gsungs/ ༈ de ltar dgag bya'i snang tshul de nges dgos/ dgag bya gang yin na bdag 'dzin/ bdag 'dzin 'di gtan la ma dbab na phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba ma tshad zhi gnas tsam la yang gegs byed ni red/ g.yeng ba rnam pa drug dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin de zhi gnas gyi mtshan nyid red/ngo bo nyid kyi g.yeng ba ni sgo lnga'i shes pa kha phyir bltas te gzugs sgra sogs yul la g.yos na ting nge 'dzin las ldang bar byed pas ngo bo nyid kyi g.yeng ba/ de'i steng du yid shes mched nas 'das pa la rjes gcod/ ma 'ongs pa la sngon bsu/ da lta'i phyi nang gi yul mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa skye na snyi rol du g.yeng ba nang ting nge 'dzin gyi ro myang nas bde gsal sogs la zhen nas ngang de las 'bral mi phod pa nang gi g.yeng ba/ ngas rtogs yod pa 'di gzhan las 'phags so bsam nas nga rgyal dang bcas te mchog go/ /mtshar ro bsam nas mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i g.yeng ba/ de yod nyan ni ma red/dge bar brtson yang mchog 'dzin rlom sems med ces gsungs ni red ni dge sems 'di nas byang chub kyi bar du 'bral med gong 'phel du 'gro dgos ni red/ngar 'dzin dang bcas pas nga 'khrul nga grol bsam nas 'dzin pa ni gnas ngan len byed kyi g.yeng ba/ rang 'dod yid byed kyi blo yod na yid la byed pa'i g.yeng ba dang drug po bral dgos/ rang don gzhan don sogs ci byas kyang bdag 'dzin 'di 'dul dgos/ bod snga rabs pas 'khor rtsa 'khor lo'i srog shing lta bu de bdag 'dzin la ngos 'dzin ni red/ bod phyi rabs pas chos bdag dang gnyis ka 'khor rtsar bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan nyon sgrib 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'jog 454

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥni gi red gsungs/ ༈ thig le stong sgron ko mo'i chu la rdo bor ba'i rnam pa thig zlum kha dog dmar ser che chung tshon gang ba 'od lnga'i mu khyud can phal cher rtsa dag pa rnams la pad 'dabs kyis bskor ba zhig snang ni red/ de yang lo gcig gnyis re ma bsgoms na de ltar snang ni ma red gsungs/ ༈ kun mkhyen gyis chos nyid mngon sum skabs su stong sgron res snang res mi snang ba'i tshul dang / gong 'phel skabs su stong sgron rgyun du snang bar gsungs so// ༈ phyi'i 'od snang la rtog dpyod zhugs pa sogs kyis lug rgyud dngos por gol ba'i skyon dang / khyad par rlung sems kyis spur ba'i stong gzugs la mchog 'dzin byas pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi dbang gis stong gzugs bdud kyi rnam par shar ba sogs 'byung ba ni lam gyi gnad legs par ma zin pa yin la/ sngon 'gro'i phyi'i ru shan gyi skabs su gzung 'dzin gyi 'ching zhen legs par bzhig thub yod na/ 'dir dngos gzhi'i skabs su rtsol bas ci tsam du gtad kyang mi 'ching ba 'ong bas de 'dra la sngon 'gros dngos gzhi drangs pa zhes zer te/ 'di la lug rgyud dngos por gol ba sogs kyi gol sa gtan nas mi 'byung zhes gsungs so// ༈ tshogs sbyor nang dpe yi ye shes ni mngon sum zer kyang rig pa mngon sum ma yin te/ rig pa'i don spyi mngon sum la go dgos/ tshogs sbyor gyi skabs chos nyid mngon sum yang rtags spyod pas ston/ tshogs sbyor gyi skabs su tshad rmi lam ni/ tshogs lam chos nyid mngon sum skabs su gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal dum re tsam zin pa dang skyon 'bring man chad grol nus/sbyor lam nyams gong 'phel gyi skabs su gnyid kyi sum cha gnyis tsam 'od 456

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥgasal du grol ba dang zin/ de yang grib sogs kyi mi zin pa yang re 'ga' tsam yod/ rkyen ngan ci lta bu yang / rang grol du shigs se lhod de grol nas 'od gsal je gsal du 'gro bas na rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ba 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mthong lam rig pa tshad phebs kyi skabs su don gyi 'od gsal thob tshe yid shes nub te/ yul yul can med par yul chos kyi dbyings de yul can ye shes kyis dngos su mthong zhing yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis thob pa yin/ dbang shes nyer lnga sogs mkhyen pa'i yon tan thob/ sgom lam sa dgu ni chos nyid zad sa'o/ /sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' na 'od gsal mtshan mo'i zla ba lta bu'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa na khams bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag thob pa'i dpe nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'o// ༈ 'phags pa legs nyes kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa'i mdo las/ mir gyur kyang mdog gnag pa gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs khyams dag gi 'og tu bzhag nas dud pas bdugs pa las gyur pa yin no/ /bu dang bu mo med pa ni sngon bya mang po'i phru gu bsad pa las gyur/ mir gyur kyang dbang po mi gsal ba de ni sngon dud 'gro'i gnas nas 'ong ba yin no/ /mdo sde sogs shes kyang gzhan la mi ston par ser sna byed pa de ni shi 'phos nas shing srin dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ku re la dga' zhing gzhan gyi mig zlos ni nee tsor skye bar 'gyur ro/ /nyal ba dang za ba kho na dga' ba de ni phag la skye bar 'gyur ba sogs mang ngo // ༈ klong chen gyis thig le stong sgron kha dog lnga ldan gyi mu khyud rab tu mang pos bskor ba'i dbus su padma 'dab bzhi yod pa gcig 'char ro/ /456

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥg/sdus///rna/ma shes dang ye shes gnyis ka gsal zhing rig pa tsam du mtshungs kyang / yul ji bzhin mi rig par phyin log tu 'dzin pa dang / ji bzhin rig pa gnyis kyi khyad yod la/ gzung 'dzin can gyi rnam shes ldog kyang ye shes mi ldog par shes par bya'o/ /mdor na rnam shes tshogs brgyad las 'das pa'i rig stong gnyug ma spros bral rang byung gi ye shes su thad kar rjen par shar ba ngo sprad par bya'o// ༈ 'gyu ba'i cha ni sems yin la/ /rig pa'i cha la ye shes zer/ /chos kun gdod nas ma grub ces/ /'dzin pa med cing rtog pa med/ /dwangs la 'gags pa med pa yi/ /lta ba'i nyams len bon la'ang yod// shes bya sgyu ma lta bu mā /'dod pa mu stegs byed la yod// ༈ ma yengasatsam du bsgom pa'i tshe/ /dran pa'i rdzi bo ma bor na/ /bsgom med rtogs zhes thos gsungs kyang ma yengs tsam du bsgom pa ni/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa yin par bshad/ /de nyid spang bar ma nus na/ /blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid min/ /ci phyir ma yengs tsam bsgom pa'i/ /blo de mtha' las ma 'das phyir/ /sems kyi dran 'dzin phra mo la/ /dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin yod ces smra/ /dran bya bral ba'i chos nyid la/ /bsgom med ces su grags na yang / /dran pa'i rdzi bo ma bor na/ /de la bsgom med ji ltar rung / /bsgom med ces pa'ang tha snyad tsam/ /don la med pa nyid 'dod na/ /med pa'i mtha' la gnas pa'i phyir/ /lta de yang dag ma yin te/ /spros bral nyid du bzung ba min/ /gal te chad par lta ba de/ /yang dag lta ba nyid yin na/ /mu stegs chad lta'ang grol bar 'gyur/ /de rnams g.yu khog bya 457

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āḥbral gsung yin/༄tsho/ /rnam rtog snga phyi 'gags pa'i bar/ /stong pa'i gnas cha ngo 'phrod na/ /mnyam nyid lta bar 'dod gsungs kyang / /ched 'dzin byas pa'i stong nyams te/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes min// ༈ srid mtha' 'gog pa'i lhag mthong dang / /zhi mtha' 'gog pa'i snying rje gnyis/ /zung 'jug 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /tshul 'di theg pa mchog gi lam/ /chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i/ /rkyen gyis ma bskyed 'dus ma byas/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung / /snying po bstan pa'i mdo sogs nas/ /bde gshegs snying po rgya cher bshad/ /'khor lo bar ma'i mdo rnams su/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum bstan/ /de nyid gsang sngags thun mong las rang bzhin gzhi yi rgyud ces bya/ /thun min sngags kyi rgyud sde las/ /rang byung gdod ma'i ye gzhi zhes// ༈ khregs chod stong pa'i ye shes dang / /thod rgal snang ba'i 'od gsal gnyis/ /zung 'jug chen por bzhugs pa la/ /'phags lam rdzogs pa chen por grags// ༈ snga ma'i rtog pa de 'gags nas/ /phyi ma'i rtog pa yang ma skyes/ /bar gyi stong nyams la zhen nas/ /mi tshe stong zad du ma gtong //༈ dus gsum gzhi rtsa bral la stong zhes brjod/ /sna tshogs 'char gzhi ma 'gags snang ba zhes/ /gnyis med rol la snang stong zung 'jug smra/ /dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i tha snyad kyang / gdod nas spros mtha' bral ba dbyings su brngod/ /ye shes rjen par bzhugs la rig pa zhes/ /ye nas 'du 'bral med la dbyings rig grags/ /snang ṭwāṃsdus ma bu 'phrad pa zhes bya yang / /
sems nyid gdod nas grol ba ma zhes brngod/ /gang snang 'dzin zhen bral ba bu ru grags/ gnyis med rol la ma bu 'phrad par smra/ /g.yu khog bya bral chos dbyings rang grole gsungs/ /dge'o// //

spyi khyab jus 'god pa/ mkhan po shes bya/dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ bkra shis/ padma tshul khrims/mdun shog ḍichar 'god pa/ bkra shis/ padma tshul khrims/g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ āX ṭwāṃ ོོ༵/ ṭwāṃ rnyisnanā rdokā ṭwāṃ sna kādri /gis par du bskrun nas bkram/khreng tu'u ༄'u thung par 'debs 'gan 'khri tshad yod kung sis dpar/2007loldi zla 1 por par swāzhi dang po bsgrigs/ṭwāṃrngo dṛsduoṭwāṃ/ gātrom̐~X rdzur gengs dang po dpar//ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃsnaṭwāoṃ/ra//5/ ḍi ༷༷8—7—5/0()—3389—0
ṅka chukhyehrī tshowaṃrshasgrorteobyelngewarshawawa wa waloXshātram̐kṣetsatt+waṃrdowa waram̐ drowawarsha ༷
